Evaluated across complex household mobile manipulation tasks on Rainbow Y1 and Unitree G1 platforms, TAMPAgent significantly outperforms direct tool-calling agentic baselines, demonstrating that integrating TAMP constraint satisfaction into agentic planning loops is essential for unstructured, partially observable environments.
summary_zh: 开放式世界中的机器人移动操作需要在仅具备部分信息的环境中执行任务。尽管近年来大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）代理展现出强大的开放式推理能力，但现有的依赖直接工具调用的架构在几何不确定性面前表现不足，因而局限于完全可观测的桌面环境。相比之下，任务与运动规划（TAMP）系统能够在部分可观测条件下解决长时域任务，但计算成本高且需要封闭世界假设。我们提出了\textbf{TAMPAgent}，一种将LVLM的推理能力与TAMP系统的结构化约束满足相统一的代理规划框架。我们赋予LVLM代理一个基于置信空间（belief-space）的规划模型，该模型在可扩展的感知、规划与控制工具API上运行。代理首先制定一个由参数化观测和执行动作组成的部分任务计划，随后通过经典搜索算法将其补全。在提取计划的几何约束后，代理利用其工具API绑定有效的参数值，以满足可行性要求并生成可执行的运动计划。在执行过程中，代理持续更新其置信历史记录，并通过交错执行观测与操作动作来重复这一闭环过程。在Rainbow Y1和Unitree G1平台上进行的复杂家庭移动操作任务评估中，TAMPAgent显著优于直接工具调用的代理基线，表明将TAMP约束满足集成到代理规划闭环中对于非结构化、部分可观测环境至关重要。
tldr: This paper introduces TAMPAgent, an agentic planning framework that integrates LVLMs with Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) for mobile manipulation under partial observability, significantly outperforming direct tool-calling baselines on real robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出TAMPAgent，一种将大视觉语言模型与任务与运动规划（TAMP）相结合的智能体规划框架，用于部分可观测环境下的移动操作，在真实机器人上显著优于直接工具调用的基线方法。

title: Human-to-Robot Transfer via Bridging Representation and Action Space in VLAs
summary: Pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies provide a strong starting point for deployment, but adapting them to a target robot and environment still requires costly embodiment-specific demonstrations. Human demonstrations are far easier to collect, yet directly leveraging them is challenging due to the substantial human-robot embodiment gap, particularly when the underlying VLA has been pretrained primarily on robot data. We introduce H2RB (Human-To-Robot Bridge), a human-robot co-training framework for adapting pretrained VLA policies from unpaired human and robot demonstrations. H2RB bridges the embodiment gap at both interfaces: geometry-anchored alignment grounds human and robot observations in a compatible representation, while a decoupled-decoder tokenizer shares action latents without forcing both domains through a single action mapping. This design allows human demonstrations to provide useful behavioral supervision while retaining the rich visual, semantic, and control priors of the pretrained VLA. Across real-world tasks, H2RB substantially improves object transfer performance from 8.0 to 51.8 and enables skill transfer to score 62.7, in settings where co-train baselines totally fail to transfer human-demonstrated skills. The benefit also persists under object-placement shifts, improving out-of-distribution transfer from 6.0 to 45.3. H2RB suggests a way for human demonstrations to serve as a scalable supervision source for adapting pretrained robotic policies, reducing the dependence on costly target-robot data collection.
summary_zh: 预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略为部署提供了强大的起点，但将其适配到目标机器人和环境仍需大量昂贵的具身特定示范数据。人类示范数据的采集则容易得多，然而由于人机之间存在显著的具身差异，直接利用这些数据颇具挑战，尤其是当底层VLA主要基于机器人数据进行预训练时。我们提出H2RB（Human-To-Robot Bridge），一种用于从非配对的人类和机器人示范中适配预训练VLA策略的人机协同训练框架。H2RB在两端接口处弥合了具身差异：几何锚定对齐将人类和机器人的观测映射到兼容的表示空间中，而解耦解码器分词器则共享动作潜在表征，无需强制两个域通过单一动作映射。这种设计使得人类示范能够提供有效的行为监督，同时保留预训练VLA丰富的视觉、语义和控制先验。在真实世界任务中，H2RB将物体迁移性能从8.0大幅提升至51.8，并在协同训练基线完全无法迁移人类示范技能的场景下实现技能迁移得分62.7。该优势在物体放置位置偏移的情况下依然保持，将分布外迁移性能从6.0提升至45.3。H2RB表明，人类示范可以作为适配预训练机器人策略的可扩展监督来源，从而减少对昂贵的目标机器人数据采集的依赖。
tldr: H2RB introduces a human-robot co-training framework that adapts pretrained VLA policies using unpaired human and robot demonstrations by aligning observations via geometry-anchored alignment and sharing action latents through a decoupled-decoder tokenizer, significantly improving object transfer and skill transfer on real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: H2RB 提出了一种人机协同训练框架，通过几何锚定对齐观测和分离解码器分词器共享动作潜在表示，利用不成对的人机演示来适配预训练 VLA 策略，在真实任务中显著提升了物体迁移和技能迁移性能。

title: WayTrace: A Map-to-Language-to-Trace Hierarchy for Embodied Urban Navigation
summary: Web services provide walking directions for nearly every city, but following them reliably over long routes remains challenging for autonomous robots. Point-goal navigation policies rely heavily on accurate GNSS, while most vision-language navigation models struggle to execute even short instructions outdoors. We present WayTrace, a hierarchical system that connects web-map directions to robot motion through language. An off-the-shelf orchestrator vision-language model reads the turn-by-turn directions, a satellite map and recent camera images, and issues one atomic language command at a time, such as "cross the road to the left". An onboard trace predictor, trained on over one million automatically labelled samples from street-level images, draws the path for this command in the image, and a reinforcement learning policy tracks it. In long-range simulated missions, WayTrace remains robust to GNSS noise and rarely leaves crosswalks or sidewalks, while point-goal baselines degrade sharply with about ten times more violations. Deployed on a wheeled-legged robot, WayTrace completes real-world missions of up to 1.37 km at about 1.1 m/s through a busy city centre, rural trails and a university campus, handling crosswalks, staircases and construction sites. Project page: https://way-trace.github.io
summary_zh: Web服务几乎为每个城市都提供了步行导航路线，但自主机器人在长距离路线上可靠地遵循这些路线仍然是一项挑战。点目标导航策略严重依赖精确的GNSS，而大多数视觉-语言导航模型即使在户外执行简短指令时也表现不佳。我们提出了WayTrace，一个通过语言将网络地图导航与机器人运动连接起来的分层系统。一个现成的编排视觉-语言模型读取逐向导航指令、卫星地图和最近的摄像头图像，并一次发出一个原子语言命令，例如“向左过马路”。一个车载轨迹预测器，在超过一百万个从街景图像自动标注的样本上训练，在图像中绘制该命令的路径，并由一个强化学习策略跟踪该路径。在远程模拟任务中，WayTrace对GNSS噪声保持鲁棒性，很少偏离人行横道或人行道，而点目标基线方法则性能急剧下降，违规次数约为其十倍。部署在轮腿式机器人上，WayTrace在繁忙的市中心、乡村小径和大学校园中完成了长达1.37公里的真实世界任务，速度约为1.1米/秒，能够应对人行横道、楼梯和建筑工地。项目页面：https://way-trace.github.io
tldr: WayTrace is a hierarchical system for embodied urban navigation that uses a vision-language model to convert web-map directions into atomic language commands, a trace predictor to generate visual paths, and a reinforcement learning policy to track them, achieving robust long-range navigation in simulations and real-world deployments.
tldr_zh: WayTrace 是一个用于具身城市导航的层级系统，利用视觉语言模型将网络地图方向转换为原子语言指令，通过轨迹预测器生成视觉路径，并由强化学习策略进行跟踪，在仿真和真实世界中实现了鲁棒的远距离导航。

title: LoopQ: Fair, Closed-Loop Evaluation of Quantized Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) for vision-language-action (VLA) models promises smaller and faster VLA deployments. However, when analyzing existing VLA quantization works, we realised that it is hard to reason about the performance of the suggested quantization method compared to existing, similar, or in many cases, simpler PTQ methods. We present LoopQ, a closed-loop benchmark that compares multiple quantization policies on the same checkpoint, layers and engine, varying only the method and the kernels. We evaluate RTN, AWQ, GPTQ, ActQuant and QuantVLA on four VLAs with more than 180,000 episodes of LIBERO and LIBERO-plus, compare against QVLA's reported results on the same layers, and benchmark whether the four public VLA-quantization releases can be reproduced. We benchmark the methods on an NVIDIA H100, an L4, and a Jetson AGX Thor. Our results show that while quantization reliably saves memory, 2-3x for real low-bit models, VLA-specific PTQ methods underperform compared to simpler generic baselines. At 4 bits, RTN, AWQ and GPTQ match or exceed ActQuant and QuantVLA, plain RTN matches the calibrated methods, and plain AWQ matches the success QVLA reports for itself. Standard LIBERO hides the losses that do exist: configurations with no significant LIBERO loss lose 1.5-4.3 points under paired LIBERO-plus perturbations. Speed is a weaker story. At batch 1 on the H100, no quantized pi0.5 or OpenVLA-OFT configuration is faster than its 16-bit model (1.06-1.58x slower on library kernels); only the L4 with int8 kernels gains (4-14%), the Thor is slower on every 4-bit configuration, and the engine alone changes latency by 2.1x. Profiling explains why: pi0.5's quantized backbone is compute-bound, while its memory-bound action expert, 63% of GPU time and 13% of the parameters, stays in 16 bits.
summary_zh: 后训练量化（PTQ）在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的应用有望实现更小、更快的VLA部署。然而，在分析现有VLA量化工作时，我们发现，与已有的、类似的，或在许多情况下更简单的PTQ方法相比，很难评估所提出的量化方法的性能。我们提出了LoopQ，一个闭环基准测试，在相同的检查点、层和引擎上比较多种量化策略，仅改变方法和内核。我们在包含超过180，000条LIBERO和LIBERO-plus轨迹的四个VLA上评估了RTN、AWQ、GPTQ、ActQuant和QuantVLA，并与QVLA在同一层上报告的结果进行了比较，同时验证了四个公开的VLA量化发布是否可复现。我们在NVIDIA H100、L4和Jetson AGX Thor上对这些方法进行了基准测试。我们的结果表明，虽然量化能够可靠地节省内存（对于真正的低比特模型可节省2-3倍），但VLA特定的PTQ方法在性能上不如更简单的通用基线。在4比特下，RTN、AWQ和GPTQ达到或超过了ActQuant和QuantVLA，普通RTN与经过校准的方法表现相当，而普通AWQ则达到了QVLA报告的成功水平。标准LIBERO掩盖了实际存在的损失：在配对LIBERO-plus扰动下，没有显著LIBERO损失的配置损失了1.5-4.3个百分点。速度方面的结论则较弱。在H100上的批大小为1时，没有量化的pi0.5或OpenVLA-OFT配置比其16位模型更快（在库内核上慢1.06-1.58倍）；只有L4上的int8内核有增益（4-14%），Thor在每种4位配置下都更慢，且仅引擎变化就会导致延迟差异达2.1倍。性能分析解释了原因：pi0.5的量化骨干网络是计算受限的，而其内存受限的动作专家（占GPU时间的63%，参数量的13%）仍保持在16位。
tldr: LoopQ is a closed-loop benchmark for evaluating PTQ methods on VLA models, finding that generic quantization baselines outperform VLA-specific methods, and that standard LIBERO benchmarks mask performance losses revealed by LIBERO-plus perturbations.
tldr_zh: LoopQ 是一个用于评估 VLA 模型后训练量化方法的闭环基准，发现通用量化基线优于 VLA 专用方法，且标准 LIBERO 基准掩盖了 LIBERO-plus 扰动所揭示的性能损失。

title: CRONOS: Benchmarking Non-Episodic Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is promising for adapting robot policies to unstructured real-world environments. However, standard RL pipelines rely on episodic training with frequent scene resets, which is impractical for real-world deployment due to the need for substantial human intervention. While prior work has studied non-episodic RL in relatively small policies trained from scratch, its behavior when fine-tuning modern large-scale pre-trained vision-language-action (VLA) models remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce CRONOS, a simulation benchmark for RL fine-tuning of VLAs under non-episodic scene resets. CRONOS leverages high-fidelity physics simulators and adopts shared-scene multi-task settings. Using CRONOS, we show that naively fine-tuning pre-trained policies fails in non-episodic settings due to shifts in object configurations and end-effector poses; however, these challenges can be mitigated through targeted reset allocation and by addressing biases in pre-trained models. Moreover, we find that non-episodic training enhances long-horizon manipulation and improves generalization to previously unseen object configurations and task sequences. Project page: https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/cronos/
summary_zh: 强化学习在将机器人策略适应非结构化真实世界环境方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，标准强化学习流程依赖于频繁场景重置的分幕式训练，这在真实世界部署中因需要大量人工干预而难以实际应用。尽管已有研究在从零训练的小规模策略中探索了非分幕式强化学习，但其在微调现代大规模预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型时的行为仍缺乏充分研究。为此，本文提出CRONOS——一个用于非分幕式场景重置下VLA模型强化学习微调的仿真基准。CRONOS利用高保真物理仿真器，并采用共享场景多任务设置。基于CRONOS，我们发现直接微调预训练策略在非分幕式设置中会因物体构型与末端执行器位姿的变化而失败；然而，通过有针对性的重置分配及修正预训练模型中的偏差，这些挑战可以得到缓解。此外，我们发现非分幕式训练能够增强长时程操作能力，并提升对未见物体构型与任务序列的泛化性能。项目主页：https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/cronos/
tldr: CRONOS is a simulation benchmark for non-episodic RL fine-tuning of vision-language-action (VLA) models in robotic manipulation, revealing challenges and solutions for long-horizon tasks and generalization.
tldr_zh: CRONOS 是一个用于机器人操作中非情节强化学习微调视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的仿真基准，揭示了长时程任务和泛化中的挑战及解决方案。

title: Trajectory Evaluation via Rollout-Free World Model for End-to-end Autonomous Driving
summary: Although existing candidate trajectory evaluators have substantially improved end-to-end planning accuracy, their underlying mechanism remains suboptimal. Model-based evaluators typically make scoring future-aware by explicitly predicting candidate-conditioned future states over the planning horizon, which we term rollout. However, rollout incurs high inference cost and accumulates prediction errors. We argue that planning does not require reconstructing a full future scene for each candidate, but only future-relevant information for reliable comparison. We therefore propose RFWorld, a Rollout-Free World model for end-to-end trajectory evaluation. RFWorld constructs a shared scene memory and shapes it into a future-readable representation via lightweight training-time temporal readout with semantic supervision, keeping training overhead low. At inference time, candidate trajectories directly query the shared memory via sparse spatial readout for scoring, reducing computation by roughly the planning horizon times the number of candidate trajectories, while avoiding recursive rollout errors. Experiments on NAVSIM and Bench2Drive show that RFWorld learns a more planning-aligned world representation and achieves state-of-the-art performance.
summary_zh: 虽然现有的候选轨迹评估器已显著提升了端到端规划精度，但其底层机制仍存在次优问题。基于模型的评估器通常通过在规划时域内显式预测候选条件化的未来状态来使评分具备前瞻性，我们称之为展开（rollout）。然而，展开不仅带来高昂的推理成本，还会累积预测误差。我们认为，规划并不需要为每个候选重构完整的未来场景，而只需提取与未来相关的信息以进行可靠比较。为此，我们提出RFWorld，一种无展开（Rollout-Free）的端到端轨迹评估世界模型。RFWorld构建共享场景记忆，并通过轻量级训练时的时间读取与语义监督将其塑造为可读的未来表示，从而保持较低的训练开销。在推理阶段，候选轨迹通过稀疏空间读取直接查询共享记忆以进行评分，计算量约减少为规划时域乘以候选轨迹数量的规模，同时避免了递归展开误差。在NAVSIM和Bench2Drive上的实验表明，RFWorld学习到更贴合规划的世界表示，并取得了最先进的性能。
tldr: This paper introduces RFWorld, a rollout-free world model for end-to-end autonomous driving that evaluates candidate trajectories by directly querying a shared scene memory, reducing inference cost and avoiding recursive prediction errors while achieving state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM and Bench2Drive.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了RFWorld，一种用于端到端自动驾驶的无回滚世界模型，通过直接查询共享场景记忆来评估候选轨迹，降低了推理成本并避免了递归预测误差，在NAVSIM和Bench2Drive上取得了最先进的性能。

title: Do Agentic Policies Need to Look at Every Step? Geometric Abstraction for Reasoning and Action
summary: Recent multimodal language models can reason directly about robot scenes, but it is unclear whether they need to repeatedly reinterpret raw visual observations at every step of an interaction. We propose shifting routine spatial reasoning from images to text and symbols through a 3D geometric abstraction that is refreshed locally from observations and read directly by the language models. Specifically, our interface represents scene geometry via typed, evidence-aware symbolic references to object parts, grounds them from calibrated RGB-D, and returns compact textual checkpoints with metric residuals after each action. Symbolic task structure can thus be reused across decisions while metric values are rebound to the current scene, with direct visual reasoning invoked only on demand. Across offline policy synthesis and continuous online execution, reasoning over grounded text and symbols improves multi-step manipulation completion while substantially reducing repeated multimodal queries, positioning explicit geometric state as an effective substrate for agentic robot policies.
summary_zh: 近期出现的多模态语言模型能够直接对机器人场景进行推理，但其是否需要在交互的每一步中反复重新解读原始视觉观察数据，目前尚不明确。我们提出将常规空间推理从图像转向文本与符号，通过一种从观测中局部刷新、并由语言模型直接读取的三维几何抽象来实现。具体而言，我们的接口通过类型化、具备证据感知的符号引用表示对象部件的场景几何结构，基于校准后的RGB-D数据对其进行 grounding，并在每次动作后返回带有度量残差的紧凑文本检查点。由此，符号任务结构可在多次决策间复用，而度量值则重新绑定至当前场景，仅在需要时按需调用直接视觉推理。在离线策略合成与连续在线执行过程中，基于已 grounding 的文本与符号进行推理，能够提升多步操作任务的完成度，同时显著减少重复的多模态查询次数，从而将显式几何状态确立为智能体化机器人策略的有效基础。
tldr: This paper proposes using a 3D geometric abstraction with symbolic references and metric residuals instead of raw images for robot policies, improving multi-step manipulation while reducing multimodal queries.
tldr_zh: 本文提出使用带有符号引用和度量残差的3D几何抽象代替原始图像用于机器人策略，在减少多模态查询的同时提升多步操作性能。

title: DRAP: Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity for Continual Learning in Physical AI
summary: Continual learning in physical AI differs from conventional continual learning because small per-step policy errors can accumulate over a trajectory. Each deviation may move the agent outside the training distribution, increase subsequent prediction errors, and ultimately cause closed-loop task failure. This work introduces Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity (DRAP), a replay-free method that estimates the historical importance of adaptable model tensors from sample-level action gradients weighted by local trajectory-amplification risk. A ridge-regularized local linear model is fitted to expert state-action transitions, and the largest singular value of its state-transition matrix provides a policy-independent, Lyapunov-inspired estimate of one-step perturbation amplification. After each task, risk-weighted squared gradients are accumulated in a tensor-level importance memory. During subsequent tasks, DRAP uses normalized cumulative importance to scale the effective AdamW learning rate of each tensor, immediately reducing the plasticity of components that supported previous behavior at dynamically sensitive trajectory points. We instantiate DRAP on a fixed KappaTune-selected subnetwork of OpenVLA and evaluate replay-free sequential adaptation across the LIBERO Spatial, Object, and Goal suites. Compared with standard AdamW fine-tuning and EWC, the results show substantially improved retention of previously learned behaviors while preserving strong new-suite acquisition.
summary_zh: 物理AI中的持续学习不同于传统持续学习，因为每一步较小的策略误差可能会在轨迹中累积。每次偏差都可能使智能体偏离训练分布，增加后续预测误差，并最终导致闭环任务失败。本工作引入了动力学风险自适应可塑性（DRAP），这是一种无需回放的方法，通过由局部轨迹放大风险加权的样本级动作梯度来估计可调整模型张量的历史重要性。该方法将岭正则化的局部线性模型拟合到专家状态-动作转换上，其状态转换矩阵的最大奇异值提供了与策略无关的、受李雅普诺夫启发的单步扰动放大估计。在每个任务之后，风险加权的平方梯度累积在张量级重要性记忆中。在后续任务中，DRAP使用归一化的累积重要性来缩放每个张量的有效AdamW学习率，从而立即降低在动态敏感轨迹点上支持先前行为的组件的可塑性。我们在固定的KappaTune选择的OpenVLA子网络上实例化DRAP，并评估跨LIBERO空间、物体和目标套件的无回放顺序适应性能。与标准AdamW微调和EWC相比，结果表明在保持新套件强获取能力的同时，对先前学习行为的保留有了显著提升。
tldr: This paper introduces DRAP, a replay-free continual learning method for physical AI that uses risk-weighted importance to adapt tensor-level learning rates, improving retention in sequential OpenVLA fine-tuning on LIBERO suites by limiting perturbation amplification.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 DRAP，一种无回放的物理AI持续学习方法，通过风险加权重要性调整张量级学习率，抑制扰动放大，在 LIBERO 套件上连续微调 OpenVLA 时显著提升旧任务保留能力。

title: HiLo-WAM: Decoupling Long-Horizon Task Evolution and Local Dynamics in World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robotic manipulation by jointly modeling visual dynamics and robot actions. However, most existing WAMs model dense short-horizon visual dynamics, capturing local interactions but providing limited long-range task context. Extending prediction horizons increases uncertainty and computation while entangling task-level evolution with fine-grained local dynamics, obscuring their dependencies and distinct roles in action generation. We propose HiLo-WAM, which decouples long-horizon task evolution from local visual dynamics while jointly modeling their interaction with robot actions. A sparse long-horizon visual stream captures historical task context and future evolution, while a dense local dynamics visual stream models short-horizon robot-object interactions. The two streams operate at different temporal scales within a unified dual-DiT architecture and guide actions through structured cross-stream attention. Progressive inference further reduces unnecessary computation through stream-wise partial denoising, joint denoising, and dynamic skipping. Experiments demonstrate strong long-horizon manipulation performance: HiLo-WAM achieves a 93.70% average success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 and a 17.43 progress score on RoboDojo long-horizon tasks, with robust in-domain and OOD performance on the Fourier GR-3 robot. Ablations confirm the complementary contributions of long-horizon task evolution and local interaction dynamics, while temporal-scale analyses highlight the importance of balancing temporal coverage and resolution. Progressive inference further achieves a 2.93x speedup while improving performance.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过联合建模视觉动态与机器人动作来提升机器人操作能力。然而，现有的大多数WAMs对密集的短时域视觉动态进行建模，虽然能够捕捉局部交互，但提供的长程任务上下文有限。延长预测时域会增加不确定性和计算开销，同时将任务层面的演化与细粒度的局部动态纠缠在一起，从而模糊了它们在动作生成中的依赖关系及各自角色。我们提出HiLo-WAM，将长时域任务演化与局部视觉动态解耦，同时联合建模它们与机器人动作之间的交互。一条稀疏的长时域视觉流捕捉历史任务上下文与未来演化，而一条密集的局部动态视觉流则建模短时域的机器人-物体交互。两条流在统一的双DiT架构中以不同的时间尺度运行，并通过结构化的跨流注意力引导动作生成。渐进式推理通过流级部分去噪、联合去噪和动态跳步进一步减少不必要的计算。实验证明了强大的长时域操作性能：HiLo-WAM在RoboTwin 2.0上达到93.70%的平均成功率，在RoboDojo长时域任务上取得17.43的进度分数，并在Fourier GR-3机器人上展现出稳健的域内和域外性能。消融实验证实了长时域任务演化与局部交互动态的互补贡献，而时间尺度分析则强调了平衡时间覆盖范围与分辨率的重要性。渐进式推理进一步实现了2.93倍的加速，同时提升了性能。
tldr: HiLo-WAM decouples long-horizon task evolution from local visual dynamics in World Action Models using a dual-DiT architecture, improving long-horizon robotic manipulation performance and computational efficiency.
tldr_zh: HiLo-WAM 通过双DiT架构解耦了世界动作模型中的长期任务演化和局部视觉动态，提升了长时程机器人操作性能与计算效率。

title: LLMs as MDP Designers: A Dependency-Aware Agentic Framework for Automated Robot Policy Generation
summary: We investigate the automated generation of executable robot reinforcement learning (RL) policies from natural-language task descriptions. Rather than using large language models (LLMs) as execution-time decision makers, we use them as designers that construct RL pipelines before deployment, including Markov decision process (MDP) formulation and simulator implementation. We identify a phase-wise structure in this problem: MDP formulation is dependency-structured and sequential, whereas simulator implementation becomes modular once the formulation is fixed. Based on this structure, we propose ARPG, a dependency-aware agentic framework that performs sequential MDP modeling, localized verification and correction, and simulator-structured implementation while externalizing intermediate artifacts. ARPG targets a key failure mode of automated policy generation: executable code may still yield non-learnable policies when state, action, reward, and termination artifacts are not semantically aligned. Experiments in Isaac Sim show that ARPG improves modeling correctness, environment executability, and policy-generation success compared with monolithic LLM baselines and off-the-shelf agentic systems. Additional demonstrations on custom robotics, standard RL, and engineering-domain MDPs further suggest that the same modeling pipeline can be reused beyond the main benchmark suite.
summary_zh: 我们研究了从自然语言任务描述中自动生成可执行的机器人强化学习（RL）策略的问题。我们并未将大型语言模型（LLMs）用作执行时的决策者，而是将其用作设计者，在部署前构建RL流水线，包括马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的制定与仿真器实现。我们在此问题中识别出一种分阶段的结构：MDP制定具有依赖关系结构且是顺序性的，而一旦制定完成，仿真器实现则变得模块化。基于这一结构，我们提出了ARPG，一种依赖感知的智能体框架，该框架执行顺序式MDP建模、局部验证与修正，以及面向仿真器结构的实现，同时将中间产物外部化。ARPG针对自动策略生成中的一个关键失败模式：当状态、动作、奖励和终止条件等组件在语义上不一致时，即使代码可执行，所产生的策略也可能无法学习。在Isaac Sim中的实验表明，与整体式LLM基线及现成的智能体系统相比，ARPG在建模正确性、环境可执行性和策略生成成功率方面均有提升。此外，在定制机器人、标准RL及工程领域MDP上的额外演示进一步表明，相同的建模流水线可在主基准套件之外复用。
tldr: This paper introduces ARPG, a dependency-aware agentic framework that uses LLMs to automate the generation of executable robot RL policies from natural-language task descriptions, improving MDP formulation and simulator implementation in Isaac Sim.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了ARPG，一种依赖感知的智能体框架，利用LLM从自然语言任务描述中自动生成可执行的机器人强化学习策略，在Isaac Sim中提高了MDP制定和模拟器实现的效率。

title: Caging Vision-Language Navigation for Legged Robots via Barrier-Certified Safety Architecture
summary: By harnessing the inherent commonsense capabilities of pretrained Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs), current Vision-Language Action(VLA) models for legged robots excel at interpreting language-based navigation commands but lack the physical grounding and explicit safety assurance required for real-world operation. Therefore, this paper aims to cage Legged-Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) through a safety architecture that provides physical grounding and ensures navigation safety. The key idea is not to abandon the powerful capabilities of end-to-end VLA planning, but rather to augment and cage them. In particular, we integrate a high-level VLA planner with a low-level physical-grounding layer that leverages efficient state estimation, in-situ 3D spatial perception, and an Signed Distance Field (SDF) representation to generate executable trajectories. We provide a navigation planner with provable collision-avoidance guarantees under the stated assumptions by combining a low-dimensional Bezier-parameterized MPPI planner with Discrete Exponential Barrier Function (dEBF) constraints. The proposed Legged-VLN system is modular, making it compatible with various VLM/VLA models and agnostic to the robot platform. The proposed system is validated with extensive real-world experiments on humanoid and quadrupedal robots, demonstrating versatile, efficient, and safe vision-language driven navigation capabilities.
summary_zh: 通过利用预训练大语言模型（LLMs）和视觉-语言模型（VLMs）固有的常识能力，当前用于腿式机器人的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在解释基于语言的导航指令方面表现出色，但缺乏实际物理约束和明确的安全保障，难以满足现实世界操作需求。因此，本文旨在通过一种提供物理约束并确保导航安全的安全架构，对腿式视觉-语言导航（VLN）进行笼络约束。核心思想并非放弃端到端VLA规划的强大能力，而是对其进行增强和约束。具体而言，我们将高层VLA规划器与低层物理约束层相结合，后者利用高效状态估计、原位三维空间感知和符号距离场（SDF）表示来生成可执行轨迹。通过将低维贝塞尔参数化MPPI规划器与离散指数障碍函数（dEBF）约束相结合，我们为导航规划器提供了在所述假设下具有可证明的避碰保证。所提出的腿式VLN系统采用模块化设计，兼容多种VLM/VLA模型，且与机器人平台无关。该系统在仿人机器人和四足机器人上进行了广泛的实际实验验证，展示了多才多艺、高效且安全的视觉-语言驱动导航能力。
tldr: This paper presents a modular safety architecture that combines a high-level VLA planner with low-level physical grounding and barrier-certified constraints for safe vision-language navigation of legged robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种模块化安全架构，将高层VLA规划器与低层物理接地和屏障认证约束相结合，实现腿式机器人的安全视觉语言导航。

title: Safeguarding Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Connected and Automated Vehicles with Recursively Feasible Control Barrier Functions
summary: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) shows promise in coordinating connected and automated vehicles but offers no safety guarantee. Although Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) can add this guarantee, their optimization problem can become infeasible in practice due to control bounds. Moreover, they often overapproximate vehicle and road geometry, which makes them conservative. This paper proposes the Backup-Horizon CBF (BH-CBF), which evaluates safety along a horizon until all vehicles stop. BH-CBF is recursively feasible under control bounds, and it considers the exact vehicle and road geometry. Based on BH-CBF, we derive a fully decentralized safety filter that only needs a single broadcast of vehicle states and routes per step and stays real-time in dense traffic. We use BH-CBF to safeguard a MARL policy over its life cycle: as a reward during pre-training, as a run-time filter at deployment, and as a filter in the training loop that keeps fine-tuning on unseen maps collision-free. In simulations on real-world maps of a roundabout and an intersection, BH-CBF avoids all collisions of unsafe MARL policies and keeps its safety guarantee at every step. Existing filters either collide, lose the guarantee, or fall back to full braking far more often. In recorded roundabout traffic with 1264 human-driven vehicles over 115 km, our safeguarded policies shorten the median travel time by 14% compared with the human drivers, without any collision.
summary_zh: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）在协调网联自动驾驶车辆方面展现出潜力，但无法提供安全保障。尽管控制障碍函数（CBF）能够增加这一保障，但在实际应用中，由于控制约束的存在，其优化问题可能变得不可行。此外，它们常常过度近似车辆和道路几何形状，导致保守性过强。本文提出了备份时域控制障碍函数（BH-CBF），该函数在直至所有车辆停止的时域内评估安全性。BH-CBF在控制约束下具有递归可行性，并考虑精确的车辆和道路几何形状。基于BH-CBF，我们推导出一种完全分散的安全滤波器，该滤波器仅需每步广播一次车辆状态和路线，即可在密集交通中保持实时性。我们使用BH-CBF在其整个生命周期内保障MARL策略的安全：在预训练阶段作为奖励，在部署阶段作为运行时滤波器，并在训练循环中作为滤波器，确保在未见地图上的微调过程无碰撞。在真实世界地图的环岛和交叉口仿真中，BH-CBF避免了所有不安全MARL策略的碰撞，并在每一步保持其安全保证。现有滤波器要么发生碰撞，要么丧失保证，要么远更频繁地退化为完全制动。在记录的包含1264辆人类驾驶车辆、总行驶里程115公里的环岛交通中，我们的受保障策略相比人类驾驶员将中位旅行时间缩短了14%，且未发生任何碰撞。
tldr: This paper proposes Backup-Horizon Control Barrier Functions (BH-CBF) to provide recursive feasibility and exact geometry for safe MARL coordination of connected and automated vehicles, validating collision-free performance in dense real-world roundabout and intersection simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出备份地平线控制屏障函数（BH-CBF），为联网自动驾驶车辆的多智能体强化学习提供递归可行性与精确几何安全保证，并在真实环岛和路口高密度仿真中验证无碰撞性能。

title: Trusting Imagined Futures: Auditing Imagined Rewards for VLA Post-Training
summary: Video world models enable candidate actions to be evaluated through imagined outcomes, but high predicted rewards can favor trajectories with poor execution quality. We introduce Trusting Imagined Futures (TIF), an offline supervision selection method for vision-language-action (VLA) post-training that audits predicted rewards using execution feedback. A multidimensional reward model predicts a utility score for candidate ranking and five dimensions of execution quality. An auditor uses reward predictions and uncertainty to identify overestimation patterns learned from paired imagined videos and real executions. TIF accepts the candidate with the highest predicted utility when its advantage over the existing trajectory exceeds a margin and its audit risk passes a threshold; otherwise, it retains the existing supervision. The retained real trajectories then supervise behavior cloning. Across four LIBERO suites and three training seeds, TIF achieves a mean success rate of 76.25%, improving over training on the existing trajectories by 3.00 percentage points with the same trajectory count and training budget. Adding audit gating yields 1.47 percentage points with the reward model and advantage margin held fixed. The gains persist against advantage ranking and logistic regression risk selection at matched replacement counts. On recorded videos from three real robot tasks, TIF increases clean completion among selected trajectories from 58.33% to 70.00% across 60 candidate pools.
summary_zh: 视频世界模型能够通过想象的结果来评估候选动作，但高预测奖励可能会偏向执行质量较差的轨迹。我们引入了“信任想象未来”（TIF），这是一种用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）后训练的离线监督选择方法，利用执行反馈来审查预测奖励。一个多维奖励模型预测一个用于候选排序的效用分数，以及五个维度的执行质量。审计者利用奖励预测和不确定性来识别从配对的想象视频和真实执行中学到的过估计模式。当候选方案的预测效用相较于现有轨迹的优势超过一定阈值，且其审计风险通过阈值时，TIF会接受该候选方案；否则，保留现有的监督。保留的真实轨迹随后用于监督行为克隆。在四个LIBERO套件和三种训练种子下，TIF实现了76.25%的平均成功率，相比在相同轨迹数量和训练预算下，对现有轨迹的训练提升了3.00个百分点。在固定奖励模型和优势阈值的情况下，加入审计门控进一步提升了1.47个百分点。在匹配的替换次数下，相较于仅靠优势排序和逻辑回归风险选择，TIF的提升依然保持。在三个真实机器人任务的记录视频中，TIF在60个候选池中将所选轨迹的干净完成率从58.33%提升至70.00%。
tldr: TIF is an offline supervision selection method that audits predicted rewards from a video world model against execution feedback to improve VLA post-training, achieving higher success rates in LIBERO simulations and real-robot video selection.
tldr_zh: TIF 是一种离线监督选择方法，通过执行反馈审计视频世界模型的预测奖励，以改进 VLA 后训练，在 LIBERO 模拟和真实机器人视频选择中取得了更高的成功率。

title: Cycle WAM: Coupling Action and Video through Cycle Consistency
summary: Recent advances in video modeling have driven substantial progress in world action models (WAMs). Existing approaches exploit pretrained video priors by decoding actions from latent representations or inferring them from generated videos. The underlying link is causal: robot actions produce changes in the scene, and video observations of these changes provide evidence for inferring the actions that produced them. However, existing training formulations do not by themselves ensure that actions and their predicted visual consequences are consistent, potentially limiting the use of pretrained capabilities. We treat video and action as paired modalities linked by this causal relationship and learn their correspondence through a unified training framework designed to better exploit pretrained video priors. Cycle WAM first augments video-action co-training with bidirectional conversion to reinforce cross-modal correspondence and recover forward and inverse dynamics. It then introduces a differentiable cycle-reconstruction objective to further couple the two mappings. The resulting model supports both forward and inverse dynamics, with the potential to improve performance through more effective use of pretrained video priors. Cycle WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance among comparable methods on LIBERO-Pro and substantially improves DreamZero on DROID. Comparisons with UWM characterize its inverse-dynamics performance and show sharper visual detail in the displayed forward-dynamics predictions.
summary_zh: 视频建模领域的最新进展推动了世界动作模型（WAMs）的显著进步。现有方法通过从潜在表示中解码动作或从生成的视频中推断动作，来利用预训练的视频先验。其内在联系是因果性的：机器人动作引起场景变化，而这些变化的视频观测为推断产生这些变化的动作提供了证据。然而，现有的训练形式本身并不能确保动作与其预测的视觉结果之间的一致性，这可能限制了预训练能力的利用。我们将视频和动作视为由这种因果关系联系起来的配对模态，并通过一个旨在更好利用预训练视频先验的统一训练框架来学习它们之间的对应关系。Cycle WAM首先通过双向转换增强视频-动作联合训练，以强化跨模态对应关系并恢复前向和逆向动力学。随后，它引入了一个可微分的循环重建目标，进一步耦合这两个映射。所得模型同时支持前向和逆向动力学，并有望通过更有效地利用预训练视频先验来提升性能。Cycle WAM在LIBERO-Pro上达到了同类方法中最先进的性能，并在DROID上显著改进了DreamZero。与UWM的比较表征了其逆向动力学性能，并在展示的前向动力学预测中显示出更清晰的视觉细节。
tldr: This paper introduces Cycle WAM, a training framework that couples action and video modalities through bidirectional conversion and cycle-consistency objectives to improve world action models, achieving state-of-the-art results on LIBERO-Pro and DROID.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Cycle WAM，通过双向转换和循环一致性目标将动作与视频模态耦合，改进世界动作模型，在LIBERO-Pro和DROID上取得最优性能。

title: Action Intent as a Bridge: Transferring Manipulation Knowledge from Human-Centric Videos to Robots
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved promising performance for generalized robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on expensive real-robot data remains a fundamental bottleneck. A scalable alternative is to transfer knowledge from off-the-shelf human-centric videos. However, existing methods extract latent action representations that are entangled with scene-specific noise, diluting the transferred knowledge. Motivated by this limitation, we propose Action-Intent Transfer (AIT), a two-stage method that transfers knowledge through a clean action representation shared across humans and robots. In the first stage, AIT extracts explicit action intents and disentangles the implicit action intent from manipulation videos. In the second stage, AIT aligns the human and robot domains within this shared intent space and decodes the intent into executable robot actions. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that AIT transfers human knowledge more effectively and consistently outperforms prior baselines.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在泛化机器人操控任务中展现了优异的性能，但其对昂贵真实机器人数据的依赖仍是根本性瓶颈。一种可扩展的替代方案是从现成的人类中心视频中迁移知识。然而，现有方法提取的潜在动作表征与场景特定噪声纠缠在一起，稀释了迁移知识的有效性。针对这一局限，我们提出动作意图迁移（AIT）方法，这是一种两阶段方法，通过人类与机器人共享的干净动作表征来迁移知识。在第一阶段，AIT提取显式动作意图，并从操控视频中解耦隐式动作意图。在第二阶段，AIT在共享意图空间中对齐人类与机器人域，并将意图解码为可执行的机器人动作。在仿真和真实环境中的大量实验表明，AIT能够更有效地迁移人类知识，并持续优于先前基线方法。
tldr: AIT is a two-stage method that transfers manipulation knowledge from human videos to robots by extracting and aligning a clean action-intent representation, improving real-robot and simulated manipulation performance over prior baselines.
tldr_zh: AIT 是一种两阶段方法，通过提取并对齐干净的动作意图表示，将人类视频中的操作知识迁移到机器人，在仿真和真实机器人上均优于先前基线。

title: Hybrid Particle-Voxel Dynamics for Multimodal 3D World Simulation
summary: Predicting how the world evolves in response to robot actions is central to policy learning, evaluation, and planning. However, many action-conditioned world models predict future observations in 2D image or video space without explicitly modeling the underlying 3D scene, making spatial consistency across viewpoints and over long-horizon interactions challenging. We introduce 3D World Simulator, an action-conditioned multimodal world modeling framework that jointly predicts appearance, geometry, and tactile observations from a unified 3D representation. Our approach combines a hybrid particle-voxel autoencoder that compresses point clouds into compact 3D voxel latents with an action-conditioned latent dynamics model that predicts their evolution. The shared 3D representation supports geometrically consistent rendering from arbitrary viewpoints and flexible integration of spatially aligned tactile signals. Our experiments demonstrate interactive, long-horizon, multimodal prediction at 50 Hz. We then show how our model enables scalable data generation for policy training and evaluation using tactile and multi-view visual observations, including wrist-mounted and novel camera views. Furthermore, we scale our method to large datasets containing diverse objects and demonstrate model-based planning with unseen objects and robot configurations. Together, these results highlight the potential of hybrid particle-voxel dynamics as a foundation for multimodal 3D world simulation.
summary_zh: 预测世界如何响应机器人动作而演变，是策略学习、评估与规划的核心问题。然而，许多基于动作的条件世界模型在二维图像或视频空间中预测未来观察结果，未显式建模底层三维场景，这使得跨视角及长时间跨度的空间一致性面临挑战。我们提出了三维世界模拟器，这是一个基于动作的多模态世界建模框架，能够从统一的三维表示中联合预测外观、几何形状及触觉观测。该方法结合了一种混合粒子-体素自编码器，将点云压缩为紧凑的三维体素潜变量，并配以基于动作的潜动力学模型来预测其演变。共享的三维表示支持从任意视角进行几何一致的渲染，并能够灵活整合空间对齐的触觉信号。实验表明，我们的方法能以50赫兹的频率实现交互式、长时间跨度及多模态预测。随后，我们展示了该模型如何利用触觉与多视角视觉观测（包括腕装视角及新颖的相机视角）实现用于策略训练与评估的可扩展数据生成。此外，我们将该方法扩展至包含多样物体的大型数据集，并展示了针对未见物体及机器人配置的基于模型的规划。综合来看，这些结果凸显了混合粒子-体素动力学作为多模态三维世界模拟基础所蕴含的潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces an action-conditioned world model that jointly predicts appearance, geometry, and tactile signals using a hybrid particle-voxel 3D representation, enabling multimodal, long-horizon simulation at 50 Hz for policy training and planning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种动作条件世界模型，利用混合粒子-体素3D表示联合预测外观、几何和触觉信号，实现50Hz的多模态长时程仿真，用于策略训练和规划。

title: All-For-One: Distilling Visual Foundation Models to a Fast, Memory-Efficient Visuomotor Policy
summary: Visual Foundation Models (VFMs) provide semantic cues such as depth and segmentation useful for robotic manipulation, but directly deploying them in closed-loop control is impractical due to high computational cost, temporal inconsistency, and distribution shift between static internet images and egocentric robot observations. We propose All-For-One (AFO), a two-stage distillation framework that leverages VFMs strictly as privileged information during training, using downstream robotic data. Following the privileged learning paradigm, AFO decouples semantic representation learning from inference-time policy execution. In the All stage, a teacher policy fuses RGB observations with outputs from multiple VFMs to learn a semantically enriched representation. In the For-One stage, this knowledge is distilled in-distribution into a lightweight RGB-only student policy. Evaluated on two Adroit tasks and five MetaWorld tasks in simulation, as well as three real-world manipulation tasks, AFO outperforms prior foundation-model-based approaches while using over 30x fewer parameters than VFM-based encoders and 50x lower latency than its own teacher in simulation benchmarks, providing an efficient pathway for transferring foundation-model knowledge to robotic control.
summary_zh: 视觉基础模型（VFMs）提供深度估计和分割等语义线索，对于机器人操作任务具有重要价值，但由于计算成本高、时间不一致性以及静态互联网图像与自我中心机器人观测之间的分布差异，直接将其部署于闭环控制并不现实。我们提出“All-For-One”（AFO）框架，一种两阶段蒸馏方法，在训练过程中仅将VFMs作为特权信息使用，依托下游机器人数据进行学习。遵循特权学习范式，AFO将语义表示学习与推理时的策略执行解耦。在“All”阶段，教师策略融合RGB观测与多个VFM的输出，学习富含语义的表示；在“For-One”阶段，这些知识被蒸馏至仅依赖RGB输入的轻量级学生策略中，且保持分布内一致性。在仿真环境中，AFO在两项Adroit任务和五项MetaWorld任务上均取得优异表现，并成功完成三项真实世界操作任务。相较于先前基于基础模型的方法，AFO取得更优性能，同时参数量较VFM编码器减少超过30倍，推理延迟较其自身教师策略降低50倍，为基础模型知识向机器人控制的高效迁移提供了可行路径。
tldr: This paper introduces All-For-One (AFO), a two-stage distillation framework that uses visual foundation models as privileged information during training to distill a lightweight RGB-only visuomotor policy, achieving efficient robotic manipulation across simulation and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出All-For-One (AFO)，一种两阶段蒸馏框架，在训练时将视觉基础模型作为特权信息，蒸馏出轻量级的纯RGB视觉运动策略，在仿真和真实世界操作任务中实现高效控制。

title: Spectrally Routed Diffusion Policy for Multi-Task Robotic Manipulation
summary: Diffusion-based policies have achieved strong performance on single-task robotic manipulation. However, a single model trained jointly on multiple tasks consistently underperforms the per-task specialists trained on the same demonstrations. We focus on two challenges. First, the convolutional encoders commonly used in diffusion-based policies produce visual conditions that are not discriminative enough. Second, gradients from incompatible action modes update the shared denoiser's dense parameters along the same directions, causing destructive interference during joint training. To address both, we propose SR-DP (Spectrally Routed Diffusion Policy). A frozen VGGT encoder with a spatial-compression adapter produces compact multi-scale semantic-geometric tokens, a task-discriminative visual condition for tasks that share a workspace. We first train the denoiser as a standard diffusion policy, then decompose selected linear layers by SVD into a frozen basis of orthogonal rank-one experts, adapted through spectral routing and Householder input rotations. On six RoboTwin tasks, SR-DP averages a 68.4% success rate, surpassing multi-task VO-DP by 21.8 points and the strongest per-task baseline by 3.8 points. On four real-world bimanual tasks, Stage 2 reaches a 43.0% average success rate and improves over Stage 1 by 19.0 points.
summary_zh: 基于扩散的策略在单任务机器人操作中表现出色。然而，在多个任务上联合训练的单一模型，其性能始终不如在相同演示数据上分别训练的各任务专属模型。我们聚焦于两个挑战。首先，扩散策略中常用的卷积编码器产生的视觉条件区分度不足。其次，来自不兼容动作模式的梯度会沿相同方向更新共享去噪器的稠密参数，导致联合训练过程中出现破坏性干扰。为解决这两个问题，我们提出了SR-DP（频谱路由扩散策略）。一个冻结的VGGT编码器结合空间压缩适配器，生成紧凑的多尺度语义-几何令牌，为共享工作空间的任务提供具有任务区分度的视觉条件。我们首先将去噪器作为标准扩散策略进行训练，然后通过SVD将选定的线性层分解为冻结的正交秩一专家基，并通过频谱路由和Householder输入旋转进行适配。在六个RoboTwin任务上，SR-DP平均成功率达到68.4%，超过多任务VO-DP 21.8个百分点，比最强的单任务基线高出3.8个百分点。在四个真实世界双臂任务上，第二阶段平均成功率达43.0%，较第一阶段提升19.0个百分点。
tldr: SR-DP improves multi-task diffusion policies for robotic manipulation by using a frozen VGGT encoder for discriminative visual features and SVD-based spectral routing to reduce gradient interference, achieving higher success rates in simulation and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: SR-DP 通过使用冻结的 VGGT 编码器提取判别性视觉特征，并利用基于 SVD 的光谱路由减少梯度干扰，提升了多任务扩散策略在机器人操作中的成功率。

title: ReflexArc: Bottom-Up Integration of Instantaneous Tactile Reflexes into Whole-Body Humanoid Control
summary: Humanoid robots operating in cluttered environments must react to unexpected contacts before the first impact peak, which arrives within tens of milliseconds. Learned whole-body policies running at 50 Hz introduce a policy-cycle delay and may suppress a protective withdrawal as a tracking error. To address these challenges, we propose ARC (Ascending Reflex Control), a bottom-up framework that integrates instantaneous tactile reflexes with learned whole-body control. ARC consists of two components: an instantaneous reflex pathway and bottom-up reflex integration. The reflex pathway detects hazardous contacts from full-body tactile sensing, solves a whole-body withdrawal pose, and delivers it directly to the motors within 10 ms. Bottom-up reflex integration combines reflex-in-the-loop policy learning, reflex-transparent policy alignment, and reflex-informed policy adaptation to sustain the withdrawal, maintain balance, and complete longer-horizon recovery. We deploy ARC on a Unitree G1 and evaluate three categories of hazardous contact. Compared with an otherwise identical reflex delayed by 20 ms, ARC reduces the first force peak by 34.1% and reduces the contact impulse from 0.2632 N s to 0.1225 N s (a 2.15x ratio). We further demonstrate protected motion tracking, teleoperation, and vision-free obstacle traversal guided by foot tactile sensing. Project page: https://minusmodulo.github.io/reflexarc-website/
summary_zh: 仿人机器人在杂乱环境中作业时，必须在首次冲击峰值到来之前（通常为几十毫秒内）对意外接触作出反应。以50Hz频率运行的全身学习策略会引入策略周期延迟，并可能将保护性退缩行为抑制为跟踪误差。为应对这些挑战，我们提出ARC（上升反射控制，Ascending Reflex Control），一种自底向上的框架，将即时触觉反射与学习型全身控制相结合。ARC由两部分组成：即时反射通路和自底向上的反射整合。反射通路从全身触觉感知中检测危险接触，求解全身退缩姿态，并在10毫秒内直接将其传递至电机。自底向上的反射整合结合了反射在环的策略学习、反射透明的策略对齐以及反射感知的策略自适应，以维持退缩动作、保持平衡并完成更长时间跨度的恢复。我们将ARC部署在宇树G1上，评估了三类危险接触场景。与延迟20毫秒的相同反射相比，ARC将首次力峰值降低了34.1%，并将接触冲量从0.2632 N·s降至0.1225 N·s（2.15倍比率）。我们进一步展示了受保护的运动跟踪、遥操作以及由足部触觉感知引导的无视觉障碍穿越。项目页面：https://minusmodulo.github.io/reflexarc-website/
tldr: This paper presents ReflexArc, a bottom-up framework that integrates instantaneous tactile reflexes into whole-body humanoid control to react to unexpected contacts within 10 ms, reducing first force peak and contact impulse while maintaining balance and completing recovery.
tldr_zh: 本文提出ReflexArc，一种自下而上的框架，将瞬时触觉反射集成到全身人形控制中，在10毫秒内对意外接触作出反应，减少首次力峰值和接触冲量，同时保持平衡并完成恢复。

title: ReSMap: Recasting Satellite Priors for Robust and Accurate Online HD Map Construction
summary: Despite recent advances in camera-based online HD map construction, these systems remain susceptible to sensor failures due to their reliance on onboard cameras. In contrast, satellite images remain available independently of real-time sensing conditions as they are cached offline. Existing methods utilizing satellite images, however, primarily leverage them under nominal conditions, without explicitly addressing them as redundancy when a sensor degrades. To address this gap, we propose ReSMap, a redundancy-aware camera-satellite fusion framework for robust online HD map construction. Our framework explicitly leverages satellite images as a complementary source to improve robustness against camera failures. A Predict-then-Fuse (PTF) module fuses camera and satellite BEV features by using each branch's own prediction confidence as a per-pixel reliability weight, with no learned router. An Object-Centric Cooperative Multi-modal Query (OCMQ) decoder then extends this per-modality separation to the query level: each modality cross-attends only to its own BEV, and per-modality updates are merged through a learned per-token gate. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes across all splits and range settings. More importantly, it also sets the new state-of-the-art under camera-failure scenarios, demonstrating that satellite images serve not only as a strong prior but as practical redundancy for robust online HD mapping.
summary_zh: 尽管基于摄像头的在线高清地图构建技术近期取得了进展，但这些系统由于依赖车载摄像头，仍然容易受到传感器故障的影响。相比之下，卫星图像因可离线缓存，其可用性不受实时感知条件制约。然而，现有利用卫星图像的方法主要是在标称条件下使用它们，并未明确将其作为传感器性能下降时的冗余手段。为弥补这一不足，我们提出ReSMap，一种具有冗余感知能力的摄像头-卫星融合框架，用于构建鲁棒的在线高清地图。该框架明确将卫星图像作为补充信息源，以增强对摄像头故障的鲁棒性。我们设计了一个“先预测后融合”（PTF）模块，利用各分支自身的预测置信度作为逐像素可靠性权重，对摄像头和卫星的BEV特征进行融合，该模块无需学习型路由器。随后，一个面向对象的协同多模态查询（OCMQ）解码器将这种逐模态分离的思想扩展到查询层面：每种模态仅对其自身的BEV进行交叉注意力计算，并通过一个可学习的逐令牌门控机制合并各模态的更新结果。我们的模型在nuScenes数据集的所有划分和距离设置下均达到了最先进的性能。更重要的是，在摄像头故障场景下，该模型同样树立了新的最先进水平，证明了卫星图像不仅是一种强先验信息，更是实现鲁棒在线高清地图构建的实用冗余手段。
tldr: ReSMap introduces a redundancy-aware camera-satellite fusion framework for robust online HD map construction, using a Predict-then-Fuse module and an Object-Centric Cooperative Multi-modal Query decoder to leverage satellite priors under camera failures, achieving SOTA on nuScenes.
tldr_zh: ReSMap 提出了一种冗余感知的相机-卫星融合框架，用于鲁棒的在线高清地图构建，通过预测-融合模块和以对象为中心的多模态查询解码器，在相机故障时利用卫星先验，在 nuScenes 上达到 SOTA。

title: ActOR: Ambient AI-Based Agentic Orchestration for Humanoid Autonomy in Operating Rooms
summary: Operating rooms (ORs) increasingly contain ambient sensing infrastructure to enable AI-based optimization of workflows and utilization. We pursue an alternative path: using ambient AI to guide robot action and optimize utilization. Deploying humanoids in the OR without ambient AI is severely limited by cumbersome de novo orientation and planning due to partial onboard observations. We posit that this can be achieved by coupling an ambient AI-based agentic orchestrator with the humanoid robotic actor, providing shared perception and execution feedback for humanoid autonomy in the OR. ActOR fuses a wall-mounted ambient camera and the robot's head-mounted camera into a shared object-level digital twin (DT). A large language model agent plans over the DT using pre-programmed locomotion and manipulation skills without task-specific training. During execution, DT updates and execution outcomes inform retries, alternative approaches, or replanning. We evaluated ActOR in simulated and physical environments. Across three tasks in two simulated ORs reconstructed from real rooms, ambient perception reduced exploration from 1.05 to 0.12 Explore calls per trial when targets were initially outside the robot's view. Closed-loop feedback increased success from 46.7% to 83.3% under nominal execution and from 8.3% to 51.7% under injected navigation, object-relocation, and grasp perturbations. In a physical mock OR with a humanoid, ActOR completed 14 of 20 single-object disposal trials and demonstrated replanning after scene changes. Ambient AI-based observations provide scene state that improves robot action planning, increasing success and reducing exploration compared with robot-only observations. Feeding skill outcomes and DT updates back to the planner improves multi-step task success. Our results show the feasibility of humanoid task autonomy for multi-step disposal tasks in a mock OR.
summary_zh: 手术室中日益配备环境感知基础设施，以支持基于人工智能的工作流程优化和利用率提升。我们探索了一条替代路径：利用环境人工智能指导机器人行动并优化利用率。在手术室中部署人形机器人，若缺乏环境人工智能，则因机载观测部分受限而导致的繁琐的新方位确定与规划严重制约其应用。我们认为，通过将基于环境人工智能的智能体编排器与人形机器人执行器相结合，提供共享感知与执行反馈，可实现手术室中人形机器人的自主操作。ActOR将壁挂式环境摄像头与机器人头戴式摄像头融合为一个共享的对象级数字孪生。大型语言模型智能体利用预编程的移动和操作技能在数字孪生上进行规划，无需针对特定任务进行训练。在执行过程中，数字孪生的更新及执行结果用于指导重试、替代方案或重新规划。我们在仿真和物理环境中对ActOR进行了评估。在从真实房间重建的两个仿真手术室中执行的三项任务里，当目标初始位于机器人视野之外时，环境感知将每次试验的探索调用次数从1.05次减少至0.12次。闭环反馈在标称执行情况下将成功率从46.7%提升至83.3%，在注入导航、物体重新定位和抓取扰动的情况下将成功率从8.3%提升至51.7%。在配备人形机器人的物理模拟手术室中，ActOR完成了20次单物体处置试验中的14次，并展示了场景变化后的重新规划能力。基于环境人工智能的观测提供了场景状态，改善了机器人行动规划，与仅依赖机器人自身观测相比，提高了成功率并减少了探索。将技能执行结果和数字孪生更新反馈至规划器，可提高多步骤任务的成功率。我们的结果证明了在模拟手术室中实现人形机器人多步骤处置任务自主操作的可行性。
tldr: ActOR integrates ambient and onboard perception into a shared digital twin, enabling an LLM-based agentic orchestrator to plan and adapt humanoid manipulation tasks in operating rooms without task-specific training.
tldr_zh: ActOR 将环境感知与本体感知融合到共享数字孪生中，使基于大语言模型的智能体编排器能够在手术室中无需任务特化训练即可规划并调整人形机器人操作任务。

title: DiMuRe: Diagnosis-Guided Multilevel Recovery for Robotic Task Execution
summary: Disturbances can invalidate the conditions required by a robot's next action even when much of its task program remains useful. A recovery system must therefore choose a response suited to the current state. We present DiMuRe (diagnosis-guided multilevel recovery), a framework for robot-use agents that uses phase-specific evidence and method preconditions to select program reuse or predefined recovery skills, including bounded vision-language-action (VLA) grasping. After the original program exits, a multimodal large language model (MLLM) can generate corrective code from images and execution feedback. Local verification checks the outcome of each recovery attempt. We also introduce LIBERO-Disturb, a benchmark for robustness and recovery under mid-execution disturbances, supporting program-based agents and VLA policies. On 801 scheduled disturbed Encore development cases, Local DiMuRe (program reuse and recovery skills) achieves 77.65% complete-task success, compared with 58.68% for the original program under the same physical-step allowance. Full DiMuRe achieves 81.90% with terminal replanning, an additional step allowance, and early handoff. Local DiMuRe also uses fewer physical steps per scheduled episode than the original program.
summary_zh: 摘要：干扰可能使机器人的下一动作所需条件失效，即便其任务程序的大部分内容仍然可用。因此，恢复系统必须根据当前状态选择适当的应对措施。我们提出了DiMuRe（诊断引导的多层次恢复），一种面向机器人使用智能体的框架，利用阶段特定证据和方法前置条件来选择程序复用或预定义恢复技能，包括有界视觉-语言-动作（VLA）抓取。在原始程序退出后，多模态大语言模型（MLLM）可以从图像和执行反馈中生成修正代码。局部验证检查每次恢复尝试的结果。我们还引入了LIBERO-Disturb，一个用于在执行中途干扰下评估鲁棒性和恢复能力的基准，支持基于程序的智能体和VLA策略。在801个计划性干扰的Encore开发案例中，局部DiMuRe（程序复用和恢复技能）实现了77.65%的完整任务成功率，而在相同的物理步数限制下原始程序为58.68%。完整DiMuRe在终端重新规划、额外步数限制和提前交接的情况下达到了81.90%。局部DiMuRe在每次计划情节中的物理步数消耗也少于原始程序。
tldr: DiMuRe introduces a diagnosis-guided multilevel recovery framework for robotic task execution, combining program reuse, recovery skills, and VLA-based grasping with multimodal LLM replanning, validated on a new LIBERO-Disturb benchmark.
tldr_zh: DiMuRe 提出了一种诊断引导的多级恢复框架，结合程序重用、恢复技能和VLA抓取及多模态LLM重规划，并在新的LIBERO-Disturb基准上验证。

title: Say the Same, Act Differently: Diagnosing and Steering Text-Action Divergence in Reasoning VLAs
summary: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models pair physical control with natural-language rationales that supervisors can read to monitor embodied safety. Prior attacks on VLA reasoning corrupt the rationale itself and leave visible evidence in the text. We show that visual perturbations can instead alter the physical action while keeping the generated rationale word-for-word identical. At the shared text/action interface of Alpamayo for driving and InstructVLA for manipulation, our text-neutral action-subspace (TNAS) diagnostic shows that the locally most action-sensitive direction is nearly orthogonal to the active text-loss gradients, with 1.87% and 5.28% norm overlap. At equal hidden-state perturbation norms across both models, interventions along this text-neutral residual shift actions 4.64x to 47.8x more than text-gradient perturbations, whereas text-gradient perturbations induce 21.2x to 277x more text drift. Steering visual perturbations along this direction reaches the same decoupling from the image. Across 154 obstacle-annotated driving scenes in Alpamayo, TNAS-guided attacks induce a new collision under a word-for-word identical rationale in 52.6% of scenes under full-image perturbations and 35.1% under a localized forward-camera patch, compared with 4.55% for unguided action attacks. Relative to a text-preserving baseline, TNAS guidance raises exact rationale preservation from 83.0% to 89.5% and cuts teacher-forced text drift by 68.4% at a comparable collision rate. In InstructVLA, TNAS guidance cuts text drift by 40.5% and preserves the exact response on 85.0% of examples alongside a 1.73-unit action-chunk shift. An unchanged rationale therefore cannot certify a safe action, so monitors for reasoning VLAs must verify the predicted action channel directly.
summary_zh: 推理视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将物理控制与自然语言推理过程配对，监督者可通过阅读这些推理来监控具身安全性。以往针对VLA推理的攻击会破坏推理本身，并在文本中留下可见痕迹。我们证明，视觉扰动可以在保持生成的推理逐字不变的同时改变物理动作。在用于驾驶的Alpamayo和用于操作的InstructVLA的共享文本/动作接口上，我们的文本中性动作子空间（TNAS）诊断表明，局部最动作敏感方向与活动文本损失梯度几乎正交，范数重叠度分别为1.87%和5.28%。在两个模型上施加相等隐状态扰动范数时，沿这一文本中性残差方向的干预对动作的改变幅度是文本梯度扰动的4.64倍至47.8倍，而文本梯度扰动引起的文本漂移则是前者的21.2倍至277倍。沿该方向引导视觉扰动可达到与图像相同的解耦效果。在Alpamayo的154个带障碍物标注的驾驶场景中，TNAS引导的攻击在整图扰动下于52.6%的场景中、在前向摄像头局部补丁扰动下于35.1%的场景中，在推理逐字不变的情况下诱发新的碰撞，而未引导的动作攻击仅为4.55%。相对于文本保持基线，TNAS引导将推理逐字保留率从83.0%提升至89.5%，并在相近碰撞率下将教师强制文本漂移降低了68.4%。在InstructVLA中，TNAS引导将文本漂移降低了40.5%，在85.0%的样本上保留了完全一致的响应，同时伴随1.73单位的动作块位移。因此，不变的推理并不能保证动作的安全性，对推理型VLA的监控必须直接验证预测的动作通道。
tldr: This paper identifies a vulnerability in reasoning VLA models where visual perturbations can change physical actions while leaving the generated rationales word-for-word identical, and introduces a text-neutral action-subspace (TNAS) diagnostic to steer such attacks, showing that unchanged rationales cannot certify safe actions.
tldr_zh: 本文发现推理式视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型存在漏洞：视觉扰动可改变物理动作，而生成的理由文本却一字不变；并提出了文本中性动作子空间（TNAS）诊断方法引导此类攻击，表明不变的理由无法保证动作安全。

title: VARP: A Visual Adaptive Rearrangement Planner for Non-Monotone Object Rearrangement Planning
summary: Object rearrangement planning in cluttered environments is often non-monotone, requiring objects to be temporarily relocated before reaching their final destinations. Although search-based planners can solve such tasks, they incur substantial computational cost and require expensive replanning when the environment changes. We propose the Visual Adaptive Rearrangement Planner (VARP), which learns non-monotone rearrangement directly from visual state representations generated from expert demonstrations. VARP predicts pick-and-place actions from the current and goal visual state representations, and incorporates an Action Refinement Strategy (ARS) to improve action feasibility and a Progress Enforcement Strategy (PES) to mitigate progress stagnation. By continuously updating actions from the latest visual state representations, VARP adapts online to disturbances without replanning from scratch or performing online combinatorial search. In challenging rearrangement benchmarks, VARP achieves a 98.3\% success rate with only 0.4 s planning time per task, 97.5\% success under execution-time disturbances, and 94.5\% under continuous severe disturbances, while generalizing effectively to unseen object counts. These results demonstrate that VARP provides a scalable and robust solution for non-monotone object rearrangement.
summary_zh: 杂乱环境中的物体重排规划通常是非单调的，要求物体在到达最终位置之前被临时转移。尽管基于搜索的规划器能够解决此类任务，但它们会产生高昂的计算成本，并且在环境变化时需要昂贵的重新规划。我们提出了视觉自适应重排规划器（VARP），它直接从专家演示生成的视觉状态表示中学习非单调重排。VARP根据当前及目标视觉状态表示预测抓取和放置动作，并引入动作精炼策略（ARS）以提升动作可行性，以及进度强制策略（PES）以缓解进度停滞问题。通过持续根据最新视觉状态表示更新动作，VARP能够在线适应干扰，而无需从头重新规划或进行在线组合搜索。在具有挑战性的重排基准测试中，VARP实现了98.3%的成功率，每个任务仅需0.4秒的规划时间；在执行过程中受到干扰时成功率达97.5%；在持续严重干扰下成功率达94.5%，并且能够有效泛化至未见过的物体数量。这些结果表明，VARP为非单调物体重排提供了一种可扩展且稳健的解决方案。
tldr: VARP learns non-monotone object rearrangement from visual state representations, predicting pick-and-place actions and adapting online to disturbances without replanning, achieving high success rates and robustness.
tldr_zh: VARP从视觉状态表示中学习非单调物体重排，预测拾放动作并在线适应扰动，无需重新规划，实现了高成功率和鲁棒性。

title: MABEL: An Open Anthropomorphic Mobile Bimanual Platform for Teleoperation and Learning
summary: As robot learning moves beyond the tabletop, many tasks require mobility, adjustable reach, active perception, and bimanual dexterity. Commercial platforms combining these capabilities are costly, while affordable open-source alternatives cover only a subset and require software integration. We present MABEL, an open-source anthropomorphic mobile bimanual robot with 56 degrees of freedom (DOF) and a US$8.1k parts cost. It combines two 7-DOF arms with 17-DOF hands, a pitching torso, a lift, a 3-DOF neck, and a holonomic base. Back-drivable arms and torso support compliant interaction, with fingertip reach from floor level to 2.23 m. The head and torso roughly triple modeled camera coverage relative to a torso-fixed camera. Apple Vision Pro head and hand tracking enables whole-body teleoperation without handheld controllers, with 137 ms mean glass-to-glass stereo video latency over the robot's Wi-Fi hotspot. We demonstrate an end-to-end imitation learning pipeline, from teleoperated data collection to policy deployment, using a shared command interface and whole-body controller.
summary_zh: 随着机器人学习从桌面场景拓展至更广阔的应用领域，许多任务对移动性、可调伸展范围、主动感知及双臂灵巧操作提出了要求。结合这些能力的商用平台成本高昂，而价格可承受的开源替代方案通常仅覆盖其中部分功能，且需进行软件集成。我们提出了MABEL——一款开源仿人移动双臂机器人，拥有56个自由度（DOF），零部件成本为8，100美元。该机器人集成了两条7自由度手臂、17自由度灵巧手、可俯仰躯干、升降机构、3自由度颈部及全向移动底盘。后驱式手臂与躯干支持柔顺交互，指尖可达范围覆盖从地面至2.23米的高度。头部与躯干相较固定于躯干的摄像头，使建模摄像头覆盖范围约增加三倍。借助Apple Vision Pro的头部位姿与手部追踪，可实现无需手持控制器的全身遥操作，经由机器人Wi-Fi热点传输的立体视频端到端延迟平均为137毫秒。我们展示了从遥操作数据采集到策略部署的端到端模仿学习流程，该系统采用共享命令接口与全身控制器。
tldr: MABEL is an open-source, low-cost (US$8.1k) anthropomorphic mobile bimanual platform with 56 DOF, featuring whole-body teleoperation via Apple Vision Pro and an end-to-end imitation learning pipeline for real-robot policy deployment.
tldr_zh: MABEL是一个开源、低成本（8100美元）的56自由度拟人移动双臂平台，通过Apple Vision Pro实现全身遥操作，并具备端到端模仿学习流程，支持真实机器人策略部署。

title: FEIJOA: Task-Driven Grounding and Execution for Mobile Manipulation
summary: A mobile manipulator asked to "put the toys away in the toy box" must decide which objects are toys and which container the user means, then find base poses, grasps, and placements it can execute. Because a scene representation is built before the instruction is known, it may lack the attributes, affordances, or concepts needed to resolve the task. We present FEIJOA, a language-model agent that grounds the instruction at test time. It queries a grounding tool over a posed RGB-D scan, inspects the returned candidates, and refines its queries until they resolve the instruction. An embodiment-aware harness checks each skill's preconditions, samples base poses from which the target is reachable, and verifies the skill's effect from observations before and after execution. On 103 open-ended grounding queries, FEIJOA resolves 94.2% exactly, compared with 68.0% for the best prebuilt representation. Over 50 real-world trials on Spot, it completes 35 tasks; 17 of these successes follow recovery from a failed tool call or verification check. Of the 15 failed trials, 13 were caused by the robot's physical skills, and only 2 by grounding or the agent's reasoning. Project website: https://williamshen-nz.github.io/feijoa/.
summary_zh: 移动机械臂在执行“把玩具放进玩具箱”的指令时，必须判断哪些物体是玩具、用户所指的容器是哪个，然后找到可执行的基座位置、抓取姿态和放置姿态。由于场景表示是在指令知晓之前构建的，因此可能缺乏解析任务所需的属性、可供性或概念。我们提出了FEIJOA，一个在测试时对指令进行语义落地的语言模型智能体。它通过一个基于带位姿RGB-D扫描的落地工具进行查询，检查返回的候选结果，并优化其查询直到解析出指令。一个具身感知框架检查每项技能的前提条件，从目标可达的基座姿态中采样，并在执行前后通过观测验证技能效果。在103个开放式落地查询中，FEIJOA精确解析了94.2%，而最佳的预构建表示仅为68.0%。在Spot机器人的50次真实世界试验中，完成了35项任务；其中17项成功是在工具调用或验证检查失败后的恢复中实现的。15次失败尝试中，13次由机器人的物理技能导致，仅有2次归因于语义落地或智能体的推理。项目网站：https://williamshen-nz.github.io/feijoa/。
tldr: FEIJOA presents a language-model agent that grounds open-ended mobile manipulation instructions at test time by interactively querying a scene-graph tool and verifying skills on a real Spot robot, significantly improving task completion over prebuilt representations.
tldr_zh: FEIJOA 提出了一种语言模型代理，在测试时通过交互式查询场景图工具并在真实 Spot 机器人上验证技能，从而将开放式移动操作指令落地，显著提高了任务完成率。

title: Physical Experience Builds Continual Spatial World Models
summary: World models are increasingly used to support prediction and planning in embodied agents, but the knowledge is usually established before deployment and then carried into later encounters. Continual operation faces a different problem. A familiar environment may change, and the agent must use previous experience without allowing old expectations to override current physical evidence. This study asks what repeated physical experience must contribute for a spatial world model to become progressively more useful rather than simply more persistent. A physics-grounded dynamic maze separates recurring spatial change from the continuous consequences of action. Cross-episode Spatial Change Memory learns relations among environmental transformations, while state-action-outcome experience refines predictions of motion. Structured experience progressively reduces the need for future route correction and transfers to spatial transitions not encountered during learning. The advantage disappears when past changes contain no information about future ones. Continuous navigation further shows that predictive memory changes behavior when a previous decision becomes invalid but leaves behavior unchanged when the decision remains correct. Physical tests expose a complementary limit: correct topology does not guarantee correct action prediction, and accumulated physical experience reduces this mismatch within the modeled dynamics. The results characterize continual world knowledge as experience that improves future prediction and action beyond stored episodes while remaining revisable by the physical outcomes it is intended to predict.
summary_zh: 世界模型越来越多地被用于支持具身智能体的预测与规划，但这类知识通常是在部署前建立，随后被携带至后续交互场景中。持续运行面临的是不同的问题：熟悉的环境可能发生变化，智能体必须利用先前的经验，同时不让旧有的预期覆盖当前的物理证据。本研究探讨的问题是：重复的物理经验必须贡献什么，才能使空间世界模型逐步变得更有用，而不仅仅是更持久。一个基于物理学的动态迷宫将重复出现的空间变化与动作的持续后果区分开来。跨情节空间变化记忆学习环境变换之间的关系，而状态-动作-结果经验则细化运动预测。结构化经验逐步减少未来路径修正的需求，并能泛化到学习过程中未遇到的空间转换中。当过去的变化不包含未来变化的任何信息时，这一优势便消失。连续导航进一步表明，当先前的决策失效时，预测性记忆会改变行为，而当决策仍然正确时，行为则保持不变。物理测试揭示了一个互补性的局限：正确的拓扑结构并不能保证正确的动作预测，而累积的物理经验会在建模动力学范围内缩小这一不匹配。研究结果将持续性的世界知识刻画为一种经验——它超越存储的情节，改善未来预测和行动，同时仍可由其旨在预测的物理结果进行修正。
tldr: This paper investigates how physical experience enables spatial world models to continually improve prediction and action in changing environments, proposing Cross-episode Spatial Change Memory and demonstrating benefits in a physics-grounded maze and continuous navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文研究物理经验如何使空间世界模型在变化环境中持续提升预测与行动能力，提出跨情节空间变化记忆，并在物理迷宫和连续导航中验证其优势。

title: A Tutorial on Shape Servoing of Deformable Objects-Part II: Advanced Concepts
summary: In robotics, shape control, or shape servoing, refers to the automatic manipulation of a deformable object toward a desired shape. This article is the second of a two-part tutorial on data-driven, Jacobian-based shape control, in which the deformation Jacobian, a local model of how robot motion changes the measured shape, is estimated from measurements. Part I built the shape-servoing loop and derived a local stability condition. This paper starts by using the singular value decomposition of the deformation Jacobian to identify shape changes that can be produced by small robot motions, those that require large robot motions, and those that are locally unavailable. It then analyses how the choice of shape features determines how the controller regulates the object's shape and, therefore, how much the object deforms on its way to the target. It then describes three ways in which the shape control loop can fail: loss of controllability, loss of observability, and occurrence of mechanical instabilities. It closes with shape-control extensions to time-varying targets, secondary tasks, and three-dimensional objects.
summary_zh: 在机器人学领域，形状控制（或称形状伺服）是指通过自动操作将可变形物体调整至期望形状的过程。本文是关于基于数据驱动、利用雅可比矩阵进行形状控制的两部分教程中的第二部分，其中形变雅可比矩阵——即描述机器人运动如何改变测量所得形状的局部模型——是通过测量数据估计得出的。第一部分构建了形状伺服回路并推导出了局部稳定性条件。本部分首先利用形变雅可比矩阵的奇异值分解来识别可由小幅机器人运动实现的形状变化、需要大幅机器人运动才能实现的形状变化，以及局部范围内无法实现的形状变化。随后分析了形状特征的选择如何决定控制器调节物体形状的方式，进而影响物体在朝向目标过程中发生的形变程度。接着，文章阐述了形状控制回路可能失败的三种情况：可控性丧失、可观测性丧失以及机械失稳的发生。最后，文章将形状控制扩展到时变目标、次级任务及三维物体等应用场景。
tldr: This tutorial paper covers advanced concepts in data-driven shape servoing of deformable objects, including analysis of deformation Jacobian via SVD, shape feature selection, failure modes, and extensions to time-varying targets and 3D objects.
tldr_zh: 本教程论文涵盖数据驱动的可变形物体形状伺服中的高级概念，包括通过SVD分析变形雅可比矩阵、形状特征选择、失败模式以及扩展到时变目标和三维物体。

title: Pixel-UMI: Learning Environment-Aware Whole-Body Manipulation from Sensorized Human Demonstrations
summary: Sensorized human demonstrations offer scalable data for mobile manipulation, but embodiment differences complicate policy learning. We present Pixel-UMI, a pipeline for learning environment-aware whole-body policies from human data. We first introduce Environment-Aware Retargeting (EAR), which combines reconstructed scene geometry with demonstrated head and gripper trajectories to determine robot posture and generate collision-aware joint and base targets. Delay-calibrated action assignment converts these trajectories into actions. However, kinematic differences can leave residual pose errors, creating viewpoint mismatches between human demonstrations and robot observations. We therefore introduce Retargeting-Error-Aware Masking (REAM), which uses these errors during training to reduce reliance on mismatched views at deployment. Finally, because estimated actions cannot fully capture contact-rich interactions, we collect on-policy human corrections through DAgger to improve performance. We evaluate Pixel-UMI on five challenging tasks spanning articulated-object manipulation, deformable-object handling, constrained-space reaching, whole-body collision avoidance, and contact-rich bimanual coordination, achieving 87.0% average task progress. Video results are available at https://pixel-robot.com/pixel-umi
summary_zh: 传感化的人类演示为移动操作提供了可扩展的数据，但 embodiment 差异使策略学习变得复杂。我们提出了 Pixel-UMI，一种从人类数据中学习环境感知全身策略的流水线。我们首先引入了环境感知重定向（EAR），该方法将重建的场景几何与演示的头部和夹爪轨迹相结合，以确定机器人姿态并生成碰撞感知的关节和基座目标。延迟校准的动作分配将这些轨迹转换为动作。然而，运动学差异可能留下残余位姿误差，导致人类演示与机器人观测之间的视角不匹配。因此，我们引入了重定向误差感知掩蔽（REAM），在训练过程中利用这些误差以减少部署时对不匹配视角的依赖。最后，由于估计的动作无法完全捕捉接触丰富的交互，我们通过 DAgger 收集策略内的人类修正以提升性能。我们在五个具有挑战性的任务上评估了 Pixel-UMI，涵盖铰接物体操作、可变形物体处理、受限空间到达、全身避碰以及接触丰富的双臂协调，平均任务进展达到 87.0%。视频结果见 https://pixel-robot.com/pixel-umi
tldr: Pixel-UMI introduces a pipeline for learning environment-aware whole-body mobile manipulation policies from sensorized human demonstrations, using Environment-Aware Retargeting, Retargeting-Error-Aware Masking, and DAgger-based corrections to achieve high task progress on challenging real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: Pixel-UMI 提出了一种从传感化人类演示中学习环境感知全身移动操作策略的流程，通过环境感知重定向、重定向误差感知掩码和 DAgger 校正，在多个具有挑战性的真实任务中取得了高任务进度。

title: Pixel: A Co-Designed Full-Stack Robot System for Learning General-Purpose Mobile Manipulation
summary: General-purpose mobile manipulation requires a combination of capable robot hardware, scalable demonstration collection, expressive whole-body control, and effective policy learning. Yet these components are often developed independently, creating mismatches that limit the capabilities of the complete system. We present Pixel, a co-designed full-stack system for learning general-purpose mobile manipulation. Pixel combines a low-cost wheeled humanoid with human-aligned kinematics and compliant grippers, multiple teleoperation and robot-free human data-collection interfaces, a unified whole-body controller, and a common policy learning pipeline across human and robot demonstrations. A hierarchical learning stack further enables language-conditioned visuomotor control and long-horizon task execution. We evaluate the system across hardware, data collection, and policy learning, and demonstrate mobile-manipulation behaviors requiring dexterity, active perception, navigation, and whole-body coordination. We hope that Pixel provides an integrated and extensible foundation for studying how robot hardware, data, control, and learning can be designed together for robot learning. More results at https://pixel-robot.com/pixel
summary_zh: 通用型移动操作需要具备高性能机器人硬件、可扩展的示范数据采集、富有表现力的全身控制以及有效的策略学习。然而，这些组件往往是被独立开发的，从而产生不匹配问题，限制了整个系统的能力。我们提出了Pixel，一个面向通用移动操作学习的协同设计全栈系统。Pixel结合了低成本的轮式人形机器人、与人体对齐的运动学结构及柔顺夹爪、多种遥操作和无机器人人工数据采集接口、统一的全身控制器，以及适用于人类和机器人示范数据的通用策略学习流程。此外，分层学习架构进一步实现了语言条件下的视觉运动控制及长时程任务执行。我们在硬件、数据采集和策略学习方面对系统进行了评估，并展示了需要灵巧操作、主动感知、导航和全身协调的移动操作行为。我们希望Pixel为研究机器人硬件、数据、控制和学习如何协同设计以促进机器人学习提供一个集成且可扩展的基础。更多结果请访问 https://pixel-robot.com/pixel
tldr: Pixel presents a co-designed full-stack robot system integrating hardware, data collection, whole-body control, and policy learning for general-purpose mobile manipulation, demonstrated on a low-cost wheeled humanoid.
tldr_zh: Pixel 提出了一种协同设计的全栈机器人系统，集成硬件、数据采集、全身控制与策略学习，用于通用移动操作，并在低成本轮式人形机器人上进行了演示。

title: Robot-Matched Soft Fingers for UMI Data Collection: Lessons from 100 Hours of Pick and Place
summary: Training robot policies for multi-task pick and place requires demonstrations on many objects, which handheld Universal Manipulation Interfaces (UMIs) can collect quickly and cheaply. However, existing UMIs depend on external base stations, use rigid fingers that give no signal about contact forces, or use parallel-jaw fingers that limit grip strength. We present a battery-powered handheld interface, built on YUBI, whose soft, angled fingers wrap around objects, deform visibly under load as a visual proxy for force, and match the grippers of the robot. With it, we collect a 99.7-hour dataset over 53 objects, train $π_{0.5}$ policies on 49 of them, and hold out the other 4 as unseen objects. We find that a top camera raises success by 13 points even when only about half of the data includes it, and that mid-training on our multi-task data raises success after fine-tuning on unseen objects from 35% to 57%. Finger design, dataset, and data processing code: https://lute-corp.github.io/soft-yubi-site/
summary_zh: 训练机器人进行多任务抓取与放置的策略，通常需要针对大量物体采集示范数据。手持式通用操作界面（UMIs）能够快速且低成本地完成这一数据采集任务。然而，现有的UMIs依赖于外部基站，或采用刚性手指而无法提供接触力信号，又或使用平行夹爪式手指而限制了抓取力度。我们提出了一种基于YUBI的电池供电手持式界面，其柔软、带有角度的手指能够包裹住物体，在负载下产生明显的形变，可作为力的视觉代理，并且与机器人的夹爪相匹配。利用该界面，我们采集了涵盖53个物体的99.7小时数据集，并基于其中49个物体训练了\( \pi_{0.5} \)策略，其余4个物体留作未见物体进行测试。实验发现，即使仅有约一半的数据包含顶部相机，其引入也能将成功率提升13个百分点；同时，在我们多任务数据上的中期训练，使得对未见物体进行微调后的成功率从35%提升至57%。手指设计、数据集及数据处理代码见：https://lute-corp.github.io/soft-yubi-site/
tldr: This paper introduces a battery-powered handheld Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) with soft, angled fingers that match the robot's grippers, enabling fast data collection for multi-task pick-and-place policies. They collected a 99.7-hour dataset over 53 objects, trained π0.5 policies, and showed that a top camera and mid-training improve success rates, especially on unseen objects.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种电池供电的手持式通用操作接口（UMI），其带有与机器人夹爪匹配的柔软倾斜手指，可快速收集多任务抓取放置策略的数据。他们收集了53个物体上99.7小时的数据集，训练了π0.5策略，并表明顶部摄像头和中期训练能提高成功率，尤其是在未见过的物体上。

title: D&A: Decoupling Description and Assessment Enables VLMs as Zero-Shot Robotic Reward Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) hold promise for zero-shot video task-progress estimation in robot learning, yet existing frameworks frequently suffer from confirmation bias, hallucinating progress in failed executions due to implicit success assumptions or relative temporal ranking designs. Naive prompting of frontier models collapses into a binary success detector that fails to capture nuanced, non-linear progress and failures. While post-training approaches can mitigate this through explicit training, they demand expensive real-world robotics data and require computationally intensive post-training for every individual base model. To resolve these limitations, we introduce D&A (Describe & Assess): our approach decouples progress estimation into an objective, task-grounded textual description of scene dynamics followed by an assessment phase using explicit rubrics. By compelling the VLM to synthesize an explicit, text-based definition of absolute success before scoring, the framework anchors evaluations to an external, global criterion rather than the video's internal timeline. Empirical results demonstrate that our method calibrates zero-shot estimates and mitigates confirmation bias, providing fine-grained, partial progress metrics that accurately penalize failed executions while correctly interpolating successful runs. Being purely prompt-based, D&A generalizes across tasks, embodiments, and benchmarks---matching or surpassing post-trained reward models---and its reward estimates enable efficient downstream reinforcement learning.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在机器人学习的零样本视频任务进度估计中展现出潜力，然而现有框架常常受到确认偏差的影响，在失败执行中因隐式的成功假设或相对时间排序设计而产生虚假进度幻觉。对前沿模型的简单提示会退化为二元成功检测器，无法捕捉细微的、非线性的进度和失败情况。虽然后训练方法可以通过显式训练缓解这一问题，但这类方法需要昂贵的真实机器人数据，并且需要对每个基础模型进行计算密集的后训练。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了D&A（描述与评估）：该方法将进度估计解耦为对场景动态的客观、基于任务的文本描述，随后使用显式评分细则进行评估。通过促使VLM在评分前合成对绝对成功的显式、基于文本的定义，该框架将评估锚定在外部全局标准上，而非视频内部的时间线。实验结果表明，我们的方法能够校准零样本估计并缓解确认偏差，提供细粒度、部分进度的度量，能够准确惩罚失败执行，同时正确插值成功轨迹。由于D&A纯粹基于提示设计，它能够跨任务、载体和基准进行泛化——匹配或超越后训练的奖励模型——并且其奖励估计能够支持高效的下游强化学习。
tldr: D&A decouples VLM-based robotic reward estimation into objective description and rubric-based assessment, anchoring to absolute success definitions to mitigate confirmation bias and enable zero-shot, fine-grained progress prediction. It matches or surpasses post-trained reward models across tasks and enables efficient downstream RL.
tldr_zh: D&A 将基于VLM的机器人奖励估计解耦为客观描述和基于量规的评估，锚定到绝对成功定义，以减轻确认偏差并实现零样本、细粒度的进度预测。它在多个任务上匹配或超越后训练奖励模型，并支持高效的下游强化学习。

title: Seeing Through the Illusion: Test-Time Scaling for World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) jointly generate actions and imagined futures, but a plausible prediction need not be realized by its co-generated action. We introduce WISE (\emph{World Action Inference Scaling through Evaluation}), a pre-execution selector that scores each sampled rollout on action validity and temporal regularity, inverse-dynamics consistency between the proposed action and the imagined motion, and instruction-conditioned task progress, and executes the highest-scoring candidate while keeping the WAM frozen. With four candidates per decision, WISE raises closed-loop success from 6.0\% to 24.0\% on RoboLab with Cosmos~3 Edge and from 75.1\% to 78.3\% mean success on LIBERO with DreamZero, and exceeds the best existing selector in aggregate by 4.0 and 0.9 points. Component ablations and agreement analyses show that the three scores rank candidates differently and that task progress carries the largest weight in the fused decision.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）联合生成动作与想象未来，但合理的预测并不一定由其共同生成的动作所实现。我们提出WISE（\emph{通过评估实现世界动作推断扩展}），这是一种预执行选择器，它根据动作有效性与时间规律性、所提动作与想象运动之间的逆动力学一致性，以及指令条件下的任务进展，对每个采样轨迹进行评分，并在保持WAM冻结的同时执行得分最高的候选动作。在每次决策使用四个候选的情况下，WISE将RoboLab上使用Cosmos 3 Edge的闭环成功率从6.0\%提升至24.0\%，将LIBERO上使用DreamZero的平均成功率从75.1\%提升至78.3\%，并且在总体表现上超越现有最佳选择器4.0个和0.9个百分点。组件消融实验与一致性分析表明，三项评分对候选动作的排序方式不同，其中任务进展在融合决策中所占权重最大。
tldr: WISE is a test-time scaling method that selects the best rollout from a frozen world action model by scoring candidates on action validity, temporal regularity, inverse-dynamics consistency, and task progress, improving closed-loop success on RoboLab and LIBERO benchmarks.
tldr_zh: WISE 是一种测试时扩展方法，通过评分动作有效性、时间规律性、逆动力学一致性和任务进度，从冻结的世界动作模型中选择最佳 rollout，在 RoboLab 和 LIBERO 基准上提高了闭环成功率。

title: FloMo: 3D Scene Flow as a World Action Model Intermediate for Learning from Human Video
summary: Pretrained video generation models distill internet-scale motion priors into robot policies, but full video is a redundant signal for action prediction. We argue that dense 3D motion is the medium through which video pretraining best transfers to robot actions, and that predicting motion rather than video affords better sample-efficiency for action prediction. FloMo is a 5B video-generation model fine-tuned to predict 3D scene-flow and action tokens. Rendering scene flow as RGB and encoding it into the same latent space as video enables a pretrained video generation backbone to efficiently adapt to predict 3D scene flow. Co-trained on action-free human video and action-labeled robot teleoperation data, our model benefits from human-video pretraining and generalizes to unseen objects, motion primitives, and tasks. Replacing motion prediction with a video prediction objective degrades out-of-distribution generalization, while adding a video prediction target alongside motion lowers policy success rather than improving it. When motion, video, and action are predicted jointly, action tokens attend far more to motion than to video, suggesting that predicting video wastes model capacity. Together, these results indicate that motion effectively mediates the transfer from video pretraining to action. More information can be found at flomo-wam.github.io.
summary_zh: 预训练的视频生成模型将互联网规模的运动先验知识提炼到机器人策略中，但完整视频对于动作预测而言是一种冗余信号。我们认为，稠密三维运动是视频预训练最佳地迁移到机器人动作的中介，而预测运动而非视频能够为动作预测带来更高的样本效率。FloMo是一个50亿参数规模的视频生成模型，经过微调用于预测三维场景流和动作标记。将场景流渲染为RGB并编码到与视频相同的潜在空间中，使得预训练的视频生成骨干网络能够高效地适应三维场景流预测。通过在无动作的人类视频和带动作标注的机器人遥操作数据上进行联合训练，我们的模型受益于人类视频预训练，并泛化到未见过的物体、运动基元和任务。用视频预测目标替代运动预测会降低分布外泛化能力，而在运动之外增加视频预测目标会降低策略成功率而非提升它。当运动、视频和动作被联合预测时，动作标记对运动的关注远多于对视频的关注，这表明预测视频浪费了模型容量。综合来看，这些结果表明运动有效地中介了从视频预训练到动作的迁移。更多信息可访问 flomo-wam.github.io。
tldr: FloMo proposes using 3D scene flow as an intermediate representation for a video-generation model, enabling efficient transfer of internet-scale motion priors to robot action prediction and improving generalization by predicting motion rather than full video.
tldr_zh: FloMo 提出将 3D 场景流作为视频生成模型的中间表示，从而高效地将互联网规模的运动先验迁移到机器人动作预测中，并通过预测运动而非完整视频来提升泛化能力。

title: Controlling Action-Head Co-Adaptation to VLM Representation Anisotropy
summary: Modern learning systems increasingly combine pretrained models with downstream heads. Despite the growing importance of such modular designs, how the downstream model co-adapts to the geometry of pretrained representations remains relatively underexplored. We study this problem through vision-language-action models (VLAs), where a pretrained vision-language model (VLM) conditions an action model for control. We find that the action model progressively concentrates its sensitivity on high-variance dimensions of the VLM outputs. Through controlled experiments across different backbone-head models, we further show that counteracting this sensitivity concentration can be beneficial under representation--task mismatch settings. Motivated by these observations, we introduce \emph{Adaptive Interface Equalizer} (AdaIE), a parameter-free mechanism that reweights pretrained representations according to the evolving downstream sensitivity during training. AdaIE improves VLA success rates on simulation benchmarks, with gains of up to $+5.28$ percentage points (pp) on RoboCasa-GR1 and $+1.68$ pp on RoboTwin 2.0, and achieves an average gain of $+19$ pp across five real-world manipulation tasks. It further generalizes to diffusion policies and world models, improving downstream performance in both settings. Our results highlight interface co-adaptation as an important optimization problem when coupling pretrained representations with downstream models.
