We introduce an iterative framework that alternates between 1) task proposal and data collection and 2) data evaluation to close the loop. For task proposal, we leverage semantic priors from vision-language models to identify relevant environments, object configurations, and goals for data collection. However, since semantic relevance does not imply policy improvement, we perform data evaluation. By leveraging predictive data attribution we approximate how the collected trajectories influence policy performance on a target deployment setting. This signal is then used as feedback to guide subsequent data collection, closing the data collection loop. We evaluate our approach in simulation and real robot settings, demonstrating that guided data collection substantially improves sample efficiency and deployment performance compared to passive data collection strategies, multiple baselines and experienced roboticists. More information at https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/guild2026/
summary_zh: 机器人领域的模仿学习策略是在通过成本高昂的真实世界遥操作收集的数据集上训练的。通常，数据收集过程缺乏引导，依赖遥操作员的直觉，导致所收集的数据对整体策略性能贡献甚微。近期研究表明，对这类无引导数据集进行筛选可以显著提升策略性能，但这些方法是在数据收集完成后对现有数据集进行过滤，因此无法阻止无信息数据的获取。在本工作中，我们提出GUILD，一种新颖的引导式数据收集（GDC）方法，该方法主动推断应收集哪些数据以最大化下游策略性能。我们引入了一个迭代框架，在1）任务提议与数据收集和2）数据评估之间交替进行，以形成闭环。对于任务提议，我们利用视觉-语言模型中的语义先验来识别相关的环境、物体配置及数据收集目标。然而，由于语义相关性并不等同于策略改进，我们执行数据评估。通过利用预测性数据归因，我们近似估计所收集的轨迹如何影响目标部署场景下的策略性能。该信号随后作为反馈用于引导后续数据收集，从而闭合数据收集环路。我们在仿真和真实机器人环境中评估了我们的方法，结果表明，与被动数据收集策略、多种基线方法以及经验丰富的机器人专家相比，引导式数据收集显著提高了样本效率和部署性能。更多信息请访问 https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/guild2026/
tldr: GUILD is an iterative, guided data collection framework for imitation learning that uses vision-language models for task proposal and predictive data attribution for data evaluation, improving sample efficiency and deployment performance in simulation and real robot settings.
tldr_zh: GUILD 是一种用于模仿学习的迭代式引导数据收集框架，利用视觉语言模型进行任务提议，并利用预测性数据归因进行数据评估，从而在仿真和真实机器人环境中提高样本效率和部署性能。

title: PyRUA-DataFarm: LLM Agent as a Cost-Efficient Teleoperator for Real-Ready Robot Data
summary: Teleoperation remains the default way to collect robot demonstrations, but every episode costs robot and operator time, and every new task starts from scratch. We ask whether a coding agent can take over the teleoperator's job. In our DataFarm, the agent receives a data request and one calibration episode of the robot in the target scene and rebuilds the task in simulation: it writes the scene, an expert controller, and a success judge. The simulator supplies exact actions, and a video model conditioned on real images renders each rollout as photographic video, generating all camera views together consistently. The output is real-ready data: synchronized camera views labelled with the robot's actions, on which a policy can be trained directly and deployed on the real robot. Independent judges certify the expert and every rendered episode before admission. On five real-robot tasks, policies trained only on farm data match policies trained on as many teleoperated episodes (93 vs. 84 successes in 100 trials), and under an unseen tablecloth and coloured light they keep 87 successes where the teleoperation-trained policies fall to 46. Adapting a task is fully automatic and costs \$21 of API usage on average, paid once per task, plus \$5 for a render contract; every further episode costs \$0.80 on average for simulation, rendering, and review, with no robot or operator. One hour of three-view data for a task costs \$107 on average, these costs included, slightly below a quote of \$117 for teleoperation in China and below \$290 in labour alone in North America.
summary_zh: 遥操作仍是采集机器人示范数据的默认方式，但每条示范轨迹都耗费机器人和操作员的时间，且每项新任务都需从零开始。我们探讨一个编码智能体能否接管遥操作员的工作。在我们的DataFarm系统中，智能体接收数据请求及目标场景中机器人的一条校准轨迹，并在仿真中重建任务：它编写场景、专家控制器和成功判定器。仿真器提供精确动作，而基于真实图像条件的视频模型将每次rollout渲染为逼真视频，同时一致地生成所有相机视角。输出的是可直接用于真实机器人的数据：与机器人动作标注同步的相机视角，策略可直接基于这些数据训练并部署到真实机器人上。独立评审员在数据入库前对专家控制器及每个渲染轨迹进行认证。在五项真实机器人任务中，仅使用农场数据训练的策略与使用同等数量遥操作轨迹训练的策略表现相当（100次试验中分别成功93次对84次），并且在未见过的桌布和彩色灯光下，农场数据训练的策略保持87次成功，而遥操作训练的策略降至46次。任务适配完全自动化，平均API使用成本为21美元，每项任务支付一次，另加5美元的渲染合约费用；此后每条额外轨迹的平均仿真、渲染和审核成本为0.80美元，无需机器人和操作员。包含这些成本在内，一项任务一小时三视角数据的平均成本为107美元，略低于中国遥操作的117美元报价，也低于北美仅人工成本290美元的水平。
tldr: The paper presents PyRUA-DataFarm, a system where an LLM coding agent automatically rebuilds robot tasks in simulation, generates real-ready training data via a video model, and produces policies that match or outperform teleoperation-trained policies on real robots at lower cost.
tldr_zh: 本文提出PyRUA-DataFarm系统，利用LLM智能体在仿真中自动重建任务，并通过视频模型生成真实可用的训练数据，使策略在真实机器人上达到甚至超过遥操作训练的效果，且成本更低。

title: MotoVerse: A Benchmark for Predictive Perception of Motorized Two-Wheelers in Dense Unstructured Traffic
summary: Motorized Two-Wheelers (MTWs) dominate personal transport across much of the Global South, yet remain largely overlooked in predictive perception research for autonomous driving and ADAS. We introduce MotoVerse, a benchmark for predictive perception from an MTW's ego-centric perspective. MotoVerse comprises 949 maneuver clips collected in dense, unstructured traffic and trajectory annotations for over 31,000 surrounding road agents, including over 16,000 MTWs, enabling two complementary tasks: Ego-Rider Maneuver Anticipation (ERMA) and Traffic Agent Trajectory Prediction (TATP). Each clip is further annotated with an MTW-specific challenge taxonomy comprising dynamic ego-motion, weak traffic structure and contextual occlusion, enabling challenge-aware evaluation. We benchmark established conventional prediction models, general-purpose Vision-Language Models (VLMs), driving-specific VLMs and vision-language-action models. Our experiments reveal three key insights: (i) video backbones reach most of their full-observation accuracy from the first fifth of a maneuver, whereas zero-shot VLMs need most of the maneuver to be observed; (ii) zero-shot VLMs, whether general-purpose or driving-specific, largely remain close to simple baselines on both tasks; a preliminary LoRA study shows that adaptation lifts anticipation sharply but leaves trajectory prediction behind conventional models; and (iii) the rider's own motion drives forecasting difficulty: for every model, including a static baseline, errors are highest during left turns and rise under dynamic ego-motion. We believe MotoVerse will serve as a challenging benchmark for safer and more robust predictive AI for intelligent two-wheelers. The dataset and evaluation code are publicly available at https://github.com/VarunIIITH/MotoVerse.
summary_zh: 电动两轮车（MTW）在全球南方地区的个人出行中占据主导地位，但在自动驾驶和高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）的预测感知研究中却长期被忽视。我们提出了MotoVerse，一个从电动两轮车自我中心视角进行预测感知的基准数据集。MotoVerse包含在密集、非结构化交通中采集的949个机动操作片段，以及超过31,000个周围交通参与者的轨迹标注，其中包括超过16,000辆电动两轮车，支持两个互补任务：骑行者自身机动操作预测（ERMA）和交通参与者轨迹预测（TATP）。每个片段还标注了一个针对电动两轮车特有挑战的分类体系，包括动态自身运动、薄弱的交通结构以及上下文遮挡，从而实现面向挑战的评估。我们对成熟的传统预测模型、通用视觉-语言模型（VLM）、驾驶专用VLM以及视觉-语言-动作模型进行了基准测试。实验揭示了三个关键发现：（i）视频主干网络在机动操作的前五分之一阶段即可达到其全观测精度的大部分，而零样本VLM则需要观测到机动操作的大部分才能达到同等精度；（ii）零样本VLM，无论是通用型还是驾驶专用型，在两个任务上的表现大多接近简单基线；初步的LoRA研究表明，微调能够显著提升机动操作预测性能，但在轨迹预测方面仍落后于传统模型；（iii）骑行者自身的运动是预测难度的主要驱动因素：对于包括静态基线在内的所有模型，左转时的误差最高，且在动态自身运动条件下误差增大。我们相信MotoVerse将为智能两轮车更安全、更稳健的预测人工智能提供一个具有挑战性的基准。数据集和评估代码已公开发布于https://github.com/VarunIIITH/MotoVerse。
tldr: MotoVerse introduces a benchmark for predictive perception of motorized two-wheelers in dense unstructured traffic, with two tasks: ego-rider maneuver anticipation and traffic agent trajectory prediction, and evaluates conventional models, VLMs, and VLA models.
tldr_zh: MotoVerse 提出了一个在密集非结构化交通中用于摩托车预测感知的基准，包含两个任务：骑手机动预测和交通参与者轨迹预测，并评估了传统模型、VLM 和 VLA 模型。

title: When to Ask for Help: Uncertainty-Triggered Aerial Refinement for Off-Road Navigation
summary: Heterogeneous air-ground teams can use aerial sensing to address the limited range and viewpoint of ground-vehicle sensors, but deciding when the UGV needs assistance and what information the UAV should collect remains a challenge. This paper presents a planner-conditioned air-ground assistance method that evaluates how uncertain map information affects the UGV's current MPPI rollouts. When navigation remains degraded, we score the same rollouts under resolved map hypotheses, select the map layer with the largest useful improvement, request the corresponding aerial measurement, fuse the returned information, and replan. Unlike approaches driven by fixed support roles, task structure, or uncertainty alone, our method conditions assistance on whether resolving uncertainty improves predicted ground navigation. Across 180 simulation trials on three off-road routes, the method achieves 98.9% goal attainment while reducing mean UAV flight time by 87.7% relative to continuous greedy aerial mapping. Aggregated across the routes, each second of estimated UAV flight time saves 2.94 s of UGV navigation time. Field experiments spanning approximately 2 km of UGV operation demonstrate uncertainty resolution and successful navigation recovery.
summary_zh: 异构空地团队可以利用空中感知来弥补地面车辆传感器在范围和视角上的局限，但如何判断无人地面车辆（UGV）何时需要辅助，以及无人飞行器（UAV）应采集哪些信息，仍是一个挑战。本文提出了一种基于规划器条件的空地辅助方法，通过评估地图信息的不确定性对UGV当前MPPI轨迹展开的影响来进行决策。当导航性能持续下降时，我们在已解析的地图假设下对相同轨迹展开进行评分，选择具有最大有效改进的地图层，请求相应的空中测量，融合返回的信息，并重新规划路径。与依赖固定支持角色、任务结构或仅依赖不确定性的方法不同，我们的方法以解决不确定性是否能改善预测的地面导航为依据来调节辅助行为。在三条越野路段的180次仿真试验中，该方法实现了98.9%的目标到达率，同时相较于连续贪心式空中测绘，平均降低UAV飞行时间87.7%。综合各路段数据，每估算1秒的UAV飞行时间可节省2.94秒的UGV导航时间。覆盖约2公里UGV运行的实地实验展示了不确定性解析和导航恢复的成功实现。
tldr: This paper introduces a planner-conditioned aerial assistance method for off-road UGV navigation, which triggers UAV measurements only when resolving map uncertainty would improve the UGV's predicted MPPI rollouts. In simulation and field tests, this reduces UAV flight time while improving goal attainment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种规划器条件式空中辅助方法，用于越野UGV导航。仅当消除地图不确定性能够改善UGV的MPPI滚动预测时，才触发UAV测量。仿真和野外实验表明，该方法在减少UAV飞行时间的同时提高了目标到达率。

title: Cognitive and Behavioural Effects of Haptic Feedback for ROV Teleoperation in Hazardous Environments
summary:
Teleoperating a Remotely Operated Vehicle (ROV) in complex underwater environments presents unique challenges. Dynamic, three dimensional obstacles and unseen water currents pose real risks to expensive robotic hardware in environments in which recovery can be next to impossible. This paper explores the cognitive effects of haptic feedback to improve vehicle safety in such environments. An in-water study is analysed with a ROV exposed to controlled cross-currents, with environmental information presented via a soft and vibrating haptic touchpad.
  Results demonstrate that while encountering an unseen cross-current significantly increases an operator's physical and temporal demand, the introduction of haptic feedback mitigates these factors and improves self-assessed performance. Interestingly, the haptic condition also produced the highest levels of mental demand and operator frustration. Despite this increased mental workload, operators drove the ROV significantly faster when receiving haptic cues compared to the current-only condition, indicating a higher level of user confidence. Ultimately, these findings suggest that while haptic feedback may initially require more cognitive processing to interpret unseen hazards, it successfully enhances operator awareness and promotes more confident navigation in hazardous environments.
summary_zh:
在复杂水下环境中远程操作遥控潜水器（ROV）面临独特挑战。动态的三维障碍物和不可见的水流对昂贵的机器人硬件构成真实风险，而在此类环境中，回收几乎不可能实现。本文探讨了触觉反馈在改善此类环境中车辆安全性方面的认知效应。通过一项水中研究，在受控横流条件下对ROV进行测试，并利用柔软且振动的触觉触摸板呈现环境信息。

结果表明，尽管遭遇不可见横流显著增加了操作者的身体负荷和时间需求，但触觉反馈的引入缓解了这些因素，并提升了操作者的自我评估表现。有趣的是，触觉条件也产生了最高的心理需求和操作者挫败感。尽管认知负荷有所增加，与仅存在水流条件相比，接收触觉提示时操作者驾驶ROV的速度显著更快，这表明操作者的信心水平更高。最终，这些发现表明，尽管触觉反馈最初可能需要更多的认知处理来解读不可见危险，但它成功地增强了操作者的态势感知能力，并促进了在危险环境下更自信的导航行为。
tldr: This paper presents an in-water study on the cognitive and behavioral effects of haptic feedback for ROV teleoperation in hazardous underwater environments, showing that haptic cues improve operator awareness and performance despite increasing mental workload.
tldr_zh: 本文通过水下实验研究了触觉反馈对危险环境中ROV遥操作认知和行为的影响，结果表明触觉提示虽增加操作员的心智负荷，但提高了态势感知和操作性能。

title: Detecting Silent Action-Interface Mismatch with Calibrated Relational World Models
summary: A robot action can satisfy shape and range constraints yet carry the wrong semantics: axes may be permuted, signs inverted, rotations rescaled, or gripper polarity reversed. We study learned state-action-effect relations as offline contracts for detecting these mismatches and ranking their likely fields. Clean held-out transitions calibrate alarms; a fixed inverse vocabulary supports closed-set localization. On ten LIBERO Spatial tasks comprising 432 source episodes, a capacity-controlled comparison at 2.5% empirical clean false-positive rate gives 46.1% recall for a ridge forward residual, 61.0% for a four-component joint Gaussian mixture, and 65.7% for the exact conditional of that same mixture. The joint score retains a 14.9 percentage-point advantage over ridge, while conditioning improves recall by a further 4.7 points. Joint scoring instead has higher localization: 95.8% versus 94.6%. These matched-rate comparisons are retrospective diagnostics, not deployment calibration guarantees. Earlier Object/Goal results broaden tasks within the LIBERO convention; DROID, all three HYDRA tasks, short temporal faults, small offsets, exact repair, and simulated mitigation fail their respective gates, while xArm contributes one task only. The evidence supports a bounded offline diagnostic and a detection-localization tradeoff, rather than joint-density superiority or cross-robot safety.
summary_zh: 机器人动作可以满足形状和范围约束，却可能携带错误的语义：轴序可能被置换、符号可能被反转、旋转尺度可能被改变，或夹爪极性可能颠倒。我们研究学习得到的状态-动作-效果关系，将其作为离线契约，用于检测这些不匹配并对其可能的字段进行排序。干净的留出转换用于校准警报；固定的逆语义词典支持闭集定位。在包含432个源情节的十个LIBERO空间任务上，在2.5%经验干净误报率下进行的容量控制比较中，岭前向残差取得了46.1%的召回率，四分量联合高斯混合取得了61.0%，而同一混合模型的精确条件分布取得了65.7%。联合评分相对于岭保留了14.9个百分点的优势，而条件化进一步将召回率提升了4.7个百分点。联合评分则在定位上表现更高：95.8%对94.6%。这些匹配率比较属于回顾性诊断，而非部署校准保证。早期的Object/Goal结果拓宽了LIBERO约定内的任务范围；DROID、全部三个HYDRA任务、短时时间故障、小偏移、精确修复以及模拟缓解均未通过各自的检验门槛，而xArm仅贡献了一个任务。证据支持有界的离线诊断和检测-定位权衡，而非联合密度的优越性或跨机器人安全性。
tldr: This paper proposes calibrated relational world models to detect silent action-interface mismatches in robot policies, validating the approach on LIBERO tasks and showing a detection-localization tradeoff rather than joint-density superiority or cross-robot safety.
tldr_zh: 本文提出使用校准的关系世界模型来检测机器人策略中的静默动作-接口不匹配，在LIBERO任务上进行验证，并展示了检测-定位权衡而非联合密度优越性或跨机器人安全性。

title: FOSCo-Net: Ego-centric Voxel Completion for Forest LiDAR Occlusions
summary: Ground robots operating in temperate forests suffer from systematic LiDAR occlusions caused by tree trunks, creating persistent blind regions that degrade traversability estimation. In this paper, we propose FOSCo-Net, a self-supervised voxel completion framework that learns to reconstruct occluded geometry from a single scan using temporally accumulated observations as automatic supervision, and we evaluate cylindrical and Cartesian ego-centric grids with multiple decoder designs. FOSCo-Net consistently improves reconstruction quality and traversal safety, with a gated skip decoder achieving the most reliable performance and significantly reducing false obstacle predictions compared to baselines.
summary_zh: 温带森林中运行的地面机器人常因树干遮挡而遭受系统性激光雷达盲区，这些持续存在的视觉死角会降低可通行性评估的准确性。本文提出FOSCo-Net，一种自监督体素补全框架，通过利用时间累积观测作为自动监督信号，学习从单次扫描中重建被遮挡的几何结构，并评估了柱坐标与笛卡尔坐标下的自中心网格及多种解码器设计。实验表明，FOSCo-Net在重建质量和通行安全性方面均有一致提升，其中门控跳跃解码器实现了最稳定的性能，与基线方法相比显著减少了虚假障碍物预测。
tldr: FOSCo-Net is a self-supervised voxel completion framework that reconstructs occluded geometry from single LiDAR scans in forest environments, using temporally accumulated observations as supervision to improve traversability estimation and reduce false obstacle predictions for ground robots.
tldr_zh: FOSCo-Net 是一个自监督体素补全框架，利用时间累积观测作为监督，从单次LiDAR扫描中重建森林环境中被遮挡的几何结构，以提高可通行性估计并减少地面机器人的虚假障碍预测。

title: Robocasa-Mem: Benchmarking Environment and Process Memory in Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
summary: In the real world, mobile manipulation robots must perform complex object interactions and make multi-step decisions, often relying on task-relevant information that is no longer observable. However, existing benchmarks provide limited evaluation of such memory-dependent decision-making in mobile manipulation. To address this gap, we introduce RoboCasa-Mem, a new benchmark comprising nine mobile manipulation tasks that require agents to use interaction history at key decision points. Specifically, the tasks are grouped into two categories of memory: One is environment memory, which captures spatial locations, object attributes, and object relationships. The other is process memory, which captures single-task progress and multi-task scheduling. Particularly, we introduce Behavior-Conditioned Evaluation. For tasks with multiple valid execution paths, instead of fixing a single target or trajectory, the evaluator derives later task constraints from the robot's earlier actions. This allows us to evaluate whether later behavior is consistent with the robot's own interaction history while reducing shortcuts based on fixed target assignments. We provide 1,800 successful demonstrations for policy training. We also develop a baseline on our benchmark, namely Hierarchical Memory-Augmented Policy(HMAP). Its high-level planner uses structured entity and process memories to generate subtasks. Its low-level VLA controller uses subgoal-conditioned queries to incorporate VGGT-Omega geometry into action generation. Together, RoboCasa-Mem and HMAP baseline support systematic evaluation of memory-dependent behavior and the development of memory-aware mobile manipulation policies.
summary_zh: 在现实世界中，移动操作机器人必须执行复杂的物体交互并进行多步决策，且常常需要依赖已无法直接观测到的任务相关信息。然而，现有基准测试对移动操作中此类依赖记忆的决策能力的评估十分有限。为填补这一空白，我们提出了RoboCasa-Mem——一个包含九个移动操作任务的新基准测试，要求智能体在关键决策点利用交互历史信息。具体而言，这些任务被分为两类记忆：一类是环境记忆，用于捕捉空间位置、物体属性和物体之间的关系；另一类是过程记忆，用于捕捉单任务进度和多任务调度信息。此外，我们引入了行为条件化评估方法。对于存在多条有效执行路径的任务，评估器不再固定单一目标或轨迹，而是根据机器人先前动作推导后续任务约束。此举使我们能够评估后续行为是否与机器人自身的交互历史一致，同时减少基于固定目标分配所带来的捷径行为。我们提供了1,800条成功的示范数据用于策略训练。同时，我们开发了一个基线方法，即层次化记忆增强策略（Hierarchical Memory-Augmented Policy，HMAP）。其高层规划器利用结构化实体和过程记忆生成子任务，底层视觉-语言-动作（VLA）控制器则通过子目标条件化查询，将VGGT-Omega几何信息融入动作生成过程。RoboCasa-Mem与HMAP基线共同支持对依赖记忆行为的系统评估，并推动感知记忆的移动操作策略的发展。
tldr: RoboCasa-Mem introduces a benchmark for memory-dependent long-horizon mobile manipulation with nine tasks and a Hierarchical Memory-Augmented Policy baseline.
tldr_zh: RoboCasa-Mem 提出了一个用于长时程移动操作中记忆依赖决策的基准，包含九个任务和分层记忆增强策略基线。

title: TwinBridge: Digital Twin-Driven Policy and Reward Transfer for Real-World Reinforcement Learning in Laboratory Robotics
summary: Online reinforcement learning offers an effective approach to precise laboratory manipulation, yet costly real-world demonstrations and limited access to dense process rewards hinder its practical application. We present TwinBridge, a digital twin-driven framework that supplies policy initialization and dense visual rewards for real-world online learning. We construct digital twins by combining 3D Gaussian splatting with physics simulation. Here, simulator states provide task events and geometric progress under physical prerequisites and ordering constraints, yielding rewards for policy pretraining with simulated demonstrations and reinforcement learning. We distill this supervision into a visual reward model. During real-world interaction, its predictions are combined with execution history to compute dense rewards for human-in-the-loop policy refinement. Across five real-world laboratory tasks, TwinBridge achieves a final mean autonomous success rate of 98% with at most 25 minutes of real-world interaction per task. Experiments show that dense rewards improve interaction efficiency over sparse rewards, and simulation-based policy initialization further accelerates learning.
summary_zh: 在线强化学习为精确的实验室操作提供了一种有效方法，然而昂贵的真实世界演示和有限的密集过程奖励获取途径限制了其实际应用。我们提出了TwinBridge，一种数字孪生驱动框架，为真实世界的在线学习提供策略初始化和密集视觉奖励。我们通过将3D高斯溅射与物理模拟相结合来构建数字孪生。在此框架中，模拟器状态在物理前提条件和排序约束下提供任务事件和几何进展，从而为基于模拟演示的强化学习提供策略预训练所需的奖励。我们将这种监督信息蒸馏为视觉奖励模型。在真实世界交互过程中，其预测结果与执行历史相结合，用于计算密集奖励，以实现人在回路中的策略优化。在五个真实世界实验室任务中，TwinBridge达到了98%的最终平均自主成功率，每个任务最多只需25分钟的真实世界交互。实验表明，与稀疏奖励相比，密集奖励提高了交互效率，而基于模拟的策略初始化进一步加速了学习过程。
tldr: TwinBridge uses digital twins built with 3D Gaussian splatting and physics simulation to provide policy initialization and dense visual rewards, achieving 98% autonomous success across five real-world laboratory tasks with minimal real-world interaction.
tldr_zh: TwinBridge利用3D高斯泼溅与物理仿真构建数字孪生，提供策略初始化和密集视觉奖励，在五类真实实验室任务中以最少真实交互实现98%的自主成功率。

title: Corridor-Based Monitoring and Emergency Braking Decision for Automated Vehicle Safety
summary: This paper addresses emergency-braking decisions for a redundant safety channel in automated vehicles. The channel is responsible for identifying hazards from sensor data and determining whether braking is necessary, given the constrained computational resources of embedded hardware. We present an emergency-braking approach that uses a predicted motion corridor to filter \ac{lidar} measurements and then decide whether the ego vehicle must brake. \ac{pmcm} constructs a curvature-aware boundary from the planned path and vehicle geometry so that the monitored region contains the full swept body on both straight and curved paths. \ac{gdeta} then decides whether the ego vehicle must command an emergency brake for objects inside this boundary, scoring geometric occupancy and temporal urgency independently. Hard gates permit braking when either source is conclusive; soft-OR arbitration combines partial evidence when neither gate is active. Consecutive-scan confirmation reduces sensitivity to transient measurement noise. Corridor coverage is evaluated in controlled collision simulations and recorded campus driving. Braking decisions are evaluated in Monte Carlo simulations of lead-vehicle braking and transverse-crossing encounters.
summary_zh: 本文针对自动驾驶车辆中冗余安全通道的紧急制动决策问题展开研究。该通道负责从传感器数据中识别危险，并在嵌入式硬件计算资源受限的条件下判断是否需要制动。我们提出了一种紧急制动方法，利用预测运动走廊对激光雷达测量数据进行过滤，进而决定自车是否必须制动。预测运动走廊模型根据规划路径和车辆几何构造曲率感知边界，使得监测区域在直道和弯道上均包含车辆完整扫掠体。广义动态紧急制动判定算法随后针对该边界内的物体，判断自车是否必须发出紧急制动指令，并对几何占用和时间紧迫性进行独立评分。当任一来源的判定结果确定时，硬门控机制允许触发制动；当两个门控均未激活时，软OR仲裁机制则结合部分证据进行综合判断。连续扫描确认机制降低了对瞬时测量噪声的敏感性。走廊覆盖率在受控碰撞仿真和记录的园区行驶数据中进行了评估。制动决策则在蒙特卡洛仿真中，针对前车制动和横向穿越相遇场景进行了评估。
tldr: This paper proposes a redundant safety channel for automated vehicles that uses a predicted motion corridor to filter LiDAR measurements and an emergency-braking decision module, validated through simulations and real-world driving data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶车辆冗余安全通道的紧急制动决策方法，利用预测运动走廊过滤激光雷达数据，并通过仿真和真实驾驶数据验证。

title: Riemannian Optimization-based Whole-body Obstacle Avoidance for Mobile Continuum Robots in Cluttered Environments
summary: Inspired by the coordination of global motion and local shape adaptation in snakes, elephant trunks, and octopus arms, we propose a unified planning and control framework for mobile continuum robots in cluttered and confined environments. Existing approaches often address high-level path planning and local motion control separately, limiting coordinated base-arm motion, kinematic consistency, and collision avoidance. Our framework integrates long-horizon trajectory planning with real-time geometric refinement under kinematic and environmental constraints. The global layer combines A* search with minimum-jerk planning to generate smooth reference trajectories. The local layer uses a geometry-consistent inverse kinematics solver and Riemannian optimization to coordinate mobile-base motion and continuum deformation while avoiding obstacles. We evaluate the framework through simulated pipe-traversal tasks with multiple baseline planners and real-world experiments involving navigation among dense obstacles and manipulation in confined spaces. Results demonstrate improved motion consistency, feasibility, and adaptability, supporting coordinated whole-body motion of mobile continuum robots in constrained environments.
summary_zh: 受蛇、象鼻及章鱼臂中全局运动与局部形状自适应协调机制的启发，本文提出了一种面向杂乱且受限环境中移动连续体机器人的统一规划与控制框架。现有方法通常将高层路径规划与局部运动控制分开处理，导致基座-机械臂协调运动、运动学一致性及避障能力受限。该框架在运动学与环境约束下，将长时程轨迹规划与实时几何优化相融合。全局层结合A*搜索与最小加加速度规划，生成平滑参考轨迹；局部层则利用几何一致性逆运动学求解器及黎曼优化，协调移动基座运动与连续体变形，同时实现避障。我们通过多组基线规划器下的管道穿越仿真任务，以及涉及密集障碍物间导航与受限空间内操作的真实实验，对所提框架进行了评估。结果表明，该方法在运动一致性、可行性与适应性方面均有所提升，能够有效支持移动连续体机器人在受限环境中的全身协调运动。
tldr: This paper proposes a unified planning and control framework for mobile continuum robots, integrating A* and minimum-jerk global planning with Riemannian optimization-based local geometric refinement for coordinated whole-body obstacle avoidance, validated in simulated and real-world cluttered environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向移动连续体机器人的统一规划与控制框架，将A*和最小加加速度全局规划与基于黎曼优化的局部几何细化相结合，实现协同全身避障，并在仿真和真实杂乱环境中得到验证。

title: Beyond Terminal Constraints: Reliable Robot Control with Learned Safe Sets
summary: Ensuring safety in advanced robot control methods such as Model Predictive Control (MPC) and Reinforcement Learning remains an open challenge. A common approach relies on control-invariant sets, yet their exact computation for nonlinear systems is generally intractable, and numerical approximations compromise theoretical guarantees. In this work, we show that safety does not need to rely exclusively on control invariance. We introduce novel classes of safe sets, each broader than classical control-invariant sets, and analyze corresponding MPC schemes that guarantee recursive feasibility by constraining different nodes of the prediction horizon rather than only the terminal state. Furthermore, when the safe set is an inner approximation of a suitable control-invariant set, our methods can ensure safety through a safe-abort strategy, even in the absence of recursive feasibility. We validate our approaches in extensive simulations on a 6-joint robot manipulator, showing fewer constraint violations than state-of-the-art methods while maintaining comparable tracking performance and computational efficiency. Hardware experiments further demonstrate the practicality of our schemes for real-world robotic applications.
summary_zh: 先进机器人控制方法（如模型预测控制与强化学习）中的安全性保障仍是一个开放的挑战。常用方法依赖于控制不变集，然而对于非线性系统而言，其精确计算通常难以实现，而数值近似则会削弱理论保证。在本研究中，我们证明安全性并不必然依赖于控制不变性。我们引入了若干新颖的安全集合类别，每一类都比经典控制不变集更为宽泛，并分析了相应的模型预测控制方案，这些方案通过约束预测时域中的不同节点而非仅约束终端状态，从而保证递归可行性。此外，当安全集合是适当控制不变集的内逼近时，即使在缺乏递归可行性的情况下，我们的方法也能通过安全中止策略确保安全性。我们在一个六关节机器人操作器上进行了大量仿真验证，结果表明所提方法相较于现有最优方法减少了约束违反次数，同时保持了可比的跟踪性能与计算效率。硬件实验进一步证明了所提方案在实际机器人应用中的实用性。
tldr: This paper proposes new classes of safe sets that are broader than classical control-invariant sets and corresponding MPC schemes ensuring recursive feasibility by constraining different prediction horizon nodes, validated on a 6-joint robot manipulator in simulation and hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了比经典控制不变集更广的新安全集类别，以及通过在预测时域不同节点施加约束来保证递归可行性的MPC方案，并在六关节机械臂的仿真和硬件实验中验证了其有效性。

title: Online Adaptation to Latent Physical Properties for Learning from Demonstration
summary: Manipulating visually identical objects with different physical properties requires adapting actions based on information acquired through interaction. We address the problem of learning from demonstrations how to adapt manipulation actions, such as regrasping and changing contact locations, based on physical-property information acquired during interaction. To this end, we propose a learning-from-demonstration method that learns latent representations of physical properties needed to predict object responses and conditions a policy on online estimates of these representations. A dynamics model and object-specific latent representations are jointly learned from demonstrations that include behaviors adapting to the objects' physical properties, and the learned representations are then used to condition an imitation policy. During execution, the dynamics model and policy weights remain fixed, while the latent representation is updated based on the discrepancy between predicted and actual observations, allowing interaction with the object to inform action generation. Real-world and simulation experiments with objects whose centers of mass differ suggest that online adaptation through latent representations of physical properties can improve task success rates. However, in simulation, success rates on center-of-mass locations absent from the demonstrations remained around 30%, indicating limited adaptation to unseen physical properties. Project page: https://isri-aist.github.io/latent-dynamics-project-page/
summary_zh: 操作视觉上相同但物理属性不同的物体，需要根据交互过程中获取的信息来调整动作。我们针对从示范中学习如何基于交互期间获得的物理属性信息来调整操作动作（如重新抓取和改变接触位置）的问题展开研究。为此，我们提出了一种从示范中学习的方法，该方法学习预测物体响应所需的物理属性潜在表征，并基于这些表征的在线估计来条件化策略。我们通过包含适应物体物理属性行为的示范，联合学习动力学模型和物体特有的潜在表征，随后利用学习到的表征来条件化模仿策略。在执行过程中，动力学模型和策略权重保持固定，而潜在表征则根据预测观测与实际观测之间的差异进行更新，从而使与物体的交互能够指导动作生成。针对质心不同的物体进行的真实世界和仿真实验表明，通过物理属性潜在表征进行在线适应能够提高任务成功率。然而，在仿真中，对于示范中未出现的质心位置，成功率仍维持在30%左右，这表明对未见物理属性的适应能力有限。项目页面：https://isri-aist.github.io/latent-dynamics-project-page/
tldr: This paper proposes a learning-from-demonstration method that learns latent representations of object physical properties, enabling a policy to adapt actions online based on prediction errors, with experiments on objects with different centers of mass.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种从演示中学习的方法，学习物体物理属性的潜在表征，使策略能够根据预测误差在线调整动作，并在不同质心物体上进行了实验。

title: LumiTac: Compact, High-Rate Six-Axis Optical Tactile Sensing for Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Integrating six-axis tactile feedback into robotic interfaces requires compact sensors with accurate load measurement and rapid online reconstruction. This paper presents LumiTac, a low-profile, camera-free optoelectronic tactile sensor combining spatially distributed illumination with spectral encoding. Five photoemitters and five RGBW photoreceivers are mounted on opposing circuit boards coupled through translucent silicone. Load-induced interlayer motion modulates the internal light field under compression, shear, bending, and torsion. The sensing head measures 12 mm in diameter and 4.75 mm in thickness, weighs less than 2 g, and has a component cost of approximately USD 7. A compact multilayer perceptron reconstructs three force and three moment components from 20 optical channels. Independent testing yielded coefficients of determination (R-squared) of 0.9657-0.9941, with mean absolute errors of 0.054-0.190 N for forces and 0.304-1.419 mN m for moments. Online prediction achieved an average update rate of 303.57 Hz and a median software processing latency of 0.722 ms. Experiments involving combined loading, light weights, and rapid tapping evaluated load tracking, sensitivity to small forces, and transient response, respectively. Robotic demonstrations further validated its applicability to tactile-guided manipulation and physical human-robot interaction. This study paves the way for compact, high-rate optical tactile sensing in robotic manipulation and human-robot interaction.
summary_zh: 将六轴触觉反馈集成到机器人接口中，需要具备精确载荷测量和快速在线重建能力的紧凑型传感器。本文提出了LumiTac，一种低剖面、无相机的光电触觉传感器，结合了空间分布照明与光谱编码。五个光发射器和五个RGBW光接收器安装在相对的电路板上，通过半透明硅胶耦合。载荷引起的层间运动在压缩、剪切、弯曲和扭转作用下调制内部光场。传感头直径为12 mm，厚度为4.75 mm，重量小于2 g，组件成本约为7美元。一个紧凑的多层感知器从20个光学通道中重建三个力分量和三个力矩分量。独立测试得到的决定系数（R²）为0.9657-0.9941，力的平均绝对误差为0.054-0.190 N，力矩的平均绝对误差为0.304-1.419 mN·m。在线预测的平均更新频率为303.57 Hz，软件处理中位延迟为0.722 ms。实验涉及组合加载、轻载荷和快速敲击，分别评估了载荷跟踪、小力灵敏度和瞬态响应。机器人演示进一步验证了其在触觉引导操作和物理人机交互中的适用性。这项研究为机器人操作和人机交互中紧凑、高速光学触觉感知铺平了道路。
tldr: LumiTac presents a compact, camera-free six-axis optical tactile sensor with high-rate reconstruction, validated for tactile-guided manipulation and physical human-robot interaction.
tldr_zh: LumiTac 提出了一种紧凑、无相机的六轴光学触觉传感器，具有高速重建能力，并在触觉引导操作和物理人机交互中得到验证。

title: FWIK: Multi-Waypoint IK Selection via Lookahead Graph Search
summary: An ordered sequence of end-effector poses can give a redundant robot arm multiple valid joint configurations at each waypoint. Inverse kinematics (IK) computes these configurations. Choosing a configuration only for the next waypoint can leave the arm poorly placed for later waypoints. This may increase planned motion time or cause a later planning failure. This paper presents Future-Window Inverse Kinematics (FWIK), an online method that selects IK solutions by considering a small window of future waypoints. FWIK generates several IK candidates, connects them in a layered joint-space graph, and ranks candidate paths with a simple motion-time estimate. A learned model removes paths whose transitions are likely to cause self-collision. A standard MoveIt 2 planner then checks the next-waypoint IK goals from the remaining paths in ranked order, and the first goal that yields a valid trajectory is selected for execution. We evaluate FWIK in simulation on two 7-DoF manipulators, the Franka Emika Panda and the KUKA LBR iiwa. Each method-planner setting contains five repetitions of 100 sequences with 50 waypoints. Across Pilz, RRT-Connect, CHOMP, and STOMP, FWIK completes 96.8-100% of sequences and gives the shortest planned trajectory duration in all eight robot-planner settings. Its mean duration is 12.8-13.1% lower than STAMPEDE, 22.5-25.6% lower than IKLink, and 27.5-37.2% lower than retry-based TRAC-IK. The results show that a small future window can improve sequence completion and reduce planned motion time while leaving final trajectory validation to the motion planner.
summary_zh: 有序的末端执行器位姿序列可为冗余机械臂在每个路径点提供多个有效的关节配置。逆运动学（IK）用于计算这些配置。若仅为下一个路径点选择配置，可能导致机械臂在后续路径点处于不利位置，从而增加规划运动时间或导致后续规划失败。本文提出未来窗口逆运动学（FWIK）方法，这是一种通过考虑一小段未来路径点来选择IK解的在线方法。FWIK生成多个IK候选解，在分层关节空间图中将其连接，并使用简单的运动时间估计对候选路径进行排序。学习模型用于剔除可能引发自碰撞的路径转换。随后，标准MoveIt 2规划器按排序顺序检查剩余路径中的下一路径点IK目标，选择首个生成有效轨迹的目标予以执行。我们在两个七自由度机械臂（Franka Emika Panda和KUKA LBR iiwa）上进行了仿真评估。每种方法-规划器组合包含五次重复实验，每次包含100个序列，每个序列含50个路径点。在Pilz、RRT-Connect、CHOMP和STOMP四种规划器下，FWIK完成了96.8%-100%的序列，并在全部八种机器人-规划器组合中获得了最短的规划轨迹持续时间。其平均持续时间比STAMPEDE低12.8%-13.1%，比IKLink低22.5%-25.6%，比基于重试的TRAC-IK低27.5%-37.2%。结果表明，较小的未来窗口能够提高序列完成率并减少规划运动时间，同时将最终轨迹验证交由运动规划器完成。
tldr: FWIK is a motion-planning method that selects IK solutions for a window of future waypoints, improving sequence completion and reducing planned motion time for redundant robot arms.
tldr_zh: FWIK 是一种运动规划方法，通过考虑未来路径点窗口来选择逆运动学解，提高了序列完成率并减少了冗余机械臂的规划运动时间。

title: Time-to-Goal: Learned Temporal Metrics for Long-Horizon Planning with JEPA World Models
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) support planning by comparing predicted latent states with an encoded goal. For this comparison to guide temporal progress, states closer in time to the goal should receive lower costs. However, training representations for prediction and distribution regularization does not directly enforce this ordering. We examine this mismatch in flat LeWorldModel (LeWM) by analyzing how its Euclidean goal cost changes with temporal separation. Our analysis identifies conditions under which states at different long offsets receive similar average costs, weakening their temporal distinction. To learn the missing ordering explicitly, we introduce Time-to-Goal (T2G), a lightweight metric trained on latent triples from offline trajectories. A margin ranking loss encourages smaller distances for temporally nearer states, requiring no rewards or policy labels. The learned metric then replaces the Euclidean planning cost while the JEPA encoder and predictor remain frozen. Diagnostics on AntMaze and FourRoom show that T2G preserves stronger temporal contrast and improves near--far ranking at long offsets. Across four navigation and manipulation benchmarks, T2G improves the average planning success rate from 32.7\% (flat LeWM) to 63.0\% and approaches or even surpasses the performance of the hierarchical H-JEPA baselines. These results show that learning temporal ordering for the goal cost can substantially improve latent planning even with a flat world model.
summary_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）通过比较预测的潜在状态与编码目标来支持规划。为使这种比较能够引导时间上的进展，更接近目标时间点的状态应获得更低的代价。然而，为预测和分布正则化而训练表征并不直接强制这一排序。我们在扁平LeWorldModel（LeWM）中通过分析其欧几里得目标代价随时间间隔的变化规律，考察了这一不匹配问题。分析揭示了在何种条件下，处于不同长偏移量的状态会获得相似的平均代价，从而削弱其时间区分度。为显式学习缺失的排序关系，我们引入了目标时间（T2G），一种基于离线轨迹中的潜在三元组训练的轻量级度量。边际排序损失鼓励时间上更接近的状态具有更小的距离，且无需奖励或策略标签。所学度量随后替代欧几里得规划代价，而JEPA编码器和预测器保持冻结。在AntMaze和FourRoom上的诊断实验表明，T2G保持了更强的时间对比度，并在长偏移量下改善了近-远排序。在四个导航和操作基准任务中，T2G将平均规划成功率从32.7\%（扁平LeWM）提升至63.0\%，并接近甚至超越了分层H-JEPA基线的性能。这些结果表明，即使采用扁平世界模型，学习目标代价的时间排序也能显著改进潜在规划。
tldr: This paper proposes Time-to-Goal (T2G), a learned temporal metric for JEPA world models that improves long-horizon planning by training a cost function to preserve temporal ordering of latent states, significantly boosting success rates in navigation and manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出时间到目标（T2G）指标，用于JEPA世界模型，通过学习保持潜在状态时间顺序的成本函数改善长时域规划，在导航和操作基准中显著提升成功率。

title: RACE: Calibrated Cumulative Scoring for Rollout-Free Robot Policy Checkpoint Selection
summary: Assessing the deployment performance of learned robot policies during training is challenging, as directly measuring task success requires costly real-world trials for each candidate checkpoint. Averaged validation loss offers a rollout-free alternative, but its checkpoint rankings can be inconsistent with deployment performance. We analyze two limitations of this criterion: it penalizes action deviations without considering whether the policy can recover from them, and gives later reference predictions equal weight even when earlier deviations may lead execution away from the reference. We propose RACE, a novel rollout-free metric for ranking checkpoints using a fixed set of held-out successful trajectories. RACE calibrates action deviations against state-conditional thresholds derived from action differences at similar states in these trajectories. We aggregate these scores through a running product, so that a substantial deviation reduces the contribution of subsequent reference predictions. Averaging the resulting cumulative scores over time and across trajectories yields the checkpoint score. In simulation, RACE outperforms baselines across validation sources, while several baselines degrade sharply when the validation set changes. On real robots, its rankings align with deployment success across the evaluated policy backbones and tasks of varying difficulty. Perturbation analyses further show that RACE distinguishes deviations with markedly different effects on task success, even when baselines respond similarly.
summary_zh: 评估训练过程中学习型机器人策略的部署性能具有挑战性，因为直接衡量任务成功需要对每个候选检查点进行代价高昂的真实世界试验。平均验证损失提供了一种无需实际部署的替代方案，但其检查点排名可能与部署性能不一致。我们分析了该标准的两个局限性：它惩罚动作偏差而不考虑策略是否能从中恢复；并且当早期偏差可能导致执行偏离参考轨迹时，它对后续参考预测赋予同等权重。我们提出RACE，一种新颖的免部署指标，利用一组固定的成功轨迹来对检查点进行排名。RACE根据这些轨迹中相似状态下的动作差异推导出的状态条件阈值，对动作偏差进行校准。我们通过累积乘积的方式聚合这些分数，使得显著偏差会降低后续参考预测的贡献。将所得累积分数在时间维度和各轨迹间取平均，即得到检查点得分。在仿真中，RACE在不同验证源上的表现均优于基线方法，而若干基线方法在验证集变化时性能急剧下降。在真实机器人上，其排名与不同策略主干及不同难度任务上的部署成功率保持一致。扰动分析进一步表明，即使基线对偏差的响应相似，RACE也能区分对任务成功具有显著不同影响的偏差。
tldr: RACE proposes a rollout-free metric for ranking robot policy checkpoints by calibrating action deviations against state-conditional thresholds and aggregating via a running product, improving correlation with deployment success in simulation and on real robots.
tldr_zh: RACE 提出了一种免回滚的策略检查点排序指标，通过状态条件阈值校准动作偏差并采用连乘聚合，在仿真和真实机器人上提升了与部署成功率的关联性。

title: OdorSpaces: Visual-Olfactory Embodied Navigation in 3D Environments
summary: Olfaction provides critical information about airborne chemical cues, yet it remains largely underexplored in embodied AI, with limited prior machine olfaction work focusing primarily on semantic odor perception. We introduce OdorSpaces, a physics-based simulation platform and benchmark for visual-olfactory embodied navigation. OdorSpaces augments Habitat-Sim with 3D odor transport and dispersion simulated by Fire Dynamics Simulator (FDS), enabling agents to navigate photorealistic indoor environments using both visual and olfactory observations. The benchmark includes two representative source-seeking scenarios: invisible gas-leak localization and early-stage fire localization. We develop an initial multimodal reinforcement learning policy that integrates visual observations and olfactory measurements over time. Experiments show that the policy outperforms a diverse set of baselines, establishing a strong reference for future research on visual-olfactory embodied navigation.
summary_zh: 嗅觉提供了关于空气中化学线索的关键信息，然而在具身人工智能领域，这一感知方式仍未得到充分探索，此前有限的机器嗅觉研究主要集中于语义层面的气味感知。我们提出了OdorSpaces，一个基于物理仿真平台及基准测试，用于视觉-嗅觉具身导航。OdorSpaces在Habitat-Sim的基础上，集成了由火灾动力学模拟器（FDS）模拟的三维气味传输与扩散过程，使智能体能够在逼真的室内环境中，同时利用视觉和嗅觉观测进行导航。该基准测试包含两个具有代表性的源搜索场景：不可见气体泄漏定位和火灾初期定位。我们开发了一种初始的多模态强化学习策略，该策略在时间维度上整合了视觉观测与嗅觉测量。实验结果表明，该策略优于多种基线方法，为未来视觉-嗅觉具身导航研究树立了强有力的参考基准。
tldr: OdorSpaces introduces a physics-based visual-olfactory embodied navigation benchmark in 3D environments, with an initial multimodal RL policy for source-seeking tasks.
tldr_zh: OdorSpaces 提出了一个基于物理的 3D 环境中视觉-嗅觉具身导航基准，以及一个用于源搜索任务的多模态 RL 策略。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Information-Theoretic Decoder Evaluation Under Latent Intent
summary: A central challenge in assistive brain-to-robot control is decoding a user's latent intent from complex and noisy brain signals. Prior approaches evaluate decoders as single-trial classifiers with accuracy-based metrics, but this neglects the inherently sequential nature of assistive control. Since a planner must integrate intermittent, noisy decoder outputs over time, single-step accuracy can only be a proxy when predicting downstream task performance. We formalize brain-to-robot control as a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP), and prove that there is a sharp phase transition: regret is uniformly bounded across the horizon as long as pairs of goals are all decoder-distinguishable, but grows linearly otherwise. We show that a single channel statistic, the worst-pair Chernoff information $Γ_{\min}$ sets this boundary. Then, we derive a closed-form regret predictor $U_{\mathrm{id}}(C)$, that can be computed from any confusion matrix in $O(K^2)$ time. Across two domains spanning orthogonal information channels, we show that $U_{\mathrm{id}}$ predicts cumulative planning regret beyond what accuracy can explain. We then highlight a pathological accuracy trap, in which two decoders have identical validation accuracy 35.1% on real EEG data (BNCI2014001 subject 5) but result in a difference of $9.6\times$ in held-out regret, which $U_{\mathrm{id}}$ predicts. Same-signal control confirms $U_{\mathrm{id}}$'s advantage with decoders that span independent feature channels. Ultimately, our work provides a drop-in diagnostic to evaluate and select sensors and decoders in sequential assistive control.
summary_zh: 辅助型脑-机器人控制中的一个核心挑战在于，如何从复杂且充满噪声的脑信号中解码出用户的潜在意图。以往的方法将解码器作为单次试验分类器，并采用基于准确率的指标进行评估，但这忽略了辅助控制本质上具有的序列性特征。由于规划器必须在时间上整合间歇性的、带有噪声的解码器输出，因此在预测下游任务表现时，单步准确率只能作为一个代理指标。我们将脑-机器人控制形式化为一个部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），并证明存在一个尖锐的相变：只要目标对在解码器上均可区分，遗憾值在整个时间跨度上一致有界；否则，遗憾值将线性增长。我们表明，单一通道统计量——最差目标对Chernoff信息 $Γ_{\min}$——决定了这一边界。随后，我们推导出一个闭式遗憾预测器 $U_{\mathrm{id}}(C)$，该预测器可在 $O(K^2)$ 时间内从任意混淆矩阵计算得出。在两个涵盖正交信息通道的领域中，我们展示了 $U_{\mathrm{id}}$ 能够预测累积规划遗憾，其预测能力超出了准确率所能解释的范围。我们进一步揭示了一个病理性的准确率陷阱：在真实脑电图数据（BNCI2014001 受试者5）上，两个解码器的验证准确率同为35.1%，但在留出集上的遗憾值却相差 $9.6\times$，而 $U_{\mathrm{id}}$ 能够准确预测这一差异。同信号控制实验进一步证实了 $U_{\mathrm{id}}$ 在跨越独立特征通道的解码器中的优势。最终，我们的工作为序列性辅助控制中的传感器与解码器评估和选择提供了一种即插即用的诊断工具。
tldr: This paper proposes an information-theoretic metric, U_id, for evaluating brain-to-robot decoders under latent intent, showing that it predicts cumulative planning regret better than accuracy and can identify accuracy traps in assistive control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种信息论度量U_id，用于评估潜在意图下的脑机接口解码器，证明其比准确率更能预测累积规划遗憾，并能识别辅助控制中的准确率陷阱。

title: Visibility-Aware Reference Generation for Benchmarking Visual 3D Reconstruction in Vegetation-Rich Environments
summary: Reliable evaluation of visual 3D reconstruction and depth estimation in vegetation-rich outdoor environments is limited by the scarcity of geometric ground-truth data and the cost of complete scanner surveys. We present a LiDARbased reference-generation pipeline for evaluating the zero-shot performance of feed-forward visual-geometry models alongside conventional structure-from-motion (SfM) methods. The pipeline reuses camera images, LiDAR scans, and reference poses from existing multi-sensor localization datasets to generate per-view depth maps and visible reference point clouds. To address visibility errors in accumulated LiDAR scans, we introduce the LargeDepth-Gap Visibility Score (LDGVS) for point-wise visibility filtering and automatic scale selection in Hidden Point Removal(HPR). Experiments on TartanAirV2 and TartanGround show that, compared with Poisson surface reconstruction, which is an approach suited to completed scan surveys, the combined HPR and LDGVS filtering retains approximately three times the point density at comparable absolute relative error. We also apply the pipeline to the BotanicGarden dataset to systematically compare depth estimation and 3D reconstruction methods. Feedforward methods produce dense depth predictions efficiently, but their 3D reconstructions can contain duplicated structures. Conventional SfM generally produces more coherent geometry, but its reconstructions remain sparse and more prone to failure in challenging vegetated scenes. The benchmark toolkit and datasets will be released.
summary_zh: 评估植被茂密的室外环境中视觉三维重建与深度估计的可靠性，受限于几何真值数据的匮乏以及完整扫描测量成本的高昂。我们提出了一种基于LiDAR的参考数据生成流程，用于评估前馈视觉几何模型与传统的运动恢复结构（SfM）方法在零样本条件下的性能。该流程复用现有跨传感器定位数据集中的相机图像、LiDAR扫描数据和参考位姿，生成逐视角深度图和可见参考点云。为解决累积LiDAR扫描中的可见性误差问题，我们引入了大深度差可见性评分（LDGVS），用于逐点可见性过滤以及隐藏点移除（HPR）中的自动尺度选择。在TartanAirV2和TartanGround上的实验表明，与适用于完整扫描测量的泊松表面重建方法相比，结合HPR与LDGVS过滤的方法在绝对相对误差相当的情况下，保留了约三倍的点密度。我们还将该流程应用于BotanicGarden数据集，系统比较了深度估计与三维重建方法。前馈方法能够高效生成稠密深度预测，但其三维重建可能包含重复结构。传统的SfM方法通常生成更具一致性的几何结构，但其重建结果仍然稀疏，并且在具有挑战性的植被场景中更容易失败。基准工具包和数据集将公开发布。
tldr: This paper introduces a LiDAR-based pipeline for generating visibility-aware reference depth maps and point clouds to benchmark visual 3D reconstruction and depth estimation methods in vegetation-rich outdoor environments. It proposes a new visibility filtering score (LDGVS) to improve the quality of reference data, enabling fair evaluations of feed-forward and SfM-based methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于LiDAR的参考数据生成流程，用于在植被茂密的室外环境中评估视觉三维重建和深度估计方法。通过引入新的可见性过滤评分LDGVS，提高了参考数据的质量，从而能够公平地比较前馈方法和传统SfM方法。

title: PACT: Pose-Robust Actuation Co-Design for Tendon-Driven Robotic Hands
summary: Humanoid robotic hands must provide sufficient force, speed, and backdrivability within a human-scale envelope. Tendon-driven transmissions address this challenge by relocating actuators to the palm and forearm, but routing paths, moment arms, and capstan dimensions jointly determine both force capability and joint speed, so selecting them sequentially satisfies one requirement at the expense of the other. This paper presents a pose-robust actuation co-design for tendon-driven robot hands (PACT) framework that optimizes tendon routing, moment arms, and capstan dimensions under pose-dependent force requirements and drivetrain-bandwidth constraints. A feasible-force formulation enforces actuator bounds and equilibrium at all joints, while a max-min objective maximizes task-force coverage at the weakest pose. Applied to a four-degree-of-freedom finger, the framework produces an asymmetric N + 1 tendon topology using quasi-direct-drive actuators. Across eight poses, the design achieves task-force coverage of 0.88-1.00 and a predicted 5 Hz minimum isolated-joint flexion/extension bandwidth within a 70th-percentile human-size envelope. Prototype measurements deviate from predictions by up to 24.5%, primarily due to unmodeled transmission losses. These results indicate that co-designing routing with the drivetrain can meet pose-dependent force requirements without relaxing the bandwidth constraint, paving the way for human-sized robotic hands with human-level performance.
summary_zh: 拟人机器人手部须在类人尺度范围内同时提供足够的力、速度和反向驱动能力。腱驱动传动通过将驱动器移至手掌和前臂应对这一挑战，但走线路径、力臂和绞盘尺寸共同决定力的能力和关节速度，因此逐一选定上述参数会在满足一项要求的同时牺牲另一项要求。本文提出一种面向腱驱动机器人手部的位姿鲁棒驱动协同设计（PACT）框架，该框架在位姿相关力需求与驱动链带宽约束下，对腱走线、力臂和绞盘尺寸进行联合优化。可行力公式对执行器边界及所有关节处的平衡施加约束，极大极小目标函数则在最薄弱位姿处最大化任务力的覆盖范围。将该框架应用于四自由度手指，得到一种采用准直驱执行器的不对称N+1腱拓扑结构。在八个位姿下，该设计实现的任务力覆盖率为0.88–1.00，并在第70百分位的人体尺寸范围内实现了预测的最低5 Hz单关节屈曲/伸展带宽。样机实测值与预测值偏差最高达24.5%，主要归因于未建模的传动损耗。上述结果表明，将走线与驱动链协同设计可在不放松带宽约束的前提下满足位姿相关的力需求，为构建具备人类水平性能的类人尺度机器人手部奠定了基础。
tldr: PACT optimizes tendon routing, moment arms, and capstan dimensions for tendon-driven robotic hands, achieving pose-robust force coverage and bandwidth within a human-size envelope.
tldr_zh: PACT 框架协同优化腱驱动机械手的腱路径、力臂和绞盘尺寸，在满足带宽约束的同时实现位姿鲁棒的力覆盖。

title: TouchéWorld tech report : Towards Online Unified Camera--Hand Exploration in Generative Worlds
summary: Recent video world models allow users to explore generated environments through camera navigation. Continuous hand motion provides a fine-grained action channel for interacting with the people and objects encountered during exploration. We present TouchéWorld, a framework that integrates gesture-driven interaction into a camera-controlled video world model. Given an initial image and a scene-description prompt, the model generates video conditioned on temporally aligned camera and hand controls. We construct joint camera--hand training data from heterogeneous egocentric videos through annotation completion, consistency-based filtering, and temporal alignment. Building on a pretrained camera-controlled world model, we combine spatial hand-skeleton conditioning with numerical hand-motion features through parameter-efficient adaptation. Causal adaptation and few-step distillation support chunk-level online generation, allowing users to update their controls based on generated visual feedback. We further introduce TouchéBench to evaluate hand-motion following, camera--hand coordination, online interaction, and object response. Together, these components establish a framework for studying continuous exploration and hand-driven interaction within generative worlds.
summary_zh: 近期开发的视频世界模型允许用户通过摄像头导航来探索生成的环境。连续的手部运动为与探索过程中遇到的人物和物体进行交互提供了细粒度的动作通道。我们提出了TouchéWorld，这是一个将手势驱动交互整合到摄像头控制的视频世界模型中的框架。给定初始图像和场景描述提示，该模型根据时间对齐的摄像头和手部控制生成视频。我们通过注释补全、基于一致性的过滤和时间对齐，从异构的自我中心视频中构建联合的摄像头-手部训练数据。基于预训练的摄像头控制世界模型，我们通过参数高效适配将空间手部骨骼条件与数值手部运动特征相结合。因果适配和少步蒸馏支持分块级别的在线生成，使用户能够根据生成的视觉反馈更新其控制。我们进一步引入了TouchéBench来评估手部运动跟随、摄像头-手部协调、在线交互和物体响应。这些组件共同构建了一个框架，用于研究生成世界中的连续探索和手部驱动交互。
tldr: TouchéWorld integrates gesture-driven hand interaction into camera-controlled video world models for online, user-guided exploration of generative environments.
tldr_zh: TouchéWorld 将手势驱动交互集成到相机控制的视频世界模型中，实现在生成环境中的在线、用户引导探索。

title: Dynamic Shape Control of Soft Trunk Robots
summary: Controlling the shape profile of soft trunk robots extends their reach into complex regions of the workspace and enhances their use in practical applications. Recent advances in soft robot design have enabled soft trunk robots to achieve greater flexibility in conforming to complex shapes. Specifically, trunk robots whose geometries are designed as helicoids have been shown to enable extreme shape-changing capabilities. Their compliance makes them highly nonlinear, which in turn makes shape control difficult. On similar tendon-driven trunk robots, model-based controllers based on the theory of adiabatic spectral submanifolds (aSSMs) have achieved high accuracy in closed-loop end-effector tracking. We extend this approach by learning an aSSM model of the full body of a trimmed-helicoid soft trunk robot from data and use this in a model predictive control (MPC) scheme to demonstrate a range of shape control tasks on hardware. On closed-loop dynamic shape regulation, our method outperforms the available linear baselines by a factor of 10. In human-in-the-loop interactive demos, our method completes section-by-section shaping and balances a tennis ball for over 25 seconds, while the linear baselines fall short. A model-free reinforcement learning policy trained for 12 hours on hardware fails on the same balancing task. These results establish aSSM-based MPC as a practical route to full-body shape control on real soft hardware.
summary_zh: 控制软体躯干机器人的形状轮廓，能够扩展其工作空间内复杂区域的到达能力，并增强其在实际应用中的适用性。近期软体机器人设计的进展使得软体躯干机器人能够更灵活地适配复杂形状。具体而言，几何形状设计为螺旋面的躯干机器人已被证明具备极端的形状变化能力。然而，其柔顺性使其高度非线性，进而导致形状控制困难。在类似的肌腱驱动躯干机器人上，基于绝热谱子流形（aSSMs）理论的模型控制方法已在闭环末端执行器跟踪中实现了高精度。我们通过从数据中学习修剪螺旋面软体躯干机器人全身的aSSM模型，扩展了这一方法，并将其用于模型预测控制（MPC）框架，在硬件上展示了一系列形状控制任务。在闭环动态形状调节中，我们的方法性能比现有线性基线方法提升了一个数量级（10倍）。在人机协同交互演示中，我们的方法实现了逐段成形，并能稳定平衡网球超过25秒，而线性基线方法则无法完成该任务。一个在硬件上训练了12小时的无模型强化学习策略，在相同的平衡任务中失败。这些结果表明，基于aSSM的MPC方法为真实软体硬件上的全身形状控制提供了一条实用路径。
tldr: This paper presents a model predictive control (MPC) scheme leveraging learned adiabatic spectral submanifold (aSSM) models for full-body shape control of a soft trunk robot, demonstrating superior performance over linear baselines and a model-free reinforcement learning policy on hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于学习绝热谱子流形（aSSM）模型的模型预测控制（MPC）方案，用于软躯干机器人的全身形状控制，并在硬件上展示了相比线性基线和无模型强化学习策略的优越性能。

title: UniLoop: Unified Loop Closure Detection from Retrieval to Geometric Verification and Relative Pose Estimation
summary: Loop closure detection conventionally cascades separate models for global retrieval, geometric verification, and relative pose estimation, leading to redundant computation and disconnected visual representations. We propose UniLoop, a unified framework that reuses the hierarchical representations of the pretrained geometric foundation model throughout this pipeline. A shared image encoder produces features for compact global descriptors; the same features are passed to the cross-view decoder for pairwise verification; and the original geometric predictions provide relative camera constraints for pose-graph optimization. Experiments on place recognition, loop verification, and relative pose estimation show that UniLoop improves loop-closure robustness and accuracy while reducing redundant backbone computation relative to modular pipelines. UniLoop achieves the best Recall@10 on MSLS (96.6) and Pitts30k (99.3) among the compared methods, while its verification branch reaches 95.63 AP and 96.29 ROC-AUC, surpassing the existing geometric verification baselines.
summary_zh: 回环检测通常将全局检索、几何验证和相对位姿估计级联为独立模型，导致计算冗余且视觉表示相互割裂。我们提出UniLoop，一个统一框架，在整个流程中复用预训练几何基础模型的层次化表示。共享图像编码器生成紧凑全局描述符的特征；相同特征传递至跨视图解码器以进行成对验证；原始几何预测则为位姿图优化提供相对相机约束。在位置识别、回环验证和相对位姿估计上的实验表明，相较于模块化流水线，UniLoop在减少骨干网络冗余计算的同时，提升了回环检测的鲁棒性和准确性。在对比方法中，UniLoop在MSLS（96.6）和Pitts30k（99.3）上取得了最优的Recall@10，其验证分支分别达到95.63 AP和96.29 ROC-AUC，超越了现有几何验证基线。
tldr: UniLoop unifies loop closure detection by reusing hierarchical features from a geometric foundation model for retrieval, verification, and relative pose estimation, improving accuracy and efficiency.
tldr_zh: UniLoop通过复用几何基础模型的分层特征，统一了回环检测中的检索、验证和相对位姿估计，提高了精度和效率。

title: Vortex-Induced Torque in Grasping Soft Objects: Influence of Geometry and Pneumatic Parameters
summary: Vortex grippers are commonly integrated into automated systems for handling objects with complex geometries in packaging, sorting, and assembling. However, their interaction with compliant objects remains difficult to predict, particularly with respect to the vortex-induced torque transmitted during grasping. This study investigates vortex-induced torque during the grasping of compliant objects and quantifies the coupled effects of supply pressure, tangential nozzle diameter, surface geometry, and curvature. The results show that increasing the tangential nozzle diameter primarily enhances the sensitivity of the generated torque to supply pressure rather than producing a uniformly higher torque. Surface geometry also strongly influences the rotational interaction, with dome-concave surfaces generally producing substantially greater torque than corresponding dome-convex surfaces, whereas the difference between cylindrical concave and convex surfaces is comparatively small. The strongest and most repeatable response was observed for a dome-concave surface exhibiting favorable object-gripper geometric matching. Among the evaluated machine-learning regression methods, Gaussian Process Regression provided the best overall predictive performance under repeated cross-validation, demonstrating that vortex-induced torque can be estimated from combined pneumatic and geometric parameters. These findings provide a basis for predicting and utilizing vortex-induced torque in the dexterous manipulation of soft objects.
summary_zh: 涡流吸盘通常被集成到自动化系统中，用于在包装、分拣和装配过程中处理具有复杂几何形状的物体。然而，其与柔性物体的相互作用仍然难以预测，尤其是在抓取过程中传递的涡流诱导扭矩方面。本研究探讨了在抓取柔性物体过程中产生的涡流诱导扭矩，并量化了供气压力、切向喷嘴直径、表面几何形状及曲率的耦合影响。结果表明，增大切向喷嘴直径主要增强了所产生扭矩对供气压力的敏感性，而非均匀地提高扭矩水平。表面几何形状对旋转相互作用也有显著影响，穹顶凹面通常产生的扭矩明显大于对应的穹顶凸面，而圆柱凹面与圆柱凸面之间的差异则相对较小。在具有良好物体与吸盘几何匹配性的穹顶凹面条件下，观察到了最强且最具重复性的响应。在所评估的机器学习回归方法中，高斯过程回归在重复交叉验证下提供了最佳的整体预测性能，表明涡流诱导扭矩可以通过气动参数与几何参数的组合进行估算。这些发现为预测和利用涡流诱导扭矩以实现软物体的灵巧操控提供了基础。
tldr: This paper experimentally investigates vortex-induced torque during grasping of soft objects, quantifying the effects of pneumatic parameters and surface geometry, and demonstrates that Gaussian Process Regression can predict this torque for dexterous manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文实验研究了抓取软物体时涡流诱导扭矩，量化了气动参数和表面几何的影响，并证明高斯过程回归可预测该扭矩以用于灵巧操作。

title: A Layered View of LLM Support in Underwater Robotics
summary: This extended abstract discusses a specific and, in our experience, practically relevant role for large language models (LLMs) in underwater robotics. Our main premise is that, in underwater fielding missions, the immediate difficulty is often not the synthesis of new low-level control laws, but the operation of complex robotic systems under limited communications, partial observability, and expensive field time. In particular, a significant fraction of the effort during sea trials is devoted to fault diagnosis, telemetry interpretation, mission adjustment, and coordination across heterogeneous assets and operators. We argue that LLMs may be useful at this higher operational level, especially when grounded in structured vehicle state, alarms, logs, mission context, and existing planning or validation tools. At the same time, current limitations in grounding, consistency, and causal reasoning make these systems lack the predictability required to guarantee direct control, especially in real-world critical applications, although we do not exclude a future evolution in this direction. This viewpoint suggests a layered architecture in which conventional autonomy remains responsible for control, perception, estimation, and validated mission execution, whereas LLM-based modules serve as an additional support layer for debugging, operator interaction, constrained replanning support, orchestration, and post-mission analysis.
summary_zh: 这篇扩展摘要讨论了大语言模型（LLMs）在水下机器人领域中一个特定的、且根据我们的经验具有实际应用价值的作用。我们的核心观点是，在水下部署任务中，眼前的困难往往不在于设计新的底层控制律，而在于有限通信、部分可观测性以及昂贵的现场时间条件下操作复杂的机器人系统。特别是，海试期间的相当大一部分工作量用于故障诊断、遥测数据解读、任务调整以及异构资产和操作员之间的协调。我们认为，大语言模型在这一更高操作层面可能发挥积极作用，尤其是当其基于结构化运载器状态、警报、日志、任务上下文以及现有的规划或验证工具时。与此同时，目前在接地性（grounding）、一致性和因果推理方面的局限，使得这些系统缺乏保证直接控制所需的可预测性，尤其在现实世界的关键应用中更是如此，尽管我们不排除未来在该方向上演进的可能性。这一观点暗示了一种分层架构，其中传统自主系统继续负责控制、感知、估计和经验证的任务执行，而基于大语言模型的模块则作为额外支持层，用于调试、操作员交互、受约束的重新规划支持、协同编排以及任务后分析。
tldr: This paper argues for using LLMs as an operational support layer in underwater robotics—for fault diagnosis, telemetry interpretation, mission adjustment, and coordination—rather than for direct low-level control, due to reliability concerns.
tldr_zh: 本文主张将大语言模型（LLM）作为水下机器人操作支持层，用于故障诊断、遥测解读、任务调整与协调，而非直接的低层控制，因为可靠性问题限制了其在关键控制中的应用。

title: 3D Pose Estimation in Projection Space via Pixel-level Visible Light Communication
summary: Projector-based augmented reality enables natural interaction between users and devices by overlaying digital information onto the physical world through projected imagery. A key technical requirement of such systems is accurate positional alignment between the projector and the devices. Pixel-level Visible Light Communication (PVLC) achieves this alignment without external sensing infrastructure by embedding invisible spatial codes into each projected pixel through high-speed brightness modulation that preserves image quality. However, the information that PVLC transmits is inherently planar. PVLC has therefore been limited to devices moving on a flat surface and cannot estimate the 3D pose of devices in three-dimensional space, such as aerial robots. To extend PVLC-based pose estimation to three dimensions, we formulate it as a Perspective-n-Point (PnP) problem. The 2D pixel positions that four coplanar photosensors on the device receive via PVLC serve as the image points, and their known 3D layout provides the object points. Experiments show that the proposed system estimates 3D pose with a latency of approximately 8~ms and a 3D position RMSE of 19.2~mm after Kalman filtering. These results confirm the first realization of real-time 3D pose estimation coordinated with high-quality projected image content without external sensing infrastructure.
summary_zh: 基于投影仪的增强现实技术通过将数字信息以投影图像的形式叠加到物理世界中，实现了用户与设备之间的自然交互。这类系统的一个关键技术要求是投影仪与设备之间的精确位置对齐。像素级可见光通信（PVLC）通过高速亮度调制将不可见的空间编码嵌入每个投影像素中，在保持图像质量的同时实现对齐，无需外部感知基础设施。然而，PVLC传输的信息本质上是平面的，因此其应用仅限于在平面上移动的设备，无法估计三维空间中设备（如空中机器人）的3D姿态。为了将基于PVLC的姿态估计扩展到三维，我们将其建模为透视n点（PnP）问题。设备上四个共面光电传感器通过PVLC接收的2D像素位置作为图像点，其已知的3D布局提供物方点。实验表明，所提出的系统在卡尔曼滤波后，3D姿态估计延迟约为8毫秒，3D位置均方根误差为19.2毫米。这些结果证实了在无需外部感知基础设施的情况下，首次实现了与高质量投影图像内容协同的实时3D姿态估计。
tldr: This paper presents a PVLC-based system that extends 2D pose estimation to real-time 3D pose estimation for devices (including aerial robots) by formulating the problem as PnP, using four coplanar photosensors to decode projected spatial codes, achieving 19.2mm RMSE without external sensing infrastructure.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于像素级可见光通信（PVLC）的系统，通过将3D姿态估计问题转化为PnP问题，利用设备上的四个共面光电传感器解码投影的空间码，在无外部感知基础设施的情况下实现实时3D姿态估计（位置RMSE 19.2mm），适用于包括空中机器人在内的移动设备。

title: Diversity-Aware Experience Replay via Statistical Leverage Scores
summary: Off-policy deep reinforcement learning trains on random samples from a replay buffer of past experience. In physical robot settings, that buffer is dominated by routine: thousands of near-identical transitions from normal operation, while the rare events that define the edges of the task are rarely sampled. We propose scoring every stored transition by its statistical leverage, which measures how unusual it is relative to the buffer's own data, computed from the stored numbers alone, with no labels, rewards, or value network. We draw each mini-batch from a mixture of this score and uniform sampling. First, the natural way to build the score along the directions where the data varies most turns out to be blind when actions are stored as one-hot indicators, because indicator columns always win the variance ranking; we instead select the feature columns with the heaviest tails (largest kurtosis) where small far-away populations are revealed. Second, the importance weights that prioritized replay uses to keep gradients unbiased cancel the method exactly: with full correction, training matches uniform sampling, so we drop the correction and deliberately optimize the rebalanced objective. Third, when the rare situations of a log are relational, visible only in how a stretch of behavior relates to its goal, not in any single stored coordinate-per-transition scores are blind; applying the same tail rule to short trajectory windows described relative to their goal restores the signal, and on a three-joint arm that must push an object around an obstacle it raises the rare-task success from 0.49 to 0.69 against a labeled-oracle ceiling of 0.74.
summary_zh: 摘要：离策略深度强化学习从过往经验回放缓冲区中的随机样本进行训练。在物理机器人场景中，该缓冲区以常规数据为主：成千上万条来自正常操作的近乎相同的转移记录，而界定任务边界的罕见事件却很少被采样。我们提出根据每条存储转移的统计杠杆对其进行评分，该杠杆衡量其相对于缓冲区自身数据的异常程度，仅依据存储数据本身计算，无需标签、奖励或价值网络。我们从一个由该评分与均匀采样混合的分布中抽取每个小批量。首先，在数据变化最大的方向上构建评分的自然方法在动作以独热编码存储时会失效，因为指示列总是占据方差排序的首位；我们转而选择尾部最重（峰度最大）的特征列，这些列能够揭示距离较远的小规模群体。其次，优先回放为保持梯度无偏而使用的重要性权重恰好抵消了该方法的效果：在完全修正的情况下，训练与均匀采样无异，因此我们放弃修正，刻意优化重新平衡的目标。第三，当日志中的罕见情境是关系型的，仅在行为片段与其目标的关联中显现，而不体现在任何单个存储坐标中时，逐转移评分失效；将相同的尾部规则应用于相对于目标描述的短轨迹窗口可恢复该信号，在一个必须将物体推过障碍物的三关节机械臂任务中，该方法将罕见任务成功率从0.49提升至0.69，而带标签的专家上限为0.74。
tldr: This paper introduces a diversity-aware experience replay method for off-policy deep reinforcement learning, using statistical leverage scores based on kurtosis to prioritize rare transitions. It demonstrates improved success on a simulated robotic pushing task, particularly for rare goal-relative trajectory windows.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于统计杠杆分数的多样性感知经验回放方法，用于离策略深度强化学习，通过峰度优先采样罕见转换，并在模拟机器人推物任务中提升了罕见任务成功率。

title: GSBR: Geometric Support Behavior Regularization for Online RL
summary: Regularizing online reinforcement learning (RL) toward a pretrained base policy can improve sample efficiency and learning stability, but regularization that is too restrictive limits how much the policy can improve. Base policies -- typically diffusion or flow-matching models trained by imitation learning on large, diverse datasets -- capture many behaviors that are reasonable but suboptimal. Existing regularizers using such base policies are too restrictive in one of two ways: behavioral cloning regularizers pull the actor toward the full base-policy distribution, penalizing it for discarding suboptimal modes, while hard support constraints forbid improvements that lie just outside the base policy's support. We propose Geometric Support Behavior Regularization (GSBR), which penalizes actions by their distance from the base policy's support. Actions within the support incur no penalty, so the actor can concentrate on high-value modes; outside the support, where value estimates are less reliable, the penalty grows smoothly with distance while still permitting improvement when the value gained outweighs the penalty. GSBR estimates this distance from a finite set of base-policy samples, so it requires only sample access to the base policy. Across 19 tasks on four robotic benchmarks, GSBR raises the average success rate from 33% for the base policy to 95%, achieving the highest average success rate and throughput among all compared methods, with about 23% higher normalized throughput than the next-best RL method. Project website and open-source code at https://charlesxu0124.github.io/gsbr/ .
summary_zh: 将在线强化学习（RL）向预训练的基础策略进行正则化，可以提高样本效率和学习稳定性，但过度严格的正则化会限制策略的改进空间。基础策略——通常是通过模仿学习在大型多样化数据集上训练得到的扩散模型或流匹配模型——捕获了许多合理但次优的行为。现有的使用此类基础策略的正则化方法在以下两种方式之一上过于严格：行为克隆正则化将演员拉向完整的基础策略分布，因丢弃次优模式而对其进行惩罚；而硬支持约束则禁止策略改进落在基础策略支持集之外。我们提出了几何支持行为正则化（GSBR），该方法根据动作与基础策略支持集的距离对其进行惩罚。支持集内的动作不产生惩罚，因此演员可以专注于高价值模式；在支持集之外，由于价值估计的可靠性较低，惩罚随距离平滑增长，同时在价值收益超过惩罚时仍允许改进。GSBR从有限的基础策略样本中估计该距离，因此仅需对基础策略进行样本访问。在四个机器人基准测试的19项任务中，GSBR将基础策略的平均成功率从33%提升至95%，在所有对比方法中取得了最高的平均成功率和吞吐量，其归一化吞吐量比次优的强化学习方法高出约23%。项目网站及开源代码见 https://charlesxu0124.github.io/gsbr/ 。
tldr: GSBR proposes a geometric support behavior regularization that penalizes actions based on distance from the base policy's support, allowing for improvement while maintaining stability. It achieves high success rates across robotic benchmarks.
tldr_zh: GSBR 提出了一种基于几何支持的行为正则化方法，根据动作到基础策略支持集的距离进行惩罚，在保持稳定性的同时允许策略改进，在多个机器人基准上取得了较高的成功率。

title: MonoLaDN: Language-Guided DeNoising for Monocular 3D Object Detection
summary: Monocular 3D object detection offers a low-cost route to 3D perception, but it remains fundamentally ill-posed, since depth must be inferred from a single view. Recent transformer-based detectors learn geometry purely from image features and 3D box annotations, lacking the high-level semantic priors that vision-language models (VLMs) acquire from large-scale pretraining. VLMs offer such priors, but deploying one directly as a detector is impractical due to its heavy inference cost. We propose MonoLaDN, a language-guided denoising framework that transfers the geometric reasoning of a VLM into a monocular 3D detector while keeping the deployed model purely vision-based. During training, a frozen VLM produces structured reasoning about each object's occlusion, depth, dimension, and angle from the image and its ground-truth boxes. We encode this reasoning into queries, perturb them with noise, and train the detector to reconstruct the clean reasoning. Reconstructing the corrupted reasoning forces the detector's depth-guided features to internalize the VLM's geometric priors, so this knowledge remains available even after the reasoning path is discarded at inference, adding no latency or parameters to the deployed model. Experiments on KITTI 3D and nuScenes show that MonoLaDN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art detectors and generalizes well to new domains.
summary_zh: 单目三维目标检测为三维感知提供了一条低成本的途径，但其本质上仍是一个病态问题，因为深度必须从单一视角中推断得到。现有的基于Transformer的检测器仅从图像特征和三维边界框标注中学习几何信息，缺乏视觉-语言模型（VLM）通过大规模预训练所获得的高级语义先验。VLM能够提供此类先验，但直接将其用作检测器并不现实，因为其推理成本过高。我们提出MonoLaDN，一种语言引导的去噪框架，将VLM的几何推理能力迁移至单目三维检测器，同时保持部署模型纯视觉驱动。在训练阶段，冻结的VLM根据图像及其真实边界框，对每个目标的遮挡、深度、尺寸和角度生成结构化推理。我们将这些推理编码为查询，对其添加噪声扰动，并训练检测器重建干净的推理。重建被扰乱的推理迫使检测器的深度引导特征内化VLM的几何先验，从而使得这些知识在推理阶段丢弃推理路径后仍然可用，且不会增加部署模型的延迟或参数量。在KITTI 3D和nuScenes上的实验表明，MonoLaDN持续优于最先进的检测器，并能很好地泛化到新领域。
tldr: MonoLaDN is a language-guided denoising framework that transfers geometric reasoning from a frozen VLM into a monocular 3D detector, improving performance and generalization without adding inference cost.
tldr_zh: MonoLaDN 是一种语言引导的去噪框架，将冻结 VLM 的几何推理转移到单目 3D 检测器中，在不增加推理成本的情况下提高性能和泛化能力。

title: Scale Anchoring via Implicit Semantics and Sequence-Consistent Loop Closure for VGGT-Based SLAM
summary: Feed-forward geometric foundation models enable dense monocular reconstruction without requiring camera calibration, but independently reconstructed submaps can accumulate scale drift, and even a valid revisit can yield an inconsistent cross-submap measurement. We extend VGGT-SLAM 2.0 with fixed-root scale anchoring and short-sequence-assisted direct loop connections. SALAD selects an image pair between the initial submap and each eligible new submap; joint VGGT inference then uses learned implicit semantic-geometric cues to supply a scale-only anchor while preserving the original overlap chain. For loop closure, neighboring image pairs support a consistency check and translation-scale alignment. Each accepted candidate contributes one robust Sim(3) factor between existing center-frame nodes, without an auxiliary loop submap. A 17-sequence comparison lowers mean Sim(3) ATE on nine TUM sequences from 0.1018 to 0.0451 m relative to the VGGT-SLAM 2.0 baseline. Anchoring improves all seven no-loop module ablations. On three Clio scenes, a fixed-loop comparison favors the direct connection pipeline over the tested auxiliary-submap pipeline. A separate candidate audit exposes additional rejections of visually overlapping pairs by the short-sequence check. These comparisons distinguish the gains from long-range scale anchoring and loop connection choices from the limitations of candidate verification.
tldr: This paper introduces SALAD, a method to improve scale consistency and loop closure in VGGT-based SLAM by using implicit semantic-geometric cues for scale anchoring and sequence-consistent loop closures, significantly reducing Sim(3) ATE on TUM and Clio benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SALAD方法，利用隐式语义-几何线索进行尺度锚定和序列一致的闭环，改进了基于VGGT的SLAM的尺度一致性和闭环精度，在TUM和Clio基准上显著降低了Sim(3) ATE。

title: Fluidic Body: Swarm Robots as a Fluid Extension of the Hand
summary: Swarm robots have attracted growing interest as a physical interface for human--computer interaction, since a swarm can reshape its formation to fit the objects and surroundings it works with. For a human operator, however, adapting the swarm's behavior remains difficult. Most existing methods require the user to specify where the swarm should go, and they offer no intuitive way to change the collective's behavior as each task demands. We present Fluidic Body, a system that lets a person operate a swarm of fluid-imitating robots as an extension of the hand. The system places a virtual fluid between the hand and the swarm, and the user adapts the swarm's behavior to each task by changing the fluid's properties through simple hand movements. When the user opens the hand, the swarm becomes soft enough to deform and flow around obstacles. Closing the hand turns it into a hard, cohesive body that can push objects. We evaluated the controller's performance and its operability in two simulation experiments and one demonstration with physical robots. First, our controller handled both obstacle avoidance and object transportation better than an existing method that behaves the same way in every task. Second, in a VR user study, 17 participants completed the combined avoidance-and-transportation task faster and more reliably than with that method. They also reported a lower workload and a stronger sense of agency. Finally, this experience carried over to physical robots in a real-world demonstration (88 participants). These results suggest that treating a swarm as a fluid, a material people already understand, allows a robot swarm to work as a deformable extension of the human body.
tldr: This paper presents Fluidic Body, a system that lets a human operator control a swarm of robots as a deformable, fluid-like extension of the hand by adjusting fluid properties through hand gestures, demonstrating improved performance in obstacle avoidance and object transportation tasks in simulation, a VR user study, and with physical robots.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了流体体，一个让操作者通过手势调整流体属性，将机器人群作为手的可变形容器进行控制的系统，并在仿真、VR用户研究和实体机器人实验中展示了其在避障和物体搬运任务中的性能提升。

title: Reflection-Robust Stereo Visual-Inertial Odometry via Kalman-Filtered Ground-Height Estimation
summary: Visual-inertial odometry relies on visual features that correspond to 3D points with consistent projections across sequential frames. In reflective indoor-floor environments, however, specular floor patterns can be detected and triangulated as virtual features below the physical ground plane, producing unreliable feature associations and inconsistent visual residuals. This paper proposes a lightweight reflection-aware front-end for feature-based stereo VIO. Rather than suppressing all floor-region features, the proposed method estimates the ground height in real time and rejects only feature candidates whose inferred 3D positions are below the estimated ground height. A floor-region mask restricts the validation process to reflection-prone regions, while stereo height uncertainty and pose uncertainty are used to construct frame-level ground-height measurements. A scalar Kalman filter with Normalized Innovation Squared (NIS) gating then provides a stable ground-height estimate, and an uncertainty-aware safety margin is used for selective below-ground virtual feature rejection. Experiments on real reflective-floor indoor sequences show that the proposed front-end generally improves trajectory accuracy in reflection-dominant environments while maintaining accurate ground-height estimates and recovering from actual ground-height changes.
tldr: This paper presents a reflection-aware front-end for stereo visual-inertial odometry (VIO) that estimates ground height in real time using a Kalman filter to reject virtual features below the ground plane, improving trajectory accuracy in reflective floor environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于立体视觉惯性里程计（VIO）的反射感知前端，通过卡尔曼滤波实时估计地面高度，并剔除位于地面以下的虚拟特征，从而在反光地板环境中提高轨迹精度。

title: Does RRT* Work on Uneven Terrain Meshes?
summary: The optimal rapidly exploring random tree (RRT*) is proven asymptotically optimal on open subsets of Euclidean space with straight-line local planning. We ask whether it works on a triangle-mesh terrain, a two-dimensional surface in R^3. First, the original RRT* cannot run on a mesh: the surface has zero volume, so uniform sampling never hits it, no clearance ball fits in it, and chords across a fold leave it. Second, the surface reformulation we call Mesh RRT*, with its naive edge, the chord costed by its length, solved every run on heightfields with slopes up to 75 degrees but minimises the wrong objective: its cost, the straight-line length of a polyline whose vertices lie on the surface while its segments may leave it by a tolerance tau, is the length of no route on the surface and lies strictly below the geodesic length on any curved mesh. In numeric simulation and after 30,000 iterations the reported cost is on average up to 2.7% below the exact geodesic, a cost no path attains, and the returned route on average 0.1-0.5% longer than it. Rewiring keeps the biased edges, the bias decays only linearly with the step on polyhedral surfaces, and shrinking tau trades bias for connectivity. Third, replacing each chord by a path on the surface above it, built from projected points joined across the mesh edges they straddle and costed by its own length, makes every edge cost the exact length of a feasible path; with no other change the exact length of the returned routes is on average within 0.07-0.16% of the geodesic at every roughness tested, two to 3.4 times closer than with chords on the rougher terrains. The planner is in MeshNav3D 0.2.0 (release pending).
tldr: This paper analyzes whether RRT* works on triangle-mesh terrains, showing that naive chord-based versions minimize the wrong objective and introducing a version with exact surface edge costs that achieves near-geodesic path lengths.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了RRT*在三角网格地形上的适用性，指出基于弦的朴素版本最小化错误目标，并引入具有精确表面边成本的版本，其路径长度接近测地线。

title: $\mathcal{C}^\infty$ Smooth Trajectory Planning with Application to Soft Robots
summary: High motion performance and avoiding structural vibrations rely on smooth trajectory planning. The smoothness requirement depends on the robot's complexity in terms of the number of degrees of freedom and system order due to the flexibility of the joints and links. For industrial robots, the smoothness requirements have been determined and subsequently taken into account. Although unknown for soft continuum robots, the exact smoothness requirement can potentially be much larger than previously considered ones such as $\mathbf{\mathcal{C}^4}$ for collaborative robots and $\mathbf{\mathcal{C}^5}$ for quadcopter drones. To address this gap, we introduce a $\mathbf{\mathcal{C}^\infty}$-smooth trajectory generator that respects defined kinematic limits and generates infinitely differentiable trajectories. The generated path addresses and generalizes to all smoothness requirements, where a transition between sequential states is needed. Therefore, all trajectories have continuous velocity, acceleration, jerk, snap, crackle, pop, etc. Of particular interest is the case of null boundary conditions, i.e., all derivatives at the start and end of the trajectory are equal to zero. We verified and evaluated our proposed approach in simulations and on hardware.
tldr: This paper introduces a C^∞-smooth trajectory generator for soft continuum robots that respects kinematic limits and generalizes all smoothness requirements, verified in simulation and hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于软连续体机器人的C^∞光滑轨迹生成器，满足运动学限制并泛化所有平滑度要求，已在仿真和硬件上验证。

title: Low-Density 3D Point Cloud Classification
summary: 3D point cloud classification, a task in computer vision, has recently gained substantial interest due to its extensive applications across various domains such as augmented and virtual reality, robotics, and autonomous driving. However, classifying 3D point clouds becomes challenging in real-world scenarios where the density levels vary. These variations are due to limitations inherent to current sensing technologies and variable environmental conditions, which often prevent the capture of detailed and comprehensive geometric representations. Existing classification methods, which have demonstrated impressive results on dense point clouds, may be affected and could experience reduced performance when dealing with low-density point clouds. Addressing this challenge, this paper introduces LD-PointNet++, an architecture optimized for the classification of low-density point clouds. To pave the way for LD-PointNet++, we conduct the first benchmarking study that systematically evaluates state-of-the-art point cloud classification methods across varying densities, revealing significant performance declines in low-density environments.
