We study energy guidance as a general mechanism and present GuidedWAM, a model-agnostic framework for injecting driving objectives into frozen WAMs at sampling time. Our framework constructs each objective as differentiable energies on the sampler's intermediate clean-action estimate, which needs only forward access to the frozen model, and is stabilized by sampling-time guidance scheduling, per-energy normalization, and velocity-bounded correction. On the NAVSIM v2 hard-split, guidance improves all three frozen, publicly released WAMs by 1.8 to 3.6 EPDMS, averaged over three sampler seeds, and adds less than 10% to the sampling time per step. These results position energy guidance as a practical post-training control channel for WAMs.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）在自动驾驶领域将驾驶策略与视觉世界模型耦合于单一生成网络中，其训练目标在训练完成后固定不变。若要适配新的驾驶目标，则需重新训练。本文研究能量引导作为一种通用机制，并提出GuidedWAM——一个模型无关的框架，用于在采样阶段将驾驶目标注入冻结的WAMs。该框架将每个目标构建为采样器中间干净动作估计上的可微能量，仅需对冻结模型进行前向访问，并通过采样时引导调度、逐能量归一化及速度有界校正实现稳定。在NAVSIM v2困难划分下，引导使三个冻结的公开WAMs在三种采样器种子上的平均EPDMS提升1.8至3.6，且每步采样时间增加不超过10%。这些结果表明，能量引导可作为WAMs的一种实用的训练后控制通道。
tldr: GuidedWAM introduces a training-free energy guidance framework that injects differentiable driving objectives into frozen world action models at sampling time, improving performance on NAVSIM v2 with minimal computational overhead.
tldr_zh: GuidedWAM 提出了一种无需训练的能量引导框架，在采样时将驾驶目标注入冻结的世界动作模型，在 NAVSIM v2 上提升性能且开销极小。

title: TactileLab: Sim-to-Real Dexterous Robot Manipulation with Efficient Shear-Sensitive Tactile Simulation
summary: Robotic simulators that represent shear within tactile sensing are becoming increasingly important for contact-rich manipulation. However, simulating contact shear with high-fidelity deformable or soft-body simulation is computationally demanding, limiting scalability to large-scale reinforcement learning. Here we introduce \textit{TactileLab}, a scalable multimodal tactile simulation framework built on IsaacLab, with a particular focus on a new optical-flow-based tactile representation termed \textit{simulated tactile flow}. Instead of relying on soft-body physics to model shear deformation, TactileLab uses rigid-body simulation to efficiently estimate dense tangential motion at the contact interface, producing tactile flow fields that encode shear-relevant contact dynamics. This flow field complements geometric features from a contact depth field. We further introduce a novel policy architecture for jointly processing long-horizon proprioceptive signals and rich tactile observations. Across multiple contact-rich tasks, policies trained using simulated tactile flow learn efficiently at scale and exhibit emergent contact-aware behaviours. To facilitate sim-to-real policy deployment, we then propose a novel real-to-sim tactile translation method that maps real tactile image streams to simulated tactile flow and depth fields, together with a new tactile data collection method, and validate it across diverse tactile sensor designs. Using this pipeline, we demonstrate real-world deployment on tasks encompassing dual-arm and dexterous in-hand manipulation. Overall, TactileLab provides an end-to-end sim-to-real framework for scalable tactile policy learning, enabling diverse shear-sensitive manipulation across heterogeneous tactile robotic systems.
summary_zh: 摘要：在触觉传感中表征剪切力的机器人模拟器，对于接触丰富的操作任务正变得越来越重要。然而，利用高保真度的可变形或软体模拟来仿真接触剪切力，计算成本高昂，限制了其在大规模强化学习中的可扩展性。本文介绍了 \textit{TactileLab}——一个基于IsaacLab构建的可扩展多模态触觉模拟框架，其核心创新在于一种基于光流的新型触觉表征，称为\textit{模拟触觉流}。TactileLab不依赖软体物理来建模剪切变形，而是利用刚体模拟高效估计接触界面处的密集切向运动，生成编码剪切相关接触动力学的触觉流场。该流场补充了接触深度场的几何特征。我们进一步提出了一种新颖的策略架构，用于联合处理长期本体感觉信号和丰富的触觉观测。在多个接触丰富型任务中，使用模拟触觉流训练的策略能够在大规模下高效学习，并展现出涌现的接触感知行为。为促进仿真到现实的策略部署，我们随后提出了一种新颖的实景到仿真触觉转换方法，将真实触觉图像流映射为模拟触觉流和深度场，并配套提出了一种新的触觉数据采集方法，已在多种触觉传感器设计上得到验证。利用该流程，我们在双臂操作和灵巧手内操作等任务上展示了真实世界的部署效果。总体而言，TactileLab提供了一套端到端的仿真到现实框架，支持可扩展的触觉策略学习，使异构触觉机器人系统能够实现多样化的剪切敏感操作。
tldr: TactileLab is a scalable tactile simulation framework on IsaacLab that uses optical-flow-based simulated tactile flow to efficiently encode shear contact dynamics, enabling sim-to-real dexterous manipulation across diverse tactile sensors.
tldr_zh: TactileLab 是基于 IsaacLab 的可扩展触觉仿真框架，利用光流式模拟触觉流高效编码剪切接触动力学，支持跨多种触觉传感器的灵巧操作仿真到现实迁移。

title: Learning Robotic World Models with Semantic and Visual Feedback
summary: Robot world models predict action-conditioned future visual states to support robotic planning and decision making. However, visual reconstruction does not fully capture task progress, semantic evaluation alone provides limited constraints on fine-grained visual errors, and homogeneous predictions limit comparative feedback. We present RoboImagine, a framework for post-training autoregressive robotic world models through candidate-future comparisons with semantic and visual feedback. Diverse search promotes diversity among candidate trajectories under shared visual observations, action sequences, and task instructions. A frozen multimodal evaluator provides task-relevant semantic preferences through pairwise video comparisons in both presentation orders, complemented by pixel- and perceptual-level visual consistency feedback that constrains local structural and appearance errors. These signals drive policy optimization through group-relative advantages. Fixed initial context and branch-specific rolling histories support long-sequence generation with bounded context and consistent conditioning between candidate generation and policy optimization. Experiments with separately trained models on RT-1, BridgeV2, and RoboCasa cover real-world and simulated manipulation. On RT-1, under matched initialization, update counts, and evaluation protocols, RoboImagine improves PSNR by 1.26 dB and reduces LPIPS by 11.93% relative to continued supervised fine-tuning. Ablations show that diverse search improves prediction quality and that combined semantic and visual feedback yields higher external multimodal evaluation scores than visual feedback alone while maintaining comparable visual fidelity. Rolling histories further improve long-horizon prediction. These results support improving visual fidelity, task relevance, and long-horizon prediction through candidate comparison and complementary feedback.
summary_zh: 机器人世界模型预测以行动为条件的未来视觉状态，以支持机器人规划和决策。然而，视觉重建并不能完全捕捉任务进展，仅靠语义评估对细粒度视觉错误的约束有限，且同质化的预测限制了对比较性反馈的获取。我们提出RoboImagine，一种通过候选未来比较并结合语义与视觉反馈来对自回归机器人世界模型进行后训练的框架。多样化搜索在共享视觉观察、动作序列和任务指令下促进候选轨迹之间的多样性。一个冻结的多模态评估器通过双向配对视频比较提供任务相关的语义偏好，并辅以像素级和感知级的视觉一致性反馈，以约束局部结构和外观误差。这些信号通过组内相对优势驱动策略优化。固定的初始上下文和分支特定的滚动历史支持在有限上下文条件下进行长序列生成，并确保候选生成与策略优化之间条件设置的一致性。在RT-1、BridgeV2和RoboCasa上分别训练模型的实验涵盖了真实世界与模拟操纵任务。在RT-1上，在匹配初始化、更新次数和评估协议的情况下，RoboImagine相较于持续监督微调，PSNR提高1.26 dB，LPIPS降低11.93%。消融实验表明，多样化搜索提升了预测质量，并且语义与视觉反馈的组合相比仅使用视觉反馈，在保持可比较视觉保真度的同时，获得了更高的外部多模态评估分数。滚动历史进一步改善了长时域预测。这些结果支持通过候选比较和互补反馈提升视觉保真度、任务相关性和长时域预测能力。
tldr: This paper introduces RoboImagine, a framework that post-trains autoregressive robotic world models by comparing candidate future trajectories with semantic and visual feedback, improving visual fidelity, task relevance, and long-horizon prediction on manipulation datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了RoboImagine框架，通过对比候选未来轨迹并结合语义与视觉反馈来后训练自回归机器人世界模型，从而提升视觉保真度、任务相关性和长期预测能力。

title: Semantics-to-Contact: A Stagewise Framework for Robust Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires precise control under complex contact dynamics while remaining robust to diverse visual conditions. However, real-world reinforcement learning often overfits to the visual appearance of training scenes. We propose Semantics-to-Contact (S2C), a stagewise framework for visually robust contact-rich manipulation. The insight is to decompose the problem into two stages: semantic focusing and contact refinement. In the first stage, a vision-language model localizes task-relevant regions across visually diverse scenes, providing coarse spatial guidance and reducing the burden of exploration. In the second stage, a real-world human-in-the-loop residual reinforcement learning policy learns fine-grained contact behaviors within the localized region using force feedback. To further improve visual robustness, we introduce an object-centric visual augmentation strategy that randomizes background appearance while preserving the robot and task-relevant objects. Experiments on six contact-rich real-world manipulation tasks exhibit that S2C consistently improves success rates over strong baselines and maintains reliable performance under significant visual and positional variations. These results demonstrate that stagewise semantic focusing and contact refinement provide a practical path toward visually robust real-world contact-rich manipulation. Our demos can be seen in https://edem-ai.github.io/S2C/.
summary_zh: 接触丰富的操作需要在复杂的接触动力学下实现精确控制，同时保持对不同视觉条件的鲁棒性。然而，现实世界中的强化学习往往对训练场景的视觉外观产生过拟合。我们提出语义到接触（Semantics-to-Contact，S2C）框架，一种用于视觉鲁棒的接触丰富操作的分阶段方法。其核心思想是将问题分解为两个阶段：语义聚焦和接触细化。在第一阶段，视觉语言模型在视觉多样的场景中定位与任务相关的区域，提供粗略的空间引导，并减少探索的负担。在第二阶段，一种真实世界中人类参与的回环残差强化学习策略利用力反馈在局部区域内学习精细的接触行为。为了进一步提升视觉鲁棒性，我们引入了一种以对象为中心的视觉增强策略，该策略在保持机器人和任务相关对象不变的同时，随机化背景外观。在六个接触丰富的真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，S2C在成功率上持续优于强基线，并在显著的视觉和位置变化下保持可靠的性能。这些结果表明，分阶段的语义聚焦和接触细化为实现视觉鲁棒的真实世界接触丰富操作提供了一条实用路径。我们的演示视频可在 https://edem-ai.github.io/S2C/ 查看。
tldr: The paper introduces Semantics-to-Contact (S2C), a stagewise framework that uses a vision-language model for semantic focusing and human-in-the-loop residual reinforcement learning for contact refinement, achieving robust contact-rich manipulation under visual variations in six real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Semantics-to-Contact (S2C)框架，通过视觉语言模型进行语义聚焦和人在环残差强化学习进行接触细化，在六个真实世界任务中实现了视觉变化下鲁棒的接触丰富操作。

title: LMGN: A Unified Policy Learning Model for Last-Mile Grasp-Navigation
summary: Legged robots equipped with manipulators have shown significant potential in the fields of daily life and industry in complex environments. However, existing methods mainly focus on global navigation or manipulation independently, while overlooking the last-mile navigation problem, where the robot must jointly determine the base placement, approach direction, and grasp execution to achieve reliable object grasping, and different manipulation stages require distinct control behaviors. To address these challenges, we propose Last-Mile Grasp-Navigation (LMGN), a unified policy learning model for Quadruped robot loco-manipulation. An Explicit Distance and Directional Reachability (ED-DR) representation is first introduced to explicitly represent the features of grasp-compatible base placement and approach direction. We then develop a semantically aligned Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts (HMoE) policy that models stage-aware behaviors across the stages of base adjustment, pre-grasp alignment and grasp execution, and object lift. Finally, a new optimization method that jointly aligns navigation and manipulation, stage-dependent expert routing, and action-level consistency is proposed to optimize the HMoE policy. Extensive experiments on the Habitat and Isaac Gym simulators demonstrate that LMGN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, denoting that integrating grasp-aware reachability with stage-aware policy learning significantly improves the success rates of last-mile navigation and target grasp for robots.
summary_zh: 配备机械臂的四足机器人在复杂环境下的日常生活与工业领域中展现出巨大应用潜力。然而，现有方法主要侧重于全局导航或独立操作，忽视了“最后一英里导航”问题——即机器人必须联合确定基座位置、接近方向并执行抓取，以实现可靠的目标抓取，且不同操作阶段需要不同的控制行为。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种名为Last-Mile Grasp-Navigation (LMGN)的统一策略学习模型，用于四足机器人移动操作。首先引入显式距离与方向可达性（ED-DR）表示，以显式表征与抓取兼容的基座位置及接近方向特征。随后，我们开发了一种语义对齐的层次化混合专家（HMoE）策略，该策略能够对基座调整、预抓取对齐、抓取执行及物体抬升等阶段中的阶段感知行为进行建模。最后，提出了一种联合优化方法，该方法同时对齐导航与操作、阶段相关的专家路由及动作级一致性，以优化HMoE策略。在Habitat和Isaac Gym模拟器上的大量实验表明，LMGN始终优于现有最先进方法，证明将抓取感知可达性与阶段感知策略学习相结合，能显著提高机器人最后一英里导航及目标抓取的成功率。
tldr: This paper introduces LMGN, a unified policy learning model for last-mile grasp-navigation on quadruped robots, which integrates an Explicit Distance and Directional Reachability representation with a semantically aligned Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts policy, demonstrating improved success rates in simulations over existing methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了LMGN，一种用于四足机器人末段抓取导航的统一策略学习模型，结合显式距离与方向可达性表示和语义对齐的分层专家混合策略，在仿真中相比现有方法显著提高了成功率。

title: MessyNav: Zero-Shot Navigation via Manipulation in Messy Environments
summary: Real-world environments are messy, with paths often blocked by everyday objects like chairs and toys, requiring robots to perform interactive navigation by manipulating obstacles to clear a path. Existing methods rely on extensive simulation-based learning or per-scene instructions specifying which objects to avoid or manipulate. They struggle to generalize across novel objects, diverse environments, and varied contexts such as a cart of fragile glassware that should be avoided while an empty one can be pushed. We formalize this problem as open-world interactive navigation and present MessyNav, a zero-shot framework based on vision-language models (VLMs). At its core, MessyNav performs explicit VLM-based affordance reasoning before task planning to decide whether to swipe, pick up, or avoid an object and produce a high-level plan. Evaluated on a mobile manipulator across real-world indoor and outdoor environments, MessyNav improves success rate by 27 percentage points (pp) over the strongest baseline in real-robot trials and achieves statistically significant gains in a larger-scale offline evaluation, without task-specific training.
summary_zh: 现实世界环境杂乱无章，路径常常被椅子、玩具等日常物品阻挡，这要求机器人通过操纵障碍物来清理通道，实现交互式导航。现有方法依赖于大量的基于模拟的学习，或针对每个场景的指令来指定应避开或操纵哪些物体。这些方法在应对新颖物体、多样环境及多种情境时泛化能力不足——例如，满载易碎玻璃器皿的推车应予以避让，而空推车则可以被推开。我们将此问题形式化为开放世界交互式导航，并提出了MessyNav——一种基于视觉语言模型（VLMs）的零样本框架。其核心在于，MessyNav在任务规划之前进行显式的基于VLM的可供性推理，以决定是推离、拾起还是避开某个物体，并制定高层计划。在真实室内外环境中，于移动操纵平台上进行的评估显示，MessyNav在真实机器人试验中的成功率较最强基线提高了27个百分点（pp），并在更大规模的离线评估中取得了统计学上显著的提升，且无需任务特定训练。
tldr: MessyNav presents a zero-shot vision-language-model-based framework for interactive navigation in messy environments, where VLMs reason about object affordances to decide whether to manipulate or avoid obstacles, improving real-robot success rates by 27pp without task-specific training.
tldr_zh: MessyNav 提出了一种基于视觉语言模型的零样本交互式导航框架，通过推理物体可操纵性来决定是否避开或移动障碍物，在真实机器人试验中成功率提升 27 个百分点且无需任务特定训练。

title: cuRoboV2-Fast: Fast Torque-Limited Collision-Free Motion Planning
summary: We present cuRoboV2-Fast, a GPU-accelerated planner that reduces both planning latency and execution time for collision-free, payload-aware, torque-limited motions. B-spline trajectory optimization reduces the required iterations, while accelerated robot computations and differentiable inverse dynamics reduce refinement cost and accommodate changing payloads. TimeOpt optimizes traversal speed along the fixed path under sampled velocity, acceleration, jerk, and torque constraints, exploiting local spline support to solve banded Newton systems efficiently on the GPU. With a 3,kg payload, cuRoboV2-Fast achieves 4.4 ms mean planning time on RTX 5090, 14.7x faster than cuRoboV2. Our method on Jetson AGX Orin plans faster than cuRoboV1 + TOPPRA on RTX 5090. A stereo-camera-based deployment on YAM achieves 5.93 s mean completed pick-and-drop cycles, 34.6% shorter than cuRoboV2. Code (Apache 2.0): www.github.com/NVlabs/curobo , Project Page: www.research.nvidia.com/labs/lpr/curobov2-fast .
summary_zh: 我们提出cuRoboV2-Fast，一种GPU加速的规划器，在保证无碰撞、负载感知和力矩受限的运动中，同时降低规划延迟和执行时间。B样条轨迹优化减少了所需迭代次数，而加速的机器人计算与可微逆动力学则降低了细化成本并适应变化的负载。TimeOpt在采样的速度、加速度、加加速度和力矩约束下优化沿固定路径的遍历速度，利用局部样条支持在GPU上高效求解带状牛顿方程组。在3千克负载下，cuRoboV2-Fast在RTX 5090上实现了4.4毫秒的平均规划时间，比cuRoboV2快14.7倍。我们的方法在Jetson AGX Orin上的规划速度快于RTX 5090上的cuRoboV1 + TOPPRA。基于立体相机的部署在YAM上实现了5.93秒的平均完成抓放周期，比cuRoboV2缩短34.6%。代码（Apache 2.0）：www.github.com/NVlabs/curobo，项目页面：www.research.nvidia.com/labs/lpr/curobov2-fast。
tldr: cuRoboV2-Fast presents a GPU-accelerated motion planner that significantly reduces planning latency and execution time for payload-aware, torque-limited trajectories, demonstrating faster planning on RTX 5090 and real-robot pick-and-drop speedups.
tldr_zh: cuRoboV2-Fast 提出了一种GPU加速的运动规划器，显著降低了负载感知、力矩受限轨迹规划的延迟和执行时间，在RTX 5090上实现更快的规划，并缩短了真实机器人拾取和放置周期时间。

title: Reinforcement Learning Enables Scaling Generalist Robot Policy Improvement
summary: The introduction of generalist robot policies has enabled a single, large model to learn to perform a variety of tasks from a vast pre-training corpus. While these models often exhibit powerful zero-shot generalization capabilities, they typically require an adaptation phase to achieve sufficient performance in deployment. Iterated self-improvement via reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated promise in enabling this adaptation, yet such approaches have been largely explored in single-task settings - where the goal is to simply improve on a narrow deployment task - which lies in stark contrast to the multi-task capabilities of the base policy. In this work we ask whether generalist robot policies are capable of multi-task, generalist improvement in deployment - targeting many diverse tasks simultaneously - and what algorithmic recipe enables this. To answer this question, we first develop a set of structured evaluations to test generalist improvement capabilities, and systematically evaluate algorithmic and practical design choices regarding value estimation, policy extraction and resource allocation. We show that not only can generalist policies be improved online across diverse tasks, but that the right recipe can enable generalization and increase performance on tasks not considered during online training. We characterize when this generalization occurs and show that both the training task distribution and the use of value-based RL are critical. To the best of our knowledge, this is among the first evidence for online generalist improvement for robot foundation models.
summary_zh: 引言：通用机器人策略的引入使得单一大型模型能够从大量预训练语料库中学习执行多种任务。尽管这些模型往往展现出强大的零样本泛化能力，但它们在部署中通常需要经过适应阶段才能达到足够的性能水平。通过强化学习进行的迭代自我改进已被证明能够促进这种适应，然而此类方法主要局限于单任务场景——目标是简单地在某个狭窄的部署任务上进行改进——这与基础策略的多任务能力形成了鲜明对比。在本研究中，我们探讨通用机器人策略是否具备多任务、通用性的部署改进能力——即同时针对多个多样化任务进行改进——以及何种算法配方能够实现这一目标。为了回答这一问题，我们首先开发了一套结构化评估方案来测试通用改进能力，并系统地评估了关于价值估计、策略提取和资源分配的算法及实践设计选择。我们不仅证明了通用策略能够在多样化任务上进行在线改进，还发现正确的配方能够促进泛化，并提升在线训练中未涉及任务的表现。我们刻画了这种泛化发生的情境，并表明训练任务分布以及基于价值的强化学习的使用均至关重要。据我们所知，这是机器人基础模型在线通用改进能力的首批证据之一。
tldr: This paper investigates whether generalist robot policies can be improved via multi-task reinforcement learning, proposing an algorithmic recipe that enables online improvement and generalization to unseen tasks. It provides evidence that value-based RL and training task distribution are critical for achieving online generalist improvement for robot foundation models.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了通用机器人策略能否通过多任务强化学习进行改进，提出了一种算法方案，实现在线改进并泛化到未见任务。研究表明，基于价值的强化学习和训练任务分配对实现机器人基础模型的在线通用改进至关重要。

title: VABAR: A Variational Automation Benchmark for Agentic Robotics
summary: For robots to operate reliably in commercial and industrial applications, they must persistently perform specific tasks with known variations in object shape and pose. We call this Variational Automation (VA) to differentiate these settings from fixed automation. Inspired by recent papers on Agentic Robotics, where pretrained LLM and VLM coding agents combine interpretable robot programming with the open-world adaptability of model free policies, we propose a general set of agentic robotics benchmark design criteria that includes accessibility, repeatability, diversity, relevance to agentic robotics and practical applications, physical realizability, resistance to benchmark saturation, and computational efficiency. We instantiate these principles in six manipulation task classes spanning industrial, medical, and infrastructure applications: tool sorting, tool hanging, gear meshing, syringe packing, cable insertion, and cable routing. We introduce the Variational Automation Benchmark for Agentic Robotics (VABAR), an open, easily replicable, simulation-based manipulation benchmark to systematically evaluating agentic robotics systems. Built fully on open-source tools, VABAR features detailed implementations using the Newton physics engine, standardized task variations, difficulty tiers, success metrics, and a library of 33 generalizable skills with human-authored programmatic reference solutions. We provide initial baseline evaluations using an open agentic manipulation harness, Graph-as-Policy (GaP), and Isaac Lab Arena.
summary_zh:
摘要：
为使机器人在商业和工业应用中可靠运行，它们必须持续执行特定任务，同时应对物体形状和位姿的已知变化。我们将其称为“变分自动化”（Variational Automation, VA），以区别于固定自动化场景。受近期关于智能体机器人学（Agentic Robotics）研究的启发——该领域利用预训练的大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）编码智能体，将可解释的机器人编程与模型无关策略的开放世界适应性相结合——我们提出了一套通用的智能体机器人基准设计准则，包括可访问性、可重复性、多样性、与智能体机器人学及实际应用的相关性、物理可实现性、抗基准饱和性以及计算效率。我们将这些原则具体落实于六类涵盖工业、医疗和基础设施应用的操作任务中：工具分拣、工具悬挂、齿轮啮合、注射器包装、线缆插接和线缆布线。我们引入了面向智能体机器人学的变分自动化基准（VABAR），这是一个开放、易于复现、基于仿真的操作基准，用于系统性地评估智能体机器人系统。VABAR完全基于开源工具构建，采用Newton物理引擎提供详细实现，包含标准化的任务变体、难度等级、成功度量指标，以及一个包含33种可泛化技能并配有专家编写的程序化参考解决方案的技能库。我们使用开放的智能体操作框架Graph-as-Policy（GaP）和Isaac Lab Arena提供了初步的基线评估结果。
tldr: VABAR is a simulation-based benchmark for agentic robotics manipulation, featuring six task classes, standardized variations, and baseline evaluations using agentic programming harnesses.
tldr_zh: VABAR 是一个基于仿真的智能体机器人操作基准，包含六类任务、标准化变体以及使用智能体编程框架的基线评估。

title: WAM-Sim0.1: World Anchored Memory Meets Online RL for Consistent and Realistic Driving Simulation
summary: Autoregressive driving world models systematically suffer from structural drift, identity drift, and quality decay over long rollout horizons due to transient conditioning signals that lack persistent state. We present WAM-Sim, a driving world model anchored by a persistent hierarchical memory and optimized via online flow-matching RL. WAM-Sim structures persistent context across three temporal and semantic scales: pose-aligned structural tokens encoding persistent road topology, read-only scene tokens supplying geolocated background appearance, and write-once instance tokens preserving individual traffic participant identities across occlusions and chunk boundaries. To restore visual sharpness and physical plausibility degraded by multi-scale conditioning, we introduce an online post-training framework that optimizes self-generated rollouts via flow-matching RL guided by hierarchy-aligned visual rewards and a vision-language model physical judge. The invariant memory empirically confines policy optimization within the anchored context, helping suppress semantic collapse and reward hacking, while online RL systematically enforces physical commonsense and fine-grained visual fidelity. On the nuScenes benchmark, WAM-Sim achieves a superior generation fidelity (FID=3.47, FVD=25.72) and strong downstream perception performance (24.16 mAP, 71.23 road mIoU). On minute-scale rollouts of self-collected data, WAM-Sim substantially mitigates structural and identity drift, preserving high scene similarity and subject identity coherence across extended horizons. Project page: https://fudan-generative-vision.github.io/WAM-Sim.
summary_zh: 自回归驾驶世界模型在长程推演中，由于缺乏持久状态的瞬态条件信号，系统性地存在结构漂移、身份漂移和质量衰减问题。我们提出WAM-Sim，一种以持久分层记忆为锚定的驾驶世界模型，并通过在线流匹配强化学习进行优化。WAM-Sim在三个时间和语义尺度上构建持久上下文：姿态对齐的结构标记编码持久道路拓扑，只读场景标记提供地理定位的背景外观，以及一次写入的实例标记在遮挡和分块边界之间保持个体交通参与者的身份。为恢复因多尺度条件化而退化的视觉清晰度和物理合理性，我们引入一种在线后训练框架，该框架通过流匹配强化学习优化自生成推演，并使用与层级对齐的视觉奖励和视觉语言模型物理评判器进行引导。不变记忆凭经验将策略优化约束在锚定上下文中，有助于抑制语义崩溃和奖励攻击，同时在线强化学习系统性地强化物理常识和细粒度视觉保真度。在nuScenes基准测试中，WAM-Sim实现了优异的生成保真度（FID=3.47，FVD=25.72）和强下游感知性能（24.16 mAP，71.23道路mIoU）。在自采集数据的分钟级推演中，WAM-Sim显著减轻了结构和身份漂移，在扩展时域上保持了高场景相似性和主体身份一致性。项目页面：https://fudan-generative-vision.github.io/WAM-Sim。
tldr: WAM-Sim introduces a driving world model with persistent hierarchical memory and online flow-matching RL to mitigate structural/identity drift and quality decay in long-horizon simulation, achieving state-of-the-art fidelity on nuScenes and stable minute-scale rollouts.
tldr_zh: WAM-Sim提出了一种具有持久分层记忆和在线流匹配强化学习的驾驶世界模型，有效缓解了长时程仿真中的结构/身份漂移和质量衰减，在nuSceens上实现了最先进的保真度，并保持分钟级rollout的稳定性。

title: SHORE: Stability-Hybrid On-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Online Bin Packing
summary: Online 3D bin packing with a processing buffer requires choosing which box to pack, its orientation, and its placement while keeping the stack stable under unknown future arrivals. A collapse ends the episode and forfeits the remaining volume. Existing methods use geometric rules or hard stability masks, limiting how risk can influence the joint choice of box, orientation, and placement. We propose Stability-Hybrid On-Policy Reinforcement Learning (SHORE), which combines a learned stability probability of a placement with an on-policy estimate of its return conditional on stability. A 3D U-Net learns stability from executed outcomes and simulated alternatives, revealing outcomes of actions underrepresented in early rollouts. A discrete on-policy actor--critic uses stability predictions in both its action values and policy prior, with gates that limit the effect of an untrained or changing model. In deployment, SHORE does not require additional search or simulation overhead. In Isaac Gym, SHORE reaches 73\% space utilization by 0.4M environment steps, while the same learner without stability modeling reaches that level at about 1M. On the expanded 60-box set, SHORE achieves 0.734 space utilization versus 0.588 for the GOPT state-of-the-art baseline, with a higher placement-failure frequency (1.03\% vs. 0.63\%), trading more risk for greater packed volume. The results show faster learning and higher utilization on the more demanding realistic box arrival set. Ablations suggest that simulated alternatives provide useful early supervision, while executed outcomes alone sustain later performance. We also demonstrate the method on a real robot to verify the simplicity of integrating the method to real bin packing pipelines.
summary_zh: 在线三维装箱问题中引入处理缓冲区后，需要在未知未来到达货物的情况下，选择装入哪个箱子、确定其朝向及放置位置，同时保持堆叠稳定。一旦发生坍塌，该回合即告结束，并放弃剩余可利用空间。现有方法通常采用几何规则或硬性稳定掩码，这限制了风险对箱子选择、朝向及放置位置联合决策的影响程度。为此，我们提出了一种名为SHORE（Stability-Hybrid On-Policy Reinforcement Learning，稳定性混合同策略强化学习）的方法，它将所学到的放置稳定性概率与基于稳定性的条件回报的同策略估计相结合。我们利用三维U-Net网络从实际执行结果和模拟替代方案中学习稳定性，从而揭示早期推演中代表性不足动作的结果。离散同策略Actor-Critic模型在动作价值和策略先验中均使用稳定性预测，并设置门控机制以限制未训练或变化模型的影响。部署时，SHORE无需额外的搜索或模拟开销。在Isaac Gym环境中，SHORE在40万环境步时即达到73%的空间利用率，而同等条件下未引入稳定性建模的学习器约在100万步时才达到该水平。在扩展至60箱的测试集上，SHORE取得了0.734的空间利用率，优于当前最优基线GOPT的0.588，同时其放置失败频率略高（1.03%对比0.63%），即以更高的风险换取更大的装箱体积。实验结果表明，在更具挑战性的真实箱体到达序列上，SHORE实现了更快的收敛速度和更高的利用率。消融研究进一步表明，模拟替代方案在训练初期提供了有效的监督信号，而实际执行结果则能维持后期性能。我们还在真实机器人上验证了该方法的可行性，证明了其易于集成到实际装箱流水线中的简便性。
tldr: SHORE introduces a stability-hybrid on-policy RL method for online 3D bin packing, using a learned stability probability and conditional return estimates to improve packing density and learning speed, validated in Isaac Gym and on a real robot.
tldr_zh: SHORE提出了一种用于在线3D装箱的稳定性混合在线强化学习方法，利用学习到的稳定性概率和条件回报估计来提高装箱密度和学习速度，并在Isaac Gym和真实机器人上进行了验证。

title: Aligning Policy Encoders with a Shape Teacher
summary: 3D-aware representations can improve robotic manipulation by providing geometric information that is robust to changes in viewpoint, object position, and occlusion. However, using 3D inputs at deployment requires additional sensing and processing, making image-based policies more practical. We ask whether an image-based policy can acquire 3D shape information during training while retaining a purely image-based interface at deployment. We propose shape-teacher alignment, a training-time mechanism that uses a pretrained 3D shape representation as an alignment target for an image-based policy encoder. Specifically, we use Point-MAE features from individual objects as targets for corresponding image patches, transferring geometric structure to the policy without changing its deployment inputs or architecture. On LIBERO, shape-teacher alignment produces image representations that are more structured around object shape and corresponding parts, while substantially accelerating policy convergence and improving success rates. For pretrained policies, convergence is accelerated by 4.7x and 5.6x on the Object and Spatial suites, respectively, without requiring the shape teacher or depth input at deployment.
summary_zh: 三维感知表示能够通过提供对视角变化、物体位置变化以及遮挡具有鲁棒性的几何信息，从而提升机器人操作性能。然而，在部署阶段使用三维输入需要额外的感知与处理成本，这使得基于图像的策略更具实用性。我们探究是否可以在训练过程中使基于图像的策略获取三维形状信息，同时保持部署阶段纯粹基于图像的接口。为此，我们提出形状教师对齐机制，这是一种训练阶段的策略，利用预训练的三维形状表示作为图像策略编码器的对齐目标。具体而言，我们使用来自单个物体的Point-MAE特征作为对应图像块的目标，从而在不改变策略部署输入或架构的前提下，将几何结构迁移至策略中。在LIBERO基准上，形状教师对齐使图像表示围绕物体形状及其对应部件形成更有序的结构，同时显著加速策略收敛并提升成功率。对于预训练策略，在Object套件和Spatial套件上收敛速度分别提升4.7倍和5.6倍，且部署时无需形状教师或深度输入。
tldr: This paper introduces shape-teacher alignment, a training-time method that transfers 3D shape knowledge from Point-MAE to image-based robot policies, accelerating convergence and improving success rates on LIBERO without requiring 3D inputs at deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出形状教师对齐方法，在训练时将Point-MAE的3D形状知识迁移到基于图像的机器人策略中，在LIBERO上加速收敛并提高成功率，且部署时无需3D输入。

title: AffordJEV: Affordance Grounding by Confirming Candidate Regions
summary: Affordance grounding asks which visible part of an object performs a requested operation, a basic capability for embodied manipulation and human--robot interaction. Most existing methods follow a System Two paradigm: a multimodal language model first writes a chain of thought and then turns its conclusion into a box or points for a segmenter. This incurs considerable inference cost, gives the semantic decision little direct control over the extent of the final region, and makes mistakes hard to correct. Yet locating an affordance is essentially a perceptual judgment that need not be argued out in words. We therefore propose, in which frozen segmenters propose candidate regions and a System One model decides directly which of them perform the operation, generating no text and reading each decision from a single forward pass. Our contributions are twofold. (1) An inference framework that confirms candidate regions level by level, from object to part to sub-part, with evidence passed between the levels in both directions so that the levels correct one another. (2) A System One model trained for this framework: existing System One models are built for general-purpose decisions, judge one candidate per request and are ill-suited to the framework's region questions, so ours learns directly from the requests the framework itself produces and judges all candidates of a level at once. Trained only on InstructPart and evaluated with definition-aligned operation words, outperforms chain-of-thought methods in domain and in zero-shot transfer to UMD and IIT-AFF, is better overall than existing System One models run in the same framework, and needs fewer judge requests. To our knowledge, is the first approach to bring System One models to affordance grounding.
summary_zh: 功能可供性定位是指确定物体上哪个可见部分能够执行所请求的操作，这是具身操作和人机交互中的一项基本能力。现有方法大多遵循System Two范式：多模态语言模型首先生成思维链，然后将其结论转化为分割器的边界框或点。这种方式带来了相当大的推理成本，使得语义决策难以直接控制最终区域的范围，并且错误难以纠正。然而，定位可供性本质上是一种感知判断，无需用语言进行论证。因此，我们提出了一种方法，其中冻结的分割器提出候选区域，System One模型直接判断哪些区域执行该操作，不生成任何文本，并通过单次前向传播读取每个决策。我们的贡献有两方面。（1）一种推理框架，从对象到部件再到子部件，逐级确认候选区域，并在各级之间双向传递证据，使各级相互纠正。（2）针对该框架训练的System One模型：现有的System One模型是为通用决策而构建的，每次请求仅判断一个候选，不适合该框架的区域问题，因此我们的模型直接学习框架自身产生的请求，并同时判断一个层级的所有候选。仅在InstructPart上训练，并使用与定义对齐的操作词进行评估，该方法在领域内以及向UMD和IIT-AFF的零样本迁移中优于思维链方法，在同一框架下运行时总体上优于现有System One模型，并且需要的判断请求更少。据我们所知，这是首次将System One模型引入功能可供性定位的方法。
tldr: AffordJEV introduces a System One inference framework for affordance grounding, where frozen segmenters propose candidate regions and a trained model directly confirms which candidates afford the requested operation, eliminating chain-of-thought text generation. It improves accuracy and efficiency over System Two methods across multiple datasets.
tldr_zh: AffordJEV 提出了一种用于可供性定位的 System One 推理框架，由冻结的分割器提出候选区域，并由训练好的模型直接确认哪些候选区域能实现请求的操作，从而无需生成思维链文本，在多个数据集上比 System Two 方法更准确高效。

title: Seeing Beyond the Next Step: World-Model-Guided Human-Like Navigation in Multi-Agent Scenes
summary: Selecting a next motion in a populated scene is not just a matter of avoiding what is currently in the way: an action can be locally feasible yet drift onto the road instead of the crosswalk, cut into a stream of crossing pedestrians, or bottleneck a narrow passage. These failure modes are invisible from the current state alone, and acting on them requires reasoning about what each candidate action will cause. World models offer exactly this, namely action-conditioned predictions of the future, but rolling them out at every decision step is a cost deployable navigation systems cannot pay, and the field has largely traded foresight for speed. We argue this is a false dichotomy. The natural place for a world model in human-aware navigation is at training time, as a preference oracle that distills foresight into a fast policy, rather than at inference time, as an online planner. We pair a discrete visual action prior with two task-aligned world models, one for nearby social dynamics and one for future scene semantics, that score candidate actions by their predicted consequences and refine the policy through group-relative preference distillation. At deployment, both world models are removed and the policy acts in a single forward pass. Across five held-out evaluation scenarios, this yields navigation that is simultaneously safer, more socially and group-coherent, and more goal-directed than strong reactive and learned baselines, with naive observers rating the resulting motion as more human-like. Taken together, our findings point to a different approach for bringing world-model foresight into deployable agents: not accelerating rollouts, but amortizing them into the policy so that the cost of looking ahead is confined to training. Project page: https://seoneun.github.io/-NeurIPS-2026-Seeing-Beyond-the-Next-Step/
summary_zh: 在人群密集的场景中选择下一步动作，不仅仅是避开当前障碍的问题：一个动作在局部上或许是可行的，却可能漂移离开人行横道而进入车道、切入横穿而过的行人流，或在狭窄通道造成瓶颈。这些失效模式仅从当前状态是无法察觉的，而要应对它们，需要对每个候选动作将引发的后果进行推理。世界模型恰恰提供了这种能力，即基于动作的未来状态条件预测，但在每个决策步骤中进行 rollout 的成本是实际部署的导航系统无法承受的，因此该领域在很大程度上以速度换取了前瞻性。我们认为这是一种错误的二分法。在人机共融导航中，世界模型的天然位置是在训练阶段，作为将前瞻能力蒸馏进快速策略的偏好裁判，而非在推理阶段充当在线规划器。我们将离散视觉动作先验与两个面向任务对齐的世界模型相结合——一个负责邻近社会动力学，另一个负责未来场景语义——通过预测的后果对候选动作进行评分，并通过群体相对偏好蒸馏来优化策略。部署时，两个世界模型均被移除，策略只需一次前向传播即可执行。在五个留出评估场景中，该方法相比强反应式基线和学习基线，同时实现了更安全、更具社会性与群体一致性、更目标导向的导航效果，且未经过训练的评估者认为其运动更接近人类行为。综合来看，我们的研究指向了一种将世界模型前瞻能力引入可部署智能体的不同路径：并非加速 rollout，而是将其摊销进策略之中，使前瞻的成本仅存在于训练阶段。项目主页：https://seoneun.github.io/-NeurIPS-2026-Seeing-Beyond-the-Next-Step/
tldr: The paper proposes using world models at training time as preference oracles to distill foresight into a fast, single-pass navigation policy, achieving more human-like and safer navigation in multi-agent scenes without online rollouts.
tldr_zh: 本文提出在训练时使用世界模型作为偏好预言机，将远见蒸馏到快速单步导航策略中，在无需在线推演的情况下实现更安全、更类人的多智能体场景导航。

title: Dual-Arm Tabletop Rearrangement with Movable Stacking and Gap-Aware Push Transfers
summary: Object rearrangement in cluttered tabletop scenes is challenging, especially in wide workspaces where dual-arm systems improve coverage and efficiency. Limited free space often necessitates buffering, while objects near or across the shared reachability region of the manipulators must be transferred under careful coordination to avoid inter-arm collisions. Conventional inter-arm transfer typically relies on a fixed handoff configuration, which constrains where and how objects are exchanged, enforces spatiotemporal synchronization of the arms, and reduces flexibility in dense layouts. This paper presents a dual-arm rearrangement framework that combines movable stacking with Gap-Aware Push Transfer for asynchronous cross-boundary exchange. The method scans the shared boundary to identify collision-free transfer gaps, places an object near a selected crossing point, and then pushes it into the receiving workspace without requiring simultaneous interaction between the two arms. A joint Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-based planner coordinates both manipulators while reasoning over buffering and transfer decisions, and execution cost is used after planning to assess the resulting plan. Experiments show that the proposed method shortens joint execution sequences and becomes increasingly advantageous over a fixed handoff baseline as scene density increases, achieving lower execution cost in denser scenes while remaining competitive in lighter ones.
summary_zh: 在杂乱桌面场景中的物体重排具有挑战性，尤其是在广域工作空间中，双臂系统可提升覆盖范围和效率。有限的空闲空间通常需要缓冲操作，而位于机械臂共享可达区域附近或跨越该区域的物体必须在精细协调下进行交接，以避免机械臂间碰撞。传统的臂间交接通常依赖固定的交接构型，这限制了物体交换的位置和方式，强制双臂时空同步，并降低了在密集布局中的灵活性。本文提出了一种双臂重排框架，结合可移动堆叠与间隙感知推送交接，实现异步跨边界物体交换。该方法扫描共享边界以识别无碰撞交接间隙，将物体放置在选定的穿越点附近，然后将其推入接收工作空间，无需两臂同时交互。基于联合蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的规划器协调两只机械臂，同时对缓冲与交接决策进行推理，并在规划后使用执行代价评估所生成的方案。实验表明，所提方法缩短了联合执行序列，且随着场景密度增加，相较于固定交接基线具有越来越明显的优势，在较密集场景中实现更低执行代价，同时在较稀疏场景中保持竞争力。
tldr: This paper presents a dual-arm tabletop rearrangement framework using movable stacking and a gap-aware push transfer strategy to enable asynchronous inter-arm object exchange, with a joint MCTS-based planner minimizing execution cost, showing advantages in dense scenes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种双臂桌面重排框架，利用可移动堆叠和间隙感知推传策略实现异步跨臂物体交换，并通过联合MCTS规划器降低执行成本，在密集场景中优于固定交接基线。

title: PhySA: Decoupling Aesthetic and Physical Rewards for Humanoid Locomotion
summary: Humanoid locomotion policies trained without an explicit smoothness objective tend to produce jerky, high-energy gaits that stress actuators. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer an appealing reward source: given a rendered rollout, a VLM returns an aesthetic quality score on [0,10] without task-specific feature engineering. We find, however, that aesthetic preference and physical smoothness point in opposite directions: across four production VLMs, clips with higher joint acceleration receive higher aesthetic scores (mean Pearson r=+0.66). We study PhySA (Physical Smoothness and Aesthetics), which keeps the two on separate, independently removable reward channels: a sparse, asynchronous VLM score and a phase-triggered correction channel that adjusts physical penalty weights from simulator state. Ablations attribute the smoothness gain to the correction channel. On MuJoCo Humanoid-v5 at 2.6M steps, PhySA lowers joint acceleration by 26 to 32% relative to vanilla PPO, Text2Reward, and Eureka (three seeds), at the cost of shorter episodes. In a single extended run it lowers joint acceleration by 59.5% relative to Prompt2Policy, while a three-seed replication shows a smaller, non-significant reduction (7.2%). The gain does not transfer to IsaacLab or the Unitree G1, even after rescaling the smoothness term.
summary_zh: 人体动作控制策略若缺少显式的平滑性目标，往往会产生急促、高能耗的步态，对执行器造成较大压力。视觉-语言模型（VLMs）提供了一种颇具吸引力的奖励来源：给定一段渲染出的动作序列，VLM无需针对特定任务的特征工程，即可返回一个[0,10]区间内的美学质量评分。然而，我们发现美学偏好与物理平滑性指向相反方向：在四种主流VLM中，关节加速度更高的片段获得了更高的美学评分（平均Pearson相关系数r=+0.66）。我们研究了PhySA（物理平滑性与美学）方法，该方法将两者保持在独立且可分别移除的奖励通道上：一个稀疏、异步的VLM评分通道和一个由相位触发的校正通道，后者根据模拟器状态调整物理惩罚权重。消融实验将平滑性提升归因于校正通道。在MuJoCo Humanoid-v5上，经过260万步训练，与标准PPO、Text2Reward和Eureka相比（三种随机种子），PhySA将关节加速度降低了26%至32%，但代价是回合长度缩短。在单次扩展运行中，相对于Prompt2Policy，PhySA将关节加速度降低了59.5%；而三次种子重复实验则显示出较小且不显著的降幅（7.2%）。该提升效果未迁移至IsaacLab或Unitree G1，即便重新调整平滑项的权重系数亦然。
tldr: PhySA decouples aesthetic VLM rewards from physics-based smoothness penalties to reduce joint acceleration in humanoid locomotion, showing improvements in MuJoCo but limited transfer.
tldr_zh: PhySA将美学VLM奖励与基于物理的平滑惩罚分离，以减少人形机器人运动中的关节加速度，在MuJoCo中有所改善但迁移有限。

title: Energy-Aware Open-Vocabulary Detection Scheduling for Low-Power Robotic Autonomy
summary: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) lets robots search for run-time object queries, but fixed-rate inference spends embedded compute on low-value frames during idle motion, map revisits, or stable viewpoints. This paper presents an energy-aware OVD scheduler for low-power mobile robots. The scheduler uses odometry, map change, and detector confidence to switch among low-, mid-, and high-power YOLO-World-S modes on a Jetson Orin Nano. We evaluate the energy-quality trade-off on an AgileX LIMO using 40 real navigation trials: two target objects, five placements per target-policy pair, and four perception policies. Across bottle and cup trials, the scheduler records 8/10 mission success compared with 7/10 for each fixed-rate baseline, while reducing mean Jetson input power (a Jetson-side power-draw metric) by 5.2% relative to an 8 Hz high-rate baseline and lowering achieved OVD call rate by 34.0%. It does not minimize mission-window Jetson input energy because longer missions can erase instantaneous power savings. A separate 60 s stationary microbenchmark isolates the perception workload: the scheduler lowers mean power from 8.045 W to 7.301 W and energy from 484.7 J to 438.1 J relative to the 8 Hz baseline. These results support robot-state-aware OVD scheduling as a promising power-management mechanism with competitive task reliability, while showing that mission-window Jetson input energy must be read together with task progress and runtime.
summary_zh: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）使机器人能够在运行时搜索目标查询，但固定频率的推理在空闲运动、地图重访或稳定视角期间会将嵌入式算力浪费在低价值帧上。本文提出了一种面向低功耗移动机器人的能量感知OVD调度器。该调度器利用里程计、地图变化和检测置信度，在Jetson Orin Nano上的低、中、高功耗YOLO-World-S模式之间进行切换。我们在AgileX LIMO上通过40次真实导航试验评估了能量与质量的权衡：两个目标物体、每个目标-策略组合五种放置位置以及四种感知策略。在瓶子和杯子试验中，调度器实现了8/10的任务成功率，而每个固定频率基线均为7/10，同时相对于8 Hz高频基线，Jetson平均输入功率（一种Jetson侧功耗指标）降低了5.2%，实现的OVD调用率降低了34.0%。调度器并未最小化任务窗口内的Jetson输入能量，因为更长的任务持续时间可能会抵消瞬时功耗节省。一项独立的60秒静态微基准测试隔离了感知工作负载：相对于8 Hz基线，调度器将平均功率从8.045 W降至7.301 W，能量从484.7 J降至438.1 J。这些结果支持将机器人状态感知的OVD调度作为一种有前景的功耗管理机制，其在任务可靠性方面具有竞争力，同时也表明任务窗口内的Jetson输入能量必须与任务进展和运行时间一起综合分析。
tldr: This paper introduces an energy-aware scheduler for open-vocabulary object detection on low-power mobile robots, dynamically switching between YOLO-World-S modes based on robot state to reduce power consumption while maintaining task success, validated on a Jetson Orin Nano with 40 real navigation trials.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向低功耗移动机器人的能量感知开放词汇目标检测调度器，根据机器人状态动态切换YOLO-World-S模式，在保持任务成功率的同时降低功耗，并在Jetson Orin Nano上通过40次真实导航试验验证。

title: GraspBench: Execution-Aware Cross-Robot Evaluation of 6-DoF Grasp Generation in MuJoCo
summary: Modern 6-DoF grasp generators are often evaluated using grasp scores, dataset-level metrics, or single-robot demonstrations, yet proposal quality alone does not determine whether a grasp is executable by a particular robot. We present GraspBench, a controlled MuJoCo protocol for evaluating complete grasp-generation pipelines after robot-specific inverse-kinematics filtering, motion planning, and fixed approach-close-lift execution. GraspBench evaluates six configured pipelines across four robot embodiments, five diagnostic objects, and a structured tabletop pose grid, yielding 540 scenarios per method and 3,240 method-scenario evaluations in total. Missing outputs are conservatively counted as failures, and success follows the binary lift criterion produced by each method's execution runner. GraspGen achieves the highest overall success rate (73.1%), followed by EconomicGrasp (63.5%), while robot- and object-conditioned analyses reveal substantial variation across embodiments and object geometries. GPG produces the largest native candidate sets but achieves 44.3% success, indicating that proposal volume alone does not guarantee robot-executable grasps. Cluster-aware paired intervals support the principal method differences while not estimating repeated-execution uncertainty. The results characterize complete configured pipelines on fixed scenarios rather than intrinsic model quality or stochastic repeatability, showing that grasping performance depends jointly on the generator, robot embodiment, scene, and execution protocol.
summary_zh: 现代6自由度抓取生成器通常通过抓取得分、数据集级指标或单机器人演示进行评估，然而，提案质量本身并不能决定某个抓取是否可被特定机器人执行。我们提出了GraspBench，一种受控的MuJoCo协议，用于在机器人特定的逆运动学过滤、运动规划以及固定的接近-闭合-提升执行之后，评估完整的抓取生成流水线。GraspBench在四种机器人本体、五种诊断对象和结构化桌面位姿网格上评估六种配置的流水线，每种方法产生540个场景，总计3,240个方法-场景评估。缺失输出保守计数为失败，成功遵循各方法执行运行器生成的二元提升标准。GraspGen实现了最高的总体成功率（73.1%），其次是EconomicGrasp（63.5%），而基于机器人和对象的条件分析揭示了不同本体和对象几何形状之间的显著差异。GPG生成最大的原生候选集，但仅达到44.3%的成功率，表明提案数量本身并不能保证机器人可执行的抓取。聚类感知的配对区间支持主要方法差异，但不估计重复执行的不确定性。结果表征了固定场景下完整配置的流水线，而非内在模型质量或随机可重复性，表明抓取性能共同取决于生成器、机器人本体、场景和执行协议。
tldr: GraspBench introduces a MuJoCo-based evaluation protocol to assess complete 6-DoF grasp-generation pipelines across multiple robots, showing that robot embodiment, motion planning, and execution critically affect grasp success beyond proposal quality.
tldr_zh: GraspBench 提出了一种基于 MuJoCo 的评估协议，用于跨多机器人评估完整的六自由度抓取生成流程，表明机器人本体、运动规划和执行对抓取成功率的决定性影响。

title: Real-Time Event-Based LED Tracking and Pose Estimation with PWM-Encoded Markers
summary: Event cameras are neuromorphic vision sensors with pixels that independently and asynchronously respond to brightness changes at microsecond resolution, supporting state estimation under rapid motion, motion blur, and high dynamic range (HDR) illumination. This also enables capture of high-frequency blinking patterns from light-emitting diodes (LEDs). Based on this, we propose a real-time event-based framework for LED tracking and six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) relative pose estimation using pulse-width modulation (PWM)-encoded LED markers. Multiple LEDs share a common blinking frequency and encode identities through distinct PWM duty cycles, reducing frequency-resource requirements and computational cost. Our dual-rate asynchronous tracking framework combines low-rate LED detection with high-rate raw-event updates, maintaining robust LED identity association and accurate pixel-level tracking under rapid motion. LED identities and positions establish reliable 2D-3D correspondences for real-time metric 6-DoF relative pose estimation. Extensive evaluations on a self-collected dataset demonstrate robustness under large motion flow and transient image-plane LED overlap. Furthermore, we develop a coordinated robotic platform comprising a quadrotor and a Mecanum-wheeled mobile robot, demonstrating the proposed framework's potential for closed-loop drone guidance through hovering and target-following experiments under time-varying HDR illumination, with onboard deployment on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. The dataset and implementation will be released to facilitate further research.
summary_zh: 事件相机是一种神经形态视觉传感器，其像素能够独立且异步地对亮度变化作出响应，时间分辨率达微秒级，支持在快速运动、运动模糊及高动态范围（HDR）光照条件下的状态估计。这一特性也使其能够捕获发光二极管（LED）发出的高频闪烁模式。基于此，我们提出了一种实时的事件驱动框架，用于基于脉冲宽度调制（PWM）编码LED标记的LED跟踪与六自由度（6-DoF）相对位姿估计。多个LED共享同一闪烁频率，并通过不同的PWM占空比编码身份信息，从而降低频率资源需求与计算成本。我们的双速率异步跟踪框架将低速率LED检测与高速率原始事件更新相结合，在快速运动下保持稳健的LED身份关联和像素级精确跟踪。LED身份与位置为实时度量级6-DoF相对位姿估计建立了可靠的2D-3D对应关系。在自采集数据集上的广泛评估表明，该框架在大运动流量及图像平面上瞬时LED重叠场景下具有鲁棒性。此外，我们开发了一个协同机器人平台，包含一架四旋翼飞行器与一台麦克纳姆轮移动机器人，并通过悬停与目标跟踪实验，在时变HDR光照条件下验证了所提框架在闭环无人机引导方面的潜力，同时实现在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上的机载部署。数据集与实现代码将对外公开，以促进进一步研究。
tldr: This paper proposes a real-time event-based framework for LED tracking and 6-DoF pose estimation using PWM-encoded markers, and demonstrates its application in closed-loop drone guidance on a coordinated robotic platform.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个基于事件的实时LED跟踪和6自由度姿态估计框架，利用PWM编码标记，并在协同机器人平台上展示了其在闭环无人机引导中的应用。

title: Whole-Body Elasto-Geometrical Calibration of Wheeled Humanoid Robots Using a Shared-Waist Dual-Chain Model
summary: Wheeled humanoid robots carry both arms on one actuated waist, usually without torque sensors, so the accuracy of both end-effectors depends on a single waist model. After a first stage that estimates the tracker and target extrinsics, we identify the waist and both arms in one problem from the target positions on both flanges, measured by an optical tracker. The kinematic model is complete, with waist-base, parallel-axis, and branch parameters; arm compliances are driven by measured torques and waist compliances by gravity torques of the robot's mass model; and Gaussian priors with evidence-maximizing scales stabilize the estimate. Independent and sequential single-chain calibration are restrictions of this problem, and its waist information is the sum of the single-chain Schur complements. On two robots with different waists, each without and with a payload, calibration reduces the mean errors on held-out poses from 11.3-31.1 mm to 0.50-1.11 mm. For every training-set size from 20 poses to all, the method has 17-63% lower mean errors than adaptations of two published whole-body calibration methods, mainly through the waist compliance. Independent calibration yields two waist models; using either for both arms raises the other arm's error to up to 3.21 mm.
summary_zh: 轮式人形机器人的双臂安装于同一个主动腰部，且通常不配备力矩传感器，因此两个末端执行器的精度依赖于单一的腰部模型。在完成跟踪器与目标外部参数估计的第一阶段后，我们基于光学跟踪器测量的两个法兰上的目标位置，在单一问题中同时识别腰部及双臂参数。该运动学模型完整，包含腰部基座参数、平行轴参数及分支参数；手臂柔顺性由测量力矩驱动，腰部柔顺性由机器人质量模型的重力矩驱动；同时，采用具有证据最大化尺度的高斯先验以增强估计的稳定性。独立的单链顺序标定是该问题的特例，其腰部信息为各单链Schur补之和。在两台腰部结构不同的机器人上，分别在有无负载的情况下进行实验，标定将保留姿态上的平均误差从11.3–31.1毫米降低至0.50–1.11毫米。对于从20个姿态到全部训练集的所有规模，该方法相比两种已发表的全身标定方法的改进版本，平均误差降低17%–63%，主要归因于腰部柔顺性的建模。独立标定产生两个腰部模型；若将任一模型用于双臂，则另一只手臂的误差最高升至3.21毫米。
tldr: This paper presents a whole-body elasto-geometrical calibration method for wheeled humanoid robots using a shared-waist dual-chain model, which significantly improves end-effector accuracy on two real robots by modeling waist and arm compliance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于共享腰部双链模型的轮式人形机器人全身弹性几何标定方法，通过建立腰部和手臂的柔顺模型，在两个真实机器人上显著提高了末端执行器的精度。

title: Embodied RAG++: Retrieval-Augmented Generation From What Exists to What Works in Embodied Scenes
summary: To serve a request in a human environment, a robot system must find an object that satisfies a functional requirement and a robot that can feasibly reach it. Scene graphs record which objects exist and where, but they often omit capabilities documented only in product manuals. Retrieval-augmented generation methods can read such manuals, yet they rarely reason jointly over object capabilities, physical instances, robot states, and dynamic connectivity. We introduce E2W-Bench, the Exists-to-Works Benchmark, which links dynamic hybrid scene graphs with real product manuals to evaluate capability-grounded robot--object assignment under availability, mobility, vertical-reach, and connector constraints. We also present Embodied RAG++, a spatially grounded retrieval framework that scopes retrieval to the manuals linked to candidate objects, caches extracted capabilities per product model, and resolves robot--object feasibility through deterministic spatial reasoning. On E2W-Bench, Embodied RAG++ reaches a pair accuracy of 0.90 with Qwen2.5-32B and 1.00 with Llama3.3-70B, compared with at most 0.30 and 0.55 for the baselines, while requiring the shortest preprocessing time among the retrieval-based methods and tying for the lowest total token count.
summary_zh: 摘要：为在人类环境中处理请求，机器人系统必须找到满足功能要求的物体，以及能够实际到达该物体的机器人。场景图记录了哪些物体存在及其位置，但往往忽略了仅在产品手册中记载的能力信息。检索增强生成方法能够阅读此类手册，但很少对物体能力、物理实例、机器人状态和动态连接性进行联合推理。我们提出E2W-Bench（从存在到可用基准），将动态混合场景图与实际产品手册相结合，在可用性、移动性、垂直可达和连接器约束下评估基于能力的机器人-物体分配。我们还提出具身RAG++，一种空间接地检索框架，将检索范围限定在与候选物体关联的手册中，按产品型号缓存提取的能力信息，并通过确定性空间推理解决机器人-物体可行性问题。在E2W-Bench上，具身RAG++在Qwen2.5-32B上达到0.90的配对准确率，在Llama3.3-70B上达到1.00，而基线方法分别最多为0.30和0.55，同时在基于检索的方法中所需预处理时间最短，总令牌数并列最低。
tldr: Introduces E2W-Bench and Embodied RAG++, a retrieval-augmented framework that jointly reasons over scene graphs, product manuals, and robot capabilities to assign feasible robot-object pairs under spatial and physical constraints, achieving high pair accuracy on a new benchmark.
tldr_zh: 提出了E2W-Bench基准和Embodied RAG++框架，通过结合场景图、产品手册和机器人能力进行空间感知的检索增强生成，在机器人-物体配对任务上显著优于基线。

title: Training-Independent Validation of a Learning-Based Controller for Stunt Maneuvers
summary: Learned controllers for vehicle maneuvers are usually validated under the conditions and objective used to train them, where they appear highly reliable, yet the parameters that change on real roads are often not those the model was trained on. We argue that validation must be independent of training: it should vary physical parameters that training kept fixed and use acceptance criteria absent from the training objective. A learning-based control policy, G-Maneuver, with 90.11% success is tested for stunt-level maneuvers. A looser terminal-heading score ranked the worst setting as the best. Because real stunt tests are safety-critical, a simulation-to-reality-to-simulation (Sim2Real2Sim) loop uses the simulation to select safe zones for real-vehicle trials with 16.9% acceptance. Automotive safety analysis frameworks are used to identify parameters for validation using coverage tests. We demonstrated that the kinematic stunt-driving indicators, namely heading change, sideslip, and speed-normalized yaw rate, match between simulation and the real world, while force and roll indicators do not, which identifies the indicators that can support safe deployment. A video of the experiments is available at https://youtu.be/dN1Oes8pNIo.
summary_zh: 学习型车辆 maneuvers 控制器通常在其训练所使用的条件和目标下进行验证，在这种情况下它们表现出高度可靠性，然而实际道路上变化的参数往往并非模型训练时所针对的参数。我们认为验证必须独立于训练：应改变训练中保持固定的物理参数，并采用训练目标中不包含的验收标准。一种基于学习的控制策略 G-Maneuver 在特技级 maneuvers 测试中取得了 90.11% 的成功率。一个较宽松的终端航向评分将最差的设置评为最佳。由于真实特技测试关乎安全，模拟-现实-模拟（Sim2Real2Sim）循环利用模拟来为真实车辆试验选择安全区域，其接受率为 16.9%。采用汽车安全分析框架，通过覆盖测试来确定用于验证的参数。我们证明了运动学特技驾驶指标，即航向变化、侧滑和速度归一化横摆角速度，在模拟与真实世界之间相匹配，而力和侧倾指标则不匹配，这识别出了能够支持安全部署的指标。实验视频可在 https://youtu.be/dN1Oes8pNIo 观看。
tldr: This paper proposes a training-independent validation framework for learned stunt-driving controllers, using Sim2Real2Sim loops and automotive safety analysis to identify reliable kinematic indicators while revealing mismatches in force/roll dynamics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种训练无关的验证框架，用于特技驾驶学习控制器，通过Sim2Real2Sim循环和汽车安全分析识别可靠的动力学指标，并发现力与侧倾指标存在失配。

title: Fast and Reliable Open-Vocabulary Object Search with Absence Detection from Robot Memory
summary: Mobile manipulators deployed in everyday human environments, such as homes for assistive care or flexible automation, often need to locate specific objects on demand from accumulated observations. Equally important, they must reliably determine when a target is absent before committing to navigation or interaction. Existing approaches demand either slow exhaustive re-processing or expensive 3D representations, and are evaluated on recall and accuracy rather than specificity, leaving their ability to abstain on missing targets unmeasured. We find existing systems that search using text or visual embedding almost never abstain on absent objects achieving at most 9\% specificity. To support accurate search at speed, we present a two-stage architecture that decouples fast candidate retrieval from verified selection, enabling both high recall and reliable absence detection from sequential RGB observations with pose. We evaluate eight retrieval-selection configurations plus an exhaustive search baseline across ScanNet apartment scenes, including significant numbers of absent objects. Adding a visual verification step to caption-based retrieval matches or exceeds exhaustive search reliability while requiring an order of magnitude fewer detector calls. We reproduce ScanNet scores on a physical robot operating entirely on-board with a single consumer GPU running in real time.
summary_zh: 移动操控机器人在日常人类环境中部署时（例如辅助护理或灵活自动化场景中的家庭环境），通常需要根据累积的观测按需定位特定物体。同样重要的是，在决定进行导航或交互之前，它们必须可靠地判断目标物体是否不存在。现有方法要么要求缓慢的穷举式重新处理，要么依赖昂贵的3D表示，并且仅在召回率和准确率上评估，而未考虑特异性，因此它们对缺失目标进行弃权判断的能力未被测量。我们发现，现有使用文本或视觉嵌入进行搜索的系统几乎不会对不存在的物体弃权，其特异性最多仅达9%。为了在高速搜索的同时保证准确性，我们提出了一种两阶段架构，将快速候选检索与验证选择解耦，从而能够从带位姿的连续RGB观测中实现高召回率和可靠的缺失检测。我们在ScanNet公寓场景中评估了八种检索-验证配置以及一个穷举搜索基线，并包含大量不存在的物体。在基于描述的检索流程中加入视觉验证步骤后，其可靠性达到或超过了穷举搜索，同时所需的检测器调用次数减少了一个数量级。我们在物理机器人上完全机载地复现了ScanNet评分，使用单个消费级GPU实时运行。
tldr: This paper presents a two-stage architecture for open-vocabulary object search in mobile manipulators, using fast candidate retrieval followed by visual verification to achieve high recall and reliable absence detection from sequential RGB observations, validated in ScanNet scenes and on a real robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种两阶段架构，用于移动操作器中的开放词汇对象搜索，通过快速候选检索和视觉验证，从连续的RGB观测中实现高召回率和可靠的缺席检测，并在ScanNet场景和实体机器人上进行了验证。

title: Kinematic analysis of a double-closed-loop four-bar chain-based leg for a multimodal quadruped-pentarotor robot
summary: This paper presents the kinematic modeling and singularity analysis of a three-degree-of-freedom, double four-bar closed-loop quadruped leg mechanism. This leg is essential for transitioning between the two operational modes; therefore, it is examined in both joint and task spaces, leading to the development of its Jacobian matrix, which is vital for designing the gaits required for terrestrial mode and mid-air aerial reconfiguration (for aerial mode). Various gaits are devised for the system's motion in the MATLAB simulation, and their practical implementation on the single-leg test rig is demonstrated.
summary_zh: 本文阐述了一种三自由度、双四杆闭链四足机器人腿部机构的运动学建模与奇异性分析。该腿部机构对于两种运行模式之间的切换至关重要，因此，本文在关节空间和任务空间中分别对其进行了研究，进而推导出其雅可比矩阵，该矩阵对于设计地面模式所需的步态以及空中模式下的空中重构至关重要。在MATLAB仿真中，针对系统的运动设计了多种步态，并展示了其在单腿试验台上的实际应用实现。
tldr: This paper presents the kinematic modeling, Jacobian derivation, and singularity analysis of a double four-bar closed-loop leg for a multimodal quadruped-aerial robot, along with gait planning and single-leg test-rig validation.
tldr_zh: 本文针对一种双四连杆闭环腿机构进行了运动学建模、雅可比矩阵推导与奇异性分析，并规划了步态，在单腿试验台上进行了验证。

title: FREE-LIVO: Physically Decoupled Yet Tightly Coupled LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry
summary: LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry (LIVO) integrates complementary LiDAR, camera, and IMU measurements to achieve robust state estimation. However, most existing methods assume a fixed relative pose and accurate time synchronization between sensors. Toward modular and heterogeneous robotic systems, this paper presents FREE-LIVO, a tightly coupled odometry method that requires neither a rigid LiDAR-camera rig nor LiDAR-camera time synchronization. The proposed method uses a pretrained image feature matcher to establish correspondences between a camera image and a dense LiDAR intensity image generated from a single LiDAR scan using a generative model. From the resulting 3D point-to-pixel correspondences, we construct reprojection factors that directly constrain LiDAR and camera poses at different acquisition times. These factors are jointly optimized in a single factor graph together with constraints from point cloud registration, visual feature tracking, and the IMU measurements associated with each sensor. On six sequences from the public M3DGR dataset, FREE-LIVO achieves an average absolute trajectory error (ATE) RMSE of 0.45 m without provided LiDAR-camera extrinsic parameters and exhibits minimal accuracy degradation under time synchronization errors of up to 0.5 s. Furthermore, experiments with the LiDAR and camera mounted on separate robots demonstrate that the method can jointly estimate the trajectories of independently moving sensors.
summary_zh: 激光雷达-惯性-视觉里程计（LIVO）融合了激光雷达、相机和惯性测量单元（IMU）的互补测量信息，以实现鲁棒的状态估计。然而，现有的大多数方法假设传感器之间具有固定的相对位姿和精确的时间同步。面向模块化及异构机器人系统，本文提出了FREE-LIVO，一种紧耦合的里程计方法，该方法既不需要刚性的激光雷达-相机刚性结构，也不需要激光雷达-相机时间同步。所提出的方法利用预训练的图像特征匹配器，在相机图像与由单次激光雷达扫描通过生成模型生成的密集激光雷达强度图像之间建立对应关系。根据所得的3D点与像素的对应关系，我们构建了重投影因子，直接约束不同采集时刻的激光雷达与相机位姿。这些因子与点云配准、视觉特征跟踪以及各传感器相关联的IMU测量值的约束一起，在单个因子图中进行联合优化。在公开的M3DGR数据集的六个序列上，FREE-LIVO在未提供激光雷达-相机外参的情况下，实现了0.45米的平均绝对轨迹误差（ATE）均方根误差（RMSE），并且在时间同步误差高达0.5秒的情况下，精度退化极小。此外，将激光雷达和相机分别安装在独立机器人上的实验表明，该方法能够联合估计独立运动传感器的轨迹。
tldr: FREE-LIVO presents a LiDAR-inertial-visual odometry method that removes the need for rigid extrinsic calibration and time synchronization between LiDAR and camera, using image feature matching and generative LiDAR intensity images to jointly optimize trajectories, even for sensors on separate robots.
tldr_zh: FREE-LIVO 提出了一种无需 LiDAR 与相机之间刚性外参标定和时间同步的紧耦合里程计方法，利用图像特征匹配和生成式 LiDAR 强度图像联合优化轨迹，甚至适用于传感器安装在不同机器人上的情况。

title: Closed-Loop Physics-Based Manipulation Evaluation at a Commodity Price: What 4.4 L4 GPU hours at $3.50 Buys You
summary: Running evaluations of contact-rich robotic manipulation at statistical scale has largely been possible only at well-resourced labs, highlighting the need for affordable and efficient options for broader audiences. We present a reproducible evaluation harness wrapper based on a previous study at 200-rollout scale on serverless commodity GPUs, at a cost of approximately $3.50 USD and 38 minutes of wall-clock per replication (4.4 L4-GPU-hours across eight parallel shards). Using the harness, we report a partially controlled negative result on action chunking with sparse data: three independently trained chunked checkpoints produce zero genuine successes across 780 rollouts, while three single-step checkpoints range from 2.6% to 11.8% success rate. A per-step-replanning control partially isolates chunk prediction, rather than open-loop chunk execution as the mechanism, with the failure localized to the training formulation and multi-step prediction. This work further democratizes physics-based policy development and evaluation through our reusable harness.
summary_zh: 在统计规模上对接触丰富的机器人操作进行评估，此前基本上只有资源充足的实验室才能实现，这凸显了为广大受众提供经济高效方案的迫切需求。我们基于先前一项在无服务器商用GPU上进行的200次 rollout 规模研究，提出了一种可复现的评估测试框架封装，每次复现的成本约为3.50美元，墙钟时间为38分钟（在八个并行分片上总计4.4个L4-GPU小时）。利用该测试框架，我们报告了一个在稀疏数据下进行动作分块的部分受控阴性结果：三个独立训练的分块检查点在780次 rollout 中未产生任何真正的成功案例，而三个单步检查点的成功率介于2.6%至11.8%之间。通过逐步重新规划的控制实验，我们部分地将机制归因于分块预测本身，而非开环分块执行，并进一步将失败定位到训练公式和多步预测环节。这项工作通过我们可复用的测试框架，进一步推动了基于物理的策略开发与评估的普及化。
tldr: This paper presents a low-cost, reproducible evaluation harness for contact-rich robotic manipulation policies on commodity GPUs, and reports a negative result on action chunking with sparse data, showing that chunked predictions fail while single-step policies succeed.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在商品GPU上进行接触丰富机器人操作策略评估的低成本、可复现的评估工具，并报告了在稀疏数据下动作分块的负面结果：分块预测失败，而单步策略成功。

title: Kinematic Hypothesis Context: Embodiment-Conditioned Learned Video Coding for Bandwidth-Limited Robot Policy Uplinks
summary: Robots increasingly run large vision-language-action policies on remote servers, making the camera uplink the bottleneck. Existing video codecs spend bits on content the receiver could predict: the robot's own motion. We introduce the kinematic hypothesis context, a zero-rate conditioning signal that both ends build from joint states, the robot model and the camera calibration. Ego-motion homographies, per-link robot reprojections, an end-effector plane and a background memory warp the previous reconstruction into hypotheses that condition a learned video codec. We prove that history-only and global-pose conditioning with a limited receptive field cannot access this information under large motion, and that coding gains become task gains at the policy's success cliff. On LIBERO, the context saves 23.9% bit rate over a capacity-matched history-conditioned codec and 40-56% over x264, x265 and SVT-AV1, and needs 23.2% fewer bits than DCVC-RT at equal policy action deviation; trained to lower rates, it matches DCVC-RT in PSNR. In closed loop at equal rate, OpenVLA-OFT success nearly doubles from 22.8% to 43.1% at 6 kbps (72.6% with lower-rate training, 23.6 points above DCVC-RT), pi_0.5 success rises from 55.5% to 77.4%, and the gain grows under packet loss. The context transfers across three codec hosts and to real robot data.
summary_zh: 机器人越来越多地在远程服务器上运行大型视觉-语言-动作策略，这使得相机上行链路成为瓶颈。现有视频编解码器将比特耗费在接收端本可预测的内容上——即机器人自身的运动。我们引入了运动学假设上下文（kinematic hypothesis context），这是一种零码率条件信号，由两端根据关节状态、机器人模型和相机标定共同构建。自运动单应矩阵、各连杆机器人重投影、末端执行器平面和背景记忆将先前重建结果扭曲为假设，用于条件化学习型视频编解码器。我们证明，在有限感受野下，仅基于历史信息和全局位姿的条件化在较大运动场景中无法获取该信息，并且编码增益在策略的成功临界点处转化为任务增益。在LIBERO基准上，该上下文相比容量匹配的历史条件化编解码器节省23.9%的码率，相比x264、x265和SVT-AV1节省40%-56%的码率，并且在同等策略动作偏差下比DCVC-RT少需23.2%的比特；在较低码率训练下，其PSNR与DCVC-RT相当。在等码率闭环测试中，OpenVLA-OFT在6 kbps下的成功率从22.8%提升至43.1%，几乎翻倍（在低码率训练下达到72.6%，高出DCVC-RT 23.6个百分点），pi_0.5的成功率从55.5%提升至77.4%，并且在丢包情况下增益进一步增大。该上下文可迁移至三种编解码器宿主及真实机器人数据。
tldr: This paper introduces a kinematic hypothesis context for learned video coding, which uses robot joint states and camera calibration to provide zero-rate conditioning for the receiver, significantly reducing bitrate and improving closed-loop policy success rates for remote robot policy uplinks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种运动学假设上下文，用于学习视频编码，利用机器人关节状态和相机标定为接收端提供零速率条件，显著降低码率并提高远程机器人策略上行链路的闭环策略成功率。

title: Dynamic Watermarking and Action-Conditioned Latent Dynamics for Secure Vision-Based Controllers
summary: Replay attacks are difficult to detect in vision-based control systems because previously recorded observations can remain plausible while the physical system follows a different trajectory. This paper develops an adaptive dynamic-watermarking framework for detecting replay attacks against vision-based controllers. A private Gaussian watermark is added to the nominal control input, and a control input-conditioned latent dynamics network (LDN) predicts the corresponding evolution in a compact latent space learned from image observations. Attack evidence is obtained from the discrepancy between the predicted latent response and the latent representation of the received image observation. A reinforcement learning policy adjusts the watermark covariance using the latent state and detector confidence, thereby balancing attack detectability, watermark energy, and control distortion. A Lagrangian penalty on task-specific safety costs is included during training to limit the adverse effect of the excitation. The framework is evaluated on a vision-guided UR5 manipulation task in which the robot reaches a target while avoiding a moving human arm under nominal and replay-attacked observations.
summary_zh: 重放攻击在基于视觉的控制系统中难以检测，因为先前记录的观测数据在物理系统沿不同轨迹运行时仍可能保持合理。本文开发了一种自适应动态水印框架，用于检测针对基于视觉控制器的重放攻击。在名义控制输入中添加私有高斯水印，并通过控制输入条件化的潜在动态网络（LDN）在从图像观测中学习的紧凑潜在空间中预测相应的演化过程。攻击证据来源于预测的潜在响应与接收到的图像观测的潜在表示之间的差异。强化学习策略利用潜在状态和检测器置信度调整水印协方差，从而平衡攻击可检测性、水印能量和控制失真。训练过程中加入对任务特定安全成本的拉格朗日惩罚，以限制激励带来的不利影响。该框架在视觉引导的UR5操作任务中进行了评估，在该任务中，机器人在名义观测和重放攻击观测下到达目标，同时避开移动的人手臂。
tldr: This paper proposes an adaptive dynamic-watermarking framework with an action-conditioned latent dynamics network to detect replay attacks in vision-based control systems, evaluated on a UR5 manipulation task.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于自适应动态水印和动作条件潜动力学网络的视觉控制器重放攻击检测框架，并在UR5机械臂操作任务上进行了验证。

title: An Ordering Optimization for Fruit-Vegetable in High-Density Environment based on Genetic Algorithm
summary: This paper presents a robotic harvesting method that combines RGB-D fruit localization, GA-based harvest ordering, and waypoint-based robot motion in dense and unstructured crop environments. The global RGB-D camera provides 3D fruit positions for ordering, while the end-effector-mounted camera provides close-range observation during execution. The GA determines the harvesting sequence, and static or dynamic waypoints define the intermediate robot motion. The method was evaluated in a controlled laboratory testbed and in four-, five-, and six-fruit field conditions. GA solutions were compared with exhaustive enumeration, and both waypoint offsets were examined by parameter sensitivity analysis. Continuous execution reduced unnecessary Home-return motion, while the dynamic waypoint changed with the remaining fruit distribution without changing the GA sequence. In the field evaluation, the dynamic-waypoint continuous strategy produced 40 collision events and a 70.7% target-approach success rate, compared with 55 collision events and 65.3% for the static-waypoint continuous strategy.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种在密集且非结构化的作物环境中，结合RGB-D果实定位、基于遗传算法的采摘排序以及基于航路点的机器人运动的机器人采摘方法。全局RGB-D相机提供用于排序的三维果实位置，而末端执行器上安装的相机则在执行过程中提供近距离观测。遗传算法确定采摘顺序，静态或动态航路点定义机器人的中间运动路径。该方法在受控的实验室测试平台以及四果、五果和六果的田间条件下进行了评估。将遗传算法求解结果与穷举法进行了比较，并通过参数敏感性分析检验了两种航路点偏移量。连续执行减少了不必要的回Home运动，而动态航路点随剩余果实分布变化，但不改变遗传算法排序。在田间评估中，动态航路点连续策略产生了40次碰撞事件，目标接近成功率为70.7%，而静态航路点连续策略则产生55次碰撞事件，成功率为65.3%。
tldr: This paper presents a robotic harvesting method that uses a genetic algorithm to optimize fruit-picking sequences in dense environments, combining RGB-D localization and waypoint-based motion, and evaluates it in lab and field tests.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种机器人采摘方法，利用遗传算法优化密集环境中的水果采摘顺序，结合RGB-D定位和路点运动，并在实验室和田间进行了评估。

title: Efficient Diffusion Policy Fine Tuning with Latent Noise Representation Bridging
summary: Pre-trained diffusion and flow policies have emerged as powerful backbones for robotics, yet adapting them to novel data via reinforcement learning (RL) remains computationally expensive, sample inefficient and lacks theoretical guarantees. Prior approaches that fine-tune the initial noise bypass costly backpropagation through time but struggle with the "noise aliasing" problem: there does not exista natural link between the noise space value and the action space value. This paper resolves these challenges by introducing the Latent Noise Linear Markov Decision Process (LNL-MDP). We derive the Bridge Equation for LNL-MDPs which eliminates the noise aliasing problem by aligning values with a shared representation between the noise and the action space. Furthermore, our LNL-MDP fine tuning framework falls under the FineTuneRL theory with near-optimal guarantee. Leveraging these insights, we propose Latent Representation Bridging for Diffusion (LARBRID), an algorithm that efficiently learns the representation to optimize the initial distribution that steers the pre-trained model to act optimally in the environment. It yields up to 2-3$\times$ performance increases on challenging control problems across a diverse suite of robotic locomotion and manipulation tasks. Code can be found at: github.com/Maincode-Research/LARBRID.git.
summary_zh: 预训练的扩散与流策略已成为机器人领域强大的主干模型，然而通过强化学习（RL）将其适应于新数据仍面临计算开销大、样本效率低且缺乏理论保证的问题。此前通过微调初始噪声来规避耗时的时间反向传播的方法，却受制于“噪声混叠”问题：噪声空间中的取值与动作空间中的取值之间并不存在自然的对应关系。本文通过引入潜在噪声线性马尔可夫决策过程（LNL-MDP）解决了上述挑战。我们推导出LNL-MDP的桥接方程，通过在噪声空间与动作空间之间建立共享表示来对齐取值，从而消除了噪声混叠问题。此外，我们的LNL-MDP微调框架属于FineTuneRL理论范畴，并具有近最优保证。基于这些洞见，我们提出了用于扩散模型的潜在表示桥接算法（LARBRID），该算法高效地学习表示以优化初始分布，从而引导预训练模型在环境中接近最优地行动。在涵盖多种机器人运动与操作任务的挑战性控制问题上，该算法带来了高达2-3倍的性能提升。代码见：github.com/Maincode-Research/LARBRID.git。
tldr: This paper introduces LARBRID, a representation learning algorithm for fine-tuning pre-trained diffusion policies via RL, which resolves the noise aliasing problem in a Latent Noise Linear Markov Decision Process framework and achieves 2-3x performance gains on robotic locomotion and manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 LARBRID 算法，通过在潜噪声线性马尔可夫决策过程框架下学习表示来优化初始噪声分布，解决了扩散策略 RL 微调中的噪声混叠问题，并在机器人运动与操作任务上获得了 2-3 倍的性能提升。

title: VREgo: Consumer VR Headsets for Learning Robot Manipulation from Egocentric Demonstrations
summary: VREgo trains manipulation policies from demonstrations recorded on consumer VR headsets; we instantiate it with EgoKit on one such headset, the PICO 4 Ultra. On-device head and hand tracking and stereo object localisation allow the operator to begin a demonstration at the table. We adapt HumanEgo's preprocessing to estimate grasp thresholds per recording, update object positions after release, and propagate segmentation masks between keyframes. We evaluate policies in simulation on two tabletop tasks recorded by one operator. For cube placement, we compare PICO and Project Aria recordings of the same 41 layouts. With 40 training demonstrations, the PICO policies placed the cube on the tray in 67, 74, and 60 of 100 evaluation layouts across three training seeds. The corresponding Aria results were 73, 78, and 0. For a two-stage stacking task recorded with the PICO alone, the baseline placed the block on the tray in 94 of 100 layouts and met the end-of-episode criterion for both placements in two. In one diagnostic episode, repeated replanning deferred release beyond the eight executed steps. Demonstration replays also showed that the open gripper could displace the cube before grasping it. After adapting the training trajectories and adding task-specific execution rules that use simulator object positions, the system met both placement criteria in 93.8% of episodes across four evaluation noise seeds. The same 100 layouts informed rule development and evaluation. VREgo is available at https://vrego.chuange.org/.
summary_zh: VREgo利用消费者VR头显记录的演示来训练操控策略；我们通过EgoKit在PICO 4 Ultra这一头显上实例化该系统。设备上的头部和手部追踪以及立体物体定位使操作员能够在桌边开始演示。我们改进了HumanEgo的预处理流程，以逐次记录估计抓取阈值，在释放后更新物体位置，并在关键帧之间传播分割掩码。我们在模拟环境中针对由一名操作员记录的两项桌面任务评估了策略。对于立方体放置任务，我们比较了同一41种布局下PICO和Project Aria的记录结果。在使用40个训练演示的情况下，PICO策略在三种训练种子下分别于100个评估布局中的67、74和60个布局中成功将立方体放置在托盘中。对应的Aria结果分别为73、78和0。对于仅使用PICO记录的两阶段堆叠任务，基线方法在100个布局中的94个中成功将积木放置在托盘中，并在两个布局中满足两个放置阶段的回合结束标准。在一个诊断性回合中，重复的重新规划将释放推迟到了执行的八个步骤之外。演示回放还显示，开放夹爪在抓取前可能移动立方体。在调整训练轨迹并添加利用模拟器物体位置的特定任务执行规则后，系统在四种评估噪声种子下于93.8%的回合中满足了两个放置标准。相同的100种布局用于规则开发和评估。VREgo可在https://vrego.chuange.org/获取。
tldr: VREgo trains robot manipulation policies from demonstrations recorded using consumer VR headsets (PICO 4 Ultra), adapting HumanEgo's preprocessing and evaluating in simulation on tabletop tasks. It shows comparable performance to Project Aria in cube placement and achieves high success with rule-based execution enhancements in a two-stage stacking task.
tldr_zh: VREgo利用消费级VR头显（PICO 4 Ultra）录制的示教来训练机器人操作策略，改进HumanEgo的预处理，并在仿真中评估桌面任务。在立方体放置任务中与Project Aria性能相当，通过规则执行增强在两阶段堆叠任务中取得高成功率。

title: CRISP: Constraint-Resolved Interactions between Subsystems for Predictive Whole-Body Cooperation
summary: This paper presents a layered control framework that recasts high-dimensional system dynamics as a composition of dynamically interconnected subsystems, with dynamic dual-arm manipulation on the humanoid serving as a representative application. The humanoid is decomposed into a single rigid body (SRB) representing the torso and floating-base dynamic models representing the articulated arms and lower-body. The rigid connections between arm and torso and the closed kinematic chain formed between the end-effectors during cooperative manipulation are represented as holonomic constraints. The corresponding Lagrange multipliers parametrize the interaction wrenches transmitted at the shoulders and between the end-effectors. The high-level nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) jointly optimizes the subsystem state trajectories, arm torques, ground reaction forces (GRFs), and interaction wrenches, enabling online wrench design and optimization while preserving the dynamic coupling among the independently modeled subsystems. The optimized arm torques are applied directly for cooperative dual-arm manipulation, whereas the prescribed GRFs are mapped to lower-body joint torque for whole-body coordination. We validate the proposed framework through numerical simulations and hardware experiments on a G1 humanoid robot. The results demonstrate optimal interaction wrenches consistent with simulated contact measurement, cooperative dual-arm trajectory tracking, and stable whole-body coordination while executing the NMPC in online manner.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种分层控制框架，将高维系统动力学重构为动态互联子系统的组合，并以人形机器人上的动态双臂操作为代表性应用。人形机器人被分解为表示躯干的单刚体模型以及表示关节臂和下半身的浮基动力学模型。手臂与躯干之间的刚性连接，以及协作操作过程中末端执行器之间形成的闭式运动链，均以完整约束的形式加以描述。相应的拉格朗日乘子参数化表征了肩部及末端执行器之间传递的交互力旋量。高层非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）联合优化子系统状态轨迹、手臂力矩、地面反作用力（GRFs）及交互力旋量，从而在保持各独立建模子系统间动态耦合的同时，实现在线力旋量设计与优化。优化后的手臂力矩直接用于协作双臂操作，而预定的地面反作用力则映射至下半身关节力矩以实现全身协调。我们通过数值仿真及在G1人形机器人上的硬件实验对所提出的框架进行了验证。结果表明，该框架能够获得与仿真接触测量一致的优化交互力旋量，实现协作双臂轨迹跟踪，并在在线执行NMPC的同时保持稳定的全身协调。
tldr: CRISP is a layered control framework for humanoid robots that decomposes the whole-body dynamics into interconnected subsystems and uses NMPC to jointly optimize arm torques, ground reaction forces, and interaction wrenches for cooperative dual-arm manipulation, validated on a G1 humanoid in simulation and hardware.
tldr_zh: CRISP 是一种用于人形机器人的分层控制框架，将全身动力学分解为相互连接的子系统，并通过 NMPC 联合优化手臂力矩、地面反作用力和交互力，以实现双臂协同操作，已在 G1 人形机器人上通过仿真和硬件实验验证。

title: An Empirical Study of Reinforcement Learning for Keypoint Positioning of Deformable Linear Objects
summary: Deformable linear object (DLO) manipulation is challenging because high-dimensional configurations, nonlinear contact dynamics, and diverse material and geometric properties produce a broad range of object responses that are both difficult to model and data-intensive to learn. This work studies reinforcement learning for planar manipulation of a one-end-grasped DLO, focusing on training efficiency, observation design, robustness, and zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. We compare three Proximal Policy Optimization training stacks and find that the GPU-parallel MuJoCo Playground stack enables faster convergence and more consistent performance than CPU-based alternatives under the same wall-clock budget. Relative keypoint observations and an asymmetric actor-critic formulation further improve learning efficiency. Policies trained with observation noise, delay, domain randomization, and disturbances achieve simulation success rates of 96.4% for single-point tracking, 98.0% for disturbance recovery, and 88.8% for two-point tracking. Using markerless RGB-D keypoint estimation, the policies transfer without real-world fine-tuning, succeeding in 9/10, 10/10, and 8/10 physical trials, respectively.
summary_zh: 可变形线性物体（DLO）的操作因高维构型、非线性接触动力学以及多样的材料与几何属性而具有挑战性，这些因素导致物体响应范围广泛，既难以建模又需要大量数据进行学习。本研究针对一端抓持DLO的平面操作，探讨强化学习方法，重点关注训练效率、观测设计、鲁棒性及零样本模拟到现实迁移。我们比较了三种近端策略优化训练架构，发现在相同的墙钟时间预算下，基于GPU并行化的MuJoCo Playground架构比基于CPU的替代方案收敛更快、性能更为稳定。相对关键点观测与非对称演员-评论家结构进一步提升了学习效率。结合观测噪声、延迟、域随机化及干扰训练的策略，在单点跟踪、干扰恢复及两点跟踪任务中的模拟成功率分别达到96.4%、98.0%和88.8%。通过无标记RGB-D关键点估计，这些策略无需真实环境微调即可实现迁移，在物理实验中分别成功完成9/10、10/10和8/10次试验。
tldr: This paper investigates reinforcement learning for keypoint positioning of deformable linear objects in planar manipulation, comparing PPO training stacks and demonstrating zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of policies trained with domain randomization to physical trials.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了平面操作中可变形线性物体关键点定位的强化学习方法，比较了不同PPO训练栈，并展示了通过域随机化训练的策略在无微调情况下成功实现仿真到现实迁移。

title: Adaptive Hybrid Force-Vision Control with EMG-Derived References for Deformable Bottle Manipulation
summary: Robotic automation of laboratory tasks has become a growing interest to remove researchers from hazardous environments and repetitive procedures. However, even equipment as simple as squeeze bottles poses a challenging manipulation problem due to its deformability. This paper presents an adaptive hybrid vision-force controller for robotic grippers to effectively manipulate laboratory squeeze bottles to dispense liquid. This approach integrates force and vision feedback according to the interaction state, enabling effective squeezing while accounting for bottle deformation and recovery. The proposed controller is validated by comparing its performance with a pure force controller on 12 combinations of conditions consisting of 2 target dispense volumes, 2 plastic squeeze bottles, and 1 to 3 squeezes used to dispense. Human demonstrations of these operating conditions were collected using electromyography (EMG) sensing mapped to a desired grip force, which was then used as the force reference for the controllers to squeeze the bottles. Results demonstrated that the proposed adaptive hybrid vision-force controller achieved more accurate liquid dispensing with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 6.54 mL compared to a MAE of 15.92 mL from the pure force controller, while also replicating the human action recorded from the EMG signal more closely.
summary_zh: 实验室任务的机器人自动化日益受到关注，其目的是让研究人员远离危险环境和重复性操作。然而，即使是像挤瓶这样简单的设备，由于其可变形性，也构成了颇具挑战性的操控问题。本文提出了一种自适应视觉-力混合控制器，用于机器人夹爪有效操控实验室挤瓶进行液体分配。该方法根据交互状态整合力反馈与视觉反馈，在考虑瓶子变形与回弹的同时实现有效挤压。通过将该控制器与纯力控制器在12种条件组合下进行性能对比验证，这些组合包括2种目标分配体积、2种塑料挤瓶以及1至3次挤压分配。利用肌电（EMG）传感采集人类操作演示，并将其映射为期望的握力，作为控制器挤压瓶子的力参考。结果表明，所提出的自适应视觉-力混合控制器实现了更精确的液体分配，平均绝对误差（MAE）为6.54 mL，而纯力控制器的MAE为15.92 mL，同时更贴近地复现了从肌电信号记录的人类动作。
tldr: This paper introduces an adaptive hybrid force-vision controller for robotic manipulation of deformable squeeze bottles, using EMG-derived force references from human demonstrations. The controller outperforms a pure force controller in liquid dispensing accuracy and replicates human actions more closely.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种自适应混合力-视觉控制器，用于机器人操纵可变形挤压瓶，使用从人类演示中获得的EMG力参考。该控制器在液体分配精度上优于纯力控制器，并更接近人类动作。

title: Distributed Geometric Optimization and Control of Rigid Differential-Drive Formations from Relative-Position Measurements
summary: Distance based formation control fixes the shape of a robot team but leaves its position and orientation unconstrained.
