We regulate all three for differential drive robots that have only one absolute position anchor, absolute headings, body frame relative position measurements, and communication with their neighbors. We derive a two layer estimation control scheme directly from optimization. The first half of the result is a set of graph-proximal estimators that reconstruct the centroid, the anchor vector, and the centered coordinates. Exact proximal updates reach consensus in finitely many steps, and a finite number of primal dual iterations leaves a bounded reconstruction error. The controller combines proximal centroid and orientation steps with distance gradient shape regulation, and a finite rotation removes the orientation drift caused by the shape step. A discrete Lyapunov analysis gives local exponential convergence once the estimators have converged. We validate the method in ROS 2 Gazebo and in experiments with five physical robots.
summary_zh: 基于距离的编队控制固定了机器人团队的形状，但未约束其位置和朝向。我们针对仅拥有一个绝对位置锚点、绝对朝向、机体坐标系下相对位置测量以及能够与邻居通信的差速驱动机器人，对其位置、朝向和形状进行统一调节。我们直接从优化中推导出一种两层估计控制方案。结果的前半部分是一组图近端估计器，用于重建质心、锚点向量及中心化坐标。精确的近端更新在有限步内达成共识，且有限次的主-对偶迭代会留下有界的重建误差。控制器将近端质心和朝向步骤与距离梯度形状调节相结合，并通过有限次旋转消除由形状步骤引起的朝向漂移。离散李雅普诺夫分析表明，在估计器收敛后，系统具有局部指数收敛性。我们在ROS 2 Gazebo仿真中及使用五台实体机器人的实验中验证了该方法。
tldr: This paper presents a distributed optimization-based two-layer estimation-control scheme for rigid formations of differential-drive robots, using relative-position measurements and a single absolute position anchor, validated in simulation and with physical robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于分布式优化的两层估计-控制方案，用于差分驱动机器人的刚性编队，利用相对位置测量和单个绝对位置锚点，并在仿真和实物实验中验证。

title: Rethinking Self-Repair in Code-as-Policy Agents: What Drives Retry Success?
summary: Code-as-policy agents often use execution feedback to retry failed programs. Additional sampling and task guidance can also improve success, leaving the contribution of failure-specific feedback unclear. We study this question in simulated robot manipulation. A fixed lookup selects feedback templates using failure labels and the API variant. A frozen code model generates a fresh program after each scene reset. On the same 252 initial failures, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B recovers 85.3% within five retries, compared with 68.3% for resampling with the same retry cap. The advantage persists under fixed total-token budgets. Feedback from other episodes and fixed task guidance yield similar recovery point estimates, with no detected benefit from matching the coarse failure label. In a separate study, a fixed guided prompt used from the first attempt achieves an observed overall success rate similar to that of template-based feedback. Template-based feedback also lowers recovery on a nut-insertion task requiring a rim grasp, consistent with an incompatible center-grasp instruction. Evaluations of robot self-repair should include resampling, mismatched feedback, and concise, task-compatible static guidance as baselines.
summary_zh: 以代码为策略的智能体常常利用执行反馈来重试失败的程序。额外的采样和任务引导也能提升成功率，这使得失败特定反馈的具体贡献变得不明确。我们在模拟机器人操作环境中研究这一问题。固定查找表根据失败标签和API变体选择反馈模板，冻结的代码模型在每次场景重置后生成新的程序。在相同的252个初始失败案例中，Qwen2.5-Coder-7B在五次重试内恢复了85.3%的成功率，而相同重试上限下的重采样方法仅为68.3%。在固定总令牌预算下，这一优势依然存在。来自其他回合的反馈和固定任务引导在恢复点估计上结果相近，且未发现匹配粗略失败标签能带来可检测的额外收益。在一项独立研究中，从首次尝试起使用固定引导提示所观察到的总体成功率与基于模板的反馈相当。在需要边缘抓取的螺母插入任务中，基于模板的反馈反而降低了恢复率，这与不兼容的中心抓取指令一致。对机器人自我修复的评估应将重采样、不匹配反馈以及简洁且任务兼容的静态引导作为基线。
tldr: This paper investigates self-repair in code-as-policy agents for simulated robot manipulation, finding that failure-specific feedback offers no clear benefit over resampling or static guidance, and that feedback can even be harmful in tasks requiring non-default grasps.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了模拟机器人操作中代码即策略智能体的自我修复机制，发现针对失败的反馈相比重新采样或静态指导并无明显优势，且在某些需要非默认抓取的任务中甚至有害。

title: RM-VLM: From Natural-Language Task Descriptions to Vision-Grounded Reward Machines
summary: Reward machines (RMs) have been proposed as a reward formulation in reinforcement learning (RL) to capture non-Markovian tasks where credit assignment depends on history. By representing reward functions as automata, RMs expose the task's temporal structure and allow such rewards to be handled within a Markovian framework. However, they assume a labelling function, a proposition-grounding oracle for observations, which must be manually engineered for each environment, limiting their wider applicability. In this work, we address this limitation by proposing RM-VLM, a novel approach in which a large language model (LLM) generates an RM from a natural-language task description, and a vision-language model (VLM) acts as the labelling function, grounding the RM's propositions over image-based observations during RM-guided policy learning. A VLM-based value function estimator is used to assess the agent's progress towards each RM transition and derive a dense reward signal. We evaluate RM-VLM on three domains covering non-Markovian grid-world navigation, robotic manipulation, and 3D object collection. Our experimental results show that RM-VLM consistently achieves higher task success rates than existing VLM-based reward methods across all tested domains.
summary_zh: 奖励机器（RMs）已被提出作为强化学习（RL）中的一种奖励形式，用于捕捉信用分配依赖于历史记录的非马尔可夫任务。通过将奖励函数表示为自动机，RMs揭示了任务的时间结构，并允许在马尔可夫框架内处理此类奖励。然而，它们假设存在一个标签函数，即对观测进行命题接地（proposition-grounding）的预言机，该函数必须针对每个环境手动设计，这限制了其更广泛的应用。在本工作中，我们通过提出RM-VLM来解决这一限制，这是一种新颖的方法，其中大语言模型（LLM）从自然语言任务描述中生成RM，而视觉-语言模型（VLM）则充当标签函数，在RM引导的策略学习过程中，将RM的命题与基于图像的观测进行接地。我们利用基于VLM的价值函数估计器来评估代理朝向每个RM转移的进展，并推导出密集奖励信号。我们在三个领域上评估RM-VLM，涵盖非马尔可夫网格世界导航、机器人操作和三维物体收集。我们的实验结果表明，在所有测试领域中，RM-VLM始终比现有的基于VLM的奖励方法取得更高的任务成功率。
tldr: RM-VLM uses an LLM to generate reward machines from natural-language task descriptions and a VLM to ground propositions in images, providing dense reward signals for RL in non-Markovian tasks, achieving higher success rates than existing VLM-based rewards in navigation, manipulation, and object collection.
tldr_zh: RM-VLM 利用大语言模型从自然语言任务描述中生成奖励机，并用视觉语言模型将命题映射到图像观测，为强化学习提供密集奖励信号，在导航、操作和物体收集中优于现有基于 VLM 的奖励方法。

title: MAC-v2: Long-horizon model-based value expansion from pixels
summary: We study whether \emph{long-horizon model-based value expansion} can serve as an effective framework in pixel-based offline reinforcement learning (RL). Long-horizon model-based value expansion from pixels is substantially harder than state-based environments, as the agent must learn both the representation and its dynamics, and errors from either can accumulate recursively over imagined trajectories. We introduce MAC-v2, which enables long-horizon model-based expansion from pixels by training a reconstruction-free latent world model with action chunking. By learning representations from prediction and control objectives, MAC-v2 does not need to encode control-irrelevant visual details that can hinder the dynamics prediction. Action chunking further mitigates the prediction error by reducing the number of recursive model predictions required for value expansion. Across diverse visual benchmarks including visual OGBench, MMBench2, Robomimic, and LIBERO-10, MAC-v2 achieves strong performance against model-free and model-based offline RL baselines. Our analyses show that long-horizon model-based value expansion is critical for the performance of MAC-v2, and that both action chunking and latent learning objectives are essential for reliable long-horizon latent imagination.
summary_zh: 我们研究长期模型基价值扩展能否在基于像素的离线强化学习中成为一种有效框架。与基于状态的环境相比，从像素出发进行长期模型基价值扩展的难度显著更高，因为智能体必须同时学习表征及其动态变化，而两者中的任何误差都可能在想象轨迹中递归累积。我们提出了MAC-v2，该方法通过采用动作分块的免重建潜在世界模型，实现从像素出发的长期模型基扩展。通过从预测和控制目标中学习表征，MAC-v2无需编码与控制无关的视觉细节，这些细节可能妨碍动态预测。动作分块进一步通过减少价值扩展所需的递归模型预测次数来缓解预测误差。在包括视觉OGBench、MMBench2、Robomimic和LIBERO-10在内的多个视觉基准测试中，MAC-v2在基于模型和无模型的离线强化学习基线中均展现出强劲性能。我们的分析表明，长期模型基价值扩展对MAC-v2的性能至关重要，而动作分块和潜在学习目标对于可靠的长期潜在想象均不可或缺。
tldr: MAC-v2 introduces a reconstruction-free latent world model with action chunking for long-horizon model-based value expansion from pixels, achieving strong offline RL performance across visual benchmarks.
tldr_zh: MAC-v2 通过无重建的潜在世界模型和动作分块，实现了从像素进行长时程模型价值扩展，在多个视觉基准上取得了良好的离线强化学习性能。

title: FreeOcc: Decoupling Ego-Motion for Efficient 4D Occupancy Forecasting via Continuous Flow Matching
summary: Current 4D occupancy world models use heavy cross-attention or deep recurrence to disentangle ego-motion from scene dynamics. This requires significant computational capacity. However, this effort is largely redundant since the ego-vehicle's intended future motion is provided by the downstream motion planner. We present FreeOcc, a lightweight continuous-time world model that introduces explicit $SE(2)$ geometric decoupling into a conditional flow-matching framework. By mathematically factoring out self-motion, we create a purely dynamic feature space. This space supports attention-free temporal fusion and allows physics-constrained ODEs to operate strictly on residual agent kinematics. To maximize deployment efficiency, FreeOcc introduces an uncertainty-aware blending mechanism. This routes well-observed voxels to a single-pass decoder, reserving the ODE solver exclusively for ambiguous, high-uncertainty regions. Requiring only 28.3M parameters-roughly 40% of comparable models-our optimal ensemble mode (FreeOcc-E) runs at 27 FPS. On nuScenes, FreeOcc achieves state-of-the-art forecasting performance with a 0.47 m Near Field Chamfer Distance (NFCD) and 32.1% mIoU. Furthermore, the model transfers zero-shot to SemanticKITTI. It also proves highly robust, retaining 92.8% of its ideal mIoU under significant sensor packet loss and timestamp jitter.
summary_zh: 现有的4D占据世界模型使用重型交叉注意力或深度递归机制来解耦自车运动与场景动态，这需要巨大的计算能力。然而，由于下游运动规划器已提供自车预期未来运动，这一努力在很大程度上是冗余的。我们提出FreeOcc，一种轻量级连续时间世界模型，将显式$SE(2)$几何解耦引入条件流匹配框架。通过数学上分解自运动，我们创建了一个纯动态特征空间。该空间支持免注意力的时间融合，并允许物理约束的常微分方程严格作用于残差智能体运动学。为最大化部署效率，FreeOcc引入了一种基于不确定性感知的融合机制，将观测良好的体素路由到单次解码器，而将常微分方程求解器仅保留给模糊、高不确定性的区域。仅需2830万参数——约为同类模型的40%——我们的最优集成模式（FreeOcc-E）即可在27 FPS下运行。在nuScenes上，FreeOcc实现了最先进的预测性能，近场倒角距离（NFCD）为0.47 m，mIoU为32.1%。此外，该模型可零样本迁移至SemanticKITTI。它还具有很强的鲁棒性，在严重的传感器数据包丢失和时间戳抖动情况下，仍能保持理想mIoU的92.8%。
tldr: FreeOcc introduces a lightweight continuous-time world model for 4D occupancy forecasting that decouples ego-motion into a dynamic feature space, enabling attention-free temporal fusion and physics-constrained ODEs for efficient and robust predictions.
tldr_zh: FreeOcc 提出了一种轻量级连续时间世界模型，通过显式解耦自运动到动态特征空间，实现了免注意力的时序融合和物理约束的 ODE，从而高效且鲁棒地进行 4D 占用预测。

title: PlayGen2: Learning Real-Time Playable Worlds with Explicit 3D State
summary: Building a playable world requires more than generating plausible video: it demands responsive control, persistent spatial structure, and coherent interactions with dynamic entities. Using generated frames as the sole recurrent world representation ties these requirements to view-dependent appearance synthesis, making it difficult to maintain long-term spatial and temporal consistency in generation and interaction. We present PlayGen2, a real-time interactive world model that separates learned 3D state evolution from neural rendering. PlayGen2 maintains a persistent world memory comprising static geometry represented by a volumetric occupancy grid and identity-indexed 3D states for the player and other entities. Within a fixed-size local region, its world-state model jointly learns action-conditioned entity dynamics, geometry completion, and entity discovery, committing updates to a persistent world memory. A separate neural renderer synthesizes first-person observations from depth and semantic projections of the world state, without feeding generated images back into state prediction. Using Doom as a testbed, we demonstrate that the model successfully learns world dynamics including geometry-aware player motion and player--NPC interactions. The framework is computationally efficient, enabling the complete simulation and rendering pipeline to achieve approximately 160ms backend latency on a MacBook Pro with an M4 Pro chip. Beyond single-player interaction, we demonstrate zero-shot deployment on unseen Doom maps, multiplayer interaction through the composition of single-player models, and programmable gameplay through rule-based state interventions. These capabilities demonstrate the transferability and extensibility of the learned game-world model. Code and pretrained model weights are publicly available.
summary_zh: 构建一个可游玩的游戏世界，其要求远不止于生成逼真的视频：它还需要响应式控制、持续存在的空间结构，以及与动态实体之间连贯的交互。若将生成的帧作为唯一的循环世界表征，则会将上述需求与视角相关的外观合成绑定在一起，使得在生成和交互过程中难以维持长期的空间与时间一致性。为此，我们提出了PlayGen2，一个实时交互式世界模型，它将学习到的3D状态演化与神经渲染解耦。PlayGen2维护一个持久化的世界记忆，其中包含由体素占用网格表示的静态几何结构，以及针对玩家和其他实体的、以身份为索引的3D状态。在固定大小的局部区域内，其世界状态模型联合学习动作条件化的实体动力学、几何补全和实体发现，并将更新提交至持久化世界记忆。一个独立的神经渲染器从世界状态的深度投影和语义投影中合成第一人称观察，而不会将生成的图像反馈至状态预测。以《毁灭战士》为测试平台，我们证明了该模型能够成功学习世界动态，包括几何感知的玩家运动和玩家与NPC之间的交互。该框架计算高效，在搭载M4 Pro芯片的MacBook Pro上，完整的模拟与渲染流程可实现约160毫秒的后端延迟。除单人交互外，我们还展示了在未见过的《毁灭战士》地图上的零样本部署、通过组合单玩家模型实现的多人交互，以及基于规则的状态干预实现的可编程玩法。这些能力证明了所学游戏世界模型的可迁移性与可扩展性。代码与预训练模型权重均已公开。
tldr: PlayGen2 is a real-time interactive world model that separates learned 3D state evolution from neural rendering, enabling persistent spatial structure and coherent interactions in a playable Doom environment.
tldr_zh: PlayGen2 是一个实时的交互式世界模型，将学习的 3D 状态演化与神经渲染分离，从而在可玩的 Doom 环境中实现持久的空间结构和连贯的交互。

title: Towards Real-Time Full-Waveform LiDAR Transformers via Intensity-Guided Token Reduction and Physics-Aware Augmentation
summary: LiDAR is a critical sensor for autonomous driving and robotics, yet it remains vulnerable to adverse conditions such as fog, rain, transparent objects, and low-reflectance surfaces. Full-waveform LiDAR (FWL) addresses these limitations by capturing the complete return waveform as a histogram, preserving rich reflection characteristics including multi-path echoes and weak signals. While recent Transformer-based approaches have demonstrated promise on FWL data, two fundamental bottlenecks remain: high computational cost from redundant tokens in low-intensity background regions, and limited generalization due to scarce annotated training data. We address both bottlenecks by exploiting the physical structure inherent to FWL data. First, we propose FWL-ToPM, a token pruning and merging mechanism that leverages intensity distributions to selectively reduce tokens while retaining critical waveform content. Second, we introduce FWLAug, a data augmentation framework designed as a regularization method that preserves waveform structure, retaining the Time-of-Flight waveform of each ray and the frustum geometry, to improve generalization to unseen scenes. Evaluated on the Ghost-FWL benchmark, FWL-ToPM achieves over 8 times speedup at real-time throughput alongside a nearly 9-point F1 gain over the prior state of the art, establishing the first real-time FWL Transformer that simultaneously improves accuracy. FWLAug further improves performance on both the standard benchmark and an out-of-distribution test set of unseen scenes. Together, these methods push FWL-based perception toward practical deployment. The code and the OOD dataset are publicly available and can be accessed via the project page: https://keio-csg.github.io/FWL-ToPM
summary_zh: 激光雷达是自动驾驶和机器人领域的关键传感器，然而其在雾、雨、透明物体和低反射率表面等恶劣条件下仍存在脆弱性。全波形激光雷达通过将完整回波波形以直方图形式捕获，保留了包括多路径回波和微弱信号在内的丰富反射特征，从而解决了上述局限性。尽管近期基于Transformer的方法在全波形激光雷达数据上展现出了良好前景，但仍存在两个根本性瓶颈：低强度背景区域中冗余令牌导致的高计算成本，以及标注训练数据稀缺所带来的有限泛化能力。我们通过利用全波形激光雷达数据固有的物理结构来同时解决这两个瓶颈。首先，我们提出了FWL-ToPM，一种利用强度分布选择性地减少令牌同时保留关键波形内容的令牌剪枝与合并机制。其次，我们引入了FWLAug，一种作为正则化方法设计的、保持波形结构的数据增强框架，该框架保留了每条光线的飞行时间波形和视锥几何结构，以提高对未见场景的泛化能力。在Ghost-FWL基准上的评估表明，FWL-ToPM在实时吞吐量下实现了超过8倍的加速，同时相较于现有最先进方法在F1分数上提升了近9个百分点，建立了首个同时提升精度的实时全波形激光雷达Transformer。FWLAug进一步在标准基准和包含未见场景的分布外测试集上提升了性能。这两种方法共同推动了基于全波形激光雷达的感知走向实际部署。代码和分布外数据集已公开，可通过项目页面访问：https://keio-csg.github.io/FWL-ToPM
tldr: This paper introduces FWL-ToPM, a token pruning and merging mechanism for full-waveform LiDAR Transformers, and FWLAug, a physics-aware data augmentation framework, achieving over 8x speedup and significant accuracy gains on the Ghost-FWL benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了FWL-ToPM，一种用于全波形LiDAR Transformer的令牌剪枝与合并机制，以及FWLAug，一种物理感知的数据增强框架，在Ghost-FWL基准上实现了超过8倍的加速和显著的精度提升。

title: Wide View Synthesis from Overlapping Perspective Cameras in Autonomous Driving
summary: Multi-perspective-camera systems are widely adopted since they provide broad visual coverage for autonomous driving, motivating the synthesis of a unified wide view from spatially separated observations. In this work, we formulate wide view synthesis (WVS), which aims to synthesize a geometrically consistent wide view at a specified virtual viewpoint from multiple perspective cameras. Unlike conventional image stitching, WVS requires reasoning about 3D geometry and visibility to handle depth-dependent parallax and occlusions arising from spatially separated camera centers. While vanilla 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-fidelity view synthesis, its reliance on per-scene optimization limits its applicability to driving scenes. Furthermore, WVS introduces additional challenges, *e.g.*, peripheral stretching under perspective projection and photometric inconsistencies across cameras. To address these challenges, we propose **Wide-View Gaussian Splatting (WV-GS)**, a feed-forward Gaussian-splatting framework that synthesizes wide views without per-scene optimization. Specifically, we introduce Piecewise Perspective Rendering (PPR) to mitigate peripheral stretching through local perspective projections sharing a common camera center, and Spatial Affine Photometric Modeling (SAPM) to account for camera-dependent photometric variations during training. We further introduce **WideDrive**, a synthetic benchmark providing dense ground-truth wide views and adapt a LiDAR-projected sparse-reference protocol to real-world datasets. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of WV-GS for WVS. Dataset and code will be publicly released.
summary_zh: 多视角相机系统因能为自动驾驶提供广阔的视觉覆盖而被广泛采用，这促使研究人员探索如何将空间上分离的观测合成为统一的全景视图。在本工作中，我们提出了广角视图合成（WVS）任务，旨在从多个透视相机在指定虚拟视点处合成几何一致的广角视图。与传统图像拼接不同，WVS需要对三维几何和可见性进行推理，以处理由空间分离的相机中心引起的深度相关视差和遮挡问题。尽管原始的三维高斯溅射（3DGS）技术能够实现高保真的视图合成，但其依赖逐场景优化，限制了其在驾驶场景中的应用。此外，WVS还引入了额外的挑战，例如透视投影下的边缘拉伸以及相机间的光度不一致性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了**广角视图高斯溅射（WV-GS）**，一种无需逐场景优化的前馈式高斯溅射框架，可直接合成广角视图。具体而言，我们引入了分段透视渲染（PPR），通过共享同一相机中心的局部透视投影来缓解边缘拉伸问题；同时引入空间仿射光度建模（SAPM），在训练过程中对相机依赖的光度变化进行建模。我们还进一步构建了**WideDrive**，一个提供稠密真值广角视图的合成基准，并将基于LiDAR投影的稀疏参考协议适配到真实世界数据集。在多个数据集上的大量实验证明了WV-GS在WVS任务中的有效性。数据集和代码将公开发布。
tldr: This paper introduces Wide-View Gaussian Splatting (WV-GS), a feed-forward framework for synthesizing geometrically consistent wide views from multiple overlapping cameras in autonomous driving, addressing challenges like peripheral stretching and photometric inconsistencies, and proposes the WideDrive benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文提出宽视野高斯泼溅（WV-GS），一种用于自动驾驶中从多个重叠相机合成几何一致宽视野的前馈框架，解决了边缘拉伸和光度不一致等挑战，并提出了WideDrive基准。

title: Motion-guided Contrastive Regularization For Latent World Models
summary: JEPA-style world models learn action-conditioned latent dynamics without reconstructing observations, but distributional regularization alone does not ensure that their representations preserve information needed for control. We identify static collapse, a failure mode in which the encoder preserves episode-specific static content while suppressing manipulation-relevant state changes. Because static content is temporally predictable yet diverse across episodes, this failure can persist despite regularizers such as SIGReg. A controlled study on OGBench-Cube shows that introducing randomized backgrounds substantially degrades planning performance while leaving the underlying manipulation task unchanged. To address this problem, we propose motion-guided contrastive regularization. Our approach compares predicted latent transitions with transitions to candidate observations from the same episode, reducing the usefulness of static background identity for distinguishing action outcomes. Optical-flow similarities provide soft contrastive targets, allowing candidates with similar motion to receive similar supervision. Combined with latent prediction and SIGReg, our objective encourages representations to preserve within-episode state distinctions and similarities between related transitions. Our method improves planning success over LeWorldModel (LeWM) from 52% to 78% on OGBench-Cube with randomized backgrounds and from 14% to 54% on LIBERO-Object, while maintaining comparable performance on four other visual-control benchmarks.
summary_zh: JEPA风格的世界模型在不重建观测的情况下学习基于动作的潜在动力学，但仅靠分布正则化并不能确保其表示保留控制所需的信息。我们识别出一种称为“静态坍缩”（static collapse）的失效模式，即编码器保留每个幕（episode）特有的静态内容，同时抑制与操作相关的状态变化。由于静态内容在时间上可预测但跨幕具有多样性，这种失效即使在SIGReg等正则化方法下仍可能持续存在。在OGBench-Cube上进行的受控研究表明，引入随机背景会显著降低规划性能，而底层操作任务本身并未改变。为解决该问题，我们提出基于运动引导的对比正则化方法。该方法将预测的潜在转移与同一幕中候选观测的转移进行比较，从而降低静态背景身份在区分动作结果方面的有效性。光流相似性提供软对比目标，使具有相似运动的候选样本获得相似的监督信号。结合潜在预测与SIGReg，我们的目标函数鼓励表示保留幕内状态区分能力以及相关转移之间的相似性。我们的方法将LeWorldModel（LeWM）在OGBench-Cube随机背景下的规划成功率从52%提升至78%，在LIBERO-Object上从14%提升至54%，同时在另外四个视觉控制基准上保持相当的性能。
tldr: This paper identifies static collapse in latent world models where background content dominates representations, and proposes motion-guided contrastive regularization using optical-flow similarities to improve planning performance on manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文识别了潜在世界模型中的静态崩溃问题（背景内容主导表示），并提出利用光流相似性的运动引导对比正则化，以提升操作基准上的规划性能。

title: VisionSIM: Beyond Idealized Sensors - A Multi-Modal Simulator for Robot Perception
summary: Robotic perception increasingly relies on heterogeneous sensor suites combining cameras with emerging modalities (event, SPAD, iToF/dToF, and thermal). Yet existing simulators idealize these sensors, hiding critical modality-specific failure modes that limit real-world deployment. We present VisionSIM, a unified, physically grounded simulation platform that elevates sensor realism to a first-class concern by modeling the raw physical measurement process for diverse conventional and emerging modalities. We expose fine-grained control over physical sensor parameters, reproducing failure modes overlooked by general-purpose simulators: pileup and glare for LiDAR; phase wrapping, saturation, and motion artifacts for iToF; refractory drops for event cameras; and history-dependent emission for thermal cameras. This enables principled cross-modality comparison on identical scenes and trajectories. We release the platform and a large indoor dataset with synchronized raw measurements and rich ground-truth annotations.
summary_zh: 机器人感知越来越依赖于将相机与新兴模态（事件相机、SPAD、iToF/dToF和热成像）相结合的异构传感器套件。然而，现有的模拟器将这些传感器理想化，掩盖了限制实际部署的关键模态特定失效模式。我们提出了VisionSIM，一个统一的、基于物理的仿真平台，通过建模多种传统和新兴模态的原始物理测量过程，将传感器真实性提升为优先关注的问题。我们提供对物理传感器参数的细粒度控制，再现了通用模拟器所忽视的失效模式：LiDAR的堆积和眩光；iToF的相位包裹、饱和及运动伪影；事件相机的 refractory drops；以及热相机的历史依赖发射。这使得在相同场景和轨迹上进行原理性的跨模态比较成为可能。我们发布了该平台以及一个包含同步原始测量和丰富地面真值标注的大型室内数据集。
tldr: VisionSIM is a physically grounded multi-modal simulator that models the raw measurement process for diverse sensors (event, SPAD, iToF/dToF, thermal, LiDAR) to reproduce realistic failure modes and enable cross-modality comparison for robot perception.
tldr_zh: VisionSIM 是一个物理基础的多模态模拟器，通过建模事件相机、SPAD、iToF/dToF、热成像和 LiDAR 等传感器的原始测量过程，再现真实故障模式，为机器人感知提供跨模态对比平台。

title: An Integrated Open-Source Stack for Vision-Based Autonomous Navigation of Wheeled Rovers
summary: Vision-based rover autonomy requires integrating perception, localization, planning and platform-specific control under limited sensing and computing resources. We present an open-source ROS 2 stack for following directional arrows, reaching a terminal cone and returning autonomously to the start. It connects YOLOv8n detection and geometric direction, range and bearing estimation with RGB-D SLAM, wheel-inertial state estimation, kinematics-aware planning, behavior-tree mission management and STM32 actuation. Standard interfaces separate reusable autonomy from the hardware layer; a proportional path-following plugin supports low-speed rover motion. Public resources include software, configuration, a labeled dataset, trained weights and evaluation logs. On 478 held-out images, the detector achieves mAP@0.5 of 0.720 under the Ultralytics evaluator and outperforms a classical OpenCV baseline under a shared evaluation protocol. The reported perception latency is 25 ms on a Jetson Orin NX. Three missions, one indoor and two outdoor, demonstrate marker-guided navigation and autonomous return without operator motion commands or reported collisions. Field results document integration failures and corrective choices; repeated instrumented trials remain necessary to quantify physical navigation errors and reliability.
summary_zh: 基于视觉的漫游车自主运行需要在有限的感知和计算资源下，整合感知、定位、规划以及平台特定的控制功能。我们提出了一套开源ROS 2软件栈，用于实现跟随方向箭头、抵达终端锥桶并自主返回起点的功能。该系统将YOLOv8n目标检测与几何方向、距离和方位估计相结合，并集成RGB-D SLAM、轮式惯性状态估计、考虑运动学约束的规划、行为树任务管理以及STM32执行控制。标准接口将可复用的自主功能与硬件层分离；比例路径跟踪插件支持低速漫游车运动。公开资源包括软件、配置文件、标注数据集、训练权重和评估日志。在478张保留图像上，检测器在Ultralytics评估器下的mAP@0.5达到0.720，并在统一评估协议下优于经典OpenCV基线方法。所报告的感知延迟在Jetson Orin NX上为25毫秒。三次任务（一次室内、两次室外）展示了标记引导导航和自主返回能力，全程无需操作员运动指令且无碰撞报告。现场结果记录了集成失败及纠正措施；仍需重复仪器化试验以量化物理导航误差和可靠性。
tldr: This paper presents an open-source ROS 2 stack for vision-based autonomous navigation of wheeled rovers, integrating YOLOv8n detection, RGB-D SLAM, and behavior-tree mission management for arrow-following and autonomous return tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于轮式漫游车视觉自主导航的开源ROS 2堆栈，集成了YOLOv8n检测、RGB-D SLAM和行为树任务管理，以完成箭头跟随和自主返回任务。

title: Leave It Better Than Found: Value-Guided Cooperation in Sequential Tasks
summary: We consider the problem of sequential task continuation, where one robot acts in a workspace that has been affected by a previous robot. Current approaches in multi-robot cooperation rely heavily on co-training or co-optimization, assumingthat the robots have access to collective interaction data during the policy training or planning process. However, as increasingly varied robotic embodiments and policies are deployed and operate in the same real-world environment, learning policies for cooperation becomes infeasible due to the combinatorial explosion of possible robot combinations that need to be accounted for. To address this challenge, this paper considers the problem of ad hoc sequential cooperation between robots that have never before operated together in a shared environment. We demonstrate that robots can explicitly communicate their environmental preferences through sharing their value functions, enabling coordination without the need for prior joint training. To ground this exchange and prevent overconfidence in out-of-distribution states, we further introduce a k-nearest neighbors (KNN)- based uncertainty filter. Our method yields an increase of up to 48.5 pp compared with naive or even selfish agents, in task success rates across simulated and real-world experiments, demonstrating that value function transmission between agents is useful not merely as an internal learning tool, but as an effective basis for ad hoc coordination. Website: https://proroklab.github.io/PAVE/
summary_zh: 我们探讨了顺序任务延续问题，即一个机器人在受先前机器人影响的工作空间中执行任务。当前的多机器人协作方法严重依赖联合训练或联合优化，假设机器人在策略训练或规划过程中能够访问集体交互数据。然而，随着越来越多不同形态和策略的机器人在同一真实环境中部署和运行，由于需要考虑的机器人组合呈组合爆炸式增长，学习协作策略变得不可行。为应对这一挑战，本文研究了从未在共享环境中协同作业过的机器人之间的临时顺序协作问题。我们证明，机器人可以通过共享价值函数来明确表达其环境偏好，从而在无需事先联合训练的情况下实现协调。为进一步夯实这一信息交换的可靠性，并防止在分布外状态下过度自信，我们引入了一种基于k近邻（KNN）的不确定性过滤器。在仿真和真实世界实验中，与朴素甚至自私的智能体相比，我们的方法在任务成功率上提升高达48.5个百分点，这表明智能体之间的价值函数传递不仅作为内部学习工具具有价值，更是实现临时协调的有效基础。网站：https://proroklab.github.io/PAVE/
tldr: This paper introduces a method for ad hoc sequential cooperation between robots that have not been jointly trained, by sharing value functions with a KNN-based uncertainty filter, achieving significant success rate improvements in simulated and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无需联合训练的自组织顺序协作方法，通过共享带KNN不确定性滤波的价值函数，在仿真和实际任务中显著提升成功率。

title: Development of Anthropomorphic Arm for collaborative and Home Service Robot CHARMIE
summary: Service Robots are becoming a reality and are progressing by leaps and bounds. Alongside this avenue of robotics is also the field of prosthetics, which is evolving rapidly. These topics are hot cakes in the industry and are widely developed. Some have one quality, and some have others, but are making a shoreline towards success. The development of arm and hand as individual or as a package is becoming common as more and more advanced collaborative robots come to the surface and join their human counterparts in the real world. This dissertation presents an open-source 3D-printed arm which was assembled and programmed on two fronts. The first is the control of the hand by utilising teleoperation with a camera and ML-based hand pose estimation. Secondly, it is the control via kinematics utilising the Denavit-Hartenberg method to define the motion and to find the position of the end effector in 3D space.
summary_zh: 服务机器人正逐渐成为现实，并以惊人的速度发展。与机器人这一领域并行的还有假肢领域，该领域正在迅速演进。这些主题在业界备受追捧，并得到了广泛的开发。有些产品各具特色，但都在朝着成功的彼岸迈进。随着越来越多先进的协作机器人涌现，并与人类在现实世界中并肩工作，手臂和手作为独立部件或作为一个整体进行开发已变得越来越普遍。本论文介绍了一种开源3D打印手臂，该手臂在两个方面进行了组装与编程。其一是利用相机和基于机器深度学习的手部姿态估计，通过遥操作对手进行控制。其二则是利用运动学进行控制，采用德纳维-哈滕伯格（Denavit-Hartenberg）方法来定义运动，并确定末端执行器在三维空间中的位置。
tldr: This dissertation presents an open-source 3D-printed anthropomorphic arm for collaborative and home service robots, controlled via teleoperation with ML-based hand pose estimation and kinematic control using the Denavit-Hartenberg method.
tldr_zh: 本论文介绍了一种用于协作和家庭服务机器人的开源3D打印拟人手臂，通过基于机器学习的手部姿态估计的遥操作和基于Denavit-Hartenberg方法的运动学控制来实现控制。

title: A Unified Fractal Impedance Control Framework
summary: Physical human--robot interaction requires controllers capable of maintaining intrinsically bounded interactions with the environment. The Fractal Impedance Controller (FIC) has been proven to guarantee these safety characteristics by design. This paper introduces the robotic implementation and experimental validation of its most advanced architecture: the Harmonic-Passive Motion Paradigm (H-PMP), an evolution of the Passive Motion Paradigm designed to mimic human-like interaction. Furthermore, we present a unified framework for FIC deployment, supported by an open-source software suite featuring ROS2, MuJoCo, and physical hardware integrations. Through three experiments conducted on a Kinova Gen3 arm (trajectory tracking, a wall press with sudden loss of contact, and learning-by-demonstration) we compare the H-PMP against earlier FIC architectures. The results demonstrate that the H-PMP achieves a seamless trade-off between admittance and impedance behaviours. This makes it ideal for deployment in unstructured environments, enabling the robot to transition between interaction modes with no computational overhead.
summary_zh: 物理人机交互要求控制器能够在与环境互动时保持内在有界的交互特性。分形阻抗控制器（FIC）已被证明能够通过设计从原理上保障这些安全特性。本文介绍了其最先进架构——谐波被动运动范式（H-PMP）的机器人实现与实验验证，该范式是被动运动范式的一种演进，旨在模拟类人交互行为。此外，我们提出了一个统一的FIC部署框架，并配套开源软件套件，支持ROS2、MuJoCo及物理硬件集成。通过在Kinova Gen3机械臂上开展的三项实验（轨迹跟踪、突然失去接触的墙壁按压以及示教学习），我们将H-PMP与早期的FIC架构进行了对比。结果表明，H-PMP在导纳与阻抗行为之间实现了无缝权衡，使其非常适合部署于非结构化环境中，使机器人能够在不产生额外计算开销的前提下实现交互模式之间的切换。
tldr: This paper presents a unified framework for Fractal Impedance Control (FIC) with a novel Harmonic-Passive Motion Paradigm (H-PMP) architecture, validated on a physical Kinova Gen3 robot through trajectory tracking, wall press, and learning-by-demonstration experiments. The H-PMP achieves a seamless trade-off between admittance and impedance behaviors for safe physical human-robot interaction in unstructured environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种统一的Fractal阻抗控制框架，并引入了新颖的Harmonic-Passive Motion Paradigm (H-PMP)架构，通过在Kinova Gen3机器人上进行的轨迹跟踪、墙壁按压和示教学习实验验证了其有效性。H-PMP实现了导纳和阻抗行为之间的无缝切换，适用于非结构化环境中的安全人机交互。

title: Structure from Collision via Hypothesis-Space Reasoning
summary: Knowledge of the hidden interior structure of an object, including the presence and location of cavities, is essential for predictive simulation, robotic manipulation, and nondestructive inspection. However, such cavities leave no direct signature on the static visible surface, making collision-induced deformation one of the few cues used to infer their presence. Structure from Collision (SfC) addresses this problem by recovering the hidden interior structure of an object from multiview observations of a collision event. SfC is challenging for two reasons: hidden cavities are only indirectly observable through surface motion, and voids correspond to the absence of material, making direct optimization using standard density representations difficult. The density-based SfC baseline inherits both difficulties. Surface-matching gradients do not directly indicate the cavity location, while density gradients can be weak or uninformative inside or near void regions. Therefore, we reformulate SfC as hypothesis-space reasoning, representing hidden cavities as explicit structural hypotheses whose variables encode available structural assumptions rather than relying on implicit density updates. A global stage performs gradient-free optimization over this hypothesis space using forward-only material point method (MPM) simulation. A local stage then refines the selected hypothesis as a Lagrangian particle system through gradient-based optimization using differentiable MPM simulation. On the SfC benchmark, our method improves hidden-structure reconstruction and future prediction over the density-based SfC baseline. Interior-topology stress tests and robustness analyses characterize its scope and limitations. The project page is available at https://www.kecl.ntt.co.jp/people/kaneko.takuhiro/projects/sfc-hypothesis/.
summary_zh: 物体隐藏内部结构（包括空洞的存在及其位置）的知识对于预测性仿真、机器人操作和无损检测至关重要。然而，这些空洞在静态可见表面上不会留下直接痕迹，使得碰撞引起的变形成为推断其存在的少数线索之一。碰撞结构恢复（Structure from Collision, SfC）通过从碰撞事件的多视角观测中恢复物体的隐藏内部结构来解决这一问题。SfC面临两大挑战：隐藏空洞仅能通过表面运动间接观测，且空洞对应材料的缺失，使得使用标准密度表示的直接优化变得困难。基于密度的SfC基线方法同时继承了这两个难点。表面匹配梯度不能直接指示空洞位置，而空洞内部或其附近的密度梯度可能较弱或缺乏信息量。因此，我们将SfC重新构建为假设空间推理问题，将隐藏空洞表示为显式结构假设，其变量编码了可用的结构假设，而非依赖隐式密度更新。全局阶段仅使用前向物质点法（MPM）模拟，在该假设空间中进行无梯度优化。局部阶段则通过基于梯度的优化，利用可微MPM模拟，将选定的假设细化为拉格朗日粒子系统。在SfC基准测试上，我们的方法在隐藏结构重建和未来预测方面优于基于密度的SfC基线。内部拓扑压力测试和鲁棒性分析刻画了该方法的适用范围与局限性。项目页面可在 https://www.kecl.ntt.co.jp/people/kaneko.takuhiro/projects/sfc-hypothesis/ 查阅。
tldr: This paper introduces Structure from Collision (SfC), a method that recovers hidden object cavities from collision-induced surface motion by treating cavity estimation as hypothesis-space reasoning with gradient-free optimization over explicit structural hypotheses and gradient-based refinement, improving reconstruction and prediction over density-based baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种从碰撞中恢复物体隐藏内部结构（如空腔）的方法，通过将问题重构为假设空间推理，结合无梯度全局搜索和基于梯度的局部细化，利用可微分的物质点法仿真，提升了隐藏结构重建和未来预测的准确性。

title: Generate-then-Rank: Learning Symbolic Goal Interpretation for Embodied Agents
summary: Goal interpretation is to translate a natural language instruction into a formal symbolic goal that a planner can execute. It is critical for embodied agents because any error here propagates to every downstream planning and action step. Doing it well requires both generating suitable candidates and reliably selecting among them. We present a two-stage generate-then-rank approach to Goal Interpretation in the Embodied Agent Interface (EAI). First, supervised fine-tuning adapts a Large Language Model (LLM) to EAI's output convention. Second, Candidate-Output Ranking from Errors (CORE) learns preferences over complete outputs from the model's own generated alternatives. We conducted experiments on the household scenes of the Embodied Agent Interface Benchmark. Multiple open source LLMs including DeepSeek-V3 chat, DeepSeek-Reasoner, and Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen2.5-72B were evaluated. The proposed method outperformed the baseline models including LLMs with simple prompting, chain-of-thought, and knowledge graph based approaches.
summary_zh: 目标解释是指将自然语言指令转化为规划器可执行的正式符号化目标。这一过程对于具身智能体至关重要，因为此处出现的任何错误都会传导至下游的每一个规划与行动步骤。要做好这一点，既需要生成合适的候选目标，也需要在候选项中可靠地进行筛选。我们提出了一种面向具身智能体接口（EAI）中目标解释问题的两阶段“先生成后排序”方法。首先，通过监督微调使大语言模型（LLM）适应EAI的输出规范。其次，基于错误的候选输出排序方法（CORE）从模型自身生成的备选方案中学习对完整输出的偏好。我们在具身智能体接口基准测试的家庭场景上开展了实验，评估了多个开源大语言模型，包括DeepSeek-V3 chat、DeepSeek-Reasoner，以及Qwen2.5-7B和Qwen2.5-72B。实验结果表明，所提出的方法优于包括简单提示、思维链和基于知识图谱方法在内的各类基线模型。
tldr: This paper introduces a two-stage generate-then-rank approach for translating natural language instructions into formal symbolic goals for embodied agents, using supervised fine-tuning of LLMs followed by a preference-learning ranker (CORE). Experiments on the Embodied Agent Interface Benchmark show it outperforms baseline LLM prompting, chain-of-thought, and knowledge graph methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种两阶段生成-排序方法，将自然语言指令转换为具身代理可执行的正式符号目标，通过监督微调LLM和基于偏好学习的排序器（CORE）实现。在Embodied Agent Interface基准上的实验表明，该方法优于基线LLM提示、思维链和知识图谱方法。

title: Flexible Piezoelectric Tactile Sensing System for Intelligent Object Recognition
summary: Tactile sensing provides information about object properties that can improve robotic grasping and manipulation. However, accurate object recognition during the early stages of grasping remains challenging, particularly under strict real-time constraints. This study presents a flexible, distributed piezoelectric tactile sensing system for early-stage object recognition. The system was experimentally evaluated using six everyday objects and three recognition approaches: feature-based classification using support vector machines (SVMs), raw-signal classification using 1D convolutional neural networks (1D-CNNs) and convolutional recurrent neural networks (C-RNNs), and spatiotemporal heatmap classification using a 2D-CNN. The effects of sensor count and temporal window size on recognition accuracy and real-time feasibility were systematically investigated. Increasing the number of sensing elements improved recognition performance across all approaches. The best-performing method, based on spatiotemporal heatmaps and a 2D-CNN, achieved F1-scores of 0.9796, 0.9846, and 0.9903 using 16, 24, and 32 sensors, respectively. The optimal configuration, comprising 32 sensors and a 100-ms temporal window (50 samples), was deployed on an embedded edge platform, achieving an end-to-end recognition latency of approximately 101 ms from contact onset and an energy consumption of 63.8 microjoules per inference. These results demonstrate the potential of distributed piezoelectric tactile sensing for accurate, energy-efficient, and real-time object recognition during robotic grasping.
summary_zh: 触觉传感能够提供物体属性的相关信息，从而提升机器人的抓取与操作能力。然而，在抓取初期实现准确的目标识别仍具挑战性，尤其是在严格的实时性约束条件下。本研究提出了一种柔性分布式压电触觉传感系统，用于抓取初期的物体识别。研究选用六种日常物品，并通过三种识别方法对系统进行了实验评估：基于支持向量机（SVM）的特征分类方法、基于一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）和卷积递归神经网络（C-RNN）的原始信号分类方法，以及基于二维卷积神经网络（2D-CNN）的时空热图分类方法。系统性地研究了传感器数量和时间窗口大小对识别精度及实时可行性的影响。增加传感单元数量在所有方法中均显著提升了识别性能。其中，基于时空热图与2D-CNN的最优方法在16、24和32个传感器配置下分别取得了0.9796、0.9846和0.9903的F1分数。最优配置（32个传感器、100毫秒时间窗口，即50个采样点）已在嵌入式边缘平台上部署，实现了从接触开始约101毫秒的端到端识别延迟，以及每次推理63.8微焦耳的能耗。上述结果表明，分布式压电触觉传感在机器人抓取过程中具备实现高精度、低能耗和实时物体识别的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents a flexible piezoelectric tactile sensing system for early-stage object recognition during robotic grasping, evaluating multiple classification approaches and achieving high F1-scores with real-time, energy-efficient deployment on an embedded platform.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于机器人抓取早期物体识别的柔性压电触觉传感系统，评估了多种分类方法，并在嵌入式平台上实现了高F1分数、实时且节能的物体识别。

title: Which Objects Stay? Learning Hierarchical Persistence Beliefs for Lifelong Open-Vocabulary Object Maps
summary: Lifelong object maps must estimate whether an object remains at its previously observed location after it leaves view. Existing persistence filters rely on class-based survival priors, making them difficult to apply reliably in open-vocabulary settings. We introduce HiPer, a hierarchical persistence filter that derives persistence beliefs directly from data rather than semantic categories. For a new object, HiPer retrieves visually and geometrically similar training instances and estimates an initial survival rate from their observed histories, without requiring class labels. This estimate initializes a conjugate Beta belief over the object's survival probability, which is updated in closed form using detections and missed observations under Rosen's persistence-filter framework. When an object is re-identified at a new location, its persistence belief is transferred with the object, enabling the map to learn object-specific mobility over time. Experiments on 120 held-out simulated sequences show that HiPer consistently achieves the best performance among competing methods. Retrieval-based priors outperform CLIP-derived label priors, and object-specific online learning provides further gains. Results on 47 held-out 3RScan environments demonstrate that the proposed retrieval-based prior also outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in real-world settings.
summary_zh: 长期目标地图必须估计物体在离开视野后是否仍停留在先前观测到的位置。现有的持久性过滤器依赖基于类别的存活先验，这使得它们在开放词汇场景中难以可靠应用。我们提出HiPer，一种分层持久性过滤器，它直接从数据而非语义类别中推导持久性信念。对于新物体，HiPer检索视觉和几何上相似的训练实例，并根据其观测历史估计初始存活率，无需类别标签。该估计值初始化了物体存活概率上的共轭Beta信念，并在Rosen持久性过滤器框架下，利用检测和漏检观测以闭式形式进行更新。当物体在新位置被重新识别时，其持久性信念随物体一同转移，使地图能够随时间学习物体特有的移动性。在120个保留模拟序列上的实验表明，HiPer在竞争方法中持续取得最佳性能。基于检索的先验优于基于CLIP的标签先验，且物体特有的在线学习带来进一步增益。在47个保留3RScan环境上的结果表明，所提出的基于检索的先验在真实世界场景中同样优于最先进的基线方法。
tldr: HiPer introduces a hierarchical persistence filter that derives open-vocabulary object persistence beliefs from retrieved training instances, without class labels, outperforming baselines in simulated and real 3D environments.
tldr_zh: HiPer 提出一种分层持久性过滤器，从检索到的训练实例中推导开放词汇物体的持久性信念，无需类别标签，在模拟和真实 3D 环境中优于基线方法。

title: Unified Overview of Safety Certificate Functions: Techniques from Hamilton--Jacobi Reachability and Control Barrier Functions
summary: Safety is a central concern in modern autonomous systems. Safety certificates---functions whose existence guarantees that a system meets its safety specification---have long been used as a principled tool for rigorously reasoning about safety. Methods for synthesizing such certificates are scattered across research areas, with little guidance on when to use a particular approach. This tutorial provides a holistic treatment of safety certificate synthesis centered on two widely used families: Hamilton--Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis and control barrier functions (CBFs). For each family of methods, we first introduce its general formulation, along with classical and learning-based tools for certificate synthesis. Next, we introduce two benchmark problems consisting of vehicle systems of differing complexity to assess the certificate quality of different synthesis methods and their effectiveness in safety-critical control. We use these benchmarks to compare various methods and provide practical guidance for selecting an approach.
summary_zh: 安全性是现代自主系统中的核心关注点。安全证书——其存在即保证系统满足其安全规格的函数——长期以来一直被用作严谨推理安全性的原则性工具。用于综合此类证书的方法分散于各个研究领域，关于何时采用特定方法的指导却寥寥无几。本教程围绕两大广泛使用的方法族，对安全证书综合进行了整体性论述：Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) 可达性分析与控制障碍函数 (CBFs)。针对每一方法族，我们首先介绍其一般性表述，以及用于证书综合的经典与基于学习的工具。接下来，我们引入两个由复杂度不同的车辆系统构成的基准问题，以评估不同综合方法的证书质量及其在安全关键控制中的有效性。我们利用这些基准对各方法进行比较，并为选择合适方法提供实践指导。
tldr: This tutorial provides a unified overview of safety certificate synthesis using Hamilton-Jacobi reachability analysis and control barrier functions, including benchmark comparisons for safety-critical control of vehicle systems.
tldr_zh: 本教程统一概述了使用Hamilton-Jacobi可达性分析与控制障碍函数的安全证书合成方法，并通过车辆系统基准比较了不同方法在安全关键控制中的有效性。

title: Curvature by Design: A Support Structure for Continuum Robots
summary: Constant- and piecewise-constant-curvature models are widely used to simplify the kinematics of continuum robots, although the assumed curvature profiles are not necessarily inherent mechanical properties of the robot and may therefore be violated during operation. Rather than assuming a prescribed curvature profile in the kinematic model and estimating deviations from it, this paper presents a multi-segment scissor-based support structure that mechanically constrains a continuum robot to exhibit prescribed constant or spatially varying curvature profiles. The design uses Taylor approximations to enable an overconstrained multi-joint linkage to predictably distribute global bending among the small-angle movements of multiple flexures. The geometric coupling is realized using compliant flexure joints, enabling the support structure to be manufactured as a single piece. The structure is integrated with a tendon-actuated continuum robot with a flexible backbone. Experiments show that the structure makes the robot resistant to deformations other than the prescribed curvature, significantly enhancing shape precision compared to classical flexible-backbone designs. This constrains the robot from making S-shapes when external loads are applied in the opposite direction of the bending. By mechanically constraining the admissible deformation, the proposed structure reduces the number of independent shape variables that must be estimated.
summary_zh: 常曲率和分段常曲率模型被广泛用于简化连续体机器人的运动学，尽管所假设的曲率分布并不一定是机器人的固有机械属性，因此在操作过程中可能被违背。本文不再在运动学模型中预设曲率分布并估计其偏差，而是提出一种基于多段剪刀式支撑结构的设计，通过机械约束使连续体机器人表现出预设的常曲率或空间变化曲率分布。该设计利用泰勒近似，使过约束多关节连杆能够将全局弯曲可预测地分配至多个柔性关节的小角度运动中。几何耦合通过柔性铰链实现，使支撑结构能够整体一体化制造。该结构与采用柔性骨架的腱驱动连续体机器人集成。实验表明，该结构使机器人抵抗除预设曲率以外的变形，相比经典柔性骨架设计显著提升了形状精度。当外部载荷沿弯曲反方向施加时，该结构约束机器人避免形成S形。通过机械约束允许的变形，所提出的结构减少了需要估计的独立形状变量数量。
tldr: This paper introduces a scissor-based support structure with compliant flexure joints that mechanically enforces prescribed constant or variable curvature profiles in continuum robots, improving shape precision and robustness to external loads.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于剪刀机构与柔性铰链的支撑结构，通过机械约束使连续体机器人实现预设的恒定或变化曲率，提高形状精度并抵抗非期望变形。

title: BEAKER: An Expert-Curated Benchmark for Embodied Brains in Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories
summary: Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories (SDCLs) are moving chemical experimentation toward embodied automation, where machines must perceive laboratory scenes, reason about experimental states, and act under physical, procedural, and safety constraints. Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly considered as embodied brains for such systems, existing laboratory benchmarks mainly focus on safety, anomaly detection, or general scientific understanding, leaving their execution-oriented embodied capabilities underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce BEAKER, a Benchmark for evaluating Embodied Actionability, Knowledge, Experimentation, and Reasoning in SDCLs. BEAKER contains 1,000 expert-curated question-answer samples across 11 image and video task types, covering key judgments required for chemical laboratory execution, including affordance grounding, trajectory planning, equipment, state, and safety recognition, apparatus setup, operation and step reasoning, and temporal procedure reasoning. All questions and annotations are manually created and reviewed by chemistry and embodied Artificial Intelligence (AI) experts, without AI-assisted generation or annotation. We evaluate 28 general-purpose, science-oriented, chemistry-specialized, and embodied MLLMs in an offline, single-turn setting. Results show that current models can follow coarse experimental procedures in videos, but still struggle to ground actions into operable regions and feasible trajectories, to recognize fine-grained laboratory apparatus, states, and safety norms, and to order steps in mid-length procedures. BEAKER thus reveals a clear gap between coarse procedural understanding and the precise, action-grounded perception required for laboratory execution, providing a diagnostic benchmark for future MLLMs in SDCLs.
summary_zh: 自主驱动化学实验室（SDCL）正将化学实验推向具身自动化，其中机器必须感知实验室场景、推理实验状态，并在物理、流程和安全约束下执行操作。尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）日益被视为此类系统的具身大脑，但现有实验室基准主要聚焦于安全性、异常检测或一般性科学理解，其面向执行的具身能力尚未得到充分探索。为填补这一空白，我们提出了BEAKER，一个用于评估SDCL中具身可操作性、知识、实验与推理能力的基准。BEAKER包含1,000个由专家精心设计的问题-答案样本，涵盖11种图像与视频任务类型，覆盖化学实验室执行所需的关键判断能力，包括功能可供性定位、轨迹规划、设备识别、状态识别、安全识别、装置搭建、操作与步骤推理，以及时序流程推理。所有问题与标注均由化学及具身人工智能（AI）领域专家人工创建和审核，未使用AI辅助生成或标注。我们在离线、单轮设置下评估了28个通用型、科学导向型、化学专精型及具身型MLLMs。结果表明，当前模型能够跟踪视频中的粗略实验流程，但在将动作落实到可操作区域和可行轨迹、识别细粒度实验室设备、状态与安全规范，以及对中等长度流程中的步骤进行排序方面仍存在困难。因此，BEAKER揭示了粗略程序理解与实验室执行所需的精确、基于动作的感知之间的明显差距，为未来SDCL中的MLLMs提供了一个诊断性基准。
tldr: BEAKER introduces an expert-curated benchmark of 1,000 QA samples across 11 image/video task types to evaluate multimodal LLMs as embodied brains for self-driving chemical laboratories, revealing gaps between coarse procedure understanding and precise action-grounded perception.
tldr_zh: BEAKER 提出了一个由专家策划的基准，包含 1000 个问答样本，涵盖 11 种图像/视频任务类型，用于评估多模态大模型作为自驾驶化学实验室具身大脑的能力，揭示了粗粒度程序理解与精确动作接地感知之间的差距。

title: PVDepth: Panoramic Video Depth Estimation via Geometry-Aware Spatiotemporal Adaptation
summary: Panoramic video depth estimation is pivotal for applications such as Virtual Reality and World Models. However, advancements in this field are impeded by two primary obstacles: the scarcity of large-scale training data and the unique spatiotemporal challenges of Equirectangular Projection (ERP), which hinder the direct transfer of perspective models. In this paper, we first present PanoCARLA, a large-scale synthetic RGB-D panoramic video dataset, featuring natural motion trajectories and drone-like roaming perspectives. Building on this foundation, we propose PVDepth, an end-to-end framework adapted from perspective video depth models. To tackle ERP-specific geometric distortions and consequent non-linear temporal dynamics, we introduce two core mechanisms: (1) A Progressive Sphere-aware Noise Initialization strategy that anneals the noise distribution from planar to spherical, guiding the model to adapt to non-uniform information density; and (2) A Cube-rectified Temporal Modeling module that incorporates an auxiliary cubemap temporal branch to rectify non-linear temporal dynamics in the ERP domain. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PVDepth achieves superior performance, generating geometrically accurate and temporally consistent depth sequences. Code and data will be released at https:// github.com/ChuanxinSong/PVDepth.
summary_zh: 全景视频深度估计对于虚拟现实和世界模型等应用至关重要。然而，该领域的发展受到两大障碍的制约：大规模训练数据的匮乏，以及等距柱状投影（ERP）特有的时空挑战，这些挑战阻碍了透视模型的直接迁移。本文首先提出了PanoCARLA，一个大规模合成RGB-D全景视频数据集，具有自然运动轨迹和无人机式漫游视角。在此基础上，我们提出了PVDepth，一个从透视视频深度模型改编而来的端到端框架。为应对ERP特有的几何畸变及其导致的非线性时间动态，我们引入了两个核心机制：（1）渐进式球面感知噪声初始化策略，将噪声分布从平面退火至球面，引导模型适应非均匀信息密度；（2）立方体校正的时间建模模块，引入辅助立方体贴图时间分支以校正ERP域中的非线性时间动态。大量实验表明，PVDepth取得了卓越的性能，生成了几何精确且时间一致的深度序列。代码和数据将在 https://github.com/ChuanxinSong/PVDepth 发布。
tldr: PVDepth introduces a panoramic video depth estimation framework with a large-scale synthetic dataset (PanoCARLA) and two core mechanisms to address ERP-specific distortions and temporal dynamics, improving depth accuracy and consistency for VR and world model applications.
tldr_zh: PVDepth 提出了一个全景视频深度估计框架，并引入大规模合成数据集 PanoCARLA 以及两种核心机制来解决 ERP 特有的畸变和时间动态问题，从而提升深度估计的精度和一致性，适用于 VR 和世界模型等应用。

title: Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement
summary: Self-improving embodied agents are increasingly being developed and compared on robot simulation benchmarks. Several recent works expose the benchmark's success criteria to the learning agent, a practice we call Criteria Exposure (CE). These criteria, originally written to verify policies trained by imitation learning, often demand more than the corresponding language instructions, so a score from such a verifier may not faithfully reflect whether the instructed task was completed, especially for robot-control programs written by an agent. As embodied coding agents report ever higher benchmark scores, a natural question arises: when a coding agent is exposed to the benchmark's criteria, does it generate code that better performs the instructed task, or code that simply overfits to the verification criteria? We conduct controlled experiments with a self-improving agent with and without CE, and find that with CE the agent quickly produces code with a higher success rate under the given criteria, but this advantage disappears when the criteria are changed slightly without departing from the original instructions. More importantly, the skills the agent develops under CE transfer poorly across tasks. We further propose instruction-faithful criteria and show that they better reflect the performance of agent-generated programs.
tldr: This paper investigates whether exposing embodied coding agents to benchmark success criteria (Criteria Exposure) leads to genuine task learning or overfitting to verifiers, proposing instruction-faithful criteria to better reflect true task completion.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了在具身自改进智能体中暴露基准成功标准是否会导致真正学会任务或过度拟合验证器，并提出符合指令的标准以更准确反映任务完成情况。

title: Fault-Geometry-Aware Control Allocation for Emergency Quadrotor Landing under Single-Motor Loss of Effectiveness
summary: Partial single-motor loss of effectiveness (LoE) changes the remaining control-authority geometry of a quadrotor and can change which control allocator performs best during emergency landing[cite: 11]. We compare three allocators in Crazyflie software-in-the-loop simulation: bounded weighted least squares (reported as PINV), a finite-candidate residual allocator (QP-lite), and the same residual allocator with scoring parameters tuned offline by the Cross-Entropy Method (CEM)[cite: 11]. For this study, fault geometry is represented by the known failed-motor index[cite: 11]. At $η=0.496$ remaining effectiveness, matched development trials select CEM for M1, M3, and M4 and PINV for M2; the M3 selection is a one-trial margin (29/30 versus 28/30)[cite: 11]. After freezing this routing map, the policy achieves 117/120 safe first-contact touchdowns on fresh seeds and 115/120 in a separate randomized-order integrated-supervisor evaluation[cite: 11]. For the critical M2/PINV branch, Firth regression gives a nominal $η_{50}\approx0.4956$ with a within-model 95% bootstrap interval of approximately [0.4955, 0.4956][cite: 11]. One-factor-at-a-time $\pm10\%$ plant perturbations shift $η_{50}$ by up to 0.05495 for thrust coefficient and 0.04974 for mass; the most frequent violated first-contact criterion also changes from vertical speed in many conditions to angular rate for mass -10% and thrust-coefficient +10%[cite: 11]. At fixed $η=0.496$, PINV has a higher M2 safe count than frozen CEM in 9/11 tested plant states and ties in 2/11; the two ties are both 0/30[cite: 11]. The experiments therefore distinguish motor-conditioned allocator selection from sensitivity to plant-model mismatch[cite: 11].
tldr: This paper evaluates control allocators for emergency quadrotor landing under partial single-motor loss of effectiveness, showing that a motor-conditioned allocator selection policy improves safety across fresh seeds and integrated-supervisor evaluations, and analyzes sensitivity to plant-model mismatch.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了在部分单电机失效情况下紧急四旋翼着陆的控制分配器，表明基于电机状态的条件分配策略在全新随机种子和集成监督评估中提高了安全性，并分析了其对模型失配的敏感性。

title: Educational robotics beyond ROS: a custom library for direct transfer of Webots controllers in the Turtlebot3
summary: Robot Operating System (ROS) is becoming a standard in robotics courses at higher education, but its installation, configuration and distributed programming model can introduce a significant entry barrier in the new landscape of AI-based master and degree studies, where many students do not have a strong informatics background. This paper presents an educational experience that enables students to program a TurtleBot3 Burger directly in Python, while preserving a direct transfer path from simulation to the physical robot. The approach is based on a custom library that mirrors the Webots API, allowing the same controller code to be executed in the simulator and on the real TurtleBot3 with minimal modification. The library provides access to the robot motors, wheel encoders, inertial sensors and LiDAR, and is complemented by scripts that automate deployment and execution on the physical platform. It was used in a master-level course on introductory autonomous vehicles, and initial student feedback suggests that the approach reduces the perceived complexity of ROS-related infrastructure and helps learners focus on algorithmic logic and real-world behaviour.
tldr: This paper presents a custom Python library that mirrors the Webots API to allow direct transfer of controllers between simulation and a real TurtleBot3, reducing ROS-related barriers in educational robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个自定义Python库，模拟Webots API，使得控制器代码可在仿真与真实TurtleBot3之间直接转移，降低教育机器人中ROS相关门槛。

title: H-TRIP: Exact Many-to-Many Distance Index for Multi-Robot Exploration
summary: Frontier-based exploration systems repeatedly evaluate geodesic travel costs between robot poses and candidate viewpoints, and tour-based planners consume the full pairwise distance matrix built from them. Recomputing these matrices with one graph search per source scales with the explored map size, whereas distance caches that refresh only locally affected or newly created frontiers can retain stale costs between surviving pairs when newly discovered free space creates a global shortcut. We present H-TRIP (Hierarchical Tropical Rank-one Incremental Propagation), an exact distance index grounded in Kleene algebra over the min-plus semiring for monotonically growing occupancy grids. H-TRIP partitions the known map into a spatial hierarchy with fixed boundary ports. Each unknown-to-free revelation is decomposed into efficient rank-one min-plus edge insertions at the affected leaf, and only decreased port-to-port summaries are propagated along its ancestor chain. A shared hierarchical lift evaluates the dense many-to-many matrix of shortest distances for all active query points on the occupancy map. We prove that sequential insertions preserve exact shortest-path distances on the grid. Benchmark experiments confirm exact agreement with reference searches on fully built maps and show that dense many-to-many queries at a few dozen viewpoints are up to two orders of magnitude faster than sequential k x BFS. On exploration runs with sixteen robots, in-loop queries on the growing occupancy graph are 2.21x-8.59x faster than co-scheduled k x BFS on maps with side 256, 512, and 1024 cells.
tldr: H-TRIP is an exact hierarchical distance index for multi-robot exploration that efficiently computes many-to-many shortest-path distances on growing occupancy grids using min-plus semiring algebra, achieving significant speedups over repeated BFS.
tldr_zh: H-TRIP 是一种用于多机器人探索的精确层次距离索引，利用 min-plus 半环代数在增长占据栅格上高效计算多对多最短路径距离，相比重复 BFS 有显著加速。

title: Symmetry-Aware Surrogate-Assisted Testing of UAVs
summary: We investigate a symmetry-aware surrogate-assisted testing approach for UAV autopilots. The proposed approach exploits geometric symmetries between flight missions by trans- forming obstacle configurations into a shared canonical coordi- nate frame. This enables a neural-network surrogate trained on a single reference mission to be reused across arbitrary missions, reducing the amount of high-fidelity simulation data required for training. The surrogate model is trained to predict the minimum clearance distance between a UAV and surrounding obstacles and is used to guide test generation towards safety-critical scenarios. We evaluate this approach using the Aerialist UAV test bench and benchmark its performance against techniques from the 2024 to 2026 UAV Testing Competitions. Results show that the approach achieves an average critical-test-case hit rate of 42% across the evaluated missions, compared with approximately 10% for the constrained-random baseline used to generate the training data. This approach also achieves high input diversity and competitive benchmark performance. However, our findings reveal limitations in transferring surrogate predictions across missions with differing flight-path characteristics, highlighting the boundaries of geometric canonicalization. To support reproducibility and future research, we provide the trained surrogate model and a dataset comprising more than 2,500 high-fidelity simulations.
tldr: This paper introduces a symmetry-aware surrogate-assisted testing approach for UAV autopilots, using geometric canonicalization to reuse a neural-network surrogate across missions and improve safety-critical scenario discovery in simulation-based testing.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向无人机自动驾驶仪测试的对称感知代理辅助方法，通过几何规范化在任务间复用代理模型，提高仿真测试中安全关键场景的发现效率。

title: Fast and Accurate Hand Estimation in Pixels, Interaction and World Space
summary: Monocular hand mesh estimators commonly predict rig parameters and project the mesh to obtain 2D keypoints. We find that directly predicted 3D joints agree better with 2D predictions, and fitting a mesh to predicted points reduces mesh error. We present FAH (Fast and Accurate Hand Estimation), a family of models built on SAM 3D Body's hand branch through fine-tuning and feature distillation. The models predict corresponding 2D and 3D joints and surface points, fit MANO or MHR-Hand, and optionally estimate anatomical parts and contact without object geometry at inference. Causal refinement reduces acceleration error, and camera estimation places the hands in world space. Experiments show improvements in image-space alignment, hand geometry, contact estimation and world-space tracking over the evaluated baselines. The default ViT-L model runs at 65 fps with mesh fitting on an RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, or 49 fps with parts and contact enabled. The smallest ViT-S model reaches 125 fps without mesh fitting, parts or contact. Code: https://github.com/noahcao/FAH.
tldr: FAH proposes a fast and accurate hand mesh estimation family built on SAM 3D Body's hand branch, predicting corresponding 2D/3D joints and surface points for image-space and world-space hand tracking.
tldr_zh: FAH 提出了一种基于 SAM 3D Body 手部分支的快速准确手部网格估计模型系列，通过预测对应的 2D/3D 关节点和表面点，实现图像空间和世界空间的手部跟踪。

title: Data-Driven Configuration of Protective Separation Zones in Collaborative Robot Cells from Operator Occupancy
summary: The protective separation zone of a collaborative robot cell is commonly dimensioned for a worst case that disregards where the operator is actually present during the task. This paper presents a camera-based, data-driven method that configures this zone from observed operator occupancy. Operator positions accumulated over several production shifts are aggregated into an occupancy heatmap, from which a protective field is derived that trades off the achievable robot velocity against the required safety distance, following the speed and separation monitoring principle of ISO/TS 15066. The resulting configuration is advisory, that is, reviewed within the risk assessment rather than applied autonomously to the robot controller. The method, which builds on a pose-based perception pipeline with activity recognition, was evaluated in two operational cells at two industrial partners, where the protective field could be reduced by approximately 17% and a productivity increase of 9% was measured. However, adoption proved to depend on more than the demonstrated gain alone.
tldr: This paper presents a camera-based, data-driven method to configure protective separation zones in collaborative robot cells from operator occupancy heatmaps, trading off robot velocity against safety distance per ISO/TS 15066, and showing a 17% zone reduction and 9% productivity gain in industrial evaluations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于摄像头和数据驱动的方法，根据操作员占用热图配置协作机器人单元中的保护性分离区域，按照ISO/TS 15066在机器人速度和所需安全距离之间进行权衡，并在工业评估中显示区域减少约17%和生产率提高9%。

title: Radio-to-Pose Information for Gauge-Drift Correction in Cooperative Localization
summary: Cooperative localization uses odometry and inter-robot measurements to estimate the motion of a robot team. These measurements describe only relative geometry, but the team's estimated position and orientation can drift together over time, i.e., gauge drift. In this work, we study correction of this gauge drift using a radio attenuation map registered in the same world coordinate frame used for robot poses. Specifically, we propose Radio-to-Pose Information (RPI), an interface that converts power residuals and their pose derivatives into a Gaussian information matrix and vector pair. RPI builds on the insight that received power is sensitive to shared displacement in the world map. The pose estimator uses the interface together with odometry and inter-robot measurements to update poses and minimize uncertainty. We characterize the shared motions detectable from the map and observed links. For an uncertain shared map, RPI keeps correlations across robots and time and reproduces joint Gaussian pose estimates and covariances. Across $1000$ simulated Gaussian trials, RPI matches the results of joint estimation. Across 32 paired trials with a registered map, RPI reduces common-position RMSE from $0.542$m to $0.140$m in a $50\times50$m arena compared with a baseline that uses radio only to weight relative measurements.
tldr: The paper proposes Radio-to-Pose Information (RPI), an interface that converts radio attenuation map residuals into Gaussian information for correcting gauge drift in cooperative robot localization, reducing common-position RMSE significantly in simulations.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出无线电到位姿信息（RPI）接口，将无线电衰减图残差转换为高斯信息，用于校正协作机器人定位中的规范漂移，在仿真中将共同位置RMSE显著降低。

title: USB Gym: A Gymnasium Testbed for Closed-Loop Ultrasound View Matching
summary:
Background and Objective: Our main goal is ultrasound guidance: moving a probe until its image matches a target view. Published methods for each part of a guide are evaluated in separate simulators. We asked whether these methods, combined into one guide, are good enough.
  Methods: We built USB Gym, a testbed whose standard engine simulates ultrasound from public patient CT, with a network drawing organ textures from CT labels. Its guide has three replaceable parts (slots), an organ segmenter, a controller and a reward, which received 20 published methods, each run on the same 60 episodes of six held-out patients. In each slot, a published method replaced ours only if detectably better on these patients. The better of this combination and our original guide on 20 new CTs is the benchmark baseline. A pose oracle, reading the exact probe pose available only in simulation, set the reference. The results below are exploratory.
  Results: On these CTs, the probe started on average 16.0 mm from the target view; the pose oracle brought it to 1.5 mm. Of the results known when the combination was fixed, only an image-similarity reward (SSIM) was slightly but detectably better, so the combination was our guide with that reward. This combination was the benchmark baseline, ending at 13.7 mm (16% of the oracle's progress).
  Conclusions: Combining untuned published methods with ours did not guide the probe near the target view; the task remains under-explored. The testbed accepts new methods; no guide was tested on hardware.
tldr: USB Gym is a new closed-loop ultrasound view matching testbed that combines 20 published methods in three replaceable components and evaluates them on held-out CT patients, finding no sufficient performance gain over baseline and highlighting the task as under-explored.
tldr_zh: USB Gym 是一个用于闭环超声视图匹配的测试平台，将20种已发表方法组合在三个可替换组件中，并在保留病人CT数据上评估，发现组合性能不足，任务仍需探索。

title: Transformer-Based Trajectory Prescription for sEMG-Optimizing Robot-Mediated Rehabilitation
summary: Robot-mediated rehabilitation has the potential to deliver high-intensity, individualized therapy, but existing systems (which have not consistently improved outcomes) typically prescribe kinematic trajectories rather than explicitly targeting the neuromotor activations thought to support recovery. To address this gap, and ultimately enable activation-optimizing rehabilitation robot behavior, we present a personalizable transformer-based model mapping individuals' muscle activations (as measured via surface electromyography) to prescribed contact force trajectories when interacting with an end-effector rehabilitation robot. The model uses a transformer encoder-decoder leveraging rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) to generate a latent representation of trajectory-relevant and user-specific neuromotor factors, and augments trajectory prediction with flow matching to produce a distribution over plausible prescriptions biased toward the training distribution. Using data from 16 healthy participants completing 15 isometric trajectory tracking tasks, we evaluate generalization across held-out tasks and users, as well as the feasibility of user-specific fine-tuning within a therapy-session timescale. The model achieves mean trajectory prediction errors of <8% on held out tasks and users, with effectively instantaneous deterministic inference and sub-second sampling of trajectory distributions. An initial test using the model during live rehabilitation tasks demonstrates that, on average, participants reach the target neuromotor activations with just 15% error accumulated throughout the task. These results provide a proof of concept for data-driven, activation-targeted trajectory prescription in robot-mediated rehabilitation and establish a foundation for future validation in clinical populations. Data and code have been open-sourced as part of the OpenRobotRehab project on SimTK.
tldr: This paper presents a transformer-based model that maps sEMG muscle activations to contact force trajectories for robot-mediated rehabilitation, achieving low prediction errors, fast inference, and promising live task performance, providing a proof of concept for activation-targeted therapy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的模型，将表面肌电信号映射到康复机器人的接触力轨迹，在低预测误差和快速推理下实现了激活目标导向的康复训练，为激活靶向治疗提供了概念验证。

title: Reversible Dynamics, Asymmetric Actions: Parking as a Trajectory-Level Affordance
summary: Drivers are often told to back into a tight parking space, not drive in nose first. The advice looks paradoxical, because a slow car is dynamically reversible: reverse its speed and replay the steering backward, and it retraces a feasible path. Played backward, though, reverse-in shows a car driving forward out of the space. Reverse-in and forward-in are different tasks: they share a start position but end facing opposite ways. We separate three clearances between car and obstacles. Static fit $F$ is the clearance the parked car keeps at its best acceptable destination pose. Eventual access $A_\infty$ is the clearance it can keep all the way there with unlimited corrections. Resource-bounded access $A_K$ is the clearance that survives a budget of $K$ reversals, switches between forward and reverse. They satisfy $F\ge A_\infty\ge A_K$. In one fully specified scene (one car, bay, aisle and start), a certified argument proves $A_\infty=F=0.5000$ m for both tasks. In this scene, all certified forward/reverse asymmetry therefore arises at finite $K$: it lies in how many corrections each task needs, not in the clearance either can eventually keep. With one reversal, an explicit path gives reverse-in at least $0.4410$ m clearance. A certified reachability argument caps forward-in's one-reversal clearance at $d_0<0.1720002$ m. With two reversals, forward-in gets at least $0.2833$ m. To keep a clearance strictly above any $d$ with $d_0\le d<0.2833$ m, reverse-in thus needs exactly one reversal and forward-in exactly two when both tasks move forward first. If both move in reverse first, the counts are two and three. The contrast depends on the start position (Section 4.15). Proposed experiments test whether observers distinguish fit, eventual access and budgeted access. They compare these with simpler cues, such as how the turning body sweeps, and learned manoeuvre labels.
tldr: This paper formalizes parking as a trajectory-level affordance, separating static fit, eventual access, and resource-bounded access, with certified results showing that forward/reverse asymmetry arises from the number of reversals needed rather than eventual clearance. It proposes experiments to test whether humans distinguish these clearance concepts.
tldr_zh: 本文将停车概念化为轨迹级可供性，区分静态适配、最终可达性和资源受限可达性，并通过严格证明表明前进/倒车的不对称性源于所需换向次数而非最终间隙，提出实验检验人类是否区分这些间隙概念。

title: Wedge-Jamming Mechanism for String Configuration
summary: Variable stiffness mechanisms that achieve both flexibility and rigidity are important technologies for robotic systems. Recently, wire-based jamming mechanisms have attracted significant attention. In the wire-based jamming mechanisms, modules are chained by a wire, and the overall stiffness is controlled by changing the friction between the modules through wire tension. These mechanisms have been widely studied due to their simple structure and controllability. However, conventional wire-based jamming mechanisms mainly focus on holding torque along the joint axis, and the resistance against disturbances in other directions has not been sufficiently explored. In this study, we propose a wedge-jamming mechanism that introduces wedge-shaped contact surfaces into the modules of wire-based jamming structures. By changing the wedge angle, the holding characteristics against disturbances in different directions can be adjusted. Experimental results show that an out-wedge configuration improves resistance to vertical disturbances, while an in-wedge configuration enhances resistance to torsional disturbances. These results demonstrate that the anisotropic holding performance of wire-based jamming mechanisms depend on wedge geometry.
tldr: This paper proposes a wedge-jamming mechanism for wire-based variable stiffness structures, enabling adjustable anisotropic holding performance against disturbances in different directions through wedge geometry.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于线缆式变刚度结构的楔形夹持机构，通过改变楔形几何形状，可调节对不同方向扰动的各向异性保持性能。

title: Not Losing Your Way: Mitigating Visual-Inertial Odometry Drift through On-Demand Visual Feature Creation
summary: Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) can degrade during aerial inspection in repetitive or poorly textured environments. We propose an active environment-modification framework for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) relying on cameras and an inertial measurement unit only, without prior maps or additional localization sensors. Inspired by the fairy tale of Tom Thumb, the UAV creates visual features on demand by releasing ground markers or marking walls through physical contact. An information-based indicator triggers interventions using temporal confirmation and hysteresis. Evaluation includes three simulated environments and a 900-run factorial campaign. Lower cruise speed and active marking are associated with reduced divergence, while accuracy among non-divergent runs depends on speed-strategy interactions. Corridor experiments, with five runs per configuration, use OptiTrack for flight control while VIO-based marking decisions remain active online. The combined framework reduces the reported position root mean square error by approximately 35% relative to baseline VIO, supporting active feature creation for drift mitigation.
tldr: This paper presents an active environment-modification framework for UAVs that creates visual features on demand to mitigate VIO drift in repetitive or poorly textured environments, reducing position RMSE by about 35% in corridor experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无人机主动环境修改框架，通过按需创建视觉特征来缓解重复或低纹理环境中的视觉惯性里程计漂移，在走廊实验中将位置RMSE降低约35%。

title: 4D Point Splatting for mmWave Radar Micro-Doppler Differentiable Rendering
summary: Millimeter-wave radar resolves the micrometer displacements of a moving body as micro-Doppler, enabling gait, gesture, activity, pose and vital-sign sensing. Each task relies on a downstream model trained on real data, yet radar datasets lag orders of magnitude behind vision and language. Brute-force collection will not close that gap, and existing synthesis methods (forward-only simulators, learned generators and static-scene inverse renderers) cannot fit a real capture of a moving body, leaving a sim2real gap. We present 4D Point Splatting (4DPS), a physics-based differentiable renderer that fits an explicit moving scene to a real capture. Using the synchronized camera to initialize the room and body, we represent the scene as oriented points carrying material, normal and velocity, and splat each point into range and Doppler bins. Our output is the raw complex return a real radar records, so we apply the same signal processing on the rendered data to obtain any representation for training any SOTA downstream model. We fit 235 sequences on HuPR and 100 on RT-Pose, two datasets with different radars. Our reconstructions set the state of the art, with median correlations of 0.940 and 0.830 on range-azimuth, 0.829 and 0.695 on range-Doppler, and 0.988 and 0.966 on micro-Doppler. Our renders also set the state of the art in downstream sim2real gap. On RT-Pose, a pose model trained on them reaches 21.9 cm MPJPE on real data, against 16.7 cm for real training and 127.6 cm for the RF-Genesis baseline, where both the rendered- and real-trained models learn nearly the same features. Our custom CUDA kernels fit a sequence in 5.7 minutes on HuPR and 12.9 on RT-Pose on one H100, making dataset-scale inverse rendering of mmWave radar possible for the first time. This work can enable synthetic data generation for any human-centered downstream task and model, and scene editing for data augmentation.
tldr: This paper introduces 4D Point Splatting, a physics-based differentiable renderer that fits an explicit moving scene to real mmWave radar micro-Doppler captures, enabling dataset-scale synthetic data generation for human-centered downstream tasks and setting state-of-the-art sim2real performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出4D点溅射（4DPS），一种基于物理的可微渲染器，将显式运动场景拟合到真实毫米波雷达微多普勒数据，实现数据集规模的合成数据生成，并在sim2real性能上达到最先进水平。

title: Detecting Silent Faults at the Environment-Trainer Boundary in Reinforcement Learning
summary:
Robot reinforcement learning increasingly runs environments outside the trainer: in another process, on another machine, in another language. Many faults at this boundary raise no error. We make the boundary a wire protocol and ask what notices a fault in it.
  On Pendulum, HalfCheetah, Hopper and a 7-joint arm (Pusher), we injected up to 23 faults into what crosses the wire and 2 into the trainer's log, from one value to every value. Unless every value was wrong, a learning-curve threshold caught at most one run in ten, and a comparison with ten fault-free seeds at most 21%. A clean evaluation of all 1,060 final policies agreed with the curves: of the 728 boundary-fault runs both curve checks passed, 723 scored no more than three standard deviations below fault-free seeds, though nearly all ended on other weights and, for reward faults, logged other returns.
  Checks of the run itself, not of its outcome, saw every fault. A step ledger kept on both sides and compared step by step caught and located every fault that crossed, on Pendulum, Hopper and Pusher on one machine and on Pendulum across two, with no fault-free run and, on Pendulum, a median 3% more training time. An episode record kept at the environment caught the faults in the trainer's log. We list such faults found in practice, in Gymnasium 1.3 and our own code and, reported by others, in five multi-agent libraries, and recommend a step ledger and episode counts kept at the environment.
tldr: This paper investigates silent faults arising at the environment-trainer boundary in distributed robot reinforcement learning, proposing a step ledger and environment-side episode record as lightweight, non-invasive checks that detect and localize all injected faults, whereas outcome-based checks (learning-curve thresholds and baseline comparisons) fail to do so.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了分布式机器人强化学习中环境-训练器边界处的静默故障，提出了一种逐步账本和环境端回合记录，作为轻量且非侵入性的检查手段，能够检测并定位所有注入的故障，而基于结果的检查（学习曲线阈值和基线比较）则无法做到。

title: H-BRICK: Hierarchical Boundary Reachability Index with Compressed Kleene Closure for Directed Grid Graphs
summary: Repeated directed reachability queries arise in online path planning, task-agent allocation, and swarm control on static grid maps, where reachability is asymmetric and full transitive closure is storage-prohibitive.
