If the estimate satisfies a user-specified $(ε, δ)$ tolerance, inference proceeds without accessing host memory. Otherwise, VerKV performs query-aware retrieval to fetch additional tokens from the CPU, refining the attention computation to meet the required tolerance. Thus, VerKV enables attention with bounded approximation error while minimizing CPU-to-GPU transfers. We show that PoissonComp outperforms state-of-the-art approaches to KV cache compression. Combined with KVFetch, it achieves near-dense performance (90-100% of dense quality at 32K context length, averaged over RULER and LOFT), using Qwen3-4B, Qwen3.5-9B and Ministral-3-8B, while reducing the GPU memory footprint by 8-32x and keeping CPU-to-GPU memory fetches within 2-23% of the cache per generated token, depending on the model.

title: Vietnamese Legal Ontology: Every legal answer, traced to the article that grounds it
summary: A legal answer is only as good as the article it rests on. Vietnam's largest open legal corpus pairs 109,543 published questions and answers with 573,851 legal documents, yet its citations are free text: "Khoan 3 Dieu 101 cua Bo luat nay" ("Clause 3, Article 101 of this Code") names neither the code nor its version. Following the five stages of NVIDIA Auto Ontology, Discover, Ground, Validate, Expose and Learn, we turn four open datasets into a knowledge graph of 11.5 M nodes and 16.0 M edges in which every node and edge carries its source record and method, with no duplicate keys, dangling edges or schema violations. Of 67,868 cited provisions, 61,487 resolve to a dated law version, 51,694 to a parsed article, clause or point, and 19,012 are confirmed word for word. The ontology then shows what flat records hide. 36% of the 78,361 answers whose citations resolve now cite a law that is no longer in force; 2,525 verified citations point to an article number that says something else in the current law; 2,520 citations were re-versioned because their words match a different version than their date suggests; and 5,575 document numbers are shared by several local authorities, one of them by 72. Every number in this paper is computed from the graph.

title: Virtual Task Prompting for Multi-Task Scene Understanding
summary: Multi-task scene understanding models typically rely on modified vision encoders or complex decoders for cross-task interaction, which limits their flexibility and compatibility with off-the-shelf vision foundation models (VFMs). We introduce Virtual Task Prompting (VTP), which frames multi-task prompting as retrieving task-adaptive compositions from a shared virtual state, where both the state and routing process are optimized in an end-to-end manner. Concretely, VTP maintains an expanded set of virtual tasks alongside the backbone. At each layer, learnable routing matrices read task-specific compositions as input to interact with image tokens and write the processed results back, forming explicit pathways that capture the intricacies among tasks outside the encoder. Since VTP keeps the backbone clean, it integrates seamlessly with pretrained VFMs, advancing the state of the art on Pascal-Context and NYUD-v2. Stress test on Taskonomy with 13 heterogeneous tasks further shows VTP's robustness in extreme settings. Ablations and analysis indicate that VTP's gains stem from adaptive routing rather than increased capacity. The project page is available at https://jacky1128.github.io/VTP/.

title: Viscot-steer: Disentangling and Transferring Visual Chain-of-Thought via Activation Steering
summary: Visual chain-of-thought (visual-CoT), also known as "thinking with images", equips LVLMs with the ability to locate and use key visual evidence for reasoning. However, acquiring such visual-CoT capabilities requires costly post-training and tightly couples them to a specific backbone, making transfer to other LVLMs difficult. Existing cross-model transfer methods typically treat visual-CoT as a monolithic capability, using a unified representation that ignores the functional distinction between grounding and reasoning and introduces stage-irrelevant interventions. To address this problem, we propose Viscot-steer, a training-free activation steering framework for transferring visual-CoT capabilities across heterogeneous LVLMs. Specifically, Viscot-steer first disentangles visual-CoT into grounding and reasoning vectors and extracts them from the source-model layers associated with the corresponding capabilities. It then aligns the vectors with the activation space of the target model and steers the grounding and reasoning layers during bounding-box prediction and reasoning-trace generation, respectively. Across benchmarks covering high-resolution visual understanding, general visual perception and reasoning, and mathematical visual reasoning, Viscot-steer transfers capabilities from different visual-CoT models to architecturally diverse LVLMs and outperforms the strongest capability-transfer baseline by an average of 1.86 percentage points on the primary evaluation metrics.

title: What Does Multiple Choice Actually Measure? Disentangling Video Understanding from Option Exploitation
summary: Video understanding evaluations are intended to measure a model's proficiency in video perception and task solving. However, current VideoQA benchmarks struggle to isolate these capabilities due to their reliance on multiple-choice (MC) answer guidance, language priors, and fragile scoring pipelines. Disentangling these confounding factors reveals how much of a model's score is supplied by the evaluation context rather than earned through faithful perception. Across six VideoQA benchmarks of varying length, we find that accuracy is significantly above chance without any visual input. This is caused by shortcutting and option-prior reliance. We express these effects in the language of faithfulness: option-exploitation and answer-conditioned reasoning traces are unfaithful even when they are correct. Together, our results show that a VideoQA score is jointly determined by language priors, option timing, and how outputs and labels are converted into correctness. We produce a novel Option-Delayed Replay (ODR) mechanism that discloses options at controlled stages of an open-ended (OE) trajectory, to obtain objective MC scores from faithful option-free inference. Our work demonstrates that agentic methods with ODR and faithful inference can match option-exploiting performance. Finally, we formalize our diagnostic collection and ODR as a reproducible evaluation protocol, and we release a human-relabelled edition of LVBench (correcting $20.5\%$ of keys) to remove annotation noise as a confounding variable.

title: What Travels Across Languages? Reading, Transfer and Erasure of Cross-Lingual Concept Subspaces in Bangla Idioms
summary: Cross-lingual concept analysis requires distinguishing the information that a subspace retains from the classifiers and erasers that transfer through it. We study these operations in six frozen encoders using 10,359 Bangla (Bengali) idiom senses, eight input conditions, and figurative-class and sentiment labels. Class-mean directions provide the most consistent evidence of shared coarse meaning: in post hoc analyses, they outperform random-subspace, permuted-label and covariance-matched nulls in all 12 model-label tests under balanced accuracy. A prospective internal re-split supports idiom-alone sharing in 10 of 12 tests, spanning five encoders. The original confirmatory logistic-regression family rejects both planned nulls in 4 of 12 tests, where English directions gain only a few accuracy points above the majority-class floor (3.0-7.3). Classifier transfer depends on the input map and regularization: English-trained class-mean readouts beat both zero-shot nulls in 8 of 12 discovery tests, and stronger source-selected penalties improve transfer through logistic and LEACE directions. These readouts use Bangla-validation-selected layers and unlabeled target preprocessing. Input controls show greater coarse-class sharing for explicit glosses than for idiom counterparts. Reading, however, does not imply effective erasure: English-fitted LEACE removes less than one percentage point of Bangla figurative-class accuracy, compared with 4-11 points for Bangla-fitted LEACE; INLP shows a similar asymmetry. Pattern-filter analysis, covariance-weighted input maps and a binary Gaussian overlap bound explain how these operations can diverge. The analogous multiclass ordering is an empirical diagnostic, observed in 11 of 12 cells. The results support an estimator-sensitive account of cross-lingual concept sharing and motivate evaluating reading, classifier transfer, erasure and overlap separately.

title: What You Show Is Not What You Get: Rethinking Demonstration Following in Visual In-Context Segmentation
summary: Visual in-context segmentation uses visual demonstrations to guide predictions for a new image. In SegGPT, we identify background color mapping deviation, where non-target regions sharing a background label receive different output colors, and part-to-parent expansion, where predictions extend beyond the requested part into its parent object. These deviations can occur even when the relevant regions remain distinguishable in internal features. Controlled changes to demonstration colors and requested targets support an account in which demonstrations guide role and color assignments over familiar semantic regions, influenced by learned semantic and color preferences. Building on these findings, we introduce Semantic Contrast Prompt Selection (SCPS). Its semantic contrast encoding assigns separate colors to the requested part and the rest of its object while keeping the remaining scene black. SCPS combines existing retrieval scores with quality estimates from labeled development images to select demonstrations and their binary or semantic contrast encodings. Averaged across seven retrieval methods on three benchmarks, SCPS improves target IoU by 0.054 and reduces leakage into the rest of the object by 22.7% relative to the original binary selectors. Our findings offer a new perspective on understanding and improving demonstration following in visual in-context segmentation.

title: When Are Nearby Experts Composable? Cross-Task Model Merging in Neural Thickets
summary: Random perturbations around a shared checkpoint can produce experts for distinct tasks, but shared origin does not ensure that their gains survive composition. We formulate expert-pair selection for joint base-relative retention, measured by strict joint success and worst-task gain with unconditional abstention accounting. An exact finite-difference decomposition and an arbitrarily small orthogonal counterexample show why proximity and orthogonality alone are insufficient. We instantiate this formulation with quality-constrained spectral selection, a fixed-budget framework combining cross-task screening, layerwise pair geometry, separate validation, and Base fallback. Across six checkpoints, 21 task pairs, and five independent perturbation pools, the procedure improves strict joint success over Top-1 averaging throughout and leads the four-method model-scale comparison on four of six checkpoints. For the five models with at least 1.5B parameters, matched quality-only, global-cosine, and spectral ranking attain 49.1%, 50.5%, and 53.1% joint success. Under this matched protocol, the spectral selector also yields the highest worst-task gain and Weak Pareto rate and the lowest regression rate. Mean worst-task gain reaches +0.61 percentage points, while 17.1% regression and 13.0% abstention show that composability remains conditional. Project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Thickets-Merge/.

title: When Calibration Data Matter in Sub-4-Bit Language Model Quantization
summary: Low-bit post-training quantization reduces language-model memory but can sharply degrade downstream task accuracy. Calibration usually relies on generic text, but when task-informed data recover accuracy and which quantizers benefit remain poorly understood. We introduce FragCal-DC, which supplements generic text with training documents from task families with low retention of full-precision accuracy in a two-bit scan. We use a two- to four-bit sweep to locate functional regimes and four-seed calibration comparisons to evaluate six data-dependent methods across six dense models (1.7B-8B) and ten tasks. At their lowest tested functional bit widths, iterative SignRound V2 and OmniQuant improve at two bits, whereas single-pass GPTQ and AWQ show small mean responses at three bits. At two bits, SignRound V2 gains 1.83 percentage points in mean ten-task accuracy over generic-text calibration across six models. At 70 billion parameters, GPTQ and SignRound V2 both improve at two bits, with functional generic-calibration baselines. For two-bit SignRound V2, task-level controls show that recovery concentrates on families included in calibration, while incorrect answer designations retain about 90% of the mean accuracy gain. Changes in reconstruction error do not consistently track accuracy gains. These findings support task-informed calibration as a design principle for preserving downstream accuracy in low-bit quantization.

title: When Credit Turns Against Tools: Transition-Aware Credit Assignment in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards trains language models through multi-turn tool interactions, yet their reasoning performance and tool-calling ability can decline during training. We trace this degradation to three coupled mechanisms: (1) tool-token imbalance produces negative overall tool credit when incorrect trajectories contain more tool tokens per turn than correct ones; (2) aggregation amplification can further strengthen this negative signal as token-mean aggregation gives longer incorrect trajectories greater weight in policy updates; and (3) failure-driven retries prolong trajectories as models tend to call tools again after execution errors, extending potential negative credit to recovery attempts. To counter this suppression, we propose Transition-Aware Credit Assignment (TACA), which targets the transition from reasoning to tool use through supervision of both call initiation and generation. Specifically, TACA uses Advantage Projection to enforce a nonnegative mean advantage on tool-call tokens within each prompt group through a minimal uniform shift. Additionally, TACA guides tool-use decisions with Decision Contrast, comparing rewards for tool-assisted and direct answers to the same prompt. Through Supervised Replay, it reinforces tool-call generation using calls from previously sampled correct trajectories. Across models and tasks, TACA improves performance and sustains more reliable tool interaction during training, raising mean accuracy over MT-GRPO on six reasoning benchmarks by 4.61 percentage points for Qwen2.5-1.5B and 3.61 for Qwen2.5-3B. Our code is available at https://github.com/tmlr-group/TACA.

title: When Normality Shifts: Multi-Level WavLM Modeling for Open-World Audio Deepfake Detection
summary: Audio deepfake detectors trained with known synthesis attacks can learn generator-specific shortcuts that fail as synthesis systems and acoustic conditions evolve. We investigate an attack-free alternative: a normality model trained exclusively on bona fide speech, which scores synthetic audio by its deviation from authentic representations. We propose MLN-WavLM, a method that applies shrinkage-Mahalanobis modeling to pooled hidden states from a frozen large-scale, pre-trained speech processing WavLM Base+ architecture. Evaluated on ASVspoof 2019 LA, our best attack-free variant achieves an 8.45\% Equal Error Rate (EER), closely tracking a fully supervised WavLM-HM-Conformer baseline (7.86%). However, when subjected to the ASVspoof 2021 DF domain shift, performance drops to 22.12% EER, exposing vulnerabilities in the bona-fide-calibrated operating point. Layer-wise analysis reveals that early WavLM representations dominate the ensemble. To test real-world viability, we simulated deployment streams using unlabeled threshold adaptation. While robust median/MAD recalibration easily handles in-domain contamination up to 10%, recalibrating under the 2021 DF domain shift triggers a total collapse of low-FPR recall. We conclude that while frozen source-domain normality can effectively rank deepfakes, it does not yield a stable open-world decision rule, and downstream threshold adaptation cannot rescue upstream ranking degradation.

title: When Self-Consistency Hurts: The Hidden Cost of Majority Voting in Small Language Models
summary: We study prompted chain-of-thought (CoT) with self-consistency (SC), i.e. sampling N traces and plurality-voting, on small language models, a regime where per-query compute budgets are tight yet SC is commonly applied with a fixed sample budget inherited from large-model practice, regardless of instance difficulty. Across two model families (Qwen-2.5-0.5B, Gemma-3-1B) at FP16 and MLX-Q4 (4-bit quantisation in Apple's MLX framework), on GSM8K and MATH-500, we run 8 per-task and 4 task-pooled experiments at n=200-400 with 1,000x paired-bootstrap confidence intervals (CIs). Our first result is an upper bound: an oracle gate deciding per prompt whether to invoke SC reaches 109-174% of always-SC's accuracy at 23-30% of its compute in all 12/12 cases, so at N=5 always-SC is dominated everywhere on our grid. That margin is exactly the rate at which SC flips correct greedy answers to wrong, here 3-10.5% of prompts, which on Qwen-Q4 x MATH-500 exceeds the wrong-to-right rate and leaves always-SC 3 pt worse than always-greedy. Our second result is a deployable approximation: a gate over greedy-pass signals skips 45-99% of SC calls, with bootstrap CI half-widths under 5 pt, removing 36-79% of always-SC compute. Accuracy retention at those operating points has point estimates of 98.1-98.8%, which we report as point estimates because their CIs are wide (lower bounds 76-86%) over an SC accuracy of only 15-36%. The evidence covers N=5 on two <=1B families and two math benchmarks, which is the scope we claim. Code is available at https://github.com/heywanrong/SiftSC.

title: When Sensors Fail: Coverage Auditing with Incomplete Sensor Records
summary: Sensor outages can conceal prediction-interval coverage deficits behind acceptable marginal performance, while unavailable future readings leave some issued forecasts unscorable. We present a measurement-record audit that links issue-time outage duration, original target availability, and time-uniform statistical evidence. The audit retains complete forecast keys, batches all sensors and overlapping horizons at each measurement tick, and projects simultaneous covered-count and scored-count bounds onto a cumulative conditional expected coverage ratio. This target is distinguished from empirical coverage and outage-conditional population coverage. Selected traffic and air-quality results illustrate the gap between pooled and long-outage coverage; in METR-LA, only 7.6% of issued long-gap forecasts have originally observed targets. Of 30 primary sequential outage-state audits, 26 are inconclusive and four lack scored support. This concise presentation gives the core construction and selected aggregate evidence without the full experimental supplement.

title: When gene summaries reveal the answers: Gene Ontology circularity in gene embedding benchmarks
summary: A gene summary can contain the very annotations used to evaluate an embedding of its text. The Alliance of Genome Resources converts Gene Ontology (GO) annotations into sentences, which NCBI Gene displays and GenePT includes in its input. These summaries covered 6,172 of 19,256 human protein-coding genes (32.1%), including 58% of genes with one to ten linked publications. We embedded the same corpus with and without the generated summaries and refitted a function-prediction probe on each version. Among genes with one to ten publications, removal reduced the reported per-gene area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) by 0.078 with a linear probe (95% bootstrap interval 0.072-0.084) and by 0.033 with a multilayer perceptron. These estimates use a historical GO scorer that mishandled ties. The original predictions are unavailable for rescoring. A simple TF-IDF encoder also benefited from the summaries, as did models evaluated only on experimental annotations. Replacing generated summaries with UniProt function descriptions recovered much of the lost performance despite little verbatim overlap. UniProt also curates many of the evaluation labels. In mouse and yeast, we found a similar dependence on the source of the description. We introduce GeneProv to compare encoders on matched text and to examine how representation rankings change across GO recovery, non-GO endpoints and co-essentiality.

title: Where Should a Gate Look? Input vs. State Gating in Diagonal State Space Models
summary: Modern state-space models owe much of their computational efficiency to their linear, often diagonal, dynamics. Classical recurrent neural networks instead allow nonlinear state-to-state interactions, which can be beneficial when memory updates need to depend on the past context. In this paper, we ask whether state feedback through a simple gate regulating memory updates can enhance the expressivity of diagonal state-space models. To investigate this question, we compare gates that depend on the current input, the recurrent state, or both. We establish a strict expressivity separation: for scalar models, state gating solves induction-head tasks for arbitrary vocabulary size and sequence length, whereas input gating fails on a finite instance under standard stability assumptions on the state transition matrix. Experiments show that state gating retains its advantage on induction-head tasks in higher-dimensional models, whereas input gating performs better on selective copying tasks. Together, our results show that even a simple, diagonal form of state-feedback gating can unlock capabilities unavailable to input-controlled models, while input and state gating offer complementary strengths and achieve the strongest overall performance when combined.

title: ZarrFM: A Canonical Tensor Storage Architecture for EEG Foundation-Model Pretraining
summary: Statistical models for brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) increasingly require large, heterogeneous EEG corpora, yet existing datasets vary in sampling rates, channel layouts, window lengths, and storage formats, creating substantial preprocessing and I/O overhead. We propose ZarrFM, an execution-oriented representation that complements BIDS by storing a corpus as a single Zarr v3 hierarchy with indexed metadata, canonical channel spaces, explicit masks, hash-stable subject splits, verified event tables, and block-aligned sharding. On real PhysioNet recordings and synthetic corpora, we compare ZarrFM with EDF, FIF, NPY, HDF5, and Parquet. Across 200 recordings, its two-level index reduces metadata queries from 601 requests to 14. Preserving native signal codes reduces storage from 42.4 MB/hour in EDF to 22.7 MB/hour, while block-aligned sampling reaches 3,131 windows/s, up to 11 times faster than Parquet. Reads remain bit-identical across independent Zarr implementations, and concurrent failure-injected appends recover without data loss. These results show that ZarrFM can provide a compact, interoperable, and execution-efficient storage layer for large-scale EEG pretraining.

title: scBIG++: Learning Across Genes and Cells to Predict Single-Cell Perturbation Responses
summary: Predicting single-cell transcriptional responses to genetic and chemical interventions supports gene-function discovery and regulatory analysis. Existing studies often focus only on highly variable genes, restricting the expression changes available for downstream analysis. Cells exposed to the same intervention can also show heterogeneous expression responses, with coordinated gene programs active to different degrees. We propose scBIG++, a full-gene perturbation prediction framework that models this heterogeneity by connecting expression-adaptive gene modules with population-conditioned generation. To preserve shared gene structure while accommodating cellular variation, Gene-Relation Clustering organizes genes into common windows, within which Dynamic SoftSub learns expression-dependent submodule memberships. This shared organization enables Set-GCAE to exchange information about corresponding gene groups across control cells, placing individual representations in their source-population context. The cell representations initialize a latent flow, while their pooled summary and the perturbation representation condition response generation. Generated states are decoded into expression profiles covering all assayed protein-coding genes retained after preprocessing, supporting comprehensive analysis of perturbation-induced expression changes. Experiments across six genetic and chemical settings spanning 6,539--19,451 genes demonstrate competitive perturbation-effect recovery and full-gene expression reconstruction under unseen targets and combinations, cross-cell-line transfer, and held-out compounds. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/ttruan2426-dot/scBIG.

title: VLA-MOPD: On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Task VLA Policy Consolidation
summary: Physical intelligence requires embodied agents to ground language in observations and execute actions while retaining useful skills. Vision-language-action (VLA) policies offer a shared interface, but task-specific post-training often produces separate specialists. Consolidation is difficult: mixed-task reinforcement learning provides sparse trajectory-level credit, while offline distillation may miss student-visited observations and endpoint distillation does not supervise intermediate action-generation states. We introduce VLA Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (VLA-MOPD), a protocol for consolidating flow-matching VLA specialists. After acquiring task or suite experts, a shared student collects robot rollouts and queries the instruction-routed frozen teacher at each visited observation and intermediate ordinary differential equation (ODE) state. Detached per-flow-step transition targets supervise valid action chunks through a masked local matching loss; an optional reference-policy term supports retention on other tasks. Starting from one trajectory per LIBERO task, VLA-MOPD raises mean success-once from 75.4% to 98.9%, compared with 98.15% for endpoint action distillation. It improves mean RoboTwin 2.0 success from 73.0% to 89.3%; on a Piper robot, two consolidation rounds improve average success from 70.0% to 90.0%. In a near-matched Spatial-adaptation study, reference matching limits the Object suite decrease to 3.0 points, versus 13.2 without the reference term.
summary_zh: 物理智能要求具身智能体将语言锚定在观测中，并在保留有用技能的同时执行动作。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略提供了一种共享接口，但针对特定任务的后训练通常会产生各自独立的专用模型。整合面临困难：混合任务强化学习提供的轨迹级奖励过于稀疏，而离线蒸馏可能遗漏学生模型访问过的观测状态，端点蒸馏则无法监督中间动作生成状态。我们提出了VLA多教师在线策略蒸馏（VLA-MOPD），一种用于整合流匹配VLA专用模型的协议。在获得任务或任务组专家模型后，一个共享的学生模型收集机器人轨迹数据，并在每个访问到的观测状态和中间常微分方程（ODE）状态下查询按指令路由的冻结教师模型。分离的每流步迁移目标通过掩蔽局部匹配损失监督有效动作块；可选的参考策略项支持在其他任务上的保留性能。在LIBERO任务中，从每个任务一条轨迹开始，VLA-MOPD将平均一次成功率从75.4%提升至98.9%，而端点动作蒸馏为98.15%。在RoboTwin 2.0上，平均成功率从73.0%提升至89.3%；在Piper机器人上，两轮整合将平均成功率从70.0%提升至90.0%。在近乎匹配的空间适应研究中，参考匹配将对象任务组的下降限制在3.0个百分点，而无参考项时下降为13.2个百分点。
tldr: VLA-MOPD consolidates multiple task-specific VLA specialists into one student policy via on-policy distillation at visited observations and intermediate ODE states, improving multi-task success across LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and a real Piper robot while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
tldr_zh: VLA-MOPD 通过在访问的观测和中间 ODE 状态进行在线蒸馏，将多个任务专用的 VLA 专家整合为一个学生策略，在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 和真实 Piper 机器人上提升多任务成功率并缓解灾难性遗忘。

title: LHNav: Long-Horizon Humanoid Navigation via Multirate Coordination and Physics-Grounded Action Data
summary: We study humanoid navigation across multiple destinations under long-horizon language instructions. This task is challenging because robots must maintain progress across successive goals while continuously producing natural, stable whole-body motion through confined spaces. However, task decomposition in existing methods does not by itself ensure progress throughout execution, while waypoint-based navigation does not guarantee natural, route-faithful whole-body motion. Our key idea is to organize navigation into three complementary roles operating at different time scales: a Brain for task reasoning, a Cerebellum for local motion generation, and a Brainstem for whole-body execution. We realize this idea in LHNav, an asynchronous system that uses progress and arrival feedback to coordinate navigation goals, VLA motion-token prediction, and whole-body control. To train the Cerebellum for natural, route-faithful motion, we develop a physics-grounded data engine that improves physical tracking of motion references along collision-aware routes and pairs the resulting demonstrations with rendered visual observations. Together, these designs allow task planning to proceed alongside continuous movement and extend single-goal navigation to successive destinations with natural, route-faithful whole-body motion. In simulation, our navigation VLA outperforms OmniNav and DualVLN in single-goal success and motion smoothness, with fewer collisions and falls. Using a VLA trained only on single-goal demonstrations, LHNav achieves a 75.56% success rate on long-horizon navigation tasks. Deployment on the Unitree G1 further demonstrates single-goal navigation and zero-shot long-horizon task execution in real-world environments, including layouts with repositioned objects. Project website: https://robbyant-research.github.io/LHNav/.
summary_zh: 我们研究了在长时间跨度的语言指令下，人形机器人在多个目的地之间的导航问题。该任务具有挑战性，因为机器人必须在连续目标之间保持进度，同时持续在狭窄空间中产生自然且稳定的全身运动。然而，现有方法中的任务分解本身并不能确保整个执行过程中的进度，而基于路径点的导航也无法保证自然、符合路径的全身运动。我们的关键思路是将导航组织为三个在不同时间尺度上运作的互补角色：负责任务推理的“大脑”、负责局部运动生成的“小脑”，以及负责全身执行的“脑干”。我们通过LHNav系统实现了这一思路，该系统是一个异步系统，利用进度和到达反馈来协调导航目标、VLA运动令牌预测和全身控制。为了训练“小脑”以产生自然、符合路径的运动，我们开发了一个基于物理的数据引擎，该引擎改进了沿碰撞感知路径的运动参考的物理跟踪，并将生成的演示与渲染的视觉观察配对。这些设计共同使得任务规划能够在持续运动的同时进行，并将单目标导航扩展到连续目的地，同时保持自然、符合路径的全身运动。在仿真中，我们的导航VLA在单目标成功率和运动平滑度上优于OmniNav和DualVLN，且碰撞和摔倒次数更少。使用仅在单目标演示上训练的VLA，LHNav在长时间跨度导航任务上实现了75.56%的成功率。在Unitree G1上的部署进一步展示了在真实环境中的单目标导航和零样本长时间跨度任务执行，包括物体位置被重新布置的场景。项目网站：https://robbyant-research.github.io/LHNav/。
tldr: LHNav introduces an asynchronous three-tier humanoid navigation system (Brain, Cerebellum, Brainstem) with a physics-grounded data engine, enabling VLA-based long-horizon multi-goal navigation with natural motion in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 robot.
tldr_zh: LHNav 提出了一种异步的三层人形导航系统（大脑、小脑、脑干），结合物理接地数据引擎，使 VLA 能够在仿真和真实 Unitree G1 机器人上实现自然运动的长时程多目标导航。

title: Compass 1: Towards Open-World and Persistent Embodied Navigation from Monocular RGB Videos
summary: Embodied navigation requires agents to achieve persistent spatial awareness and long-horizon execution stability in open-world environments. However, existing navigation architectures struggle to sustain both capabilities, remaining effective only over a handful of recent frames. We present Compass 1, the first embodied navigation foundation model to unify language understanding and video generation while enabling memory backtracking through nearly 2mins of visual history. Without altering the underlying architecture, we introduce History Representation, which integrates sparse visual keyframes with an explicit History Representation Map to preserve long-term spatiotemporal context. To effectively leverage this history, we further introduce History Utilization, a structured VQA supervision protocol comprising three categories: task-stage grounding, exploration consistency, and spatiotemporal target retrieval, enabling map-grounded reasoning and stable persistent long-horizon navigation. To fuel this system, we establish a complete annotation pipeline for monocular RGB videos and open-source a massive dataset featuring over 500 hours of high-quality real-world interactions and over 2,000 hours of annotated web videos. Trained mainly on the distribution of 1m height camera, Compass 1 generalizes seamlessly across diverse embodiments and scenarios, ranging from indoor environments to pedestrian-dense streets, spanning wheeled robot at 0.35m, quadruped dog at 0.5m, humanoid at 0.85m, and aerial drone at 1.5m. Compass 1achieves a dominant overall success rate of 79.4% across open-world evaluations, compared to 17.8% for the strongest baseline. It demonstrates exceptional zero-shot execution exceeding 90% on foundational tasks, a 250% boost in exploration, and an unparalleled leap from 0% to 58% in challenging persistent history backtracking.
summary_zh: 具身导航要求智能体在开放世界环境中实现持久的空间感知和长时程执行稳定性。然而，现有导航架构难以同时维持这两种能力，仅在有限的近期帧范围内有效。我们提出了Compass 1，这是首个将语言理解与视频生成相统一，并支持通过近2分钟视觉历史进行记忆回溯的具身导航基础模型。在不改变底层架构的前提下，我们引入了历史表征（History Representation），将稀疏视觉关键帧与显式历史表征图（History Representation Map）相结合，以保留长期时空上下文。为进一步有效利用这一历史信息，我们提出了历史利用（History Utilization），一种结构化VQA监督协议，包含三类任务：任务阶段定位、探索一致性和时空目标检索，从而实现基于地图的推理和稳定的持久长时程导航。为支撑该系统，我们建立了完整的单目RGB视频标注流水线，并开源了一个大规模数据集，包含超过500小时的高质量真实世界交互数据和超过2000小时的标注网络视频。Compass 1主要在1米高度相机分布上进行训练，却能无缝泛化到多种具身形态和场景，涵盖室内环境到行人密集街道，跨越0.35米轮式机器人、0.5米四足机器狗、0.85米人形机器人和1.5米空中无人机。在开放世界评估中，Compass 1实现了79.4%的显著整体成功率，而最强基线仅为17.8%。在基础任务上，它展现出超过90%的卓越零样本执行能力，探索能力提升250%，并在具有挑战性的持久历史回溯任务中实现了从0%到58%的突破性跃升。
tldr: Compass 1 is an embodied navigation foundation model that unifies language understanding and video generation while enabling memory backtracking through nearly 2 minutes of visual history, achieving a dominant success rate of 79.4% across open-world evaluations.
tldr_zh: Compass 1是一个统一的具身导航基础模型，结合语言理解与视频生成，并支持近2分钟视觉历史回溯，在开放世界评估中实现了79.4%的主导成功率。

title: DeltaForge: A Post-hoc Mixture-of-Experts VLA for Multi-Domain Autonomous Driving
summary: Fleets of driving vision-language-action (VLA) models are developed one domain at a time: each operator finetunes a shared base model on private data, producing specialized experts that are costly to consolidate into a single model. Weight merging loses accuracy as heterogeneous domains accumulate, and dense mixture-of-experts routing is prohibitively expensive to combine them. We present DeltaForge, to our knowledge the first post-hoc mixture-of-experts VLA for driving, which consolidates N independently finetuned per-domain models into a single multi-domain model from their weights and a small proxy set alone. When different operators finetune the same base model, their weight updates end up sharing a lot of structure. We exploit this by decomposing all the updates together using singular value decomposition (SVD), splitting each one into a shared part (the same across all domains) and a tiny domain-specific part. The router then only needs to work with those tiny domain-specific pieces, not the full expert weights, which is what keeps the approach efficient. Then two cooperating clip-level blind routers, one over the VLM reasoning experts and one over the flow-matching dynamics experts, are trained from soft labels on the proxy dataset. Across six diverse domains spanning urban, off-road, and highway driving on cars, trucks, and all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), DeltaForge approaches the accuracy of the per-domain experts and surpasses every merging, routing, centralized, and federated baseline at close to single-model parameter and compute cost. Adding a new domain requires only projecting its weight update onto the shared basis with no end-to-end retraining needed. The resulting model also generalizes to domain combinations it was never explicitly trained on.
summary_zh: 摘要：驾驶视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的车队通常是逐领域开发的：每位运营者在其私有数据上微调共享的基础模型，产生各自领域的专家模型，而将这些模型整合为单一模型往往成本高昂。权重合并会因异构领域的累积而损失精度，而稠密混合专家路由在组合这些模型时计算开销过大。我们提出DeltaForge，据我们所知，这是首个用于驾驶的事后混合专家VLA模型，它仅凭各领域独立微调模型的权重和一个小型代理数据集，即可将N个领域专属模型整合为单一多领域模型。当不同运营者对同一基础模型进行微调时，其权重更新往往共享大量结构。我们利用这一特性，通过奇异值分解（SVD）将所有更新联合分解，将其拆分为共享部分（各领域一致）和极小的领域特定部分。路由网络因此只需处理这些微小的领域特定片段而非完整专家权重，这正是该方法保持高效的关键。随后，两个协同工作的片段级盲路由——一个负责VLM推理专家，另一个负责流匹配动力学专家——借助代理数据集上的软标签进行训练。在涵盖城市、越野和高速公路驾驶，以及轿车、卡车和全地形车（ATV）的六个多样化领域上，DeltaForge接近各领域专家模型的精度，同时在几乎等同于单一模型的参数量和计算成本下，超越了所有合并、路由、集中式及联邦式基线方法。新增领域时，仅需将其权重更新投影至共享基空间，无需端到端重训练。所得模型还能泛化到从未显式训练过的领域组合。
tldr: DeltaForge introduces a post-hoc mixture-of-experts approach to consolidate multiple domain-specific driving VLA models into a single efficient multi-domain model by decomposing weight updates into shared and domain-specific components and training lightweight routers, achieving near-expert accuracy across diverse driving domains at low cost.
tldr_zh: DeltaForge 提出了一种事后混合专家方法，通过将权重更新分解为共享和领域特定部分并训练轻量路由器，将多个领域特定的驾驶 VLA 模型整合为单一高效的多领域模型，在多种驾驶领域中以低成本接近专家精度。

title: APS-VLA: Action-Guided and Future-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies have demonstrated strong generalization in robotic manipulation, yet processing dense visual tokens often incurs high inference latency. Visual token pruning offers a practical way to reduce this cost, but identifying a compact set of tokens that preserves reliable action generation remains challenging. Existing methods largely rely on static or immediate heuristic cues to estimate token importance. We introduce APS-VLA, a framework that learns visual token selection from robot demonstrations while keeping the pretrained VLA backbone frozen. A lightweight Decision Influence Estimator scores tokens conditioned on current visual observations, language instructions, and robot proprioception. Its training combines two complementary signals: action supervision matches both the full-input policy predictions and demonstrated actions, while an auxiliary visual transition objective uses demonstrated actions to predict subsequent visual features from the selected representation. At deployment, the estimator performs a single hard selection and packing step before the policy's native action-generation procedure; the auxiliary predictor is removed. Experiments with OpenVLA-OFT on LIBERO and with $π_{0.5}$ and XR-1 on RoboCasa365 demonstrate inference acceleration with modest changes in task success. Across five real-world tasks on two dual-arm platforms, APS-VLA reduces mean policy inference latency from 137.25 to 93.25 ms, achieving a $1.47\times$ speedup with an average success rate of 61%, compared with 60% for the unpruned baseline. Together, these results support APS-VLA as a modular, plug-in framework for efficient robotic control across VLA architectures, preserving the underlying policy parameters and native action-generation procedure.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略已在机器人操作中展现出强大的泛化能力，然而处理密集的视觉令牌往往带来较高的推理延迟。视觉令牌剪枝提供了一种降低该成本的实际途径，但如何识别出一组紧凑且能保持可靠动作生成的令牌仍具挑战。现有方法大多依赖静态或即时启发式线索来估计令牌的重要性。我们提出APS-VLA，一种从机器人演示中学习视觉令牌选择、同时保持预训练VLA骨干网络冻结的框架。轻量级的决策影响估计器根据当前视觉观测、语言指令和机器人本体感知对令牌进行评分。其训练结合了两类互补信号：动作监督既匹配全输入策略预测，也匹配演示动作；辅助的视觉转移目标则利用演示动作从所选表示中预测后续视觉特征。在部署阶段，估计器在策略原生动作生成流程之前执行一次硬选择与打包步骤；辅助预测器被移除。在LIBERO上使用OpenVLA-OFT，以及在RoboCasa365上使用π₀.₅和XR-1进行的实验表明，在任务成功率变化不大的情况下实现了推理加速。在两个双臂平台上的五项真实世界任务中，APS-VLA将平均策略推理延迟从137.25毫秒降至93.25毫秒，实现1.47倍加速，平均成功率为61%，而未剪枝基线为60%。综合这些结果，APS-VLA可作为一种模块化、即插即用的高效机器人控制框架，适用于多种VLA架构，同时保留底层策略参数和原生动作生成流程。
tldr: APS-VLA introduces a plug-in visual token pruning framework for Vision-Language-Action models, learning action-guided and future-aware token selection from demonstrations to reduce inference latency while maintaining task success in robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: APS-VLA 提出了一种即插即用的视觉 token 剪枝框架，通过从演示中学习动作引导和未来感知的 token 选择，在保持任务成功率的同时降低 VLA 模型的推理延迟。

title: DriveFoundry: Co-Evolving Data and Model for Efficient Closed-Loop Iteration in Autonomous Driving
summary: A driving foundation model must learn reusable decision knowledge from rare critical events and apply it under strict runtime constraints. We introduce DriveFoundry, a closed-loop framework improving iteration efficiency under data and computation budgets by coupling structured causal data refinement with adaptive inference. The Data Engine builds traceable scene-candidate records linking scene evidence and factor-decision relations to candidate trajectories and outcome assessments. Candidate comparisons and counterfactual annotations clarify how scene factors affect behavioral feasibility and preference. Verified model failures guide VLM-assisted annotation and expert correction, refining training data and annotation systems. The model engine, Xiaomi-Drive-o1, unifies Perception, Causation, Action, World, and Value within a shared vision-language backbone to enable cross-task knowledge transfer. Block-wise latent refill passes candidate-specific evidence and predicted visual consequences between task blocks, connecting scene understanding, planning, and evaluation. A learned value-of-computation head selects tasks and allocates latent tokens based on expected benefit and cost, adapting inference to each decision. On PhysicalAI, the 9B model achieves the lowest ADE@1 across evaluated splits and horizons among tested models. In AlpaSim, it outperforms Alpamayo 1.5 across all metrics and achieves lower close-encounter and off-road rates than the 34B Alpamayo 2 Super, while trailing in progress and AlpaSim scores. For the 0.8B variant, joint training reduces 5 s minADE@6 by about 54% without altering the inference path or token budget. Adaptive inference matches full reasoning performance using only 28% of tokens. Real-vehicle tests confirm runtime feasibility, supporting a unified paradigm for learning from critical experience and dynamically allocating computation.
summary_zh: 驾驶基础模型必须从罕见的关键事件中学习可复用的决策知识，并在严格的运行时约束下加以应用。我们提出DriveFoundry，一种闭环框架，通过将结构化的因果数据精炼与自适应推理相结合，在数据和计算预算受限的条件下提升迭代效率。数据引擎构建可追溯的场景-候选记录，将场景证据及因素-决策关系与候选轨迹和结果评估相连接。候选比较与反事实标注阐明了场景因素如何影响行为可行性与偏好。经验证的模型失败案例引导基于视觉语言模型的辅助标注和专家修正，从而优化训练数据与标注体系。模型引擎Xiaomi-Drive-o1在统一的视觉-语言骨干网络内融合感知、因果、行动、世界与价值五大模块，实现跨任务知识迁移。分块潜变量回填机制在任务块之间传递候选特异的证据及预测视觉结果，衔接场景理解、规划与评估。学习得到的计算价值头根据预期收益与成本选择任务并分配潜变量token，使推理过程自适应于每个决策。在PhysicalAI上，9B模型在评测的分割片段与预测时域中取得了最低的ADE@1。在AlpaSim中，该模型在所有指标上优于Alpamayo 1.5，并在近距离接近率和偏离道路率上低于34B的Alpamayo 2 Super，但在进度和AlpaSim得分上仍有所不及。对于0.8B变体，联合训练在不改变推理路径或token预算的情况下，将5秒minADE@6降低了约54%。自适应推理仅使用28%的token即可达到完整推理性能。实车测试验证了运行时可行性，支持从关键经验中学习并动态分配计算资源的统一范式。
tldr: DriveFoundry introduces a closed-loop autonomous driving framework that co-evolves structured causal data refinement with adaptive inference, featuring a unified VLA-based model (Xiaomi-Drive-o1) with block-wise latent refill and a learned value-of-computation head, demonstrating strong performance in simulation and real-vehicle tests.
tldr_zh: DriveFoundry 提出了一个闭环自动驾驶框架，将结构化因果数据改进与自适应推理相结合，并采用统一的视觉语言动作模型（Xiaomi-Drive-o1），通过块级潜在回填和学习计算价值头，在仿真和实车测试中表现出色。

title: VLA Adaptation with Real and Simulated Data: A Case Study on Robotic Chess
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are trained as general-purpose foundation models for robot learning, and require fine-tuning for each downstream task and robot. This raises practical questions such as how much data and training updates are needed, how checkpoints should be selected, and whether simulation can be leveraged to alleviate the cost of real data collection. We study these questions on a task that requires both precise manipulation and spatial understanding of the scene. In this task, an SO-101 arm moves a chess king between two squares that are given only by their names, such as e4 and a5. We fine-tune $π_{0.5}$ with various dataset sizes and update budgets, using teleoperated demonstrations as well as simulated demonstrations from a randomized scripted expert that imitates the variability of human demonstrations. In simulation, the success rate scales with both data and updates. Importantly, we find that a short learning-rate cool-down adds up to 31 points and is necessary for comparing checkpoints, and that validation loss and action error are unreliable for model selection. On the real arm, we fine-tune on up to 256 teleoperated demonstrations and evaluate ten policies in 25 trials each. Partial results indicate that pretraining on the simulated demonstrations helps substantially, most clearly when real data is scarce. We also present a negative result, in which training on the policy's own rollouts with filtered behavior cloning, RECAP-style advantage conditioning, corrections from an automatic coach, or residual reinforcement learning did not yield a measurable improvement over plain behavior cloning in our setting. We release the simulator, the expert and the real demonstrations.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型作为机器人学习的通用基础模型进行训练，需要针对每个下游任务和机器人进行微调。这带来了一些实际问题，例如需要多少数据和训练更新次数、如何选择检查点，以及能否利用仿真来降低真实数据采集的成本。我们在一个既需要精细操作又需要对场景进行空间理解的任务中研究了这些问题。在该任务中，SO-101机械臂需要在仅给出名称（如e4和a5）的两个棋盘格之间移动一枚国际象棋王。我们使用遥操作示范以及来自随机化脚本专家的仿真示范（该专家模仿人类示范的变异性），以多种数据集规模和更新预算对$π_{0.5}$进行微调。在仿真中，成功率随数据和更新次数的增加而提升。重要的是，我们发现短暂的学习率冷却阶段可带来高达31个百分点的提升，并且是对检查点进行比较所必需的；同时，验证损失和动作误差在模型选择方面并不可靠。在真实机械臂上，我们使用多达256次遥操作示范进行微调，并对十种策略各进行25次试验评估。部分结果表明，在仿真示范上进行预训练有显著帮助，尤其是在真实数据稀缺时效果最为明显。我们还报告了一个负面结果：在我们的设定中，使用策略自身轨迹进行训练，无论采用过滤行为克隆、RECAP风格优势条件、自动教练的修正，还是残差强化学习，均未比普通行为克隆产生可测量的改进。我们公开了仿真器、专家策略和真实示范数据。
tldr: This paper studies the fine-tuning of a VLA model (π0.5) for a robotic chess manipulation task, examining the effects of data scale, update budgets, learning-rate cool-down, and simulated pretraining, while also reporting a null result for several self-improvement methods.
tldr_zh: 本文以机器人国际象棋任务为例，研究了VLA模型（π0.5）微调中数据量、更新预算、学习率冷却和模拟预训练的影响，并报告了多种自我改进方法未获提升的负面结果。

title: Bridging Task Planning and Execution for Language-Conditioned Bimanual Manipulation
summary: Robots are increasingly expected to execute natural-language manipulation tasks in real-world environments. This is particularly relevant in household assistance and logistics, where clutter requires reasoning about both task objectives and execution feasibility. This challenge becomes even more pronounced for bimanual humanoid platforms, where coordinating two manipulators introduces additional interaction and kinematic constraints. We present a zero-shot vision-language framework for execution-aware bimanual manipulation that jointly reasons about task objectives and physical feasibility. Planning is grounded in a structured scene representation that combines semantic object relations with execution constraints, enabling the selection of obstacle relocations and execution choices while preserving task semantics. Compatible actions are organised into parallel bimanual stages with explicit pre- and post-conditions. A hierarchical validator evaluates these conditions under perceptual uncertainty and uses stage-level execution history to support local recovery or targeted replanning. Experiments on the CENTAURO hybrid wheeled-legged humanoid robot across nine language-conditioned manipulation scenarios show higher task success than a non-execution-aware baseline. In dedicated failure scenarios, hierarchical validation recovers from execution failures with fewer model queries than always replanning. These results demonstrate the benefits of combining execution reasoning directly into task planning. Videos and additional material are available on the Project Webpage: https://advrhumanoids.github.io/bridging-planning-execution/.
summary_zh: 机器人正越来越多地被期望在真实环境中执行自然语言操控任务，这在家庭辅助和物流领域尤为突出。在这些场景中，杂乱的环境要求系统同时推理任务目标与执行的可行性。对于双臂人形平台而言，这一挑战更为显著，因为双臂协调引入了额外的交互与运动学约束。我们提出了一种零样本视觉-语言框架，用于实现具备执行感知的双臂操控，该框架联合推理任务目标与物理可行性。规划过程基于一种结构化场景表示，将语义物体关系与执行约束相结合，从而在保持任务语义的同时，支持障碍物重新放置和执行选择的决策。兼容的动作被组织为并行的双臂阶段，并带有明确的前置和后置条件。一个分层验证器在感知不确定性条件下评估这些条件，并利用阶段级执行历史来支持局部恢复或定向重新规划。在CENTAURO混合轮腿式人形机器人上开展的九项语言条件化操控场景实验中，该方法展示了比不具备执行感知的基线更高的任务成功率。在专门设计的失败场景中，分层验证在恢复执行失败时比始终重新规划所需的模型查询次数更少。这些结果证明了将执行推理直接整合进任务规划的优越性。视频及更多材料可在项目网页获取：https://advrhumanoids.github.io/bridging-planning-execution/。
tldr: This paper presents a zero-shot vision-language framework that jointly reasons about task objectives and physical feasibility for bimanual manipulation on a humanoid robot, using structured scene representations and hierarchical validation to improve task success and recovery.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个零样本视觉语言框架，用于双机械臂操作，联合推理任务目标和物理可行性，通过结构化场景表示和分层验证提高任务成功率并支持恢复。

title: PCTac: Mechanochromic Photonic-Crystal Tactile Sensor for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Modern visuotactile sensors primarily sense contact by imaging the deformation of a compliant interface. Using techniques such as photometric stereo, they can recover detailed contact geometry, often represented as surface normals or depth. However, force-related information typically still needs to be inferred indirectly through calibration, geometric reconstruction, or learned mappings. Mechanochromic photonic-crystal (PC) materials offer an alternative physical encoding mechanism: contact loading changes their periodic microstructure and spectral response, directly transforming local stress into a spatially resolved structural-color field. Despite this potential, PC materials have rarely been explored as visuotactile sensors for closed-loop robot learning. We present PCTac, an open-source mechanochromic PC fingertip that uses a dense hue field as its tactile observation. Loading characterization demonstrates a repeatable relationship between the applied normal load and the observed hue response. We further integrate this representation directly into a Diffusion Policy and evaluate it on three real-robot manipulation tasks. Across 90 physical rollouts, PCTac Hue achieves 68 successes (75.6\%), compared with 60 (66.7\%) for PCTac RGB, 57 (63.3\%) for Wedge RGB, and 29 (32.2\%) for vision-only. PCTac Hue also achieves the highest observed success rate on each evaluated task, including Perturbed Test-Tube Insertion, where it achieves 16/30 successes versus 13/30 for tactile RGB baselines and 1/30 for vision-only. These results demonstrate the potential of mechanochromic structural color as a compact, load-sensitive tactile representation for robot learning and closed-loop manipulation. Project page: https://bey0ndt1me.github.io/PCTac-page/.
summary_zh: 现代视触觉传感器主要通过成像软性界面的形变来感知接触。借助光度立体视觉等技术，它们能够恢复详细的接触几何信息，通常以表面法线或深度表示。然而，与力相关的信息通常仍需通过标定、几何重建或学习映射来间接推断。机械变色光子晶体材料提供了一种替代性的物理编码机制：接触载荷改变其周期性微结构和光谱响应，直接将局部应力转化为空间分辨的结构色场。尽管具有这一潜力，光子晶体材料在闭环机器人学习中的应用却鲜有探索。我们提出PCTac，一种开源的机械变色光子晶体指尖传感器，使用密集色调场作为其触觉观测。载荷特性测试表明，施加的法向载荷与观测到的色调响应之间存在可重复的关系。我们进一步将该表示直接集成到扩散策略中，并在三项真实机器人操作任务上进行了评估。在90次实际 rollout 中，PCTac Hue 取得了68次成功（75.6%），而 PCTac RGB 为60次（66.7%），Wedge RGB 为57次（63.3%），纯视觉为29次（32.2%）。PCTac Hue 还在每项评估任务上取得了最高成功率，包括扰动试管插入任务，其中取得16/30次成功，而触觉RGB基线为13/30次，纯视觉仅为1/30次。这些结果表明，机械变色结构色作为一种紧凑、对载荷敏感的触觉表示，在机器人学习和闭环操作中具有巨大潜力。项目页面：https://bey0ndt1me.github.io/PCTac-page/。
tldr: PCTac introduces a mechanochromic photonic-crystal tactile sensor that encodes normal load as a hue field and integrates the representation into a Diffusion Policy for closed-loop dexterous manipulation, outperforming RGB and vision-only baselines on real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: PCTac 提出了一种基于力致变色光子晶体的触觉传感器，将法向载荷编码为色调场，并直接集成到扩散策略中用于真实机器人灵巧操作，优于 RGB 和纯视觉基线。

title: AutoVLA-D: Learn a Trajectory-Geometric Condition from Reasoning for Autonomous Driving VLA
summary: Autoregressive VLA planning usually predicts continuous trajectories as the final output, but driving instructions often describe actions rather than ego states, which weakens direct conditioning on the final continuous trajectory. We address this gap with TrajCond, which introduces a discrete trajectory-geometric condition for VLA planning. Specifically, we represent TrajCond as a 1D-Brohan differential action trajectory and learn it with a two-stage training framework before final continuous trajectory prediction. With the simultaneous autoregressive generation of discrete and numeric trajectories, we name our method AutoVLA-D (Double). Experiments on NAVSIM navtest, nuScenes, and NeuroNCAP show that discrete trajectories are weaker as direct outputs but more effective as TrajCond, consistently improving final continuous trajectory prediction across closed-loop and open-loop driving benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/ShivaTeam/AutoVLA-D.
summary_zh: 自回归视觉语言模型（VLA）规划通常将连续轨迹预测作为最终输出，但驾驶指令往往描述的是行为而非自车状态，这削弱了对最终连续轨迹的直接条件约束。针对这一问题，我们提出了TrajCond方法，在VLA规划中引入离散轨迹几何条件。具体而言，我们将TrajCond表示为1D-Brohan微分作用轨迹，并采用两阶段训练框架进行学习，随后再进行最终连续轨迹预测。通过离散与数值轨迹的同步自回归生成，我们将该方法命名为AutoVLA-D（双重）。在NAVSIM navtest、nuScenes和NeuroNCAP上的实验表明，离散轨迹作为直接输出时性能较弱，但作为TrajCond条件时更为有效，能够在闭环与开环驾驶基准上持续提升最终连续轨迹预测的精度。代码已公开于https://github.com/ShivaTeam/AutoVLA-D。
tldr: AutoVLA-D introduces TrajCond, a discrete trajectory-geometric condition, to improve autoregressive VLA planning for autonomous driving by learning a two-stage trajectory-conditioned generation before continuous trajectory prediction, demonstrating consistent improvements across driving benchmarks.
tldr_zh: AutoVLA-D 提出了 TrajCond，一种离散轨迹几何条件，通过两阶段轨迹条件生成来改进自动驾驶中的自回归 VLA 规划，在多个驾驶基准上持续提升连续轨迹预测性能。

title: Be My Eye: Learning to See Beyond a Robot's Own Perspective
summary: Robots operating in the real world are inherently subject to partial observability, particularly in multi-robot collaboration, where individual observations may be insufficient for effective task execution. A key challenge is leveraging complementary observations from partner robots to support collaborative decision-making. We argue that information sharing should go beyond passively transmitting raw observations or generic visual features. Instead, robots should selectively encode task-relevant information according to task objectives and execution progress. To this end, we propose a task-oriented active context sharing framework that transforms robot observations into compact representations, preserving critical information under constrained communication budgets. The framework adopts a two-stage training paradigm. In the first stage, onboard observations and task instructions are jointly encoded into compact context representations. Task-oriented future prediction and soft task-progress correspondence learning guide this collaboration-agnostic compression, preserving information about task objectives and execution progress. In the second stage, the learned representations are integrated into a pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy, enabling bidirectional context exchange. Each robot combines complementary partner information with local observations to guide action generation. Action supervision jointly refines the context representations and policy, aligning information sharing with collaborative decision-making. Controlled experiments demonstrate substantial performance gains under constrained communication budgets, while three real-world experiments validate the framework in complex dual-robot tasks. These results highlight a shift from passive visual transmission toward active, task-oriented context sharing that directly supports collaborative decision-making.
summary_zh: 在真实世界中运行的机器人本质上受到部分可观测性的限制，尤其是在多机器人协作场景下，单一个体的观测信息往往不足以支撑高效的任务执行。一个关键挑战在于如何利用伙伴机器人的互补观测信息来支持协作决策。我们认为，信息共享不应仅限于被动传输原始观测数据或通用视觉特征，而应依据任务目标与执行进度，有选择性地编码与任务相关的信息。为此，我们提出了一种面向任务驱动的主动上下文共享框架，该框架将机器人观测信息转化为紧凑表示，在有限通信带宽约束下保留关键信息。该框架采用两阶段训练范式：第一阶段，将机载观测与任务指令联合编码为紧凑的上下文表示，通过面向任务的未来预测与软任务进度对应学习，引导这种与协作无关的压缩过程，从而保留关于任务目标与执行进度的关键信息；第二阶段，将学习到的表示集成到预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中，实现双向上下文交互。每个机器人将伙伴提供的互补信息与自身局部观测相结合，以指导动作生成。动作监督信号联合优化上下文表示与策略，使信息共享与协作决策紧密对齐。受控实验表明，在有限通信带宽条件下，该方法取得了显著的性能提升；同时，三项真实世界实验在复杂双机器人任务中验证了该框架的有效性。上述结果凸显了从被动的视觉传输向主动、面向任务的上下文共享转变，从而直接支撑协作决策的研究方向。
tldr: This paper proposes a task-oriented active context sharing framework that compresses robot observations for multi-robot collaboration and integrates them into a pretrained VLA policy, demonstrating performance gains in simulated and real dual-robot tasks under constrained communication budgets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种面向任务的多机器人主动上下文共享框架，将观测压缩为紧凑表征并集成到预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中，在受限通信预算下通过仿真和真实双机器人实验验证了性能提升。

title: Robo-MLT: Dual-System Robotic Manipulation for Long-Horizon Medical Laboratory Tasks
summary: Reliable medical laboratory automation requires robots to complete entire workflows in protocol order while handling changes during execution. A robot may execute each motion correctly yet fail the workflow by confusing visually similar stages or stalling after human intervention. We present Robo-MLT, a dual-system framework that couples explicit workflow monitoring with learned action generation. A vision--language planner composes an ordered atomic-skill sequence from the protocol and the initial workspace observation. A multiframe execution monitor detects when the active skill has completed or become infeasible, then advances the workflow or triggers replanning. A skill-conditioned vision--language--action policy generates the manipulation trajectories, and an asynchronous runtime coordinates it with the monitor. We evaluate Robo-MLT against four policy baselines and a VLM-based monitor baseline on blood gas analysis and blood sample tube sorting, with 50 nominal configurations per method and 20 sample-removal configurations. Robo-MLT achieves task success rates of 82\% and 70\%, exceeding $π_{0.5}$ by 30 and 22 percentage points, respectively. After an operator removes the sample being handled, the system revises the remaining plan and continues processing the other samples. These results indicate that, under the evaluated conditions, explicit workflow monitoring makes long-horizon laboratory manipulation more reliable and recoverable.
summary_zh: 可靠的医学实验室自动化要求机器人在按协议顺序完成整个工作流程的同时，处理执行过程中出现的变化。机器人可能正确执行每一个动作，却因混淆视觉上相似的阶段或在人工干预后停滞而导致整个流程失败。我们提出了Robo-MLT，一种将显式工作流监控与学习型动作生成相结合的双系统框架。视觉-语言规划器根据协议和初始工作区观测结果编排有序的原子技能序列。多帧执行监控器检测当前技能是否已完成或变得不可行，然后推进工作流或触发重新规划。技能条件下的视觉-语言-动作策略生成操作轨迹，异步运行时负责协调其与监控器之间的配合。我们在血气分析和血液样本试管分拣任务上，将Robo-MLT与四种策略基线及一种基于VLM的监控基线进行了评估，每种方法包含50个标称配置和20个样本移除配置。Robo-MLT的任务成功率分别达到82%和70%，较π₀.₅高出30和22个百分点。当操作员移除正在处理的样本后，系统会修正剩余计划并继续处理其他样本。这些结果表明，在评估条件下，显式工作流监控使长时程实验室操作更加可靠且更易恢复。
tldr: Robo-MLT is a dual-system framework for long-horizon medical laboratory manipulation tasks that couples explicit vision-language workflow monitoring with skill-conditioned vision-language-action policy generation, achieving higher success and recovery rates on blood gas analysis and tube sorting tasks.
tldr_zh: Robo-MLT 是一个用于长期医疗实验室操作任务的双系统框架，它将显式的视觉语言工作流监控与技能条件下的视觉语言动作策略生成相结合，在血气分析和试管分类任务中实现了更高的成功率和恢复能力。

title: RoboACE: Adversarial Co-Evolution for Robot Self-Improvement
summary: Robot agents can improve reusable skills, planning procedures, and recovery strategies from execution feedback, yet a fixed practice source leaves the search for new weaknesses unchanged. Useful practice depends on the agent's current capabilities, so the procedure that chooses practice must also be revisable. We present RoboACE (Robot Adversarial Co-Evolution), a framework that jointly evolves curriculum and execution harnesses around frozen foundation models. The curriculum harness uses accumulated capability evidence to propose informative challenges, while the execution harness responds with reusable revisions that expand execution capabilities. Alternating updates hold one side fixed as the other changes, and admitted challenges form fixed snapshots for comparing execution revisions. Starting from a compact set of LIBERO practice conditions, the resulting frozen deployment outperforms the evaluated controllers and agent systems across four LIBERO-family panels. On LIBERO-PRO, it reaches 74.0% success, exceeding the initial deployment by 15.0 percentage points and direct execution by its VLA controller by 13.5 points. Case studies document changes to evidence-guided practice selection, drawer-skill grounding, and controller intervention.
summary_zh: 机器人智能体能够从执行反馈中改进可复用技能、规划流程与恢复策略，但固定的练习来源使得对新弱点的搜索保持不变。有效的练习取决于智能体当前的能力，因此选择练习的程序也必须是可修订的。我们提出RoboACE（机器人对抗性协同演化）框架，该框架围绕冻结的基础模型联合演化课程与执行框架。课程框架利用累积的能力证据提出具有信息量的挑战，而执行框架则以可复用的修订进行回应，从而扩展执行能力。交替更新使一方固定而另一方变化，已通过的挑战形成固定快照，用于比较执行修订的效果。从一组精简的LIBERO练习条件出发，所得到的冻结部署在四个LIBERO系列测试面板上均优于所评估的控制器和智能体系统。在LIBERO-PRO上，其成功率达到了74.0%，比初始部署高出15.0个百分点，比其VLA控制器的直接执行高出13.5个百分点。案例研究记录了证据引导的练习选择、抽屉技能基础化以及控制器干预方面的变化。
tldr: RoboACE introduces a framework that jointly evolves a curriculum and execution harness around frozen foundation models, using adversarial co-evolution to improve robot self-improvement and performance on LIBERO benchmarks.
tldr_zh: RoboACE 提出了一种框架，通过对抗性协同进化，在冻结基础模型周围共同演化课程和执行工具，以提升机器人自我改进能力和 LIBERO 基准性能。

title: Embodied First Exam
summary: Early successes on agentic robotics point to a potential paradigm shift toward using coding agents to control robots. Existing robotics benchmarks are built around visuomotor policy learning, leaving it open whether coding agents can reliably control diverse robots under physical-world constraints. We therefore introduce the Embodied First Exam, a unified, comprehensive, and agent-native evaluation framework where coding agents can choose their own control approach: direct control, code to control, or train a policy to control. We hope it serves as a first exam for coding agents before they enter the physical world, with 1,156 tasks in 35 suites on 47 robots, including 9 new suites that go beyond pick-and-place to spatial puzzles, dexterous manipulation, multi-robot interaction, dynamic whole-body control, and sim-to-sim engineering. Each task can be run in up to three evaluation settings. The Standard Setting mimics the real world: the agent receives only sensor observations and, by default, cannot reset the environment. Its Realtime variant keeps the environment running while the agent reasons. The Privileged Setting gives the agent access to the full simulator state and unlimited resets, allowing it to search for an oracle solution for training purposes. Success rates in this setting serve as an approximate upper bound. On the 456 core tasks, the strongest of eight agents, GPT-6 Astra in Codex, achieves a success rate of 34% in the Standard Setting, leaving much room for improvement. To see where agents fail, we label the stage at which failed attempts go wrong and compare failures across agents, settings, and stage categories.
summary_zh: 早期在智能体机器人领域的成功进展，预示着一种潜在的范式转变——即利用编程智能体来控制机器人。现有的机器人基准测试主要围绕视觉运动策略学习构建，对于编程智能体能否在物理世界约束下可靠地控制多种机器人，这一问题仍悬而未决。为此，我们提出了“具身第一考”，一个统一、全面且面向智能体原生的评估框架，允许编程智能体自行选择控制方式：直接控制、代码控制或训练策略进行控制。我们希望这能成为编程智能体进入物理世界前的首次考核，涵盖47种机器人上的35个任务套件、共1156项任务，其中包括9个超越抓取放置任务的新套件，涉及空间拼图、灵巧操作、多机器人交互、动态全身控制以及仿真到仿真工程。每项任务最多可在三种评估设置下运行。标准设置模拟真实世界：智能体仅接收传感器观测，且默认无法重置环境。其实时变体在智能体推理期间保持环境持续运行。特权设置则允许智能体访问完整的模拟器状态并无限制重置，使其能够搜索用于训练的神谕式解决方案，该设置下的成功率可视为近似上限。在456项核心任务中，八种智能体中表现最强的Codex环境中的GPT-6 Astra在标准设置下仅达到34%的成功率，仍有很大提升空间。为探究智能体的失败原因，我们标记了失败尝试出错的阶段，并跨智能体、设置和阶段类别对失败情况进行比较。
tldr: The paper introduces the Embodied First Exam, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating coding agents on diverse robot control tasks, finding that even the strongest agent achieves only 34% success, highlighting significant room for improvement.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了“具身首次考试”，一个全面的基准，用于评估编码代理在多种机器人控制任务上的表现，发现最强代理的成功率仅为34%，表明仍有很大的改进空间。

title: GeoMind: A Benchmark for Spatial Understanding in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation has advanced rapidly in mapping visual observations and language instructions to actions. However, reliable manipulation in open-world environments requires robust spatial understanding: the ability to identify targets in complex layouts (spatial reasoning) and adapt to scenes that continuously evolve through interaction (spatial memory). Yet existing embodied benchmarks fall short in evaluating spatial understanding: they often introduce strong visual cues that bypass spatial reasoning, and focus on static scenes that offer little insight into an agent's capacity for spatial memory. To address this gap, we introduce GeoMind, a systematic benchmark for structured spatial understanding through tabletop manipulation. GeoMind comprises 54 evaluated task variants organized around spatial reasoning and spatial memory. It also incorporates a scalable pipeline that automates the generation and annotation of task instances with verified targets and executable interactions. Extensive evaluations across diverse embodied agents reveal their consistent weaknesses in spatial understanding. Our findings highlight that these agents struggle to track identities after spatial changes and convert relational or geometric constraints into executable actions. We release the GeoMind benchmark at https://github.com/Notfound-JH/GEOMIND-benchmark.git.
summary_zh: 机器人操作技术在将视觉观察和语言指令映射到行动方面取得了快速进展。然而，在开放世界环境中实现可靠操作需要强大的空间理解能力：即在复杂布局中识别目标的能力（空间推理），以及适应通过交互持续演变场景的能力（空间记忆）。然而，现有的具身基准在评估空间理解方面存在不足：它们往往引入强视觉线索以绕过空间推理，并且侧重于静态场景，无法深入洞察智能体的空间记忆能力。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了GeoMind，一个通过桌面操作进行结构化空间理解的系统性基准。GeoMind包含54个评估任务变体，围绕空间推理和空间记忆组织，并引入了一个可扩展的流水线，能够自动生成和标注具有验证目标及可执行交互的任务实例。对多种具身智能体的大规模评估揭示了它们在空间理解方面的一致弱点。研究结果表明，这些智能体在空间变化后追踪物体身份、以及将关系性或几何约束转化为可执行动作方面存在困难。我们在https://github.com/Notfound-JH/GEOMIND-benchmark.git发布了GeoMind基准。
tldr: GeoMind is a benchmark for evaluating spatial understanding in robotic manipulation, comprising 54 task variants that test spatial reasoning and memory, with a scalable pipeline for generating annotated task instances. Evaluations show that current embodied agents struggle with spatial tracking and converting geometric constraints to actions.
tldr_zh: GeoMind 是一个用于评估机器人操作中空间理解的基准，包含54个任务变体，测试空间推理和空间记忆，并提供自动生成和标注任务实例的流程。评估显示现有具身代理在空间跟踪和将几何约束转化为动作方面存在不足。

title: GAP: Generalized Adaptation Prior for Dexterous Piano Playing
summary: Dexterous hands enable versatile manipulation, but policies trained in simulation often degrade on hardware owing to non-idealities, and the high-dimensional action space makes real-world adaptation costly. Piano playing, which requires precise and coordinated multifinger motion, offers a representative testbed. We propose GAP (Generalized Adaptation Prior for Dexterous Piano Playing), a sample-efficient adaptation framework that learns how to adapt, rather than how to act, during simulation pretraining and transfers this adaptation prior to hardware. Between repeated executions, GAP uses feedback to adjust the actions of the next one: a gradient guidance network learns from paired executions how adjusting actions affects playing performance, and its gradients guide these adjustments. In simulation, GAP yields approximately 2.4 times the F1 scores improvement of the existing fast-adaptation baseline for dexterous piano playing under the same interaction budget. The learned prior also generalizes to musical pieces held out from pretraining. On a physical dexterous hand, the same simulation-pretrained prior improves F1 scores by 3.6%-23% across three pieces of varying difficulty after approximately 7 min of adaptation each. These results suggest a practical route to reduce the real-world interaction needed to deploy dexterous hands.
summary_zh: 灵巧手能够实现多种操作任务，但在仿真中训练的策略因非理想因素往往在硬件上表现下降，且高维动作空间使得真实世界中的适应成本高昂。钢琴演奏需要精确且协调的多指运动，为此提供了一个代表性测试平台。我们提出了GAP（面向灵巧钢琴演奏的泛化适应先验），一种样本高效的适应框架，在仿真预训练阶段学习“如何适应”而非“如何行动”，并将这一适应先验迁移至硬件。在重复执行之间，GAP利用反馈调整下一次执行的动作：梯度引导网络从成对执行中学习动作调整对演奏表现的影响，并以其梯度指导这些调整。在仿真中，GAP在相同交互预算下，灵巧钢琴演奏的F1分数提升约为现有快速适应基线的2.4倍。所学先验还能泛化至预训练中未涉及的乐曲。在物理灵巧手上，同一仿真预训练先验在三首难度不同的曲目上，经过每次约7分钟的适应，F1分数提升了3.6%至23%。这些结果表明，一种减少灵巧手部署所需真实世界交互的实用路径是可行的。
tldr: GAP proposes a simulation-pretrained adaptation prior that learns to adjust piano-playing actions from feedback, enabling sample-efficient transfer to a real dexterous hand and improving F1 scores with only ~7 minutes of hardware adaptation per piece.
tldr_zh: GAP提出了一种在仿真中预训练的适应先验，通过反馈调整弹奏动作，以样本高效的方式迁移到真实灵巧手，每首曲目仅需约7分钟硬件适应即可提升F1分数。

title: SPARK: Simple Post-training for Adapting pRetrained Knowledge to Robot Control
summary: Large-scale representation learning has produced public foundation models that provide strong general-purpose visual features. However, their pretraining objectives are not designed for robot representation learning, so the resulting embeddings tend to emphasize global semantics rather than the temporally sensitive representations required for robot control. Training robot models from scratch is also undesirable due to the limited scale and high collection cost of robotics data, as well as the substantial computational burden of pre-training. In this paper, we propose SPARK (Simple Post-training for Adapting pRetrained Knowledge), a post-training method that adapts foundation models to robot control. SPARK is built on two principles: temporal abstraction, which encourages the encoder to derive compact features that preserve information essential for understanding temporal changes and action-relevant scene structure, and knowledge preservation, which aligns patch-level representations with those of the original foundation model to retain useful pretrained semantics. These objectives yield compact visual state representations that remain semantically meaningful while preserving useful prior knowledge. Experiments across multiple robotics benchmarks show that SPARK consistently improves success rates and generalization over vanilla foundation models, and further demonstrate that these gains transfer to real-world robot manipulation.
summary_zh: 大规模表征学习已催生出诸多公共基础模型，这些模型能够提供强大的通用视觉特征。然而，其预训练目标并非专为机器人表征学习而设计，因此所生成的嵌入往往侧重于全局语义，而非机器人控制所需的时间敏感表征。由于机器人数据规模有限、采集成本高昂，加之预训练计算负担沉重，从头训练机器人模型同样不可取。本文提出SPARK（面向预训练知识适配的简单后训练方法），一种将基础模型适配至机器人控制的后训练方法。SPARK基于两大原则构建：时间抽象，鼓励编码器提取紧凑特征，保留对理解时间变化及动作相关场景结构至关重要的信息；以及知识保持，将块级表征与原始基础模型中的对应表征对齐，以保留有用的预训练语义。上述目标使得最终得到的紧凑视觉状态表征既保持语义意义，又保留有价值的先验知识。在多个机器人基准上的实验表明，SPARK相较于原始基础模型持续提升了成功率与泛化能力，并进一步证明这些改进可迁移至真实世界的机器人操作任务。
tldr: SPARK is a post-training method that adapts pretrained visual foundation models for robot control by combining temporal abstraction with knowledge preservation, improving success rates and generalization across multiple robot manipulation benchmarks and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: SPARK 是一种后训练方法，通过时间抽象与知识保持相结合，将预训练的视觉基础模型适配到机器人控制，在多个机器人操作基准和真实世界任务中提高了成功率和泛化能力。

title: Grasp-Taxonomy Conditioning as a Mode Switch for Dexterous Grasping of Climbing Holds
summary: Dexterous grasping in robotics relies on distinct hand configurations depending on object geometry. We introduce BetaGrasp, a 3D diffusion policy that conditions a DP3-style point-cloud policy on a four-class grasp label (crimp, sloper, pinch, and jug), running on a Franka arm with a 16-DoF LEAP hand. We also introduce a climbing-hold benchmark: a spring testbed whose ratchet gives a slip-force reading in newtons. In our analysis the policy's point-cloud encoder did not separate the four holds, so the scan alone gave it little to choose a grasp from. Without the label (a DP3-style baseline), simulated rollouts from the robot's reset pose all end in a jug grasp, whatever the hold (25% correct grasp type, versus 94% for BetaGrasp). The label works as a switch for which grasp the policy performs. On 80 paired hardware trials, BetaGrasp raises average slip force from 9.6 N to 14.3 N, and grasps slipping fully off the hold drop from 44% of trials to 10%.
summary_zh: 灵巧抓取在机器人技术中依赖于根据物体几何形状的不同手部构型。我们提出了BetaGrasp，一种3D扩散策略，该策略将DP3风格的点云策略条件化为四类抓取标签（握捏、斜板、捏取和抛掷），运行在配备16自由度LEAP手的Franka机械臂上。我们还引入了一个攀岩支点基准：一个弹簧测试平台，其棘轮以牛顿为单位提供滑脱力读数。在我们的分析中，该策略的点云编码器未能区分四种支点类型，因此仅凭扫描数据几乎无法为策略提供选择抓取方式的依据。在没有标签的情况下（即DP3风格的基线），从机器人复位姿态出发的模拟展开无论面对何种支点都以抛掷抓取告终（正确抓取类型仅为25%，而BetaGrasp达到94%）。标签起到了切换策略所执行抓取方式的作用。在80次配对硬件试验中，BetaGrasp将平均滑脱力从9.6牛顿提升至14.3牛顿，且完全从支点上滑脱的抓取比例从试验次数的44%降至10%。
tldr: BetaGrasp is a 3D diffusion policy conditioned on grasp-type labels for dexterous grasping of climbing holds, improving slip force and reducing full-grasp failures on a real Franka/LEAP hand system by acting as a mode switch when point-cloud alone is ambiguous.
tldr_zh: BetaGrasp是一种以抓握类型标签为条件的3D扩散策略，用于攀岩支点的灵巧抓取，通过模式切换在点云歧义时提升滑脱力并减少脱手失败。

title: OASIS: Optimization-Aware Subgoal Inference with Safety Constraints for Autonomous Mobile Robot Navigation
summary: Navigation in dynamic environments requires mobile robots to make progress toward their goals while respecting motion limits and avoiding surrounding obstacles. Learned subgoal policies can guide model predictive control beyond its local prediction horizon, but a geometrically suitable subgoal does not necessarily lead to a successfully solved control problem. This paper proposes OASIS, a hierarchical navigation framework that incorporates recent optimization outcomes into reinforcement learning-based subgoal generation. A high-level policy trained using Soft Actor--Critic generates local subgoals, while a nonlinear model predictive controller tracks them subject to motion limits, geometric collision-avoidance constraints, and embedded high-order control barrier function constraints. The outcomes of controller optimizations over each subgoal interval are summarized and provided to the policy at its next decision, without requiring additional optimization calls. The framework is evaluated in five navigation scenarios with static and moving obstacles, including dense interactions and sensing uncertainty. Comparisons with hierarchical and direct-goal control variants show that OASIS achieves the highest aggregate navigation success. Matched comparisons across three training seeds further show a consistent success advantage over the otherwise identical hierarchy without optimization-status input. The selected-policy comparison also shows fewer primary optimization failures with similar mean controller time.
summary_zh: 在动态环境中导航要求移动机器人在朝目标前进的同时，遵守运动限制并避开周围障碍物。学习到的子目标策略可以引导模型预测控制超越其局部预测视界，但一个几何上合适的子目标并不一定能导致控制问题被成功求解。本文提出OASIS，一种分层导航框架，将最近的优化结果纳入基于强化学习的子目标生成中。使用软演员-评论家算法训练的高层策略生成局部子目标，而非线性模型预测控制器在运动限制、几何避碰约束以及内嵌高阶控制障碍函数约束下跟踪这些子目标。控制器在每个子目标区间内的优化结果被汇总并在下一次决策时提供给策略，无需额外调用优化。该框架在五个包含静态和移动障碍物的导航场景中进行了评估，包括密集交互和传感不确定性。与分层和直接目标控制变体的比较表明，OASIS在总体导航成功率上达到最高。跨三个训练种子的匹配比较进一步显示，相较于不具备优化状态输入的相同分层结构，OASIS在成功率上具有一致的优势。选定策略的比较还显示，在相似的平均控制器耗时下，主要优化失败次数更少。
tldr: OASIS is a hierarchical navigation framework that feeds optimization outcomes from a nonlinear MPC controller back into a reinforcement learning-based subgoal policy, improving autonomous mobile robot navigation success in dynamic environments.
tldr_zh: OASIS 是一个分层导航框架，它将非线性 MPC 控制器的优化结果反馈给基于强化学习的子目标策略，从而提升自主移动机器人在动态环境中的导航成功率。

title: Thermo-VLA: A Thermal-Aware Vision-Language-Action Model with Gated Residual Modulation for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have begun incorporating thermal sensing, but existing approaches typically treat thermal images as ordinary visual inputs, providing limited support for temperature-aware relational reasoning in manipulation. To address this limitation, we propose Thermo-VLA with a ThermoRes Encoder, which decomposes thermal images into cold and hot attribute representations and injects them into the RGB token through language-conditioned residual modulation, enabling temperature-driven target selection and continuous manipulation. We further construct six real-world robotic tasks on a dual-arm Unitree G1 platform, spanning basic grounding to relational reasoning. Experiments show that Thermo-VLA achieves an average success rate of 0.86 across four thermal-dependent tasks, outperforming a pi_0.5 baseline that directly incorporates RGB-thermal observations by 18 percentage points. Under unseen-object and scene variations, Thermo-VLA maintains an average success rate of 0.78, achieving the best generalisation performance among the compared methods. Beyond thermal sensing, we transfer the same residual modulation mechanism to colour attributes and observe consistent improvements in both simulation and real-robot experiments, indicating its potential to generalise beyond thermal attributes. Project website: https://j-x-chen.github.io/Thermo-VLA-web/
summary_zh: 近期，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已开始融入热成像感知能力，但现有方法通常将热图像视为普通视觉输入，在操作任务中对温度感知的关系推理支持有限。为解决这一局限，我们提出Thermo-VLA，并配备ThermoRes编码器，该编码器将热图像分解为冷、热两个属性表征，并通过语言条件残差调制将其注入RGB令牌中，从而实现温度驱动的目标选择与连续操作。我们进一步在双臂Unitree G1平台上构建了六项真实机器人任务，涵盖从基础定位到关系推理的多个层次。实验表明，Thermo-VLA在四项温度依赖任务上的平均成功率达0.86，比直接融合RGB-热观测的pi_0.5基线高出18个百分点。在未见物体与场景变化条件下，Thermo-VLA仍保持0.78的平均成功率，在对比方法中取得了最优泛化性能。除热感知外，我们将相同的残差调制机制迁移至颜色属性，并在仿真与真机实验中均观察到一致的性能提升，表明该方法具备超越温度属性进行推广的潜力。项目网站：https://j-x-chen.github.io/Thermo-VLA-web/
tldr: Thermo-VLA introduces a thermal-aware VLA model with a ThermoRes Encoder that decomposes thermal images into cold/hot attributes and injects them into RGB tokens via language-conditioned residual modulation, improving temperature-driven manipulation on a dual-arm G1 robot.
tldr_zh: Thermo-VLA 提出了一种热感知 VLA 模型，通过 ThermoRes 编码器将热图像分解为冷/热属性，并利用语言条件残差调制将其注入 RGB 标记，从而提升双机械臂 G1 机器人的温度驱动操作能力。

title: Flip Anything with Agentic Robotics Self-Learning
summary: Flipping is a fundamental robotic manipulation skill that requires reorienting a target object in a stable pose on a planar support surface by rotating it 180$^\circ$ about an axis parallel to the support surface -- think of flipping a coin from heads to tails. Although flipping is a common objective in industrial tasks such as parts inspection, mechanical assembly, and tool use, coding a bimanual robot with grippers to flip diverse objects is a significant challenge. In this paper, we show that a coding agent can autonomously develop and refine object-flipping strategies through iterative learning in physics simulations across diverse object geometries. Progressive skill acquisition, from basic handover to toppling and pushing, robust grasping and sensing, and thin-object manipulation with recovery, improves task success from 24.7% to 95.0%. The resulting graph-based code integrates high-level strategy selection with reactive control, enabling multi-stage flipping on physical robots.
summary_zh: 翻转是一种基础性的机器人操作技能，要求将目标物体在与支撑面平行的轴上旋转180°（可类比于将硬币从正面翻到反面），从而使其在平面上稳定地重新定向。尽管翻转在零件检测、机械装配和工具使用等工业任务中是一个常见目标，但为配备夹爪的双臂机器人编程以翻转多种物体仍是一项重大挑战。在本文中，我们展示了一个编程智能体能够通过在不同物体几何形状的物理仿真中迭代学习，自主开发并优化物体翻转策略。从基本的交接逐渐扩展到倾倒与推动、稳健的抓取与感知，以及带恢复机制的薄物体操作，一系列渐进的技能习得将任务成功率从24.7%提升至95.0%。最终生成的基于图的代码将高层策略选择与反应式控制相结合，使得多阶段翻转能够在实体机器人上实现。
tldr: This paper presents an agentic robotics self-learning approach where a coding agent autonomously develops and refines object-flipping strategies in simulation, progressively acquiring skills to achieve high success on diverse objects and transferring to physical robots.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种代理式机器人自学习方法，通过编码代理在仿真中自主开发和改进物体翻转策略，逐步获得技能，在多样化物体上实现高成功率，并迁移到物理机器人上。

title: Distilling Instructions into Weights: Closed-Form Edits Fix a Robot Policy's Misreading
summary: Generalist robot policies often fail at one step of a task they can otherwise perform. We ask whether such a failure can be repaired by editing the policy's weights directly, without gradients, training data, or a change to the instruction. Told to put the cube then the banana in the bowl, a zero-shot $π_{0.5}$ vision-language-action policy in RoboLab releases the cube before it reaches the bowl. Replaying 21 of these decisions under rewordings shows that it binds "in the bowl" to the wrong object. Closed-form instruction distillation copies the per-layer effect of an explicit rewording into the language model's MLP weights. On 128 held-out seeds, success rises from 27 to 106 episodes, with 81 fixed and 2 broken ($p=7\times10^{-22}$), while an update of the same size in random directions leaves success unchanged. The edit also lifts two other tasks without detectable harm on the remaining 13, and a variant that stores 0.16% of the parameter count keeps most of its effect. Placed in the action expert or action head instead, the same distillation helps less or not at all. Our released tool reproduced the fix end to end on new held-out seeds, from 8/64 to 36/64. Edits aimed at perception, a missing grasp, contact physics, or the gripper threshold did not help, and of seven blind Claude Opus editors, only the one given the misread instruction produced an edit that passed held-out scoring. These results suggest that weight edits work best when a known-good input already exists to distil.
